name: Acheron Soul Cleaver
description: Slaine is considered the best of the Legion's Soul Cleavers, and others would be able to rise to his level if he could just stop biting them. His Lord armed him with this blade, and advised apprentices to learn by watching him.

name: Adorable Pink Blade of Cuteness
description: Yeah that's a lot of words, but this sword once belonged to the most ruthless of the underworld generals… turned cute by Beleen! Be wary of its pink power!

name: Advent Darkness Blade
description: This sword was a gift to a worthy hero who promised to rid the Northlands of SHadow. They succeeded, but all that remains of their great deeds is a blade stuck in the snow, and scarps of clothing clinging to sharp teeth.

name: AdventureQuest Reign Blade
description: The Reign Plate was crafted by the ancients of Alnaphar in the AdventureQuest timeline. This sword was inspired by that classic artifact.

name: Adventurer's Sword
description: A fine, sturdy sword for the daring and courageous.

name: Adventus Blade
description: Adventus spent a lifetime to achieve his status atop the Legion. This double multi-blade is a testament to his dedication and skill.

name: Aegean Calabaza Blade
description: An eldritch touch awakened a humble pumpkin, and its evolution surged. A snarling jaw, greedy vines, and a temptingly sweet edge - ready to harvest and reap.

name: AeroFrost Katana
description: Gundahar, famed Northlands Hunter and Smith, forged this blade from the frozen breath of a dire beast terrorizing helpless villagers in the Northlands.

name: Aetherial Ark Dagger
description: A heavenly being was struck down, and its golden feathers were forged into royal armaments. As magnificent and powerful as this blade is, it disappears in the shade of the night.

name: AFKalibur
description: A blade that can no-clip you straight into a whole new dimension, perfect to AFK at.

name: Ahoyrion's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Many have heard of the Bermuda Triangle. But on Lore, stare too deeply into the heart of the Runix Cube and you'll be mezmerized, doomed to sail off into the unknown, never to return again.

name: Ahoyrion's Cutlass (AC)
description: Many have heard of the Bermuda Triangle. But on Lore, stare too deeply into the heart of the Runix Cube and you'll be mezmerized, doomed to sail off into the unknown, never to return again.

name: Airship Avenger
description: Slash! Slice! Rip into and through your enemies with this blade that will serve you well as you move up through the ranks of the Skyguard.

name: Akamatsu Katana
description: Red pine is both luxurious and resistant to rot. This katana was made from a sacred tree that reached the end of its natural life in the Yokai Isles' royal gardens.

name: Akiban BladeMaster Katana
description: Akiban BladeMasters can walk even the most dangerous streets without fear. No opponent is too deadly, and no challenge too great.

name: Akiban BladeMaster Reversed Katana
description: Akiban BladeMasters can walk even the most dangerous streets without fear. No opponent is too deadly, and no challenge too great.

name: Akiban Defender's Blade
description: To get this sword you must have the reputation of a true defender of Akiba!

name: Akiban Samurai Katana

name: Akiban Samurai Nodachi (Sword)
description: An upper echelon of the warrior class, the Akiban Samurai defends the Empress and the land from evil. Their warcry is: "For honor, for the Isle, and for the Empress!"

name: Akriloth's Oblivion Blade (AC) (1)

name: Akriloth's Oblivion Blade (AC) (2)
description: A prize from one of the most feared monsters in all of Lore, the mighty fire dragon Akriloth!

name: Akumu Katana
description: Slash through any bad dreams a Baku can't eat away. Item gives 15% more rep and gold when equipped.

name: Alabaster Lily Rapier
description: The rapier strikes, resonating with a cold chime that calms the mind. Vision clearns your consciousness reaches the the heavens and the nether. In no time at all, your opponent splits in two, banished to both peaks.

name: Alchemical Aura Blade
description: A rare blade made up of the purest form of Alchemy.

name: Alchemical Commander's Sword (0 AC)
description: Alchemical Naval Commanders scour the seas in search of new reagents and creatures to use in their mystical, magical workings.

name: Alchemical Commander's Sword (AC)
description: Alchemical Naval Commanders scour the seas in search of new reagents and creatures to use in their mystical, magical workings.

name: Alchemical Onyx Blade
description: A blade crafted by Bido fusing Onyx and Baltic Ambar together using Alchemical Runes.

name: Alchemical Onyx Katana
description: A katana crafted by Bido fusing Onyx and Baltic Ambar together using Alchemical Runes.

name: Alchemist Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Aletsch Glacial Frostblade (0 AC)
description: A shard from the heart of a dead god of the Northlands was forged into a jagged keepsake. Elves who mourned Aletsch's death sought Ouro's power as a way to regain the supremacy they once had.

name: Aletsch Glacial Frostblade (AC)
description: A shard from the heart of a dead god of the Northlands was forged into a jagged keepsake. Elves who mourned Aletsch's death sought Ouro's power as a way to regain the supremacy they once had.

name: Alexiares Key
description: A blade shaped like a key. It can be used for combat, unlock paths in the Underworld, and plunged into the chest of a gatekeeper to turn them into a sentient seal.

name: Alina's 8-Bit Gem Blade
description: The green pixels mean this blade has poison on it. *Poke* *poke* *jab* *die*

name: Alina's Deca Blade
description: This blade by renowned weaponsmith Bido to commemorate Alina's 10 years of battling through Lore. (Has a chance to do the Golden Coin Showers attack animation)

name: All Hallowed Blade
description: A menacing blade forged to frighten Lore's bravest saints and martyrs. Whoever crafted this did a mighty fine job!

name: All-Purpose Treasure Blade
description: An experienced Treasure Hunter can pick a lock with a weathered blade. Some even challenge themselves by going on expeditions armed with this one trusty sword.

name: Alliance Exponent Sabre
description: A razor sharp weapon made from double-tough, enchanted steel from the Alliance Exponents, the chosen warriors of the Alliance.

name: Almost Visible Blade
description: This type of sword is especially difficult to master.

name: Alpha Phantom Karambit
description: Stealth fighters who will stop at nothing whether the enemy be Good, Evil or Chaotic. These phantoms will survive.

name: Alpha Rogue Knife
description: No better outfit to wear while rebelling against the rampant consumerism of the approaching holiday season!

name: Alteon's Dragon Sword
description: The magic sword of Lore's greatest King.

name: Alteon's Polished Dragon Sword
description: The magic sword of Lore's greatest King.

name: Alteon's Pride
description: This gold and alabaster sword is appropriately named for its regal design. Proof of your dedication to Swordhaven and the surrounding areas.

name: Alteon's Star Sword
description: The twelfth Chaos Lord to rise was Alteon. You can feel what is left of his corrupted, once regal, power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Alteon Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQWorld's 12th Upholders on the game's twelfth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Amaranthine Void Blade
description: When this sword was forged with void magic, both ice and darkness became compatible with the other. These elements are unexpected combinations, but the pain they inflict on their targets is eternal.

name: Amber Aura Blade
description: A rare blade made up of the purest form of Baltic Ambar.

name: Amethyst Claymore
description: The intricate craftsmanship that has gone into this large blade hides the engineering behind its awesome power.

name: Amethyst Rune Blade
description: An ancient amethyst blade derived from the fabled planes of the Void. Strange, illegible runes are etched within the surface.

name: Amethyst Toxic Blade
description: Forged from a variety of gemstones, these swords make it easier to defeat you Draconic foes.

name: Amethyst Willowcreek Blade
description: Infused with amethyst this blade is definitely utsukushii.

name: Ameythst Dragon's Laser
description: A chaotic weapon for a disorderly age. The purple beam glows for all that is chaorrupt.

name: Amore Divino
description: A blade forged for Heroes Heart Day masquerades. It's a replica of the original Valentidus, who ascended to Arcadian godhood alongside his beloved Lupercalia.

name: Anagenesis
description: A sword made from your own flesh, mutating, transforming, and growing. Together, you and the Arcana evolve, taking fate into your own hands, and turning it into a divine weapon.

name: Anatomically Alien
description: The skeletal remains of an unfortunate alien now aid you in your many battles to come.

name: Ancestral Dao
description: Golden blades are wielded by the Royal Family’s protectors. During the Lunar New Year, a Jade Descendant blesses them with fortune and protection. A hint of their unique magic manages to slip in, too.

name: Ancient Blade of Victory
description: Time to hack and slash your way through undead, make Artix proud! Released in honor of Artix Entertainment's neew mobile game "Undead Assault"

name: Ancient Bones
description: No, this isn't an undead sword. This… this is true ancient bones. The very supporting feature of our world, the stone used to make this magnificent sword carry within it millions of years of experience in survival and attack. Enjoy the release of all that pent-up rage and force.

name: Ancient Dismal Claymore
description: A claymore from days of yore, it is imbued with a gloomy aura that sparks all around it.

name: Ancient DragonSlayer's Kurutta Katana
description: With a shriek of rage and mourning, the ancient dragon departs, leaving wreckage in its wake. We may never know what was lost… or what has been gained. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Ancient Evil Runeblade
description: You've defeated Blightbringer's Shadow Man and witnessed the beginning of the Undead Legion through the eyes of its first General! Wield these blades well, Warrior!

name: Ancient Greatsword Of Ice
description: Found deep in the icy caverns near Frostvale, this greatsword slices through your enemies like a hot knife through butter!

name: Ancient Grovebreaker Blade
description: Wield this in defense of those who might be giants, those who live in fear, and those who need a Hero, wherever they may be!

name: Ancient Knight's Golden Blade (AC)
description: Long before the Guardian Tower rose in the heart of Battleon, an order of knights roamed the land, dedicated to helping those in need. Now you, too, can fight as they did.

name: Ancient Knight's Golden Blade (Legend)

name: Ancient Monstrous Jawblade
description: Aeons before Drakath, this bestial warrior served the Queen of Monsters with a loyalty that could not be shattered.

name: Ancient PaladinSlayer Claymore (AC)
description: Grim, grimy, and graven… this Undead Paladinslayer is out to slay ALL who have wronged them.

name: Ancient PaladinSlayer Claymore (Legend)
description: Grim, grimy, and graven… this Undead Paladinslayer is out to slay ALL who have wronged them.

name: Ancient Platinum Blade
description: For reason's unknown, this sword was sought by dragons for ages. Now you've found it!

name: Ancient Scimitar (1)
description: This sword is old, but very sturdy. They don't make 'em like this anymore!

name: Ancient Scimitar (2)
description: Once lost after a tomb was raided, this scimitar was found by a famous treasure hunter.

name: Ancient Shogun Katana
description: A samurai should always be prepared for death - whether his own or someone else's. (Item does 50% more damage to human tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Ancient Shogun Sheathed Katana
description: A samurai should always be prepared for death - whether his own or someone else's. (Item does 50% more damage to human tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Ancient Skull Blade
description: The skull of an ancient unknown beast is attached at the hilt, magically attuning itself to its master's Accessory Color. Only the wisest magi of Arcangrove have ever been seen wielding such power.

name: Ancient Skulls and Doom Blade
description: Victory is yours! And so is Groglurk's blade. This sinister blade holds immense dark energy.

name: Ancient Wanderer's Scarab Blade
description: This wanderer has traveled far from his home port in the Sandsea. How he ended up here, we may never know.

name: Ancient Wanderer's Scimitar

name: Ancient Wanderer's Spine Blade
description: This wanderer has traveled far from his home port in the Sandsea. How he ended up here, we may never know.

name: Androktasia (0 AC)

name: Androktasia (AC)
description: A blade carried by the Willbreakers of the Underworld's Phlegethon. It contains a portion of their soul to ensure a 'deeper experience.' They can feel the sensation of cutting into bone and flesh more intimately.

description: A ray of sunshine caught by the Archangel and given to one of his most capable attendants. It falls from the skies, striking down evil to protect the innocent.

name: Ankh Athame
description: Fun sized version! Perfect for scraping dragon scales and shreds of lavazard skin off your face.

name: Annihilator Of Order Blade
description: Take up your sword and bring down those who wish to preserve Order!

name: Anti-Energy Blade
description: If you can see the ninja's blade, you're already dead!

name: Anti-Kaiju Knife (AC)
description: You can take down the Kaiju with a thousand cuts, or one well-placed stab. It's a matter of preference.

name: Anti-Kaiju Knife (Non-AC)
description: You can take down the Kaiju with a thousand cuts, or one well-placed stab. It's a matter of preference.

name: Antiquated Shadow Pistolsword

name: Antiquated Shadow Sabre
description: ShadowSlayers have battled the creatures of darkness for as long as we can remember… and always will.

name: Ao Tsuki Kunai
description: No forgemaster is the same, and those who provide to the Ao Tsuki are unwelcome by villages all over Yokai. Their weapons are meant to destroy sacred power, and the yokai who hold that power.

name: Ao Tsuki Wakizashi
description: No forgemaster is the same, and those who provide to the Ao Tsuki are unwelcome by villages all over Yokai. Their weapons are meant to destroy sacred power, and the yokai who hold that power. (Color Customizable to Accessory)

name: Apa's Grace
description: Along with her twin, Eta, Apa has been entrusted by the Crystallis administration to oversee all of the soldiers on the Shinkansen.

name: Apex MindSmasher Blade
description: This sharpened tooth was torn from the maw of a leviathan that fell into the depths. The entity who rules the deep imbued it with a maddening resonance. Every sound it makes shakes the mind with visions writing in the dark. (Does 30% more damage to all monsters)

name: Apocalyptic Darkblood Blade
description: The cruel hook is meant to cause pain, and draw out a long death. It craves the flesh of monstrous kin over the thin blood of mortals.

name: Apocalyptic DeathLord's Blade
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: Apocalyptic Draconian Blade
description: An ancient prophecy fortells: when the dracoliches rise, the end of the world is near… Which side you will battle on when hordes of undead dragons fall upon Lore?

name: Apocalyptic Draconian Sword
description: An ancient prophecy fortells: when the dracoliches rise, the end of the world is near… Which side you will battle on when hordes of undead dragons fall upon Lore?

name: Apocalyptic Dragon's Blade
description: These fierce DragonLord's have survived through the most imminent danger and destruction.

name: Apocalyptic Dragon's Edge
description: These fierce DragonLord's have survived through the most imminent danger and destruction.

name: Apocalyptic Raikiri
description: A decisive blade, unburdened by fear, hope, or will. The katana strikes faster than lightning, stopping hearts long before rivals realize they're dead. It seeks to cut the core of the world next.

name: Apocalyptic Shadow Blade
description: The terrible combination of vampire and werewolf, these loners never truly fit in with either race making them outcasts and dangerous to all creatures of the night.

name: Apocryphal Blade Of The Truth
description: This blade, once holy, is now apocryphal… forbidden. Its light is profane and will turn its owner insane. But that is a small price in exchange for the power and guidance it gives.

name: Apocryphal Destroyer's Mutation
description: Dark forces are hungry to feed on any hero unfortunate to wield this blade. Will you risk great power and great rewards… if the cost is your life itself?!

name: Apocryphal Eons Broadsword
description: From the throat of a Shadowy Beast, this weapon re-emerges. Tainted by the creature it was meant to slay, it finds new purpose in slaughtering the living.

name: Apocryphal Eons Sword
description: The sheathe of this blade was the serpantine throat of the monster that swallowed a hero. From the Shadows, the sword returns to destroy its former master's descendants.

name: Apocryphal Nightmare Hunter Blade
description: Dark forces are hungry to feed on any hero unfortunate to wield this blade. Will you risk great power and great rewards… if the cost is your life itself?!

name: Apocryphal Retribution Blade
description: This blade awakened the moment it was torn from the Shadows. Though dark and mysterious, gripping the blade fills you with grim resolve. Justice will dawn above Darkness and Light.

name: Apostate Alpha
description: A basic Infernal blade, crafted from Exalted Forgemetal. Can be upgraded.

name: Apostate Omega
description: An ornate Infernal blade, upgraded from Apostate Alpha. Can be upgraded.

name: Apostate Ultima
description: An ornate Infernal blade, upgraded from Apostate Omega. Can be upgraded. (Item deals 30% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Apprentice's SpellBlade
description: An elemental sword forged by a learning apprentice.

name: AQ3D Tech Demo Starsword
description: Awarded for outstanding loyalty and participating in the creation of new worlds. Also known as the "TECHnomancer's DEMOlisher Blade"

name: Aqua Core Double Sword
description: No matter how far you are from the sea, you'll hear the lapping of water and soft songs seep into your dreams.

name: Aqua Dreamripper
description: A levaithan's ugly spine was sharpened and polished into a blade to better fit the beauty aesthetics of the depth's favorite prey. Its frightening abilities remain, able to tear the mind's barrier, connecting dreams to the waking world.

name: Aquamer Bloodletter
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Aquamer‘s Cutlass
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Aquamer Sheathed Bloodtaker
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia, there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Aquatic Warrior's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Awash in love and loyalty, Aquatic Warriors have pledged to follow the Avatar of Water until the very seas run dry.

name: Aquatic Warrior's Cutlass (AC)
description: Awash in love and loyalty, Aquatic Warriors have pledged to follow the Avatar of Water until the very seas run dry.

name: Aquitaine
description: The ancestral blade of House Vaughn, said to have been pulled from the heart of a golden buck. Like its master, there's a legend about it. The more paintings, copies, depictions there are of the sword, the sharper it gets.

name: Arachnid Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Don't get yourself caught in this commander's web, it'll be the last thing ye ever do!

name: Arachnid Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: Don't get yourself caught in this commander's web, it'll be the last thing ye ever do!

name: Arachnid Commander's Sword
description: Don't get yourself caught in this commander's web, it'll be the last thing ye ever do!

name: Arachnid Voracity of Nulgath
description: Nulgath presents you a deadly sword, forged from solidified venom entangled with the souls of numerous traitors. A single slash is all it takes for the strongest of enemies to fall at death's door.

name: ArachnoFury Blade
description: Sling around the web fighting villains and staying away from newsmen who demand pictures.

name: Arachnotana
description: The big black spider, made a web on the tree. It was big and round, until you sliced it up with a sword.

name: Arasat's Bane
description: This blade is proof that Arasat has been destroyed.

name: Arbiter's Glory
description: Paladins are known to be good, trustworthy, and fair. The Sanctified Arbiters are an corps of Paladins who travel the land dispensing justice and righting wrongs.

name: Arboreal Seed Spit (AC)
description: Arcangrove contains many dark and deep swamps, perfect for concealing pirate hideaways. That is why YOU are so needed. With a trusty Mudluk to guide you, you've cleaned out hundreds of camps.

name: Arboreal Seed Spit (Legend)
description: Arcangrove contains many dark and deep swamps, perfect for concealing pirate hideaways. That is why YOU are so needed. With a trusty Mudluk to guide you, you've cleaned out hundreds of camps.

name: Arc Of Seraphim
description: This sword can allow one to glide a short distance if swung at the right angle. The direction of that angle depends on which way the mana scarf blows.

name: Arcane Blade of Glory
description: This blade has been gifted to ALL the heroes of Lore for surpassing the AdventureQuest 3D Share Challenge! You have an ultimate blade of Light! This blade gives 20% more XP when equipped.

name: Arcane Evolution Blade
description: A sword crafted by one of the original founding Mages, meant for the hands of a Warrior companion. These days, Mages have a wider array of skills, and can choose to adventure solo.

name: Arcane HoloGram Blade
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Arcane Pirate Cutlass
description: Thought to be a long-lost work of art, this mana-powered blade was found in the ruins of an underwater city. The runes are difficult to make out, but the raw power indicates that the once-great civilization has a deep connection to the mana plane.

name: Arcane Pirate Rapier
description: Don't be fooled by how light it is. A studious mermaid that touched such a sabre grew to be a cunning empress with nearly limitless mana, but in the end, that's what she became and no one touched the sabre since.

name: Arcane Underworld Blade (0 AC)
description: These warriors have truly become one with the Underworld, showing their full allegiance to Dage the Evil.

name: Arcane Underworld Blade (AC)
description: These warriors have truly become one with the Underworld, showing their full allegiance to Dage the Evil.

name: Arcane Void Knight Blade
description: Nulgath kindly makes sure a Void Knight does not go without their blade whether they want it or not. This sword gives 25% more XP and Class Points when equipped.

name: Arch Broodfiend Blade
description: Infect the world with Nulgath's darkness and bring strength and victory to the Nation! (The eyes and trim on this set are color customizable).

name: Arch DoomKnight's Edge
description: The Arch Doomknights were once a duo of corrupt dragonslayers who traded their lives to become death knights in their quest for power and fame.

name: Arch DoomKnight Sword
description: The Arch Doomknights were once a duo of corrupt dragonslayers who traded their lives to become death knights in their quest for power and fame.

name: ArchDoom Fiend Spinal Blade
description: The ArchDoom Fiend mutates into an even greater beast after it emerged from the bloodied arenas of the Nation. New flesh and bone grows. Their old spine is forged into a deadly branched weapon.

name: Archer's Keysword
description: An emperor's sword destined for you.

name: Archfiend Arachnomancer's Claymore
description: Built from the carcasses of arachnids in Tercessuinotlim. Brandish this sword, and become walking-arachnophobia.

description: Seated at the right-hand of Nulgath the ArchFiend, his Overlord oversees the hordes of Nation followers as they race to conquer all the corners of Lores and the Oversoul for their Master.

name: Argent Ace (AC)
description: Silver is an essential tool in a Shadowslayer's arsenal. Iron is turning into a close favorite as the wandering hunters become more aware of the Fae's dark side.

name: Armaghan's Excalibur
description: This is the blade of Armaghan, legendary warrior of Lore. The weapon was handcrafted in his honor by none other than Dage the Evil!

name: Armored Turdraken Sword
description: Roast your opponents then stuff them!

name: Articus
description: A beautiful platinum blade with silver filagree captured from the commadore of a large fleet after losing to his piratical foes.

name: Artifact Hunter Blade (AC)
description: Since Artifact Hunters use both strength and intelligence, you should always have an elegant weapon at your side.

name: Artifact Hunter Blade (Merge)
description: Since Artifact Hunters use both strength and intelligence, you should always have an elegant weapon at your side.

name: Artix's Star Sword of Destiny
description: Crafted in honor of Artix the Paladin, one of your first and best friends on Lore. This blade's power allows it to shift form to resemble a weapon from the DragonFable timeline.

name: Ascended Aurum Wings Blade
description: The sheathe of this blade is your own soul. Formed from the strength within, it cleaves through all obstacles in your way. Its wings carry you towards endless possibilities.

name: Ascended Avatar's Blade
description: A divine gift from the heavens, this blade is gifted to those who are preparing for their journey.

name: Ascended Blade of Awe
description: You turned your Blade of Awe in during the quest for Drakath's armor! To reward you for your willingness to sacrifice your most valuable gear… we're giving it BACK to you! (With a 5% XP bonus!)

name: Ascended Bloodletter of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Your thirst for bloodshed has been increased with the ascension. But there's always room for seconds… and thirds… and more…!

name: Ascended Bloodletter of Nulgath (AC)
description: Your thirst for bloodshed has been increased with the ascension. But there's always room for seconds… and thirds… and more…!

name: Ascended Champion Blade of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath says he forged this sword from the spirit of great heroes. They all wielded this blade at one time, but they have all disappeared. After ascension, this blade is yours.

name: Ascended Champion Blade of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath says he forged this sword from the spirit of great heroes. They all wielded this blade at one time, but they have all disappeared. After ascension, this blade is yours.

description: After ascension, the sword teems with even more powerful energy.

name: Ascended Oblivion Blade of Nulgath (AC)
description: After ascension, the sword teems with even more powerful energy.

name: Ascended Overfiend Blade of Nulgath (Merge)
description: Nulgath's original Overfiend blade has ascended.

name: Ascended Paladin Sword
description: Shining brightly, this righteous sword is only for the pure.

name: Ascended Phoenix Blade of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath twisted the powers within the Phoenix Blade even more after your ascension. It is now under your control.

name: Ascended Phoenix Blade of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath twisted the powers within the Phoenix Blade even more after your ascension. It is now under your control.

name: Ascended Raziel
description: Battling with a transformed Celestial Knight as your weapon may seem a bit strange, but Raziel can bring even the toughest enemies to justice. (Click the center gem to transform)

name: Ascent to Conquer
description: "Bow down before I ascend this blade upon thee."

name: Asgardian Knight Blade (AC)
description: Powerful enough to cut small glaciers in two without a scratch. Bright enough to guarantee a safe viewing of the polar lights. Use this majestic sword wisely.

name: Asgardian Knight Blade (Legend)
description: Powerful enough to cut small glaciers in two without a scratch. Bright enough to guarantee a safe viewing of the polar lights. Use this majestic sword wisely.

name: Ashenfang Reaver

name: Assassin Commander Sword (AC)
description: Curved and slick as solid rock, it can do much more than slice and dice fruit to make smoothies.

name: Assassin Commander Sword (Legend)
description: Curved and slick as solid rock, it can do much more than slice and dice fruit to make smoothies.

name: Assassin of Nulgath Sword
description: According to legend, a sword similar to this one was wielded by a conquer with undying greed. He would not stop until all of his illustrious satisfactions were fulfilled, but alas, he died before they were and his his soul has lingered inside his weapon since. Let's just hope it's a replica

name: Assassin's Blade of Shadows
description: Darkness falls across the land, and the midnight hour is close at hand… Wise heroes avoid you on Friday the 13th, when your power is at its strongest.

name: Assassin's Katana of Shadows
description: Darkness falls across the land, and the midnight hour is close at hand… Wise heroes avoid you on Friday the 13th, when your power is at its strongest.

name: Astor's Blade
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And we aren't talking about Sneevils or Zards here…

name: Astral Alignment Greatsword
description: A blade that attains the power to split planets only when they align with the center of the universe. Who made this astral weapon, and why do they want destruction?

name: Astral Alignment Sword
description: A blade that attains the power to split planets only when they align with the center of the universe. Who made this astral weapon, and why do they want destruction?

name: Astral Shard of Fate

name: Astral Star Blade
description: Bring down the stars with this blade!

name: Astravian Alchemist's Black Sword (AC)
description: The armaments of Astravia, meant to purge vermin outsiders from the lands of Alprecha’s Beloved. When the outsiders were eradicated, what was left for these blades? All that remained was the blood of Astravia’s citizens.

description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

description: These ShadowSlayer's toil in defense of the Crown.  Stationed in Darkovia, they hold the line against the Vampires and Weres.

name: Austere Kriegsmesser
description: A long blade constructed in the fashion of a knife. Capable of weathering the harshest conditions, the simple yet sturdy design is ideal for the needs of a Shadowslayer.

name: AutoEdge
description: The blade of the AutoEdge was forged for one thing and one thing only…AutoKilling!

name: Avatar's Flame Sabre
description: The Elemental Avatars act through their Champions on Lore. The power, passion, and energy they bestow burning with an intensity that would sear a normal mortal's mind and body.

name: Ave Amore
description: A blade forged for Heroes Heart Day masquerades. It's a replica of the original Valentidus, who ascended to Arcadian godhood alongside his beloved Lupercalia.

name: Ave Valentidus
description: A blade forged for Heroes Heart Day masquerades. It's a replica of the original Valentidus, who ascended to Arcadian godhood alongside his beloved Lupercalia.

name: Awakened Carnage Maw Cleaver
description: From the throat of the Metamorphosis Maw comes a cleaver made from its new flesh. It gnashes its teeth, longing to feed on those born in enviable Lore. What was once separated will be one, those lost will join together within this maw.

name: Awakened Chaotic Horizon
description: A glimpse of a new universe born from Chaos. Galaxies and planets, life and their eventual death, surge across void space. Finally, they are free from destiny and doom. But reality will set in, and reveal that this is mere wishful thinking.

name: Awakened Chaotic Rigel Blade
description: A glimpse of a new universe born from Chaos. Galaxies and planets, life and their eventual death, surge across void space. Finally, they are free from destiny and doom. But reality will set in, and reveal that this is mere wishful thinking.

name: Awakened Death's Requiem Blade (0 AC)
description: A rare soulforged weapon that honor the dead. Inhabiting this blade are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Awakened Death's Requiem Blade (AC)
description: A rare soulforged weapon that honor the dead. Inhabiting this blade are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Awakened Fiend's Blade (0 AC)
description: The weapon hisses and snarls, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Fiend's Blade (AC)
description: The weapon hisses and snarls, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Fiendslasher
description: At random intervals, the hilt harms its wielder for daring to believe that they are worthy of the Fiend God's power. The Archfiend respects your tenacity to scoff at its attempts.

name: Awakened Frost Katana
description: The scent of red snow, mud, and battle rouses the blade. Their true potential awakens when one must fight alone.

name: Awakened Primal Katana
description: The scent of red snow, mud, and battle rouses the blade. Their true potential awakens when one must fight alone.

name: Awakened Scimitar of Zal
description: It is said the oracles of the Djinn Realm can not only SEE into the future, but can also manipulate it. If that is true… do we really control our own fates? It MUST be a rumor.

name: Awakened Titan Blade (0 AC)
description: The weapon hisses and snarls, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Titan Blade (AC)
description: The weapon hisses and snarls, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Azaelea Rapier (0 AC)
description: In flower language, Azaeleas symbolize passion, beauty, and love.

name: Azaelea Rapier (AC)
description: In flower language, Azaeleas symbolize passion, beauty, and love.

name: Azalith's Cutlass (AC)
description: Humans were not created for the sea, a vast expanse of death. Yet, they strove to conquer it. Azalith saw this from the clouds, and felt begrudging admiration.

name: Azalith's Cutlass (Legend)
description: Humans were not created for the sea, a vast expanse of death. Yet, they strove to conquer it. Azalith saw this from the clouds, and felt begrudging admiration.

name: Azione Solo
description: A one-man action. A lone blade that melds with the dark. Those who wander deep into the Underworld become sacrifices. Others, should their will and grudges prove strong, become entities even the dead fear.

name: Azure Cleric Sword
description: A gilded sword for those times when the sword is mightier than the pen!

name: Azure Iryerris
description: Forged on a promise Sora made to the last member of The Fallen.

name: Azure Starblade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Azureblood Blade
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed blood descendants.

name: B'Naner Blade (AC)
description: Mmmf… munch munch… aw, man… I gotta stop eating my sword!

name: B'Naner Blade (Legend)
description: Mmmf… munch munch… aw, man… I gotta stop eating my sword!

name: Backbreaker
description: Approximately named, Backbreaker is a massive piece of Shadow Slayer equipment used in onslaughts against Darkovian dangers. An engraving at the bottom reads: Outlaw13th.

name: Backhand Kagutsuchi Inori
description: The flames can only be lit with blood. A swordsmith modeled this masterpiece after a child of flame. Their birth and immediate death created eight volcanos.

name: Backhanded Dragon's Breath Katana
description: The same dragon that offered the jizamurai villages their blood gifted the assassins their breath as well. Lightning cooled in a sacred spring, and solidified into blades.

name: Backhanded Enchanted Speirling Dagger
description: The original gilded dagger wielded by the First Champion of Energy's younger brother. Its gold can be traced back to Camlan, where Light and Lightning clashed for dominion over the continent that would one day become Greenguard.

name: Backhanded Speirling Dagger
description: An instrument of interrogation as well as a deadly weapon. The crackle of electricity is constant, and reminds the wielder of the consequences of failure.

name: Backhanded Speirling Guardian Dagger
description: The original gilded dagger wielded by the First Champion of Energy's younger brother. Its gold can be traced back to Camlan, where Light and Lightning clashed for dominion over the continent that would one day become Greenguard.

name: Backstab Blade
description: How COULD you?! Artix was your friend. He TRUSTED you! I hope you're happy now. Traitor.

name: Bakunawa Guard Blade
description: Your quest is to follow the Bakunawa, the serpent who eats moons, no matter where it journeys. Your mission: to protect the seventh moon, the sea, and the safety of your people.

name: Baleful Spine of the Abyss (0 AC)
description: Fiends of the Nation undergo constant mutation, and Archfiend Nulgath isn't an exception. This spine is from one of his 'old bodies.' As a weapon, it can destroy his own Fiends, and horrifically transform everything else.

name: Baleful Spine of the Abyss (AC)
description: Fiends of the Nation undergo constant mutation, and Archfiend Nulgath isn't an exception. This spine is from one of his 'old bodies.' As a weapon, it can destroy his own Fiends, and horrifically transform everything else.

name: Balloon of Awe
description: Could this be the real thing? *feels edge* Nope. Pretty Awe-some replica, though!

name: Balloon Sword
description: The best weapon EVER for bopping your enemies on the head!

name: Balor's Cruelty
description: It is said the great demon warrior Balor's evil spirit is sealed inside of one of his ancient weapons.

name: Balor's Hatred
description: Feel the hatred following.

name: Balor's Hunger
description: Nulgath acknowledges your thirst and hunger. He empowers your cursed sword to levels no other ally in the Nation would dare crave for.

name: Balrog Blade
description: Weapons of such ferocity are a rare find indeed. Its blade burns with eternal fire.

name: Balrog Sword
description: Mehmetaligzkzl, an honored - but Dark - weaponscrafter, offers this blade only to the greatest heroes.

name: Bamboo Slicer Katana
description: Strange things happen on Yokai Isle… Even the pandas can become Samuari!

name: Banana Leaf Sword
description: A traditional savory dish widely served during ceremonies and celebrations, characterized by its yellow rice and a wide variety of foods included in it. Now you can wear it like the Palatable Paladin that you are!

name: Banana Thorn Blade
description: Banana Thorn Blade? Sure, that makes sense.

name: Bane of Akriloth Blade
description: This blade was forged out of pure dragonsbane ore and plunged into the heart of the fiery volcano. Akriloth doesn't stand a chance.

name: Bane of Dragonslayers
description: Whether or not a Dragon deserves to be slain hasn't been taken into account. This blade is that of a manslayer's, and the cycle of vengeances continues to spin and spin.

name: Bane of Nulgath
description: Nulgath infused this blade with the blood of fallen foes.

name: Banjo
description: You ain't strummin' in the kitchen with Dinah anymore— it's time to defeat your foes with the power of bluegrass!

name: Barbarian Steel Blade
description: This blade was made to be wielded by warriors with immense strength.

name: Barbaric Blade of Darkness
description: This Darkness sword has seen countless battles and thirsts for bloodshed.

name: Barbarous MindSmasher
description: This sharpened tooth was torn from the maw of a leviathan that fell into the depths. The entity who rules the deep imbued it with a maddening resonance. Every sound it makes shakes the mind with visions writing in the dark.

name: Barbed Horror
description: When Yulgar was asked to smith a good weapon for a barber… we think he misunderstood us!

name: Barbed Wire Bat
description: The barbs are mean, but if we were bringing out the bats, no one was thinking about peacing it out in the first place.

name: Base DaiDoji Katana
description: This blade once belonged to the weapon collection of one of Akiba's finest samurai. It is color custom to your armor's BASE color.

name: Basic Balloon Sword
description: *boing* Not really good for a serious fight, but AWESOME for playfighting.

name: Basic Claymore of Pain
description: Why Dilligaf thought he would be able to keep this blade from you is a mystery. I guess we'll never know, since all that is left of his is this lifeless corpse.

name: Basic War Sword
description: A basic blade that can be used for Good or for Evil; if you are one of the Chosen, you can turn this sword in for the Behemoth Blade!

name: Bat Broad Blade
description: A massive blade bound with aged linen cloth. This sword really puts the 'bat' in battle!

name: Battle Herald Sword
description: These beautiful swords can only be used by the respected officers of arms of Swordhaven.

name: Battle Party Blade
description: Battle your way right into the New Year!

name: Battleblade of the Necromancer
description: Be bad to the bone! Released in honor of Artix Entertainment's new mobile game "Undead Assault"

name: Battleon Warbeast Blade
description: When towers topple, their stone and steel are repurposed to arm the people. Until this land becomes barren and blank, Battleon will never know true defeat.

name: Battleworn Guardian Sword
description: This blade has clearly been through MANY battles. We may never know who wielded it, but now it rests in your hands. What victories will it bring you?

name: Beach Umbrella Lance
description: Sturdy beach umbrellas make decent lances and shields whenever they're not keeping you from being cooked alive when sunbathing.

name: Beamsword of Love (AC)
description: For some reason, the sound of sparkling dust is heard instead of the average buzzing noise. This dust allows the wielder to gain a small rise of accuracy in battle.

name: Beamsword of Love (Legend)
description: For some reason, the sound of sparkling dust is heard instead of the average buzzing noise. This dust allows the wielder to gain a small rise of accuracy in battle. (Suggested by Hancok)

name: Beast King's Glory
description: The glorious sword wielded by Bluddron, the hideous beast who gave Beleen a Heroes Heart Day she'll never forget.

name: Beast King's Lightning
description: Crackling with energy, this blade can only be wielded by those who have proven to be Bluddron's equal in battle.

name: Beastbane's Blood Blade
description: A sword that is a monster in of itself. Often sheathed in the fresh hides of fallen beasts, warmed by the life it took. (Item gives 25% more gold when equipped.)

name: Beastly Chronicle Blade (0 AC)
description: A fine and regal blade found in the hands of the wild Iron Fang Warriors. It tells a silent tale of imprisonment, escape, and finally, freedom.

name: Beastly Chronicle Blade (AC)
description: A fine and regal blade found in the hands of the wild Iron Fang Warriors. It tells a silent tale of imprisonment, escape, and finally, freedom.

name: Beastly Mettle Blade (0 AC)
description: It is impossible to truly tame a beast meant to lord over the wilds. This blade was strapped to a wolf, ordered to serve its master. The pack bit and clawed their way to freedom, their mettle proven.

name: Beastly Mettle Blade (AC)
description: It is impossible to truly tame a beast meant to lord over the wilds. This blade was strapped to a wolf, ordered to serve its master. The pack bit and clawed their way to freedom, their mettle proven.

name: Beautiful Misery
description: This sword is a work of art with a terrible hunger for blood. The painful twist of fate that leads an enemy to be impaled on this blade will only leave the victim a brief moment to savour the view before death claims the soul.

name: Bee Arthur Katana
description: Just BEE yourself. Or l'll cut your head off. Then you'll just BEE dead.

name: Begemmed Blade
description: Entrance your opponents with the gleaming gems bound into this blade!

name: Begemmed Blade of Swordhaven
description: Jewel-encrusted blades that are so opulent, they're almost too difficult to wield. Each gem is enchanted with a powerful spell, one imparted by each noble family in Greenguard…or at least, the ones that like you.

name: Behemoth Blade of BlueMoon
description: After mining rare mineral deposits from the mysterious BlueMoon, a massive sword has been forged, capable of slicing through all known elements.

name: Behemoth Blade of Light
description: A blade of undeniable size, power, and reputation. Wardens of light have sacrificed everything in hopes of obtaining such an honor as the Behemoth Blade.

name: Behemoth Blade of Shadow
description: A blade of undeniable size and power. Conquerors of Shadow have sacrificed everything in hopes of obtaining such a notorious reward as the Behemoth Blade.

name: Bejeweled Blade
description: Forged from 6 rare jewels, this sword has one of the sharpest edges anywhere!

name: Beleen's Balloon Cutelass
description: Hoist the sails, this ship isn't going to stop until every shade and hint of pink has been commandeered by Captain Beleen! The ocean's about to be taken by a tidal wave of peach lemonade!

name: Beleen's Crimson Cutelass (AC)
description: Hoist the sails, this ship isn't going to stop until every shade and hint of pink has been commandeered by Captain Beleen! The ocean's about to be taken by a tidal wave of peach lemonade!

name: Beleen's Crimson Cutelass (Non-AC)
description: Hoist the sails, this ship isn't going to stop until every shade and hint of pink has been commandeered by Captain Beleen! The ocean's about to be taken by a tidal wave of peach lemonade!

name: Beleen's DragonBlade
description: This is what happens when Beleen gets a hold of Nulgath…no one is safe.

name: Beleen's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Beleen, the pun-loving, BalloonCrafter and Pink Mage of LOVE! Hearts for you, hero!

name: Beleen's SUPER PINK DragonBlade
description: This is what happens when Beleen gets a hold of Nulgath…no one is safe.

name: Benedizioni Blade (0 AC)
description: A righteous weapon handcrafted by Nulgath the Archangel for an ascended warrior of justice. Their great deeds echo through the heavens.

name: Benedizioni Blade (AC)
description: A righteous weapon handcrafted by Nulgath the Archangel for an ascended warrior of justice. Their great deeds echo through the heavens.

name: Berserker Blade of Glory
description: Kick your victories into OVERDRIVE! Thank you for supporting AdventureQuest 3D on Kickstarter!

name: Berserker's Fiendish Agonizer (0 AC)
description: This blade is the most durable the Nation has to offer, and for good reason. If their Berserker breaks their weapons in the middle of a fight, they'll grab the nearest Fiend and use them as a bludgeon to compensate.

description: As a former Legion FiendHunter, Vhall now has the ability to control Nation Fiends with the sword besides killing them.

description: A sword named and forged by Dage the Evil, and cooled in the freezing and wailing waters of the River Cocytus. The Bestial Warlord yearns for cries of lamentation. The cursed souls attached to this blade tide them over until the next war.

name: Beta Tester Star Sword
description: This blade seems to harness the power of light itself. It's a force to be reckoned with.

name: Betrayal Blade of Nulgath
description: Nulgath smirks. Then tells you this blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. Though you can wreak incredible devastation the sword can also betray you…

name: Betrayal Blade of Nulgath (Rare)
description: Nulgath smirks. Then tells you this blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. Although you can wreak incredible devastation the sword can also betray you… (Rare)

name: Bido's Black Blade
description: Darkness forged this and in the end darkness will consume it.

name: Bido's Toxic Gift Blade (AC)
description: Bido - legendary artist, tester, and all-around great hero - celebrated his birthday by crafting this new blade for you!

name: Bido's Toxic Gift Blade (Legend)
description: Happy birthday from Bido - legendary artist, tester, and all-around great hero!

name: Biela's Crystallized Oath
description: A comet was said to have fallen from the sky, and landed in an Energy Dragon's mouth. His breath transformed the shooting star into an astral blade.

name: Big 100K
description: Yes, that's right. THE Big 100K.

name: Big Daddy Smitestick
description: Crafted by DEUCE for Memet's birthday 2015!

name: Big Daddy (Sword)
description: The magical runes make this heavy blade as swift as the katana. This sword was inspired by art created by your fellow player Tokijin.

name: Bigger 100K
description: A powerful sword sold by Warlic to a Hero you've never met, but feel you would know well. It was recreated from the sample obtained in the Lore of AdventureQuest's timeline. Click it and it will change its form.

name: Binky's Man Eating Uni-horn
description: You…you do realize you could've taken the head OFF before you stuck the hilt onto this thing, right? May play a special animation when auto attacking.

name: Binky's Star Slasher
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Binky. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Binky's Uni-horn
description: You…you do realize you could've taken the head OFF before you stuck the hilt onto this thing, right?

name: Bio Buster Blade
description: You unlocked this sword by supporting Biobeasts! The trapped creatures of the lab thank you!

name: Bio-War Cultist Blade (AC)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: Bio-War Cultist Blade (Special)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: BioBeasts Memorial Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by BioBeasts. Thanks for supporting the game! (Click the handle to change blade colors)

name: Bionic Cleaver
description: After years of dedicated research, Mieteor has finally discovered the way to merge metal with machine.

name: Bit O Bacon Blade
description: A deep-fried n' delicious broadsword unlike any other. Only those who share a truly special bond with the bacon may ever hope to wield such a blade. Bring home the bacon!

name: Bitten Blade
description: You wouldn't think a sword made out of chocolate and strawberry marshmallow creme would do well in battle, but it tastes DELICIOUS!

name: Bitter Deathgiver
description: *No description*

name: Bitter Soul Sunder (0 AC)
description: Nulgath armed his Deathstalkers, and they quickly went out of control. Every soul they claimed was ripped from the natural cycle of life and death. They were fed directly to the God of Fiends instead.

name: Bitter Soul Sunder (AC)
description: Nulgath armed his Deathstalkers, and they quickly went out of control. Every soul they claimed was ripped from the natural cycle of life and death. They were fed directly to the God of Fiends instead.

name: BitterEdge Blade
description: Slashing through the snow, with a frozen hilt and blade, over enemies we go, stabbing all the way!

name: BitterEdge Broadsword
description: For when the weather outside is truly frightful.

name: Bitterfrost Doublebladed Blade
description: Tales of your deeds are chilling… and so is your cold, cold heart!

name: Black Blood Blade
description: Victory is yours! And so is Groglurk's blade… but it has been tainted by DARKNESS!

name: Black Bloodriver
description: Sometimes you need a really big sword to fight your way through the Black Friday sales.

name: Black Dragon Ninja Sword
description: The creation of this blade was an unspeakable crime that was committed unto the word by no other than Dage himself. To wield this katana is to wield wrongness itself.

name: Black Dragon's Ascension (0 AC)
description: The violet fang of the regal black dragon who needs no crown.

name: Black Dragon's Ascension (AC)
description: The violet fang of the regal black dragon who needs no crown.

name: Black Dragon Scimitar (0 AC)
description: A charming choice for a naval who is gifted when maintaining order in the crew is involved, yet mysterious. Be weary for not all commanders who wear black are wicked.

name: Black Dragon Scimitar (AC)
description: A charming choice for a naval who is gifted when maintaining order in the crew is involved, yet mysterious. Be weary for not all commanders who wear black are wicked.

name: Black Dragon Star Sword (1)
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Black Dragon Star Sword (2)
description: This specially-crafted black dragon Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Black Dragon Tongue (0 AC)
description: Forged by an ancient Evil, this hefty blade was created in the image of a legendary dragon. Its performance in battle reflects the dragon's unyielding animosity.

name: Black Dragon Tongue (AC)
description: Forged by an ancient Evil, this hefty blade was created in the image of a legendary dragon. Its performance in battle reflects the dragon's unyielding animosity.

name: Black Gold Reigns' Sword
description: The people of Lore will fall and the Black Gold Reigns will rise!

name: Black Hole Spear
description: Black hole spear, come over here, and slice away the paaaaaain

name: Black Hole Sword
description: For those who want their singularity in a swordlier form.

name: Black Ice Reborn
description: Glaciers melt slowly, but contain great black. This blade was forged from a shard of black taken deep inside the heart of a black at the top of the black.

name: Black Katana
description: A black, curved, single-edged sword traditionally used by Japanese samurai.

name: Black Knight Katanas (0 AC)
description: Not even death can keep Nulgath's most loyal, dark knights from serving him. FOREVER.

name: Black Knight Katanas (AC)
description: Not even death can keep Nulgath's most loyal, dark knights from serving him. FOREVER.

description: Not even death can keep Nulgath's most loyal, dark knights from serving him. FOREVER.

name: Black Legion Flesh Ripper (0 AC)
description: Dark and dangerous in any hands, this blade delights in causing pain and anguish.

name: Black Legion Flesh Ripper (AC)
description: Dark and dangerous in any hands, this blade delights in causing pain and anguish.

name: Black Lightning Katana
description: Do you feel the power flowing through this cursed blade?

name: Black Mantis Sai
description: When Unhallowed Wights pass on, their younger siblings inherit their skulls and skills. It allows them to master weapons like this easily, and even experience shared memories.

name: Black Matter Dagger
description: Lorean scientists are certain that this exists, and when you wield it, you'll be able to prove them right!

name: Black Moon Dagger
description: A desert onyx prize donated by the Pharaoh of the Sandsea. It's made for the dept hands of a professional. Any who carry it will be welcomed into the Sandsea's royal guard.

name: Black Rune Edge
description: Blade of the black elemental.

name: Black Sonic Blade (Sword)
description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, they must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

name: Black Star Blade
description: A blade said to have been forged from a black star (though it doesn't look like it).

name: Black Sun Ninja Katana
description: So fast, people will swear the shadows themselves came to life.

name: Black Thorn Blade
description: Every rose has its thorn, Just like every night has its dawn

name: Black Valentine Sabre
description: It's pronounced "Sah-Bray"! Forged from a blend of special dark chocolate, this Black Valentine Sabre works well for those with a bitter-sweet tooth.

name: Black Vespa Katana (0 AC)
description: When Unhallowed Wights pass on, their younger siblings inherit their skulls and skills. It allows them to master weapons like this easily, and even experience shared memories.

name: BlackBolt Blade
description: This blade, enhanced by the power of lightning will cause any foe struck with it to have their minds rotten to the core.

name: BlackBolt Claymore
description: This blade, enhanced by the power of lightning will cause any foe struck with it to have their minds rotten to the core.

name: BlackLight Dragon's Blade
description: This sword was born in an unsettling future. One where the only light Lore knows comes from their own weapons. Survive. Face fate. Battle on!

name: Blackrog Blade
description: Weapons of such ferocity are a rare find indeed. Its blade burns with an unending fire fueled by the aggravation of Black Friday Shoppers.

name: BlackSkulls Breaker Blade
description: When Friday the 13th day loses its light, the BlackSkulls come to play in the night.

name: BlackSkulls Sword Breaker
description: When Friday the 13th day loses its light, the BlackSkulls come to play in the night.

name: Blade of 16-Bit Awe
description: Made up of 4 4-bit pieces. Does this one summon a digital Guardian Dragon?

name: Blade of Adulation
description: Only the best fighters deserve a blade of such honor and strength.

name: Blade of Affliction
description: Nulgath says this weapon can kill your enemy from the inside out. There's no cure for the vile toxins this blade holds.

name: Blade of Alt
description: Never use in conjunction with the F4 blade.

name: Blade of Ancient Evil
description: I know evil is in your name, but really? Taking a bite out of your own sword is pushing it.

name: Blade of Ancient Justice
description: With help of Golden Claw you repair this once lost weapon of times long past. (Color Custom, Clickable)

name: Blade of Ancient Vengeance
description: With help of Golden Claw you repair this once lost weapon of times long past. (Color Custom, Clickable)

name: Blade of Ashes
description: The Cleric of Nulgath twists the powers within the Blade of Ashes to bend to you will. You are now under its control.

name: Blade of Awe
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Blade of Awe-ful
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Blade of Aww
description: AWWWWWW! Everyone thought the Blade of Awe was legendary… now meet the super adorable Blade of Aww!

name: Blade of aww.. man..
description: Draw the sword from the stone? HAH! Someone scribbled this one from the stone! (Will disintegrate in one week… we think.)

name: Blade Of Awww
description: AWWWW! Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive powers… of ADORABLENESS!

name: Blade of Balance
description: Equally balanced in both a literal and metaphysical sense, this blade will always bring the good out of the worst battles… usually with gold and exp!

name: Blade of BananAWE (0 AC)
description: Slip into Summer with this beachin' Blade of BananAWE. It's got real a-PEEL.

name: Blade of BananAWE (AC)
description: Slip into Summer with this beachin' Blade of BananAWE. It's got real a-PEEL.

name: Blade of Blasphemy
description: Deep below the waves, down in the depths where no light shines, your Master waits. Your role: to serve the ancient, eldritch god who steals hearts and souls of heroes, binding them to its will. (This item is color customizable)

name: Blade of Bones
description: *No description*

name: Blade of Chaos
description: The legendary sword that has been by Drakath for nearly 6 years. Soooo…chaorrupted.

name: Blade of Chaos Binding
description: Bestowed to those who fight for Chaos! The purple symbolize the true Heroes of Chaos.

name: Blade of Cursed Glow
description: A rare weapon of glowing belonging to She Who Walks Behind The Rave. Some glow has been placed on this blade… but I'm sure it's nothing to dance about…

name: Blade of Cursed Shadow
description: A rare weapon of power belonging to She Who Walks Behind The Stalks. Some curse has been placed on this blade… but I'm sure it's nothing to worry about…

name: Blade of Darkness
description: Darkness… is… coming!

name: Blade of De'ther
description: Sael commissioned the forging of this blade from the crafters of DragonRune Hall thanks to your efforts to thank you for your efforts to destroy Jir'abin.

name: Blade Of Derp
description: Could this be the real thing?!?! No way. But it's so shiny… SUPER Shiny… okay so maybe a little TOO shiny… it IS the Blade of Derp after all!

name: Blade of Destiny (1)
description: The runes foretell the future… but what do they say?

name: Blade of Destiny (2)
description: To you one body down is one body too many!

name: Blade of Discord
description: A massive longsword appropriately named for its devastating blows dealt to the very unlucky. Its origins are unknown, but point towards a Chaos lineage.

name: Blade of Disorder
description: The starter blade for those who feel the belong to Chaos.

name: Blade of Divine Intervention
description: The most legendary sword from the City of the Dawn is the Blade of Divine Intervention. Since the great battle of the Dawn against Chaos there seem to be copies of it made by the angels of the Dawn. And you're lucky to own one of these divine blazing swords!

name: Blade of Doomination
description: DOOM will rain down upon anyone who crosses you!

name: Blade of Dragon Control
description: Can you control the dragon spirit in this blade?

name: Blade of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Blade of Embers
description: This sword was crafted by one of Pyralis' pyromancers out of super-heated lavarock.

name: Blade of Eternal Shadows (0 AC)
description: The Shadow Dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Blade of Eternal Shadows (AC)
description: The Shadow Dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Blade of Eternal Victory
description: The time dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Blade of Fealty
description: You've sworn an oath to loyalty. Do not break it.

name: Blade of Feelings
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: The beating of a heart is a comforting sound. Armies march to its cadence and lovers feel their hearts pounding every time they look at one another. Suggested by Disturbed Indestructible.

name: Blade of Fiery Destruction
description: Burn enemies straight to their molten core.

name: Blade of Fiz
description: Mew124 and Drean598 blew the lid off this creation! How are you supposed to not shake it with every swing?!?!

name: Blade of Forbidden Doom
description: Returning from the abyss of eons past, a time when titans clawed up seas and mountains, Doom rises. This blade had the honor of leaving scars on the light, and has returned in the shade of eclipse.

name: Blade of Gale Warrior
description: The weapons of Gale Warrior was forged by the legendary Randor The Red!

name: Blade of Glacial Torment (0 AC)
description: A blade made from living ice. Some say its the remains of an Ice Elemental. Others whisper that you can make weapons this deadly from the bones of a Glaceran.

name: Blade of Glacial Torment (AC)
description: A blade made from living ice. Some say its the remains of an Ice Elemental. Others whisper that you can make weapons this deadly from the bones of a Glaceran.

name: Blade of Glorious Destiny
description: Wielding this blade, you will look as glorious as your destiny.

name: Blade of Glorious Victory
description: You shall be part of the glorious victory.

name: Blade Of Glory
description: If you're on the edge of glory, this is the blade for you.

name: Blade of Gold Coins
description: This set is 100% gold. Literally. Made out of the many gold coins you've saved up while adventuring. Talk about a status symbol!

name: Blade of Guiding
description: The AQW Ambassadors thank you for playing AQWorlds. This weapon is a gift from them to wish you good luck in your adventures!

name: Blade of Hail
description: Control the fall of ice this sharp blade.

name: Blade of Half Awe-f
description: It's BROKEN! (Cannot be reforged)

name: Blade of Havoc
description: Chaos physically flows in this blade, chaorrupting the once harmonious weapon.

name: Blade of Holy Might
description: Holy Might, Silent might, monsters quake at the sight!

name: Blade of Honor
description: Be honorable in your quests.

name: Blade of Ignis
description: A blade brimming with the power of an Infernal Warlord King.

name: Blade of Immortality
description: Grab your blades and slay all of those who oppose the forces of good! Villages and kingdoms shall remember the name, General Lionfang!

name: Blade of Khopesh
description: Finely crafted, this hefty curved Drow sword is ready to slice and dice.

name: Blade of Life-Taking
description: This is a weapon. Use it to take lives.

name: Blade of Loyalty
description: Used by LightCaster Truthsayers, this blade glows in the presence of treason.

name: Blade of Malevolence
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Blade of Meh
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Blade of Modulation
description: The keys of this double decker piano blade will make your enemy transcend. The first song every played on this musical weapon was in fact the Transcendental Etude.

name: Blade of MoonLight (0 AC)
description: Word's spreading about secret beach parties. Think it'll be chill? There's a good chance you'll stumble into a freaky moon ritual instead. Ah well, as long as the music's good.

name: Blade of MoonLight (AC)
description: Word's spreading about secret beach parties. Think it'll be chill? There's a good chance you'll stumble into a freaky moon ritual instead. Ah well, as long as the music's good.

name: Blade of Omniramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Blade of Pain
description: It thirst for the screams of its next victim.

name: Blade of Platinum Joy
description: This bright blade was forged in the Celestial Realm, crafted by a peerless weaponsmith, and will cut through the darkness and your enemies with equal ease.

name: Blade of Purification
description: You shall bare the mark of the witch and will forever be cast out! To the pits with you!

name: Blade of Rage and Fury
description: This hilt channels your rage, turning it into a solid blade harder than steel!

name: Blade of Revenant
description: A fate worse than death, revenants and wraiths that have no place left in this world are forged together to make something useful. This blade that is used to take lives is made out of former living spirits.

name: Blade of Revontheus the Good
description: A bruised and disfigured sword that has relived both the past and future. Deformed by the despair and sorrow that surrounded it, it is still a formidable source of power for electromancers.

name: Blade of Semiramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Blade of Shade
description: To you there's never one body to many!

name: Blade of Shimazu
description: Shimazu the Defiler was awakened by Malgor, but has proven to be no match for your might!

name: Blade of Sigils
description: For centuries, King Alteon's bloodline has been favored by the dragons. They are the sigil of his house.

name: Blade of Silent Might
description: Silent Might, holy might, monsters quake at the sight!

name: Blade of the Archfiend (0 AC)
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Blade of the Archfiend (AC)
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Blade of the Battle Kris
description: When all else fails, a sharp object always does trick. This sword is color custom.

name: Blade Of the Black Sea
description: Only the fiercest pirates sail the Blacksea and only the bravest become captains!

name: Blade of the Black Sun Eclipse
description: A blade said to have been forged from a black star (though it doesn't look like it).

name: Blade of the Bone
description: Nothing cuts through bone better than a blade made from bone. Don't believe me? Give it a swing and find out!

name: Blade of the Bound Eclipse
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿In the shadow of the eclipse, two gods are bound and forced to see the mortals who stole their powers dance among the clouds. Your torment of them caused their rage to seep into Umbrabrand, turning its edge jagged and hateful.

name: Blade of the Brilliant Chronomancer
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, a blinding light shines out of the entrance to the Plane of Light. Only Chronomancers of Light possess the magic to survive the combined might of time magic mixed with radiant beams of elemental power.

name: Blade of the Burning Sun
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿In the spirit of Yokai Isles' oldest purification shrines, Solarbrand was used to bleed the old gods and soaked in their power. Traditionally, this power would have been regarded as impurities and discarded, but here, it is a searing blessing, thrust into your hands.

name: Blade of the Chaotic Fleet
description: Given to members of the Chaotic Fleet, this blade feeds off of the Chaotic force that flows through everyone.

name: Blade of the Chilling
description: This dark blade will chill you to the bone…or cut that bone in half.

name: Blade of the Cosmic Winds
description: A celestial body has answerd your call; its spirit forming into the blade of your weapon. Was it a star tied to your fate, or a planet from beyond that claims you as its own.

name: Blade of the Dawn
description: One of the few Blades of the Dawn forged for the great battle of the Dawn against the chaos forces. Legends say that the blades are made by a cyan potato and a paladin blacksmith.

name: Blade of the Deep
description: Kaiju Cannoneer's follow the call of Klashex.

name: Blade of the Desert Dunes
description: Rumor has it that the smith who forged this blade crafted it in honor of the endless sand dunes and hills all across the Sandsea. Though ancient, the sword still holds an edge to this day.

name: Blade of the Djinn King
description: Only the bravest warrior in all the realm are able to wield the majestic power of this blade.

name: Blade of the Dragonsworn
description: Drawn from the energy of the skies, electrify your foes white the power of Krenos.

name: Blade of The Fallen
description: At the tip of this custom blade… EVIL WILL FALL!

name: Blade of the Fallen Djinn
description: When a Djinn falls the blade bends as it slowly looses its power.

name: Blade of the First Sunbeam (0 AC)
description: A blade forged in the image of the first bent ray of sunlight that shone on Lore, giving rise to a Golden Dragon. It's difficult to acertain whether this is the truth or not, but it's a lovely story nonetheless.

name: Blade of the First Sunbeam (AC)
description: A blade forged in the image of the first bent ray of sunlight that shone on Lore, giving rise to a Golden Dragon. It's difficult to acertain whether this is the truth or not, but it's a lovely story nonetheless.

name: Blade of the Forgotten Tombs
description: Stored in the Forgotten Tombs, this blade has been inscribed with a peculiar engraving. When evil forces threatens the tombs, the blade's glyphs glow to warn it's owner of the imminent danger.

name: Blade Of The FrostSpawn
description: Rip through your enemies AND their gifts! Gives 10% more XP when equipped!

name: Blade of the Gemmed Heart
description: Dorene crafted this slender blade knowing the one weakness of everyone who participates in Heroes Heart Day: their heart! Capable of stabbing through to ones heart and draining their essence, this blade collects the energy it steals into a heart-shaped gemstone at the hilt.

name: Blade of the Glowing Moon
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿The moon is always changing, reborn when a cycle ends. Lunarbrand was once the sword of a knight that tore off the chains of his duties. Reborn and drenched in the blood of the old gods, it now gleams like the glowing moon, dealing death to creatures that think the night is theirs.

name: Blade of the Incinerated
description: This dark blade is sure to cut through bone like a knife cutting warm butter.

name: Blade of the Kingdom
description: By the tip of this blade, you will return to the circle of life!

name: Blade of the Legion Beast
description: From deep within the shadows of the Underworld, the Beasts of the Legion stalk their prey, slaying swiftly and silently. To slay the beast, you must BECOME the beast.

name: Blade of the Light
description: For honor… for glory… we BATTLE ON!

name: Blade of the Lone Hunter
description: Encased in a sheathe of ice, the blade waits for those who wander alone. It's new master will carve a path through the frigid mountain, culling the weak from these harsh lands.

name: Blade of the Loyal Legion Warrior
description: This blade is Dage the Evil's gift to you, loyal members of his Undead Legion! (This weapon gives a 20% boost to gold when equipped.)

name: Blade Of The Mount
description: Fun fact: the whorls in the center of the blade are created when the metal is infused with magical energy.

name: Blade of the Neverborn
description: ”So what kind of stuff does it cut?” “Oh, you know, wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey…stuff.”

name: Blade of the Nosferatu
description: These vampires care not for royal garb or flamboyant parties. Only hunting prey for their next meal.

name: Blade of the Oracle
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Protect yourself. Most will viciously rebuke the truth.

name: Blade of the Overlord (AC)
description: As cold as ice, the very stone of that comprises the blade could chill to the bone and bring visions of how their wielders will meet their demise.

name: Blade of the Overlord (Legend)
description: As cold as ice, the very stone of that comprises the blade could chill to the bone and bring visions of how their wielders will meet their demise.

name: Blade of the Phoenix
description: Let loose the phoenix of fire and prepare to FIGHT!

name: Blade of the Pumpking
description: Perfect for carving up enemies.

name: Blade of the Pumpking Legion
description: Perfect for carving up enemies.

name: Blade of the Scourge Overlord
description: As cold as ice, the very stone of that comprises the blade could chill to the bone and bring visions of how their wielders will meet their demise.

name: Blade of the Underworld (0 AC)
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Blade of the Underworld (AC)
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Blade of the Void Dragon
description: Weapons Nythera crafted with magic, and the materials she found in her travels through the Void. They're made from creatures that are close to the half-dragon, but she doesn't mind. If anything, that guarantees the dagger's effectiveness.

name: Blade of the Voidborn
description: Deep in the heart of the Void, a race of creatures spawned by Darkness, wait for Nulgath the ArchFiend's command. The Voidborn are his creatures - body, breath, and soul.

name: Blade of the Watchers
description: They are ready with their blades drawn, waiting for that dreadful day to come.

name: Blade of the Wicked
description: The sinister blade of darkness.

name: Blade of the Wiki-d
description: This blade is given to those chroniclers of Lore who have served loyally and well. The AQWorlds team thanks you for everything you've done to help us and your fellow players! Enjoy the increased damage range and free storage!

name: Blade of Thorns (1)
description: Some say certain forest elves might have wielded such blades.

name: Blade of Thorns (2)
description: While flowers can be strong, those with thorns are strongest!

name: Blade Of Truth
description: If you're on the brink of Truth, this blade is for you.

name: Blade of Twilight
description: Forged by you fellow player Lavitz, the Blade of Twilight becomes ever more powerful when in the paws of a Lycan Knight!

name: Blade of Unicorn Power
description: Your enemies will be mesmerized by the sheer prismastic power and beauty of this unicorn blade.

name: Blade of Vampire
description: This evil blade constantly thirsts for fresh blood. If its thirst isn't quenched regularly, owner beware…

name: Blade Of Vengeance
description: Your future holds fury and flame.

name: Blade Of VorDREAD
description: PINK SKULLS OF DOOM!.

name: Blade of Zephyrs
