description: Those who study the element of wind who chose to use swords use the air around to swiftly get around and confuse their enemies during combat.

name: Blade Ov 1000 Kittehs
description: I had 2 skin teh kat 4 curiosity!

name: Blade's Blade
description: Blade's Sword. Where did you get this?

name: Bladed Cypress Tendril
description: Exquisite in design and performance, the Bladed Cypress Tendril takes on the power of The Cloister herself. The spirit of nature thrives within.

name: Bladed Dagger of Soul
description: Overwhelmed by OverSoul souls? Practice collecting souls with this blade before you try your hand at dual-wielding!

name: Bladedlord's Katana
description: The sword of the BladeLord must cut with precision and accuracy, much like the master.

name: Bladehaven Ice Sword
description: It may be made of ice, but don't worry - this sword is sturdier than it looks!

name: Bladelord Sword of Vokun
description: The sword of the BladeLord must cut with precision and accuracy, much like the master.

name: Blademaster Assassin Backwards Katana
description: At the proper angle, aiming it right can slice and dice one's own shadow temporarily. It's not necessary, but it demonstrates how sharp the katana is.

name: Blademaster Assassin Katana
description: At the proper angle, aiming it can slice and dice one's own shadow temporally. It's not necessary, but it demonstrates how sharp the katana is.

name: Blademaster's Cruelty (0 AC)
description: VoidFiend Blademasters are dropped into an arena ten at a time to fight to the death. Only the strongest leaves alive, and their blood-soaked weapons gain a sharper, hungier edge.

name: Blademaster's Cruelty (AC)
description: VoidFiend Blademasters are dropped into an arena ten at a time to fight to the death. Only the strongest leaves alive, and their blood-soaked weapons gain a sharper, hungier edge.

name: BladeMaster's Katana
description: The blademaster's weapons are carved with precision to move through the air faster than the human eye can see.

name: BladeMaster's Sword (1)
description: In this case, though the tool is deadly, the wielder is even deadlier.

name: BladeMaster's Sword (2)
description: The blademaster's weapons are carved with precision to move through the air faster than the human eye can see.

name: BladeStorm
description: Forged from a rare energy that resinated in the Lore of MechQuest, the Blade Storm has a magical blade that slices through limbs like butter.

name: Blasted Energy Blade
description: You are 1 of 100 heroes who won the Black Friday Prize Pool!

name: Blaze of Awe
description: The wings of this legendary sword alight with an undying flame. Its might and awe are for your hands only. The unworthy will be engulfed in fire and scars.

name: Blazebeard's Cutlass
description: The fiery cutlass of the legendary Blazebeard is now yours to wield.

name: Blazebringer Molten Blade
description: May the fire that burns in the core of this blade never extinguish.

name: Blazing Challenger
description: Melt through the shackles that plague Embresea's innocent!

name: Blazing Chaos Blade
description: Raging chaos infused into this blade gives it the glow.

name: Blazing Heart Katana
description: Crafted by one of Pyralis' pyromancers, these flames were frozen in place. Their edges are as sharp a fire dragon's fang.

name: Blazing Igneus Sickle
description: Ow ow ow it's hot ow ow owwwww!

name: Blazing Onyx DOOMFire Blade
description: This might blade's power to start a raging whirlwind of harvested souls and thickened dark clouds allows it to live up to the legendary DoomKnight's name.

name: Blessed Beloved's Kris Knife
description: A blade meant to be worn at all times. It shows that you're always ready to protect your family, and all that they hold dear.

name: Blessed Blade of Power
description: These rare Knights are affiliated with the Order of Paladins, but channel a special type of light magic which melds with their armor, hair, and weapons over time.

name: Blessed Blade of the North
description: These ghostly blade appears in the hands of the High Kings and Queens of the North while they ride into battle, signaling the blessing of the Avatar of Ice.

name: Blessed Frostguarde Blade
description: Created by the magic of the first Champion of Ice, these blades were bestowed upon her protectors. Just a touch could freeze your blood solid.

name: Blessed Naval Cutlass (AC)
description: Who said pirates can't have a good side? These peaceful privateer's work hard to shine pirates in a better light.

name: Blessed Naval Cutlass (Special)
description: Who said pirates can't have a good side? These peaceful privateer's work hard to shine pirates in a better light.

name: Blessed Rose Blade
description: A pristine blade, blessed by a white rose. It's meant to be wielded by two hands, yours and your dearly beloved's.

name: Blessed Rune Blade of Hope
description: This artifact from the Battle of the Dawn forged by Dracometus was once stolen by a powerful dragon. It was said to be wielded by the divine leprechauns.

name: Blessed Sword of Salvation
description: May salvation find you, even if all seems lost.

name: Blessing of Chadough (Sword)
description: This weapon was crafted just for Chadough, winner of the July Custom Weapon prize. It has 15% XP, CP, Gold, and Rep boosts, plus does 15% more damage to all monsters. Congratulations, Chadough!

name: Blight Blade
description: Enter the blighted, wasted lands ruled by the tyrannical Titans and you'll find that this blade will serve you beyond all others of its class.

name: Blight Oracle Dagger
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Protect yourself. A dagger can be easily hidden in a sleeve.

name: BlightFall Commander Blade (0 AC)
description: A fierce weapon for battle but its gold trimmings give the look of subtle elegance.

name: BlightFall Commander Blade (AC)
description: A fierce weapon for battle but its gold trimmings give the look of subtle elegance.

name: Blinding Blade of Destiny
description: Stop the bloodshed! No longer will the power cower from the evil that has plagued the land!

name: Blinding BrightShield Blade
description: Bestowed to those who fight for Good! The gold and white symbolize the true Heroes of Swordhaven.

name: Blinding Broadsword of Destiny
description: You've finally become the hero that everyone has needed!

name: Blinding Caladbolg
description: Find your sunglasses! This purified version of the infamous Caladbolg can eradicate darkness with its brilliance.

name: Blinding Edge
description: A heavy blade used by those who fight for the side of good. They fight… for their right… to smite!

name: Blinding Edge of the Good
description: Victory often comes to those who fight long and hard just like this sword who has found its rightful owner after offering patronage to a giving marketplace.

name: Blinding Gladius of Victory
description: The quickest way to disarm an opponent is a slash through the shoulder.

name: Blinding Igneus Blade
description: Igneus warriors have to stand the heat of this blade before they can go into battle.

name: Blinding Rage Katana
description: Hakuna Katana, what a wonderful blade! It means no defeats for the rest of your days! It's a problem-free key to victory! Hakuna Katana!

name: Blister's Chainsaw
description: Somehow, I don't think he used this to cut down timber.

name: Blood Energy Katana
description: This is the key to a new order. This katana means freedom.

name: Blood Fire
description: This is chilling weapon is one of a set of two. Blood Fire can burn the blood of whomever is struck with it.

name: Blood Guardian's Sword
description: No mangy dogs will defeat the Vampires, Queen Safiria will rise again!

name: Blood Hanzo Void Katana
description: You are a Crimson Horror, slashing through the night, killing all in your sight. Gives +15% Class Points when equipped.

name: Blood Ice
description: This is chilling weapon is one of a set of two. Blood Ice can cast a frost over the soul of whomever is struck with it.

name: Blood Isle Corsair's Cutlass
description: When these vampiric blades have their fill of Werewolves, they turn on their kin. Plunder the treasure in their veins. It tastes sweeter if they scream.

name: Blood Moon Cleaver
description: *No description*

name: Blood Needle
description: This will be sure to prick your foes and make them bleed.

name: Blood of the Mountain
description: Mountain give me sword. Not sure how big rock give sword, BUT DID.

name: Blood of the Void Blade
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword hold power beyond compare.

name: Blood Oni Bat
description: This spiked bat is carried by warriors sworn to serve the ravenous Blood Oni of Yokai. The Blood Oni Dedicants are some of the islands most terrifying warriors.

name: Blood Oni Wakizashi
description: This Wakizashi is carried by warriors sworn to serve the ravenous Blood Oni of Yokai. The Blood Oni Dedicants are some of the islands most terrifying warriors.

name: Blood Rage Cutlass (AC)
description: A selfish blade that hungers to spill blood in righteous fury. For their tainted steel and their wielder, justice is a delusion.

name: Blood Rage Cutlass (Non-AC)
description: A selfish blade that hungers to spill blood in righteous fury. For their tainted steel and their wielder, justice is a delusion.

name: Blood Rage Sword
description: A selfish blade that hungers to spill blood in righteous fury. For its tainted steel and their wielder, justice is a delusion.

name: Blood Rose Sword
description: Roses are red, thorns are grey. Not all that is neatly decorated is as they seem and this hold true for blood-colored roses.

name: Blood Scripture Blade
description: The language of the Bright One eerily resembles the growls of the Infernal.

name: Blood Scripture Key
description: The language of the Bright One eerily resembles the growls of the Infernal.

name: Blood Star Blade
description: Bring down the stars with this blade!

name: Blood Sworn Daikatana
description: These warriors serve a powerful master, they've sworn an oath only to him. The price? Their own blood.

name: Bloodbinder Katana
description: A mythical blade crafted by a secret sect of Yokai swordsmen. The blood of your enemies calls to this blade, making it harder and harder to avoid battle.

name: Bloodbiter Blade
description: The Sanguine Shields serve as royal bodyguards for Vampire Queen Safiria. They are some of her most loyal devotees.

name: Bloodblade of Nulgath
description: Look closely. Are those…eyes?

name: BloodBlade of Vokun
description: Originally the blade was silver but years of bloody soaked battles has discolored it.

name: Bloodborne DragonsFang Blade
description: Plague Knights use the infectious powers of this sword to increase the delay rate of their victims brains if things are going to plan.

name: Bloodborne Knight's Edge
description: Your prestigious reward for purchasing the vampire t-shirt from Heromart!

name: Bloodborne Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Bloodbound Void Katana (0 AC)
description: Bloodbound Void Warriors wear an armor infused with the blood of their first opponent slain in battle. It is a gruesome method of crafting a supremely valuable piece of battle gear.

name: Bloodbound Void Katana (AC)
description: Bloodbound Void Warriors wear an armor infused with the blood of their first opponent slain in battle. It is a gruesome method of crafting a supremely valuable piece of battle gear.

name: Blooddrop Slasher
description: A remarkably sharp curved blade, designed for the most skilled DoomKnights in all of Skullholme.

name: Bloodfang Blade
description: A crimson streak in battle… the last thing a dragon sees before the end.

name: BloodFire Chainsword
description: Blood red blade, golden chains for added abuse, this blade will do whatever you want. Cut down an enemy or tease them with quick slices, followed by a whipping of gold. Either way, this blade is guaranteed to inflict pain and take care of your opposition.

name: Bloodgroove
description: The blade of an ancient Barbarian Warlord turned Vampire Hunter after the slaughter of his family.

name: Bloodhunt Void Blade (0 AC)
description: Ever since Nulgath was betrayed, his loyal followers have begun to fuse the skulls and blood of their enemies into weapons that scream. They look to add to their collection, and please their Master.

name: Bloodhunt Void Blade (AC)
description: Ever since Nulgath was betrayed, his loyal followers have begun to fuse the skulls and blood of their enemies into weapons that scream. They look to add to their collection, and please their Master.

name: Bloodletter Katana
description: A bloodthirty weapon made from Carnage's body, requiring focus and a sharp mind. The maddening rituals he withstood were meant to test the strength of his resolve and loyalty.

name: Bloodlust Dirk
description: As a member of Vampire Queen Safiria's royal blood court, all nobles are expected to serve with absolute loyalty ruthlessness, and in consummate style.

name: Bloodmoon Faerie's Claymore
description: The faeries dance under a bloody moon, singing a song of death and doom; I saw pale kings and princes, too / Pale warriors, death-pale were they all / They cried: La Belle Dame de la Nuit / Hath thee in thrall!

name: Bloodriver
description: This blade was forged in another dimension, made from Nexusteel and sharpened against the edge of reality itself. Impressive, right?

name: Bloodsea Captain's Cutlass
description: Remember pirates don't take prisoners. So there will be blood on the high seas tonight.

name: BloodShield Blade
description: The Sanguine Shields serve royal bodyguards for Vampire Queen Safiria. They are some of her most loyal devotees.

name: Bloodthirsty Scytheblade (AC)
description: A hooked sword, styled like a Vampire's fangs. They aren't of Shadowslayer origin, but the hunters of the dark covet this fearful weapon. It can stab a heart, and drag it out of a Vampire's body with ease.

name: Bloodthirsty Scytheblade (Non-AC)
description: A hooked sword, styled like a Vampire's fangs. They aren't of Shadowslayer origin, but the hunters of the dark covet this fearful weapon. It can stab a heart, and drag it out of a Vampire's body with ease.

name: BloodVoid Knight's Greatsword
description: More heavily armored than their un-Knighted breathen, BloodVoid Knights are used to hunt Nulgath the ArchFiend's unluckiest prey. They hide in the shadows, attacking his victims when they least expect it.

name: BloodVoid Knight's Longsword
description: More heavily armored than their un-Knighted breathen, BloodVoid Knights are used to hunt Nulgath the ArchFiend's unluckiest prey. They hide in the shadows, attacking his victims when they least expect it.

name: Bloody Samurai Katana
description: By decree of the Warlord of Yokai Isle, only the truest, bravest warriors are worthy of equipping the Blood Samurai gear.

name: Bloody UndeadSlayer Sword
description: It's time to hack, slash, and stab your way through any opposition.

name: Blooming Katana
description: Drawing its power from the sun, this sleek katana flourishes with foilage. The Blooming Katana is as much of a symbol of life and rebirth as it is a symbol of great honor and power.

name: Blooming Pine Ember
description: This emerald green sword is unique. There are none like it in the world and only you may be able to possess the power within. The ember blade beats with your heart, and the greater your heart the greater the blade.

name: Blooming Rose Ember
description: This blushing pink sword is unique. There are none like it in the world and only you may be able to possess the power within. The ember blade beats with your heart, and the greater your heart the greater the blade.

name: Bludrut Blade
description: This is it! The fabled Bludrut Blade! (Infinity Exclusive)

name: Blue Balloon Sword
description: *boing* Not really good for a serious fight, but AWESOME for playfighting.

name: Blue Dragon Scimitar (0 AC)
description: Ye been warned about these pirates, the sting of the electric eel runs through their veins.

name: Blue Dragon Scimitar (AC)
description: Ye been warned about these pirates, the sting of the electric eel runs through their veins.

name: Blue Dragon Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Blue Giftbox Sword
description: Sometimes you just want to run around dressed like a giant gift box!

name: Blue Light Sword
description: You'll cut your hand off! You'll cut your hand off!

name: Blue Raspberry Ice Pop
description: Mmmm! Chill out with a blue raspberry ice pop. Who knows? Maybe the monsters you're defending against will want one, too.

name: Blue Sneevil Chainsaw
description: Blue is definitely your color. Seems like it doesn't work all the time though…

name: Blue Sonic Blade
description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, they must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

name: Blue Tachyon Blade
description: Often mistaken for a short-ranged gun, the blade flies straight at the target regardless of distance. If aimed correctly, it will never miss.

name: Blue Vitriol Dagger
description: A crystal dagger with acidic properties, rumored to have been forged from the wrath of the mountains. You aren't sure if it's actually made of copper sulfate, but the color matches well enough.

name: Blueblood Blade
description: Honor those the vampires heed, in thought and favor, word and deed.

name: Boar's Guard Sword
description: These ham-tastic set celebrates the Year of the Pig! Slice your enemies into bacon stripes!

name: Bog Hunter's Blade
description: What lurks in the muddy bogs? Monsters most definitely, but with them lay treasures perfectly preserved in time. This blade cuts through the rot in search, and eventually embodies the decay of the bog.

name: Bogslayer
description: Don't be bogged down by a heavy weapon! Despite its size, the Bogslayer is surprisingly light and slices through the air with ease like a musty swamp breeze.

name: Boiled Prawn Rapier
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Bold Tobolica (0 AC)
description: An elegant and noble blade, subtly embellished with ermine fur. It's more or less a statement of what the BeastMaster's favorite critter is.

name: Bold Tobolica (AC)
description: An elegant and noble blade, subtly embellished with ermine fur. It's more or less a statement of what the BeastMaster's favorite critter is.

name: BoltStriker Blade
description: This blade, enhanced by the power of lightning will cause any foe struck with it to have their minds rotten to the core.

name: BoltStriker Claymore
description: This blade, enhanced by the power of lightning will cause any foe struck with it to have their minds rotten to the core.

name: Bom Velhinho Blade
description: Spread the Frostval spirit world-wide with this jolly red sword!

name: Bone Bane Blade
description: Combining the powerful crystals with the magically enchanted bones you've found, this sword seems to hurt the undead more than other weapons do.

name: Bone Blade Inferno
description: The Infernal Flames' horns don't stop growing. They tear out the growths, and use them to tear open their enemies. Fire catches the blood, burning them to nothing.

name: Bone Claw
description: For those who know what you did last Friday the 13th.

name: Bone Claymore
description: Made from the spine of a slaughtered Turdrakolich.

name: Bone Quaker Betrayal Blade
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to crush the spine of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Unidentified 65 (Bone Slasher)
description: Also known as the Bone Slasher, it seems an unknown warlord crafted the sword from a very powerful dracolich…

name: Bone Sword
description: Sword of bones.

name: Boneblade of Gorgorath
description: These warriors, loyal to the dragon Gorgorath, craft their weapons with the bones of the dragon's prey.

name: Bonebreaker Naval Crusher (0 AC)
description: Crossing the sea to find more bones to break. We're comin' fer ya!

name: Bonebreaker Naval Crusher (AC)
description: Crossing the sea to find more bones to break. We're comin' fer ya!

name: Bonebreaker Naval Gutter (0 AC)
description: Crossing the sea to find more bones to break. We're comin' fer ya!

name: Bonebreaker Naval Gutter (AC)
description: Crossing the sea to find more bones to break. We're comin' fer ya!

name: Bonebreaker Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: BoneChilling Carver
description: You will not be able to survive these harsh conditions as well as the edge of my blade!

name: Bonefang Blade
description: Legend says that in other timelines, the Bonefang had the power to summon an Undead Steed for warriors to ride on. This version is not magical, but make no bones about it, it can still skewer an enemy.

name: Bonefang Blade of DOOM
description: The Bonefang has always been connected to the Undead and now, whatever power YOU contain has fully revived its connection to the Darkness… and to DOOM!

name: Bonefiend Manslayer's Katana (0 AC)
description: You’re a BONE-afied, certified, fiendishly destructive ManSlayer. Nulgath gave you his Seal of Approval once you proved your worth to the Nation.

name: Bonefiend Manslayer's Katana (AC)
description: You’re a BONE-afied, certified, fiendishly destructive ManSlayer. Nulgath gave you his Seal of Approval once you proved your worth to the Nation.

name: BoneFire Warlord's Burning Cleaver (0 AC)
description: Do not stare too deeply into the flames… you wil become trapped in the flickering soulfire, and it will be your DOOM.

name: BoneFire Warlord's Burning Cleaver (AC)
description: Do not stare too deeply into the flames… you wil become trapped in the flickering soulfire, and it will be your DOOM.

name: BoneSaw's Saw
description: With a hack hack here and a slash slash there…

name: Bonespar Rapier
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones' locker.

name: Booger Blade
description: "Pick" on someone your own size! Warning: should not be used when digging for gold.

name: Boost Ram
description: Crafted by Boost Ram, the hilt of his sword is lined with the skulls of the champions that have fallen to its blade.

name: Boreal Cavalier Blade (0 AC)
description: Legend says that creator of this weapon pulled its essence straight from the aurora borealis.

name: Boreal Cavalier Blade (AC)
description: Legend says that creator of this weapon pulled its essence straight from the aurora borealis.

name: Boreal Katana (AC)
description: By Khazri's breath and blessing, Boreal Warriors harness the winds to do their bidding… blasting destruction or bringing salvation to the lands they journey through.

name: Boreal Katana (Non-AC)
description: By Khazri's breath and blessing, Boreal Warriors harness the winds to do their bidding… blasting destruction or bringing salvation to the lands they journey through.

name: Borgrix Guardian's Blade
description: We are Borgrix, resistance will not be tolerated.

name: Borked Blade of Dragon Control
description: Rumor has it that a royal princess once wielded this. But don't believe everything you hear. Anyway, something shattered it, so you have have it for half off. HAH! Half off, get it?

name: Botanical Reaper
description: You unlocked this sword by supporting Biobeasts! The trapped creatures of the lab thank you!

name: Bound Sword of Serekh
description: Symbols of kingship adore this blade. Whosoever wields this sword is destined for royalty.

name: Bounded Blade
description: Stare too long into the eyes engraved on this blade's hilt and your soul will be eternally bound to Darkness.

name: Bounty Hunter Blade
description: Well if anything this might blind your opponents into submission.

name: Bounty Hunter's Dealbreaker
description: When you go hunting for Fiends, your blades will need to tear into them and their contracts. The Nation keeps close tabs on promises undone.

name: BountyHunter Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: BountyHunter Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Box Guardian Blade
description: This great blade is wielded by the mighty Box Guardians of the sneevil people.

name: Boxhead Shrade Great Machete
description: Do NOT open the box. The horrors that await you will feast on your dreams. And screams.

name: Brabo Encantado
description: The first cry for justice inspired the people to stand up for themselves, and each other. Their dreams became gold, sharpening into a blade that will carve the way to the future.

name: Brabo Retumbante
description: The first cry for justice inspired the people to stand up for themselves, and each other. Their dreams became gold, sharpening into blades that will carve the way to the future.

name: Bramble Blame Blade
description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but Heroes and Paladins can't handle the weight. Thorns creep towards its masters hands as it thirsts for their sullied blood.

name: Bramble Ivory Blame Blade
description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but Heroes and Paladins can't handle the weight. Thorns creep towards its masters hands as it thirsts for their sullied blood.

name: Brand of Glory
description: Your work has paid off, here is your reward!

name: Breath of Oblivion Blade (0 AC)
description: So ye be join' the Nation's crew? Dun think he'll be goin' any easy on ye scurry rat then Dage would. Nulgath will do more than simply lock ye in the brig Serve him well.

name: Breath of Oblivion Blade (AC)
description: So ye be join' the Nation's crew? Dun think he'll be goin' any easy on ye scurry rat then Dage would. Nulgath will do more than simply lock ye in the brig Serve him well.

name: Breath of Oblivion Katana (0 AC)
description: So ye be join' the Nation's crew? Dun think he'll be goin' any easy on ye scurry rat then Dage would. Nulgath will do more than simply lock ye in the brig. Serve him well.

name: Breath of Oblivion Katana (AC)
description: So ye be join' the Nation's crew? Dun think he'll be goin' any easy on ye scurry rat then Dage would. Nulgath will do more than simply lock ye in the brig. Serve him well.

name: Bright Astravian Rapier
description: This isn't steel or iron. The synthetic material created with Astravia's now forbidden technology can't be forged by any other means, even magical. It's said to never rust, or melt in lava.

name: Bright Blade (1)
description: Battle your foes with a blade edged in pure light!

name: Bright Blade (2)
description: The Bright Blade shines brighter than any battleaxe known to mankind. Step aside, Blinding Light of Destiny!

name: Bright Blade of Champions
description: This enchanted sword captures every moment of their owner's life and its glistening light leaves a bitter reminder that as a hero, you will always be ill-fated.

name: Bright Blade of Deception
description: Drawn from the energy of the skies, electrify your foes with the power of Krenos.

name: Bright Blade of Destiny
description: It's time to protect the people from all the bloodshed!

name: Bright Blade of Light
description: Using spells calling on the Light, these Battlemages are feared throughout the darker parts of Lore.

name: Bright Blade of Protection
description: Sworn to protect and serve, the Celestial Templar Guardians will defend any who seek refuge from the terrors that lurk in the Shadows.

name: Bright Blade of the ArchAngel
description: All hail ArchAngel Nulgath, greatest guardian the Mirror Realm has ever known! Defend him with your blade, your breath, and if need be, your blood.

name: Bright Blade of the Sunhawks
description: Discovered buried deep within a previously unknown tomb by the HarpySlayers while on assignment, these mystical weapons glow with a sinister purple light.

name: Bright BloodDrinker Blade
description: A blade that resembles a living creature rather than a weapon. You can see the blood coursing through its… veins?

name: Bright Broadsword of Destiny
description: You are on your way to becoming the hero that everyone needs.

name: Bright DragonKnight Blade
description: The Bright Dragon Knights of Swordhaven are an elite squad of warriors. Wielding light magic is a bonus, but not required to join.

name: Bright Faerie's Claymore
description: Over hill, over dale, thorough bush, thorough brier, over park and pale, through flood, through fire, the Faerie Queen's knights wander everywhere. Their quest? To bring her Summer's jewels to enchant and dazzle mortal fools.

name: Bright Guardian of Time Blade
description: You are Lore's Hero, and the safety of all our universes and timelines depend up YOU. Fight for good, and defend our worlds from those that would harm it.

name: Bright Mana Flame Sabre
description: The Elemental Avatars act through their Champions on Lore, prevented from connecting to the Mana Core that is the heart of our world. Should the flame of its power be extinguished, the spirit of our world itself would die out.

name: Bright New Hero Blade
description: Congratulations! You are one of the brightest new heroes this world has ever seen! You will do great things!

name: Bright Nymph's Honor
description: "In Her name I will slay thee and all that is Evil!"

name: Bright Officer's Blade
description: Whether you are a Paladin, Litch, BeastHunter, or Void HighLord… whatever class, role, or alignment you choose, it's important to take time to celebrate the holidays with your family and friends.

name: Bright Officer's Kunai
description: Whether you are a Paladin, Litch, BeastHunter, or Void HighLord… whatever class, role, or alignment you choose, it's important to take time to celebrate the holidays with your family and friends.

name: Bright Paladin's Sword
description: For junior paladins in training.

name: Bright Rypt Sword
description: Once the weapon of the mighty paladin, Rypt, this sword fell into obscurity a century ago. Recently is was found at the bottom of a well in Arcangrove. How it got there is a mystery. Suggested by AQW player Vultex023.

name: Bright SnowAngel's FrostBlade (AC)
description: No matter how dark the night, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Bright SnowAngel's FrostBlade (Non-AC)
description: No matter how dark the night, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Bright SoulSeeker (AC)
description: Straight from Dage's Soulforge, and empowered by the rage and hatred of those who have passed on. This sword was made to stamp out all things good and beautiful.

name: Bright SoulSeeker (Legend)
description: Straight from Dage's Soulforge, and empowered by the rage and hatred of those who have passed on. This sword was made to stamp out all things good and beautiful.

name: Bright Star's Blade
description: Silent Knight, holy knight, let my light bless your might!

name: Bright Victory Blade
description: Never challenge a swordsmith unless you a willing to feel the wrath of their blade!

name: Bright Warlord of Nulgath Blade (0 AC)
description: Bending the light energies of the void are what these devotees of Nulgah do best. These champions thrive when returning the world to time of peace and prosperity.

name: Bright Warlord of Nulgath Blade (AC)
description: Bending the light energies of the void are what these devotees of Nulgah do best. These champions thrive when returning the world to time of peace and prosperity.

name: Bright Wrapping Paper Blade
description: Wreck the halls with blades or wrapping, fa lalalalaaaaaa la la la LA!

name: Brightblade of Joy
description: The Northlands Ranger travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: BrightFall Commander Blade
description: A fierce weapon for battle but its gold trimmings give the look of subtle elegance.

name: BrightFrost Elf Sword
description: Elves are some of the most resourceful beings in Lore. Even the colds of the Northlands cannot keep these skilled warriors away.

name: Brightoak Avenger Blade
description: Those who desire revitalization in their passions and self-esteem will find comfort grasping the blade cut from pure emerald. Look inside the hilt to find a lone spirit that will let you know that you are not alone.

name: Brightoak Poison Sword
description: Watch yourself around this poisonous plant, one poke will send you to the nearest healer.

name: Brightoak Raven Sword
description: I'm not saying stabbing anyone with this will make them explode in a green magic scented fireball. But I'm not DENYING it either.

name: Brightoak Salvation Blade
description: Those who desire revitalization in their passions and self-esteem will find comfort grasping the blade cut from pure emerald. Look inside the hilt to find a lone spirit that will let you know that you are not alone.

name: BrightScythe Claymore
description: Such a behemoth of a blade is capable of trembling walls down to rubble in one swift slash, allowing escape from the depths of an abyss to be a piece of cake.

name: Brightscythe Katana
description: Swift like the shinobi, this blade could cut the wind in half.

name: Brikebeiner Ice Claymore
description: Birkebeiner was an ice dragon that was said to have crawled out of the Underworld. It was hungry for Kings but a dragonlord defeated it in combat, and urged it to travel to the Northlands with them in search of better prey.

name: Brikebeiner Soul Claymore
description: Birkebeiner was an ice dragon that was said to have crawled out of the Underworld. It was hungry for Kings but a dragonlord defeated it in combat, and urged it to travel to the Northlands with them in search of better prey.

name: Brilliant Beacon Blade
description: This celestial sword was crafted by Bido for Gjappy. It is a beacon of hope, and now they are sharing it with you!

name: Brilliant Brightscythe Claymore
description: The ONLY weapon regal enough for the Brightscythe Warriors.

name: Brilliant Cutlass
description: Ye mates be wantin' to trade doubloons for ye treasure sword. Tell them to walk the plank!

name: Brilliant Heavy Holy Blade
description: This was once an ordinary Heavy Holy Blade from Doomwoog… but no longer! Now your giant golden blade will shine even more brightly as you smash the undead.

name: Brilliant Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword is one of two designed and built for the AQW's 6th Upholders on the game's sixth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Brilliant Sword of Cosmic Fate
description: Forged with the magical energy from the star you were born under. Cosmic dust coalesced into magnificent steel. The shape of your heart and destiny is a righteous sword.

name: Broad Sword
description: A basic but sturdy blade. Nothing fancy about it.

name: Broad Werepyre Blade
description: Much like a Werepyre, this hybrid blade deals devastating blows to anything on the receiving end.

name: Broadsword of Bane
description: Only the screams of their torment is what you will hear.

name: Broadsword of Destiny
description: Only a wielder of this broadsword possesses the qualities to be a true hero.

name: Broadsword of the Chaorrupted Fang
description: The origins of this sword remains a mystery, lost beneath the Chaos that engulfs it. Those that wield it may one day share the same fate. A design inspired by your fellow player, Blake Don.

name: Broken Blade
description: I wonder where the other piece is? This sword of the rock elemental is a wonder.

name: Broken Horseshoe Blade
description: This sword harnesses the bad luck of a shattered horseshoe. Weapon not recommended for cavalry use.

name: Broken Split Blade of the Deep
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: a ghostly hand grasps this blade aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… it is a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Broken Zweihander
description: How do you break a sword this strong? I guess someone must've hit some really REALLY hard.

name: Bronco Hand of Domination 16
description: Cheer for your favorite patriotic team!

name: Broncolich Hand Of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite undead destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Bronze Destroyer
description: This blade is one of only a handful of swords given to some of the greatest heroes in Lore!

name: Bronze ShortSword
description: A good starter weapon for those just beginning their journey.

name: Broodmaster Plague
description: Your Dreadspider brethren are nesting in this blade, and their venom coats its edges Together, you will conquer. Together, you will crush the arrogant surface dwellers.

name: Broodmaster Venom
description: Your Dreadspider brethren are nesting in this blade, and their venom coats its edges Together, you will conquer. Together, you will crush the arrogant surface dwellers

name: Brown Dragon Scimitar (0 AC)
description: A naval whose uniform matches the color of stone are oftentimes well-respected by their mateys for their dependability and honesty, even though they tell the occasional tall tales.

name: Brown Dragon Scimitar (AC)
description: A naval whose uniform matches the color of stone are oftentimes well-respected by their mateys for their dependability and honesty, even though they tell the occasional tall tales.

name: Brown Dragon Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Brutal Battle Blade
description: This sword is gifted to the most promising heroes who train in Oaklore Keep.

name: Brutal Cam-PAIN Blade
description: You got this blade for discovering the code to our MegaCon 2014 reward sword! Grats!

name: Brutal Sword
description: Looks just like a certain dagger, but bigger!

name: Brutal Wolf Blade
description: The epic blades wielded by Lycans, the premier hunters of Dage's Legion.

name: Brute Strength
description: Masterfully crafted, this sword displays the sheer brute strength of a Fire Dragon. Only the strongest warrior can handle this sword. Do you have what it takes? Or should you be sent back down the ranks for dragonet training?

name: Bunny Blade
description: Distract your foes with this adorableness of this bunny sword before you slash them with the razor sharp ears or pummel them with the tail mace! Dangerously cute!

name: Bunny Popsicle
description: A cold popsicle for the summer, now with two ears attached.

name: Burning Blade (1)
description: So we heard you like skulls on your sword. So we put skulls on skulls. And on fire! This blade is a truly fearsome sight!

name: Burning Blade (2)
description: A blade forged from Brimstone and Hellfire.

name: Burning Blade Of Abezeth
description: Drenched in the suffering of others, this blade once wielded by Abezeth crackles with energy when it's master is close.

name: Burning Freeze
description: "Huh. This looks pretty cool. *gives it a click* Whoa. WHOA." -Unsuspecting item tester

name: Burning Igneus Blade
description: Igneus warriors have to stand the heat of this blade before they can go into battle.

name: Burning Phoenix Blade
description: Reborn from the ashes, now a burning new blade.

name: Burning Pointe's Edge
description: This sword is hot hot hot! The runes burn revealing the magic infused in the blade.

name: Burning Ruby Blade
description: The heart of the flame burns brightest in those mages willing to sacrifice everything for their power.

name: Burning Sapphire Blade
description: The heart of the flame burns brightest in those mages willing to sacrifice everything for their power.

name: Burning Sun Blade (Merge)
description: The sun shines brightly over the island of Yokai, thanks in large part to the patronage of the Sunlord and Sunlady. Show respect to those who renew the light at the beginning of each day.

name: Burning Sun Blade (Wheel)
description: The sun shines brightly over the island of Yokai, thanks in large part to the patronage of the Sunlord and Sunlady. Show respect to those who renew the light at the beginning of each day.

name: Burning Sword of Doom
description: An infamous blade touched by relentless fire. The blade has become jagged and burns to the touch. If there was a Shadow that hid inside, it has now been irrevocably changed. Such is the nature of molten flame.

name: Busterline of Souls
description: Great for stabbing OR slicing, this wicked blade crafted by Evokersoul is a wise warrior's best friend.

name: Butcher's Carver
description: The leg bone is disconnected from hip bone! The head is disconnected from the neck bone!

name: Butterfly Sword
description: Don't try to catch this with a net! Butterfly Swords come in pairs that are cleverly nested together so they appear to be one blade, not two.

name: Byakko's Wind Cutter Katana
description: The white tiger has long been recognized as the true "king of the beasts." He is most honorable and worthy of your worship. If you serve him with a pure heart and absolute virtue, you will be rewarded.

name: Caladbacon Blade
description: *sizzle sizzle* SLAY

name: Caladblue Sword of DOOM
description: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOO! (I hope you saved your progress.)

name: Caladboard
description: Wielding Caladboard, you will be able to chop the heads off an entire army of undead paper dolls!

name: Caladbolg
description: Wielding Caladbolg, you will be able to chop the heads off your enemies and the tops off hills!

name: Caladbolg 3017
description: The future is now, but the Darkness is eternal… and so is Dage's Undead Legion.

name: Caladbolg of Cheer
description: When Dage and Gravelyn of the Mirror Realm looked back at the blade, Caladbolg had matched itself with its master's festive red. And soon, it wil give a shower of snowflakes, too!

name: Caladboogly
description: Fighting for the Undead Legion can drive the weak-minded insane. When they lose their minds, their Caladbolgs reflect that. You've picked up the sword from one of those unfortunate warriors.

name: Caladgourd Blade
description: This gear was made so the Undead Legion could… SQUASH… the competition.

name: Calamitous Event
description: This sword of catastrophic might protects you from all the world may throw at you.

name: Candy Corn Crusher Blade
description: This candy corn was melted, molded, and tempered by the flames of a thousand jack-o-lanterns. It'll cut through bones, and shatter teeth.

name: Candycorn Sword
description: This sweet treat might look corny, but you can make your enemies eat dirt if you wield it well.

name: Cangaceiro's Peixeira
description: Determinação. Fidelidade. Dignidade. Justiça.

name: Captain's Plasma Blade
description: This blade's technology can pierce almost any kind of armor.

name: Captain Wary's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Y'know how they say "Beware of Pirates"? Well, y'should be extra wary of this one!

name: Captain Wary's Cutlass (AC)
description: Y'know how they say "Beware of Pirates"? Well, y'should be extra wary of this one!

name: Captive
description: The eye of all-knowing; holds us fugitive even inside our own feeble mind.

name: CardBlade
description: You recieved this Color Custom CardBlade from your purchase of the AQW Battle Card Game. You can use these blades to surgically remove the Heart of the Cards. Matches your Eye color.

name: Cardboard Chainsaw
description: Wow, these actors had a HUGE budget. Not.

name: Cardboard of Awe
description: Could this be the real thing? Oh… no. But it is a GREAT, low-cost reproduction! Perfect for cosplaying or trick-or-treating at Mogloween.

name: Cardboard Sword
description: Made from 100% recycled empty toilet paper rolls but somehow hits just as hard as any other blade. Going green rocks on Earth Day and everyday!

name: Cardboard Sword of Oblivion
description: It may not be the real thing, but it'll do when you Battle paper mache Sneevils in their Box town.

name: Cardletter Katana
description: Not meant for duels in the rain.

name: Carmine Cutter
description: This blade is usually wielded by the commanding fishman generals, but has now been dyed pink for the Pink-o-mancer. This sword embodies the the power of pink!

name: Carnax Disciple's Dagger
description: The Alpha are a cult of psionic sorcerers whose leader created Carnax in another timeline. Your task is to do whatever you can to protect and defend this creature… no matter where or when it appears.

name: Carnax Laser Sword
description: Magic lasers. When laser lasers just don't cut it.

name: Carnelian Dragon Scale Sword
description: This elegant sword is crafted from scales of a Camelian dragon for elemental resistance!

name: Carrotene Cutter
description: With the Carrotene Cutter, Vitamin A stands for AWESOME.

name: Cavern Strike
description: All they will see is darkness, but all you will hear are their cries and screams! Parts are color custom.

name: Celebration Blade
description: A wooden toy given to aspiring new heroes during one of the most special days in Battleon. They'll be next year's greatest Warriors.

name: Celebration by Fireworks
description: Feliz Ano Novo! Manigong Bagong Taon! Joyeux Nouvel An! Xin Nian Hao! S Novim Godom! Frohes Neues Jahr! Felice Anno Nuovo! Happy New Year!

name: Celebration Dagger
description: A wooden toy given to aspiring new heroes during one of the most special days in Battleon. They'll be accomplished Rogues in no time.

name: Celebration Katana
description: These are ornate and very decorative katanas but don't let the appearance fool you. This weapon is for serious warriors.

name: Celebratory Skewer
description: You're supposed to skewer the lime for the coconut drink, not make the lime itself into the skewer! Taste the sting of citrus!

name: Celestia's Blade
description: Belongs to Lady Celestia, but if you prove yourself to be heroic enough, she might let you borrow it.

name: Celestial Abyss Blade
description: The fall is inevitable. Fate and the abyss are one and the same.

name: Celestial ArchFiend Sword
description: Smite Evil in the name of justice and all that is good? Definitely not anymore, but the Nation finds these weapons invaluable. They have Evil rivals after all.

name: Celestial Avenger Blade
description: Those who desire revitalization in their passions and self-esteem will find comfort grasping the blade cut from pure emerald. Look inside the hilt to find a lone spirit that will let you know that you are not alone.

name: Celestial Beacon Blade
description: This celestial sword was crafted by Bido for Gjappy. It is a beacon of hope, and now they are sharing it with you!

name: Celestial Blade Of Awe (AC)
description: The Blade of Awe, a legendary artifact of untold power, has been blessed by a Celestial Knight. (This weapon will give 25% more gold when equipped)

name: Celestial Blade Of Awe (Non-AC)
description: The Blade of Awe, artifact of untold power, has been blessed by a Celestial Knight.

name: Celestial Blade of Judgement
description: The bells will toll, and all will answer. No one will escape judgement.

name: Celestial Commander's Plank
description: Whether you sail the seas or the skies, victory is always within your reach.(Item does 30% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Celestial Commander's Sword
description: Whether you sail the seas or the skies, victory is always within your reach.(Item does 30% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Celestial ForceBlade
description: When the light fades, the fall approaches. When this happens, the monsters begin to run.

name: Celestial Khopesh
description: Battle the undead with the power of moonlight! This weapon will do 35% more damage against undead when equipped.

name: Celestial Love Sword
description: With Beleen's unbirthday right around the corner, Sayn had no trouble pinkifying his favourite sword. Hopefully, the same can be said with you when you wield it.

name: Celestial Naval Cutlass (AC)
description: Who said pirates can't have a good side? These peaceful privateer's work hard to shine pirates in a better light.

name: Celestial Naval Cutlass (Special)
description: Who said pirates can't have a good side? These peaceful privateer's work hard to shine pirates in a better light.

name: Celestial Sandsword
description: Defend the helpless and help the defenseless. With the blade of the Sandknights, you are honorbound to aid those who need it.

name: Celestial Slayer's Blade
description: Infused with evil this blade seeks out Light to destroy it.

name: Celestial StarBlade
description: Infused with starlight!

name: Celestial Starsaber
description: The light of this weapon came from a radiant ancestor. Their eyes are as numerous as the stars. Even now, they watch the progress of the progeny.

name: Celestial Summoner Blade
description: A blade forged in honor of Aranx, Guardian of the Celestial Realm!

name: Celestial Sword of Nulgath (AC)
description: During the days that Nulgath could freely see the once peaceful world, he found a broken statue in a stone village long forgotten. Enticed by the feminine face and sensing the pure light fading away, Nulgath took the statue and made into his signature sword so that light can be everlasting.

name: Celestial Sword of Nulgath (Legend)
description: During the days that Nulgath could freely see the once peaceful world, he found a broken statue in a stone village long forgotten. Enticed by feminine face and sensing the pure light fading away, Nulgath took took the statue and made into his signature sword so that light can be everlasting.

name: Celtic Hunter Blade
description: This epic Celtic Hunter Blade is from a dimension far, far away… one where your luck, skill, and strength in battle will lead you to VICTORY!

name: Ceremonial Dragon Blade (AC)
description: A sword of grand importance, forged in honor of you a great Dragonlord who fought through chaos and shadows, prevailing over all.

name: Ceremonial Dragon Blade (Non-AC)
description: A sword of grand importance, forged in honor of you a great Dragonlord who fought through chaos and shadows, prevailing over all.

name: Ceremonial Iron Sickle
description: This sickle is used by Zot when she invokes the power of Iron in ancient Horc ceremonies. The iron in the sickle sings to the veins of iron in the mountain, invoking its presence in the ritual.

name: Ceremonial Jade Katana
description: A beautifully sculpted relic that was brightly polished, causing it to reflect like the real gemstone.

name: Ceremonial Legion Blade
description: Even the Dark Lord of the Undead Legion is impressed by this massive blade, forged from the countless souls who failed to pay their respect to Dage the Evil.

name: Ceremonial SkySword
description: Worn for the most ceremonial of duties, this blade is granted to each member of the SkyGuard upon graduation from the Training Academy.

name: Ceremonial Temple Blade
description: Celebrate the Thai new year in festive style!

name: Ceremonial Tribal Blade
description: We wish you a Yeti New Year!

name: Cerulean Flame Sword
description: Wielded in battle by the powerful Razorclaw clan, this elegant sword is crafted from the scales of a Cerulean dragon for heat and damage resistance!

name: Cerulean J6 Phoenix Blade
description: Drawn during the first in-game livedrawing event of 2012 by J6!

name: Cerulean StarBlade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Chained Oni Blood Katana (0 AC)
description: The Oni's katana was transformed by the Fiend's Void, and thirsts for the blood of their former brethren. It exemplifies both the creed of the Oni, and the maxims of the Nation.

name: Chained Oni Blood Katana (AC)
description: The Oni's katana was transformed by the Fiend's Void, and thirsts for the blood of their former brethren. It exemplifies both the creed of the Oni, and the maxims of the Nation.

name: Chained Rune Bonebreaker
description: A chains slowly envelops a sword that remains a noble symbol of resistance and enlightenment. If it successfully wraps itself around the hilt, the sword will suffocate, losing the will to go on. The chain halts when in possession of a like-minded warrior.

name: Chainfire Blade
description: In celebration of Artix Entertainment's attendance of DragonCon 2012, we proudly present you with the Chainfire Blade! You can count this on your list of con Pros.

name: Chainsaw
description: Please don't run with this metal death trap. It will turn off and on by clicking on it. Happy Mogloween!

name: Chainsaw Hand
description: Goes hand and saw with Ebil Dread Paladin!

name: Chainsaw Katana
description: The ancient mystical weapon referred to in the journal found in /darkoviahorde. Never bring a gun to a katana fight.

name: Champion Blade of Nulgath
description: Nulgath says he forged this sword from the spirit of great heroes. They all wielded this blade at one time. Now he says this blade is yours to wield…

name: Champion Hydra Sword
description: This ancient Hydra blade is said to choose its owner. The sword only chooses those who are or will be great champions. Lucky you!

name: Champion Of Order Blade
description: Take up your sword and bring down those who wish to destroy Order!

name: Chaonslaught Blade
description: Let the power of Chaos flow through your blade and into your enemy!

name: Chaorrupted Blade of Awe
description: The chaorrupted version of the Legendary weapon.

name: Chaorrupted Bloodletter
description: The terrifying blade of Chaos.

name: Chaorrupted Dragonblade
description: The Dragonlord is well aware of Vath's shortcomings. Why use a weapon liable to break free and eat you when one can partner with a like-minded dragon? This blade was carved from a willing dragon's talon, and gestated in the Dragonlord's chaorrupted blood.

name: Chaorrupted Dragonlord's Sword
description: Lets face it, anything is better if dragons are involved.

name: Chaorrupted Dragonlord's Sword +3
description: Lets face it, anything is better if dragons are involved. (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Chaorrupted K'Sork Blade
description: Given to the defenders of K'Thurr, this blade is made of the finest Horc steal and infused with the shards of Arashtite, the living Ore. This blade, however, has been Chaorrupted!

name: Chaorrupted Nifarii Blade
description: This blade is given to shield-warriors who defend the Trolls as they cast their battle-magics! Made of Arashtite, the Living Ore, receiving it is one of the highest honors! This blade, though, has been Chaorrupted!

name: Chaorrupted Nightmare
description: The chaorruption has saturated this blade. You can feel it twisting in your grasp, trying to get away. It is beyond your control.

name: Chaorrupted Northland Blade
description: Once a relic of a Northland tribe, this blade has since been Chaorrupted with an infusion of chaotic trimmings!

name: Chaorrupted Pirate Cutlass (1)
description: This is what happens when pirates think they can battle Chaos and win. They become one with Chaos, and then sow Chaos wherever they go.

name: Chaorrupted Pirate Cutlass (2)
description: Ye'd best be careful when sailing the seas of Lore.. things can get Chaotic!

name: Chaorrupted Rapier
description: Yarrrr! Chaorrupted sea monsters will fall to your blade… just make sure you don't get distracted by all their waving tentacles.

name: Chaorrupted Ruler's Blade (0 AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Chaorrupted Ruler's Blade (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Chaorrupted Skeleton Sword
description: Wield the terrifying glare of a trapped soul with this sharp-edged sword. This blade was designed by Cheater no 1, has no scruples and will take on anyone, or anything, that comes your way. Just don't look into its eyes.

name: Chaorrupted SkyGuard Blade
description: Great now Stratos's own sword is chaorrupted. But he didn't do it.

name: Chaorrupted Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword is one of the two designed and built for the AQW's 4th Upholders on the game's fourth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Chaorrupter Locked
description: This blade was created from pure Chaos. It may do damage against anything at anytime… including Chaos itself.

name: Chaorrupter Unlocked (AC)
description: This blade was created from pure Chaos. It may do damage against anything at anytime… including Chaos itself.

name: Chaorrupter Unlocked (Free Player)
description: This blade was created from pure Chaos. It may do damage against anything at anytime… including Chaos itself.

name: Chaorrupter Unlocked (Legend)
description: This blade was created from pure Chaos. It may do damage against anything at anytime… including Chaos itself.

name: Chaos Ally Blade
description: Crafted from shards of the Chaos Gemerald, this weapon radiates chaotic malevolence.

name: Chaos Avenger's Greatsword
description: In one timeline, The Hero managed to defeat Drakath and get a hold of their Chaos Amulet. Instead of becoming the Slayer who tried to destroy Lore, The Hero became the Avenger that saved it.

name: Chaos Avenger's Hook Blade
description: In one timeline, The Hero managed to defeat Drakath and get a hold of their Chaos Amulet. Instead of becoming the Slayer who tried to destroy Lore, The Hero became the Avenger that saved it.

name: Chaos Backstabber
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: Chaos Bandit's Rusted Blade
description: This bandit's blade must have been looted from a nearby camp during Drakath's attack on Battleon. Look, the chaorruption has already started seeping into it. O_O

name: Chaos Beleen Blade
description: Just because you're busy slicing up your foes doesn't mean you can't look absolutely fabulous while doing it.

name: Chaos Blade of the Imperium
description: Evil you are, Good you may be. Dark exists not without Light, but CHAOS FEEDS REBELLION!

name: Chaos Champion Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQWorld's 12th Upholders on the game's twelfth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Chaos Crystal Blade
description: Made from shattered and reforged Chaos Crystal, this blade's shifting hues will distract and hypnotize your opponents.

name: Chaos Dragon Cutlass (0 AC)
description: YARRRR! Only a true Chaos Dragon Pirate could steal as many gems as you have right out from under the noses of those mountain dwaves.

name: Chaos Dragon Cutlass (AC)
description: YARRRR! Only a true Chaos Dragon Pirate could steal as many gems as you have right out from under the noses of those mountain dwaves.

name: Chaos Dragon's Dark Cutlass (AC)
description: YARRRR! Only a true Chaos Dragon Pirate could steal as many gems as you have right out from under the noses of those mountain dwaves.

name: Chaos Edge of Madness
description: The madness consumes you!

name: Chaos Eruption Blade
description: Don't touch this sword, you'll get infected with Chaos!

name: Chaos Fiend's Sword (0 AC)
description: The fiends were not infected by Chaos. It grew from within spread like a rash, and dug its roots into their edged steel.

name: Chaos Fiend's Sword (AC)
description: The fiends were not infected by Chaos. It grew from within spread like a rash, and dug its roots into their edged steel.

name: Chaos Giftbox Sword 2017
description: Tinsel says "Happy Frostval, Hero!" (Does NOT transform)

name: Chaos Gutter
description: Stick'em with the pointy end!

name: Chaos HydraSlayer Blade
description: Crafted from the scales of the Hydra, everyone will know which gallant warrior slayed the ferocious beast!

name: Chaos Infused Blade
description: Time to send your enemies and even your mind down a roller coaster ride to insanity with this pointy blade!

name: Chaos Longsword
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: Chaos Magus Greatsword
description: In this world, there is nothing so beautiful that it cannot be tainted.

name: Chaos Overlord Bladesaw
description: When being a simple Chaos Lord isn't enough. As an Overlord you want to bring Chaos to ALLLLL realms in Lore!

name: Chaos Pirate Cutlass
description: This is what happens when pirates think they can battle Chaos and win. They become one with Chaos, and then sow Chaos wherever they go.

name: Chaos PuppetMaster Scissors
description: The Queen of Monsters was a heartless manipulator, using her son - Drakath - as a pawn in her quest to return to our world. Recognize her skill and celebrate her ruthlessness. BOW DOWN.

name: Chaos Shaper Sword
description: A weapon with a truly chaotic nature, this sword is capable of dealing out massive damage or very little. You never can tell.

name: Chaos Shifter
description: The hilt looks a little like spider legs, doesn't it? …did you just see something move?!?

name: Chaos Shogun Sword
description: Undeniable proof that you defeated the Chaos Shogun, Kitsune. The blade's origin is rumored to be from the Rift in Time…

name: Chaos Skull Rapier
description: YARRRR! Even this rapier could not withstand the power of chaorruption.

name: Chaos Slicer
description: The blade is doubly sharp, and the tentacles will hold onto your arm to keep your grip firm.

name: Chaos Spy Cutter
description: Take caution when choosing this twisted sword because as long as its eyes are open, you will never find contentment again.

name: Chaos Warrior Omegus
description: With this blade, you will bring about the End: the end of your opponents, the end of Order, and the end of LORE itself! All shall fall to the power of Chaos!

name: Chaos Widow Saber
description: A strong saber crafted from the Chaos Widow.

name: ChaosFang Commander's Tentacle (0 AC)
description: The means justifies the ends, when you lead a crew as viciously dedicated to Good as the ChaosFang Naval Commander does.

name: ChaosFang Commander's Tentacle (AC)
description: The means justifies the ends, when you lead a crew as viciously dedicated to Good as the ChaosFang Naval Commander does.

name: Chaotic Asura
description: The tides of war, Doom, and Chaos overlap. A dull blade that once belonged to a forgotten traveler awakens, furious and alone. It seeks to spread an agony that destroys language.

name: Chaotic Banneret's Gemmed Blade
description: Demonhunters need to have a second career, for all those times when there are no demons around. Hikari is also a blacksmith who takes all the Chaos loose in parts of Lore and crafts it into epic gear.

name: Chaotic Banneret's Shortsword
description: Demonhunters need to have a second career, for all those times when there are no demons around. Hikari is also a blacksmith who takes all the Chaos loose in parts of Lore and crafts it into epic gear.

name: Chaotic Blade of Doom
description: Formed from the combination of a shard of Sepulchure's coffin and pure chaos, this sword bears a striking resemblance to the dark one's own blade.

name: Chaotic Blade of Nulgath
description: Shatter the souls of any undead or chaotic enemies you encounter. This blade does 15% more damage against Chaos and Undead monsters

name: Chaotic Bramble
description: He that dares not grasp the thorns should never crave the flower of Chaos.

name: Chaotic Captain's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Captain's Cutlass (AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Chainsaw +5
description: This chainsaw does 5% MORE DAMAGE against Undead monsters as long as you have it equipped! Wield it well, Hero!

name: Chaotic Draconian Blade
description: *No description*

name: Chaotic Dragon Blade
description: A "gift" given to a Red Dragon from a former Dragonslayer. How kind of him to pass the present along to you!

name: Chaotic Event Horizon
description: Chaos from the other end of our universe fixes its gaze on you. Its pupil shudders, dreaming of a time when all existence falls to Chaos, or disappears into nothingness.

name: Chaotic Fire Dragonblade
description: Akriloth's attacks last only a moment, buy his legacy: a lifetime.

name: Chaotic Guilt Blade
description: *No description*

name: Chaotic Hanzamune
description: A legendary blade harnessed with chaotic energies. Proof that you defeated Chaos Shogun Kitsune.

name: Chaotic Khopesh
description: Magic imbued with Chaos is much stronger - it is no wonder that so many Sorcerers and Sorceress' fall prey to its lure.

name: Chaotic Knight Blade
description: An obsidian blade chaorrupted by Cemaros to help her punish deserters of the chaotic alignment.

name: Chaotic Lightning Katana
description: Shock your opponents with the power of your skill!

name: Chaotic Manticore Tamer
description: Crafted from the manticore's toxic tail and infused with the power of chaos, this weapon has greater damage range than it's non-chaotic counterpart.

name: Chaotic Miasma Blade
description: This blade exudes madness and chaotic energy. Each cut fills your foe with a different form of pain.

name: Chaotic MonsterHunter's Sword
description: A true hero will always fight to save Lore, no matter how deep or dark the chaorruption has spread.

name: Chaotic Naval Commander Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Have you ever wondered what Drakath would have been like had he turned to piracy? Well, wonder no more!

name: Chaotic Naval Commander Cutlass (AC)
description: Have you ever wondered what Drakath would have been like had he turned to piracy? Well, wonder no more!

name: Chaotic Naval Commander Rapier (0 AC)
description: Have you ever wondered what Drakath would have been like had he turned to piracy? Well, wonder no more!

name: Chaotic Naval Commander Rapier (AC)
description: Have you ever wondered what Drakath would have been like had he turned to piracy? Well, wonder no more!

name: Chaotic Obsession Blade
description: The idea of 'control' has seeped its way into every being of Chaos. Even this sword resembles a closed clawed fist clutching the blade. All will be taken with Chaos.

name: Chaotic Pirate Captain Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Avast! These pirates have fallen prey to Chaos, and are now a force for Chaotic Evil on the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Pirate Captain Cutlass (AC)
description: Avast! These pirates have fallen prey to Chaos, and are now a force for Chaotic Evil on the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Pirate Captain Rapier (0 AC)
description: Avast! These pirates have fallen prey to Chaos, and are now a force for Chaotic Evil on the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Pirate Captain Rapier (AC)
description: Avast! These pirates have fallen prey to Chaos, and are now a force for Chaotic Evil on the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Pirate Cutlass
description: Ye'd best be careful when sailing the seas of Lore.. things can get Chaotic!

name: Chaotic Rigel Blade
description: Chaos from the other end of our universe fixes its gaze on you. Its pupil shudders, dreaming of a time when all existence falls to Chaos, or disappears into nothingness.

name: Chaotic Savage Blade
description: These Berserkers have been overcome, but they STILL fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: Chaotic Scar Ripper
description: Chaos is always moving, even when only dregs of it remain. This blade was awarded to those who refuse to give up on ambition and fury. They have a mission - to remind the world why they feared Chaos.

name: Chaotic Scimitar
description: Only pain and suffering will be left behind in this scimitar's wake!

name: Chaotic Short Sword
description: This Sword has been corrupted by chaos!

name: Chaotic Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword is one of the two designed and built for the AQW's 4th Upholders on the game's fourth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Chaotic Storm Blade
description: Crafted deep inside the heart of ThunderForge, this blade is awarded to champions who have served the Darkblood well!

name: Chaotic Sword of the Lost
description: Scavenged from the sewers, but not before it became tainted by chaos.

name: Chaotic Vampire Blade
description: An enchanted blade used by Vampire Knights to blind their enemy with sharp, contrasting colors!

name: Chaotic Winterror
description: This wicked scimitar has gotten even deadlier now that it's been merged with chaotic materials!

name: Charcoal ShortSword
description: A good starter weapon for those just beginning their journey.

name: Charfade's Blade
description: Oddly enough, this sword that is teeming with life can easily take it away with one fatal chop.

name: Charged Cyber Katana
description: EBILCORP AUTHORIZES YOU TO USE THIS DEVICE ON A PROVISIONAL BASIS. PENALTY FOR UNAUTHORIZED USE LISTED IN SECTION C.1.1.3 OF THE PLATINUM CODEX.

name: Charged Ninja Katana
description: The loyal blade of a ninja.

name: Charon's Shears
description: For the barber that has everything…

name: Cheat Code Blade
description: Cheating is bad… but this blade is so much badder!

name: Chelicera's Bite
description: Used by the Chelicera, this short sword packs more than just a bite!

name: Chelicera's Sting
description: After you wake up in your cocoon-like resting place, only then will you remember of the vicious blade that brought you there.

name: Cherry Ice Pop
description: Mmmm! Chill out with a cherry ice pop. Who knows? Maybe the monsters you're defending against will want one, too.

name: Cheval Glass Sword
description: This enchanted sword captures every moment of their owner's life and its glistening light leaves a bitter reminder that as a hero, you will always be ill-fated.

name: Chewy Cookie Sword
description: Step 2: Mold into the shape you desire.

name: ChickencowMancer’s Blade
description: The power of the Chickencow compels you… to battle!

name: Chilling Winter Broadsword
description: Carved from stone so cold, it's said holding it too long gives the wielder frostbite.

name: Chimeric Pincer Blade
description: A weapon born from the same well of life as the Chimera Parasitoid. In its sibling's hands, it renders all battles almost tiresomely tame.

name: Choco-Sword
description: There's nothing better than a good battle. Except a good battle with a 5 foot bar of milk chocolate. Taste sweet victory--literally!

name: ChocoBlade of DOOM
description: The dark chocolate compels… DOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!

name: Chromium Void Blade
description: While traveling through different timelines, this renegade ChronoKnight came to the attention of Nulgath the Archfiend. He reached into the void and corrupted their time powers creating the Void ChronoKnight.

name: Chromium Void Chrono Blade
description: While traveling through different timelines, this renegade ChronoKnight came to the attention of Nulgath the Archfiend. He reached into the void and corrupted their time powers creating the Void ChronoKnight.

name: Chrono Cryolysis Blade
description: A weapon created from a frozen fragments from a river of time. Everything it touches freezes as they were, living the same moment forever.

Instead of arguing and fighting, the meeting resulted in the creation of Coeur du Mer, or the Heart of the Seas. description: Made from material that rarely comes into existence in our universe. A sabre of this nature has only been found in the hands of a Cosmic Bounty Hunter, and they don't share secrets for free. (Item is CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Creep Blade

name: Crimson Brightsword
