description: Eye can't imagine an opponent would enjoy the sight of you in this terrifying battlegear.

name: Cypress Blade
description: An ancient weapon cherished by the Druids for its versatility and beauty. Branches from The Cloister fuse the blade to its timbered hilt.

name: Cypress Scalpel
description: A deadly weapon meant for precise slicing and clean cuts. Outside of battle, it was used to carve and sculpt frozen statues. Some of them were alive, just warm enough to feel every slice.

name: Cysero's Defender Sword
description: This style of weapon was crafted by Cysero in honor of all his friends, who are ready to jump to his defense at any moment.

name: Cysero's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Cysero, the Mad Weaponsmith and Green Mage. Once the ring of fire burns the sun, this blade will do something… Silly. Very Cysero-like. Until then… DO NOT PUSH THE SECRET BUTTON.

name: Dage's Dark Key (Sword)
description: Dage's Dark Keyblade is a powerful and rare weapon. You did well to receive it!

name: Dage's Desolation E
description: Blood calls to blood, and blade to blade! Dage wants you to destroy them all!

name: Dage's Desolation G
description: Blood calls to blood, and blade to blade! Dage wants you to destroy them all!

name: Dage's Desolation P
description: Blood calls to blood, and blade to blade! Dage wants you to destroy them all!

name: Dage's Dragonbone Slasher
description: A wicked and vicious sword forged from the bones of a freshly slain dragon.

name: Dage's Pride Blade
description: Those who've wielded this cursed blade have all met a grisly end. And you won't be the last.

name: Dage's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Dage the Evil, lord of the Underworld and ruler of the Undead Legion. Wielding this blade will NOT grant him dominion over your soul… unless you've already joined his Undead Legion. O_O

name: Dagger of Abyssal Order
description: Nulgath forged this dagger in fire, and cooled it with his blood. Merely owning the dagger would compel obedience from members of the Nation through powerful magic.

name: Dagger of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Dagger of Maddened Will (0 AC)
description: Madness drips from the dagger's sharpened point. You are its chosen master, and your footsteps will be feared throughout these rotting lands. (Color-customization to Accessory)

name: Dagger of Maddened Will (AC)
description: Madness drips from the dagger's sharpened point. You are its chosen master, and your footsteps will be feared throughout these rotting lands. (Color-customization to Accessory)

name: Dagger of Malevolence
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Dagger of the Depths
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: ghostly hands grasp these blades aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… they are a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Dai Tengu Blade of Wind
description: You now wield a powerful weapon of the Tengu teeming with Yokai magic.

name: Dainashini
description: While a sword made of niobium would be far too soft to fight with, a light plating can still produce a lovely blue sheen.

name: Dainty Alchemist's Athame
description: Recruited by Big Daddy, these alchemists are entrusted to brew handmade love potions.

name: Damaged Onslaught Sword
description: In the name of our general and the great land of Lore, we shall fight against all the Evils that plague the world and all of those who don't see it fit to fight those Evils. Glory to Maxamilian Lionfang!

name: Damask Rose Rapier
description: A gallant sword that will always be raised to defend the beautiful. Its sweet scent fortells its arrival.

name: Dancing Sakura Shortsword
description: Theis razor sharp shortsword is made of Sakura glass, which combines sand, shredded sakura petals, and ancient magics into the deadliest of weapons!

name: Dangerzone Lightstick
description: Made up of billions of microscopic mech, this blade slices through solid steel like butter.

name: Dark Aeneid Cutlass (0 AC)
description: The forging of this cutlass was inspired by one of Vergil's stories. It told of a great destiny that would be born from devastating loss. A Hero crossed the endless sea to build the foundation of a grand empire. It's a favorite of Dage's.

name: Dark Aeneid Cutlass (AC)
description: The forging of this cutlass was inspired by one of Vergil's stories. It told of a great destiny that would be born from devastating loss. A Hero crossed the endless sea to build the foundation of a grand empire. It's a favorite of Dage's.

name: Dark Akiban BladeMaster Katana
description: Akiban BladeMasters can walk even the most dangerous streets without fear. No opponent is too deadly, and no challenge too great.

name: Dark and Ugly Stick
description: There's quite a few monsters that have already been beaten with this.

name: Dark Angelic Neesha's Dagger (0 AC)
description: A ray of sunshine caught by the Archangel and given to one of his most capable attendants. It falls from the skies, striking down evil to protect the innocent.

name: Dark Angelic Neesha's Dagger (AC)
description: A ray of sunshine caught by the Archangel and given to one of his most capable attendants. It falls from the skies, striking down evil to protect the innocent.

name: Dark Arachnotana
description: How to be stealthy and edgy in 2 easy steps.

name: Dark Artist's Sword
description: It takes an artist to become a truly great necromancer and weaponsmith! This sword was crafted in honor of the creative mind behind Dage the Evil.

name: Dark Assassin Sword
description: Curved and slick as solid rock, it can do much more than slice and dice fruit to make smoothies.

name: Dark Astravian General Broadsword
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Dark Astravian General Longsword
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Dark Astravian General Rapier
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Dark Astravian Rapier
description: A rapier made of material that can't be replicated by any forge or Mage. It's as if something alive is taking the form of a sword to lure humans into making contact.

name: Dark Azione Solo (0 AC)
description: A one-man action. A lone blade that melds with the dark. Those who wander deep into the Underworld become sacrifices. Others, should their will and grudges prove strong, become entities even the dead fear.

name: Dark Azione Solo (AC)
description: A one-man action. A lone blade that melds with the dark. Those who wander deep into the Underworld become sacrifices. Others, should their will and grudges prove strong, become entities even the dead fear.

name: Dark BitterHeart's Rage
description: Completed by an ill-tempered weaponsmith who wanted more money than offered, this weapon provokes bitterness.

name: Dark Blade Katana
description: Suggestion item (Dark Blade Katana) by Mateus 1002

name: Dark Blade of Swordhaven
description: It may seem abnormally heavy at first, but if the wielder is a worthy owner, the soothing power of light helps support the weight you must carry. It's the same way your burdened responsibility as a faithful commander must carry to save the world.

name: Dark Blade of the Fifth
description: Evil you are, Good you may be. Not *all* bad, you are! Dark exists not without Light.

name: Dark Blade of the Loyalist
description: All hail ArchFiend Nulgath, the greatest ruler our world AND the OverSoul has ever known! Defend him with your blade, your breath, and if need be, your blood. You were wise to defect back to his side, hero!

name: Dark Blade of the Shadowscythe
description: The darkness that envelopes this blade reflects the darkness of your soul. You are a true Shadowscythe!

name: Dark Bloodletter Katana
description: Nation hopefuls are maddened by Nulgath's trials until they become mindlessly loyal attack dogs. Ironically, Carnage started out that way, and was shaped to become a skilled General instead. This blade sharpened as he rose.

name: Dark Bone Knight Broken Sword
description: These shadow creatures seem to imbue everything they touch with dark energy. Unlike it's counterpart, this bone weapon has been soaked in dark energy.

name: Dark Bone Knight Greatsword
description: These shadow creatures seem to imbue everything they touch with dark energy. Unlike it's counterpart, this bone weapon has been soaked in dark energy.

name: Dark Botanical Broadsword
description: You unlocked this sword by supporting Biobeasts! The trapped creatures of the lab thank you!

name: Dark Brine Cutlass (0 AC)
description: A gravestone was carved and sharpend into a unique cutlass. Its Dark magic is stronger in the hands of the Undead.

name: Dark Brine Cutlass (AC)
description: A gravestone was carved and sharpend into a unique cutlass. Its Dark magic is stronger in the hands of the Undead.

name: Dark Carrot Kunai
description: Carrots aren't actually that healthy of a snack to feed to rabbits. Too much sugar. It makes more sense to shower your enemies in a rain of adorable carrot kunai.

name: Dark Caster Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Legion Dark Casters. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Dark Celestial Avenger Blade (0 AC)
description: Those who desire revitalizations in their passions and self-esteem will find comfort grasping the blade cut from pure emerald. Look inside the hilt to find a lone spirit that will let you know that you are not alone.

name: Dark Celestial Avenger Blade (AC)
description: Those who desire revitalizations in their passions and self-esteem will find comfort grasping the blade cut from pure emerald. Look inside the hilt to find a lone spirit that will let you know that you are not alone.

name: Dark Chainsaw Hand
description: Goes hand in hand with… awwww, man. TOO SOON for this joke, what with being an undead undeadslayer and all… and, y'know, NOT HAVING A HAND.

name: Dark Champion Blade
description: Pulsating with sinister energy, this is the blade of choice of the champion of darkness. Designed by shadow master2015!

name: Dark Champion Sword (1)
description: Although it has been sliced in half, this sword's dark energy holds it together. Designed by shadow master2015!

name: Dark Champion Sword (2)
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword hold power beyond compare.

name: Dark Comedy
description: Your enemies won't think it's so funny.

name: Dark Corsair Cutlass
description: These buccaneer's buccaneers never back down from a fight, now whether they fight fair is another question.

name: Dark Crystal Claymore
description: The crystals of this sword are twisted and imbued with dark energy.

name: Dark Diamond Blade
description: You're the one to be ballin and shot callin on the battlefield!

name: Dark DoomWood Dragon's Roar (0 AC)
description: The DoomWood DragonKnight's original Dragon couldn't be recovered in one piece. The Necromancers used what they could find to craft a new sword for their Warrior. It roars, luring Dragons into the dangerous night. (CC to Accessory)

name: Dark DoomWood Dragon's Roar (AC)
description: The DoomWood DragonKnight's original Dragon couldn't be recovered in one piece. The Necromancers used what they could find to craft a new sword for their Warrior. It roars, luring Dragons into the dangerous night. (CC to Accessory)

name: Dark Draco Sanguis Blade
description: Deep below the waves lives a nation of sea dragons. Masters of aquatic elemental magic, these ancient and powerful creatures have never been known to interact with the humans of Lore… until now. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Dark Draconian Sword
description: Draconian sword of darkness.

name: Dark Dragon Heart Render
description: One of many blades that growls and spits. The Dracolich Lord has an entire armory of them, created from the bones of dragons that were partnered with enemy Dragonlords.

name: Dark Dragon of Time GreatSword (0 AC)
description: The Dragon of Time is able to move through and control space and time… but the galaxy is riddled with dark and corrupted matter. A Dark Dragon of Time may spell DOOOOM for us all!

name: Dark Dragon of Time GreatSword (AC)
description: The Dragon of Time is able to move through and control space and time… but the galaxy is riddled with dark and corrupted matter. A Dark Dragon of Time may spell DOOOOM for us all!

name: Dark Dragon's Fang
description: Stand out from other warriors with CC blade.

name: Dark Dragon Samurai Katana
description: This sleek katana is the weapon of choice for Dragon Samurai.

name: Dark Dragonfang Blade
description: A brutal sword that was formed from tainted amethysts by one of the lead cultists-voted to Tyrath. Although pure darkness can be used by either good or evil, the cultist desired to cleave the light in two, transforming this sword into a dangerous thorn to his targets.

name: Dark Druid's Blade
description: Sometimes those who once protected now seek to destory.

name: Dark Elemental Havoc
description: A prized possession of a great Shadowscythe commander, it is usually kept as decoration in the throne room because of its unchecked power. If used gently and rarely, its power might not awaken……..yet.

name: Dark Empress Blade (Sword)
description: Embrace the Darkness! Awarded for purchasing the Unarmored and Armored Gravelyn Prints from HeroMart, our online store!

name: Dark Energy Katana
description: This is the key to a new order. This katana means freedom.

name: Dark Eons Broadsword
description: This blade was made to destroy parasites that burrowed into the Planet of Darkness. The hero who wielded it sliced and crushed the Shadows, jumping into the Maw to destroy it from within. They never returned.

name: Dark Eons Sword
description: For a time, these weapons were wielded valiantly heroes from Lore, but they became lost to the Shadows. Voidstar no longer calls for aid.

name: Dark Evanescence
description: An interesting name…Though a blade of great power forged by Dage the Evil himself, it's ephemeral and meant to leave the Underworld. Intended for those he can trust his realm to, Dage does not expect them to stay, nor will he trap them.

name: Dark Frost Fang Katana (0 AC)
description: A hunter whose heart is truly frozen by winter's skin-numbing bite can hold such a blade with no further handicap. It may be as light as paper, but it can slice glaciers as if they are citrus fruit.

name: Dark Frost Fang Katana (AC)
description: A hunter whose heart is truly frozen by winter's skin-numbing bite can hold such a blade with no further handicap. It may be as light as paper, but it can slice glaciers as if they are citrus fruit.

name: Dark Fyreborn Tiger Blade (AC)
description: Easy there tiger, leave enough monsters for the rest of us.

name: Dark Fyreborn Tiger Blade (Special)
description: Easy there tiger, leave enough monsters for the rest of us.

name: Dark Grenblade
description: All hail the Dark Grenwog!

name: Dark Guardian's Blade
description: You are Lore's Hero, and the safety of all our universes and timelines depend up YOU. Fight for evil, and defend our worlds from those that would harm it.

name: Dark Hand's Slaughter
description: The Dark Hand Behemoth brutally crushes their opponents in a roaring frenzy of blood. When their prey stops moving, a horrible sense of disappointment washes over them, and they set their sights on their next duel.

name: Dark Harbinger Blade (0 AC)
description: Listen…can you hear the whispers of the souls this blade has consumed?

name: Dark Harbinger Blade (AC)
description: Listen…can you hear the whispers of the souls this blade has consumed?

name: Dark Heart Sabre
description: Strike your foes with LOVE!

name: Dark Infernal's Half-blade
description: The replica of a legendary sword said to have the ability to cut the price of items by half. However, the curse it carried demanded that one buy whatever it cut. Fortunately, or unfortunately, this is only a replica.

name: Dark Key Blade
description: Now all we need is a dark door.

name: Dark Knight's Acolyte Blade
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dark Knight's Apprentice Blade
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dark Knight's Blade (1)
description: A dark knight rises up, ready to answer Gravelyn's call to battle at any time, day or night. Though they may die, they know they will always return in her service.

name: Dark Knight's Blade (2) (0 AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

name: Dark Knight's Blade (2) (AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

name: Dark Knight's Ensorcelled Blade (AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

name: Dark Knight's Master Blade
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dark Legacy Doom Blade
description: A Doomblade that was the foundation of the original Shadows. Their Empire was built brick by brick by the Mysterious Stranger of the Shadowscythe. It's influence is long gone, overcome by the Empress and her beloved father.

name: Dark Legend Sword
description: You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

name: Dark Lord's Double Blade
description: Dark Lords channel the power of the Fourth to further their goal of taking over the universe for the dark side. (And they have cookies!)

name: Dark Lord's Laserblade
description: Dark Lords channel the power of the Fourth to further their goal of taking over the universe for the dark side. (And they have cookies!)

name: Dark Mana Flame Sabre
description: The Elemental Avatars act through their Champions on Lore, prevented from connecting to the Mana Core that is the heart of our world. Should the flame of its power be extinguished, the spirit of our world itself would die out.

name: Dark Manifestation Sword
description: Your negative emotions are being ejected from the timestream, like a mortal's body getting rid of toxins. Combined with your power, a new form of life has been created… and has evolved.

name: Dark Marrowblade
description: Blunt but effective, what this blade lacks in elegance it makes up for in brute force.

name: Dark Matter DragonBlade (0 AC)
description: Chase the evil of dragons into the unknown. When even the space you exist in becomes hostile, will you still forge on?

name: Dark Matter DragonBlade (AC)
description: Chase the evil of dragons into the unknown. When even the space you exist in becomes hostile, will you still forge on?

name: Dark Mirrored Blade
description: If you ever face a beast that takes "looks can kill" to a dangerous level, then anything with a mirror you can get your hands on is ideal for the confrontation. This one is not effective against vampires.

name: Dark Nosferatu Blade
description: These vampires care not for royal garb or flamboyant parties. Only hunting prey for their next meal.

name: Dark Omen Barb
description: A blade that humbles houses and pact writers, yearning to tear into the arrogant who sit atop thrones built on mortal mistakes.

name: Dark OmniKnight Blade
description: A blade with the strength to pierce the heavens, only a true OmniKnight may wield its power!

name: Dark Ops Cold Steel Knife
description: A skilled hand can use this knife to cut through bones like butter before the enemy realizes that they've been reduced to cubes.

name: Dark Ops Cold Steel Kukri
description: A skilled hand can use this blade to cut through bones like butter before the enemy realizes that they've been reduced to cubes.

name: Dark Ostrakon
description: A simple blade given to new members of the Legion. Made from shards of broken weaponry, the sword has been reforged countless times. It forces the wielder to refine their skills and techniques.

name: Dark Phoenix Blade
description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

name: Dark Phoenix Blade +5
description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

name: Dark Pirate Caster's Blade (0 AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Dark Pirate Caster's Blade (AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Dark Pirate Caster's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Dark Pirate Caster's Cutlass (AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Dark Prismatic Katana
description: A blackened Katana blade wielded by those who have devoted themselves to the island of Yokai. Color custom base, trim, and glow!

name: Dark Refraction Dagger (0 AC)
description: The reflection in the blade of this dagger rarely ever shows your current self. Lights dance and you'll catch glimpses of you at your best, your worst, and what you'll never be.

name: Dark Refraction Dagger (AC)
description: The reflection in the blade of this dagger rarely ever shows your current self. Lights dance and you'll catch glimpses of you at your best, your worst, and what you'll never be.

name: Dark Reversed BladeMaster Katana
description: Akiban BladeMasters can walk even the most dangerous streets without fear. No opponent is too deadly, and no challenge too great.

name: Dark Rune Blade
description: An ancient blade teeming with dark magic, said to originate from the Void. Strange, illegible runes are etched within the surface.

name: Dark Rune Sword
description: The mysterious runes on this blade give this sword power.

name: Dark Runic Claymore
description: The script running down the length of this blade pulses with dark energy.

name: Dark Sea Corsair's Rapier
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it.

name: Dark Seas Cutlass
description: A cutlass gleaming with gold that was found inside a wooden chest locked away in an isolated grotto near Dwarfhold Mountains. Legend has it that its user could detect gold coins and valued treasures by how bright it gets.

name: Dark Shadowrise Blade
description: Bestowed to those who fight for Evil! The black and red symbolize the true Heroes of the Shadowscythe.

name: Dark Shadowslayer Z Sword (AC)
description: A broad, ornate sword crafted by Elder Shadowslayers. This blade features a color custom base and accessory glow.

name: Dark Shadowslayer Z Sword (Non-AC)
description: A broad, ornate sword crafted by Elder Shadowslayers. This blade features a color custom base and accessory glow.

name: Dark Shogun Katana
description: These former rulers aren't ready to concede yet. Their undying pledge to defend their lands goes beyond life itself.

name: Dark Sin Of Revontheus
description: You who could barely grasp the true power of Revontheus; are you worthy of wielding his weapon?

name: Dark SnowAngel's FrostBlade (0 AC)
description: No matter how dark the night or black the feathers, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Dark SnowAngel's FrostBlade (AC)
description: No matter how dark the night or black the feathers, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Dark Solistice Sword
description: The Winter Solistice, full moon, and lunar eclipse all came together in a perfect storm of nature night-time beauty, and this weapon was forged for you to celebrate it!

name: Dark Soul Blade
description: The eye can see your soul.

name: Dark Star Claymore
description: The blade only glows when gripped by the Dark Mage whose power is then transferred to it.

name: Dark Starsaber
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: Dark Tech Blade
description: Slice it up with a deadly tech blade, StarCaptain style!

name: Dark Tempest Soldier Laserblade
description: When a Tempest Soldier moves so far into the Darker side that they are beyond cookies… they get awarded the Dark Tempest Soldier gear.

name: Dark Tower Sword
description: This blade emanates corrupted power, pushing away the light and drawing in the darkness.

name: Dark Ultra OmniKnight Blade (0 AC)
description: A blade with the strength to pierce the heavens, only a true OmniKnight may wield its power!

name: Dark Ultra OmniKnight Blade (AC)
description: A blade with the strength to pierce the heavens, only a true OmniKnight may wield its power!

name: Dark Undead Leader Sword (0 AC)
description: Symbols are power. The mere sight of the fearsome blade will tame the even the wildest wills of the restless dead.

name: Dark Undead Leader Sword (AC)
description: Symbols are power. The mere sight of the fearsome blade will tame the even the wildest wills of the restless dead.

name: Dark Void Paladin Katana
description: The bursts of electricity that spiral down the blade will deliver a "shocking" blow to the foolish who dare challenge you.

name: Darkblood Ashura
description: As the Dark Hand Behemoth's streak of bloody victories increased, they grew stronger, larger, and their thoughts became consumed by battle. To the master of this blade, this is the proper evolution of their kind.

name: Darkblood Blade
description: Given to the Falguard Dreadwatch Soldiers, this blade was forged with the sole purpose of slaying those who attempt to breach the walls of Falguard.

name: Darkblood Great Sword
description: Captain Madra's spare blade, this sword has defeated many heroes who have dared the quest of retrieving the Darkblood Scroll.

name: Darkblood Katana
description: When exploring the dangers found in Blackhorn Tomb, the Darkblood Katana shall help protect you. The same thing can't be said about your foes.

name: Darkblood Keysword
description: The key to the victory is PUNISHMENT!

name: Darkblood Nulgath Blade
description: A new nation bows to Nulgath… and an army of Darkblood Warriors battle in the name of the Archfiend!

name: Darkblood Symbiotic Sword (AC)
description: Only a weapon, that combines the dark arts will the blade of a sword, holds the power to help you on your quest. What choices you make after that are up to you and you only…

name: Darkblood Symbiotic Sword (Legend)
description: Only a weapon, that combines the dark arts will the blade of a sword, holds the power to help you on your quest. What choices you make after that are up to you and you only…

name: Darkblood Tattered Blade
description: This sword has seen its fair share of severed limbs in its day. Those that have reached the city of Falguard know of the power that this sword posses. They will alway always remember. They can never forget!

name: Darkborn Blade of Awe
description: A Dark version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will help you hide even in places with no shadows. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: Darker Darkblood Nulgath Blade (0 AC)
description: A new nation bows to Nulgath… and an army of Darkblood Warriors battle in the name of the ArchFiend!

name: Darker Darkblood Nulgath Blade (AC)
description: A new nation bows to Nulgath… and an army of Darkblood Warriors battle in the name of the ArchFiend!

name: Darkfire Sword
description: The powers of Darkness, Fire, and Lightning have been forged together to make this blade.

name: DarkIce Calibreaker
description: In legend, it's said that the balde was pulled from the side of a glacier and can take any enemy down with a single blow.

name: DarkLord PaladinSlayer DarkBlade
description: TECHNICALLY A LIGHTBLADE BUT WHAT PALADINSLAYER IN THEIR RIGHT MIND USES ANYTHING WITH THE WORD LIGHT IN IT?

name: DarkLuster
description: This unique weapon is the result of an ancient collaboration between a sand elf and a horc weapon-makers. The result, while beautiful, is extremely difficult to wield. Suggested by AQW player Reki.

name: Darkness Eater
description: Slay all those who oppose you with this blade made of crystallized, inverted darkness!

name: Darkon's Debris 1935 Stick
description: Three takoyaki on a stick. You can eat one, and still have two left to beat monsters with.

name: Darkon's Debris 319
description: This emergency tool will be of help whenever the bunny patting goes wrong. Can also be used for monster slaying if you're into that kind of gig.

name: Darkon's Debris 508
description: What you're looking for is closer than you think.

name: Darkon's Debris 6
description: Perfect for cutting up big fish to serve as sashimi. Might have been used on humans before, but don't sweat the small stuff. (Boost: 12% more damage to all monsters when equipped + chance to summon comets)

name: Darkon's Debris 8
description: A handy knife to have if you want to cut a huge piece of steak. Or for some beheadings. Tomato-tomahto. (Boost: 15% more damage to all monsters when equipped + chance to summon comets)

name: Darkon's Delicious Blade
description: NOM NOM NOM

name: Darkovian Carryon Cutter
description: You'd think hitting the Darkovian beach would turn you into a bloody mess, but that's where the fun is!

name: Darkovian Pirate Captain Cutlass (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas!

name: Darkovian Pirate Captain Cutlass (AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas!

name: Darkovian Pirate Captain Knife (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas!

name: Darkovian Pirate Captain Knife (AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas!

name: Darkovian Shell Piercer
description: You'd think hitting the Darkovian beach would turn you into a bloody mess, but that's where the fun is!

name: Darkside Ascension Blade (0 AC)
description: Once, heroes joined the Darkside for cookies. It is the pure, intoxicating power of the shadows that keeps them here.

name: Darkside Ascension Blade (AC)
description: Once, heroes joined the Darkside for cookies. It is the pure, intoxicating power of the shadows that keeps them here.

name: Darksided Fiend Blade
description: A deadly blade sheathed in darkness. It slays the enemies of the Nation silently, letting their pieces sink into the Void.

name: Darkwave Khopesh
description: With this blade, you can take down the undead AND get more XP and Gold while you're battling!

name: Darkwolf Bandit's Sword
description: Hmm… there's something familiar about these bandit blades. (Imported from DragonFable.)

name: DataKnight HoloGram Blade
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Dawn Vindicator Blade
description: As a recruit gains more knowledge, they are able to move up a rank and wear the Dawn Vindicator gear.

name: Dawn Vindicator Sword
description: As a recruit gains more knowledge, they are able to move up a rank and wear the Dawn Vindicator gear.

name: Ddog Sea Serpent Sword
description: Nulgath says, Ddog is a powerful hero indeed. He's still growing in strength and will do great things one day. To honor him, he crafted this weapon. Those that own this blade are lucky.

name: Deadly Chaos Sword
description: You've succumbed to Chaos, now take up your sword and begin to defeat this world.

name: Deadly Draugr Blade
description: This deadly blade is wielded by the Draugrs of the Northlands. You must be truly skilled to have wrested this from its cold, dead hands.

name: Deadly Intent Blade
description: *No description*

name: Deadly Tower Blade
description: Forged for the most vicious of warriors, this blade knows no mercy.

name: Deadman's Decapitator (Sword)
description: Careful in the carnival, you just might lose your head.

name: Deadsea Scalper
description: Not one of Naval Commander Vordred's favorite tools. It shaves way to much off the top, and he's left with pieces of what would have been perfectly good SKULLS.

name: DeadTech D00MBLADE 2.0
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 2)

name: Deady Sized Sword
description: Deady is deadly with this weapon, and now YOU can be, too!

name: Death Bane of the Legion
description: Undead Legion warriors give a whole new twist to death and destruction…

name: Death Drive (AC)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of this blade is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Death Drive (Non-AC)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of this blade is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Death From Above
description: Look out below! And to your left and to your right! You've got the color custom Death From Above Blade! Time to smash some heroes…or do some smashing… in HeroSmash!

name: Death Pit Sword (Tier 1)
description: You're not going to get very far with this…

name: Death Pit Sword (Tier 2)
description: Ok getting better, pointer…

name: Death Ripper Of Vokun
description: Some believe that the souls of those killed by this sword are trapped within it, creating its ghastly glow.

name: Death's Bright Blade (Sword)
description: The Archfiend has brought a bright blade from the Oversoul straight to you by way of the Tercessuinotlim! If you can pry it from the Death's Head's cold, dead gauntlets, that is!

name: Death's Culling of the Sea (0 AC)
description: Out at sea, death comes easily. Some are born, and instantly go cold. The anguish of sailors stranded on broken wooden planks, slowly perishing, exposed to the elements, is embodied by this cruel looming blade.

name: Death's Culling of the Sea (AC)
description: Out at sea, death comes easily. Some are born, and instantly go cold. The anguish of sailors stranded on broken wooden planks, slowly perishing, exposed to the elements, is embodied by this cruel looming blade.

name: Death's Requiem Blade (0 AC)
description: A rare soulforged weapon that honors the dead. Inhabiting this blade are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Death's Requiem Blade (AC)
description: A rare soulforged weapon that honors the dead. Inhabiting this blade are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Death Scar Bright Energy Blade
description: Star Captains… Take on the Shadowscythe wherever you find them with this deathly Death Scar Energy Blade!

name: Death Scar Energy Blade
description: Star Captains… Take on the Shadowscythe wherever you find them with this deathly Death Scar Energy Blade!

name: Deathdealer
description: This weapon was crafted by the savage Horcs. In the right hands, it can be a weapon of devestating power.

name: DeathFiend Blade of Nulgath
description: There's always a time when sorcerers want to taste warm blood on their cold steel.

name: Deathknight Blade
description: No one is quite sure how Undead minions got a hold of such an ornate blade. However, there is one theory involving a certain unlucky Knight…

name: DeathKnight's Blade
description: *No description*

name: DeathKnight's Blade of Despair
description: Those who have sold more than just their soul to Empress Gravelyn, these knights protect Shadowfall at all costs.

name: DeathKnight's Cleaver
description: A pure sword of abomination!

name: DeathKnight's Revenge Blade
description: After slaying countless armies, no King or Emperor is willing to lose more men to your mighty blade.

name: Deathless Caster Sword
description: If you are courageous enough to stare into the gaze of a Deathless Caster be warned, many who tried went mad.

name: Deathlord Blade of Nulgath
description: (Item does 40% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)The primary weapon Vulnios used before his discharge from the Nulgath Nation. Nulgath warns you that this weapon lusts for immense power, so wield it at your own peril.

name: Deathly Flurry
description: Rarely is a work of art so compelling, so intricate, so delicately deadly. The details mesmerize the enemy into standing, wide-eyed, as you wield it through the air. Most don't mind being your victim, if to just see this work of art one last time.

name: Deathly Misericordia
description: Perhaps this life didn't offer enough, or took everything it gave. A DeathSworn Knight, dissatisfied or scorned by their lot, sacrificed what little they have left to pursue power through slaughter. This is a mercy available to the lost.

name: DeathSpitter
description: Blue-blooded blade desiring to be covered in red… this blade will do what ever you want. Cut down an enemy, or tease them with quick slices.

name: Deathwalker Blade (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Blade (Non-AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deax Goldwing
description: The one called Deax Goldwing was made by player "Deax"

name: Debris 297 Blade
description: Do you know what true emptiness is? There is no light. Not even a space for the darkness to fill the sun's absence. Will you trust in fate, or take control of your own destiny? The choice is yours.

name: Debris 297 Sheathed Blade
description: Do you know what true emptiness is? There is no light. Not even a space for the darkness to fill the sun's absence. Will you trust in fate, or take control of your own destiny? The choice is yours.

name: Debris Broadsword of Pain
description: Based off the signature stitches from the creatures and creations featured in Darkon's Elegy of Madness. Bring the pain and suffering to your enemies.

name: Debris Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim,Accessory.)

name: Debris Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim,Accessory.)

name: Decay
description: The origin of this sword is unknown, but legend says the smithing required a sacrificial element…

name: Decaying Blade of Agony
description: Teeming with death, the name says it all. This ancient cursed blade was recently discovered by a Beta Berserker named Shmbugi.

name: Decima Render
description: In the Underworld, fate is flexible. Stray too far into the Land of the Dead, and this blade will cut your fate short. All that are claimed by the Sentinels belong to the Lord of the Legion.

name: DeckMaster's Scimitar
description: Carry out the Captain's orders or they be havin' you walk the plank!

name: Decorem
description: A prized relic of the Trolls. It is said to have taken a generation to form this blade.

name: Deep Fried Dricken Sword
description: Whoever wields this definitely gets the big piece of dricken.

name: Deep Galactic Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword is one of two designed and built for the AQW's 5th Upholder on the game's fifth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Deep Khaox Kris
description: Chaos hasn't invaded the rest of the universe… has it?!

name: Deep Terror Blade (Sword)
description: This blade was recovered from the deepest depths of the ocean. Gives 5% more gold and damage against undead, and unlocks a quest from Lucia in the Pirates map.

name: Deeprage Decapitator
description: Crafted from the bones of strange creatures unknown to the modern world, forged with hate and magic in the darkest darkness beneath the world.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Blade
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: Deepspace Saber
description: Schwiiiiiiing! Bwwwwwzap! Fwooooosh! Use this Forceful violet starlight saber to conquer your enemies all across the galaxy!

name: Deer Starsword
description: Harness the power of the aurora's light. The string of festive lights give it another boost.

name: Default Sword
description: Sword

name: Default Sword of Awe
description: This slightly-used but still AWE-some blade is for adventurers who haven't quiiiite finished their quests to create all of the Items of Awe.

name: Defender Of Light
description: Commissioned by King Alteon himself, your fellow warrior Snowcownes designed this blade to represent all that Good stands for.

name: Defender Of SwordHaven Blade
description: As a committed defender of Swordhaven, you know that loyalty to the realm sometimes requires difficult decisions.

name: Defender of the Reef
description: Coral reefs can grow on just about any material given the right conditions. This nautical blade is home to a thriving reef found only in The Natatorium.

name: Defiant Rogue Blade
description: This type of blade signifies you as a member of the Lore Rogues Guild. No matter where you go you will be recognized as a dirty, rotten thief! Yay, you!

name: Defiled Dragon Blade
description: This Dragon Blade has been tainted with undead filth. If you see any Paladin Dragons around, you know what to use.

name: Defiler of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged this sword using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Dekanor's Disparia (0 AC)
description: Named for the Great Dragon of Darkness, the dream of all Legion Dragonlords. None of them know what the real Dekanor looks like, so the face adorning this blade is but a fantasy.

name: Dekanor's Disparia (AC)
description: Named for the Great Dragon of Darkness, the dream of all Legion Dragonlords. None of them know what the real Dekanor looks like, so the face adorning this blade is but a fantasy.

name: Deleuze Ice Blade (0 AC)
description: Cut and carved from the living Fiend Tundra known as the Deleuze, the blade shares a mind with the Winter Void. It takes pleasure in freezing and shattering foes.

name: Deleuze Ice Blade (AC)
description: Cut and carved from the living Fiend Tundra known as the Deleuze, the blade shares a mind with the Winter Void. It takes pleasure in freezing and shattering foes.

name: Delicate Snowflake Rapier
description: The Court of the Winter Fae enjoy the dramatics of romance and duels. It is tradition for the duelists to have their weapons created by the ice magic of their heart's desire. A delicate snow flower made these rapiers.

name: Deliverance of Agony
description: The tides of love and war overlap. Dull blades that once belonged to a forgotten traveler awaken, furious and alone. They seeks to spread an agony that destroys language and cuts a wounded, scorned warrior to the core.

name: Delta V Exile Sword
description: While there are members of the Exile still fighting, this sword will bring them the hope that is needed to vanquish the Legion once and for all from Delta V!

name: Delta V Legion Sword
description: Wielded by members of the Legion, this sword will be the very undoing of the Exiles on Delta V!

name: Delta V Prison Blade
description: If you find yourself in the depths of Delta V and see someone wielding this blade, it's best to stay away.

name: Deluge Destroyer
description: Hit your foes like a tidal wave!

name: Deluge Dreadnaught
description: Overwhelm your adversaries with this colossal broadsword, once belonging to a great and mighty water dragon.

name: Demented Doom Blade
description: Found during the battle for control of the Underworld, who knows what this blade will be capable of.

name: Demented Doom Broadsword
description: Found during the battle for control of the Underworld, who knows what this blade will be capable of.

name: Demonic Devourer
description: While a powerful blade had been forged, Max Man58 felt his creation needed more. Trapping the soul of the most powerful demon he could find inside the blade's cold steel, it now hungers for anything living. The blade is as dangerous to your enemies as it is to you.

name: Demonic Doujikiri
description: The blade of an exiled OniSlayer Empress. She died, betrayed and abandoned. Her vengeful spirit haunts the katana. Now the coveted weapon of the Four Oni Lords, it seeks the blood of those it once protected.

name: Demonic Maw Blade
description: Be glad this demon gasping the blade, and not reaching for your soul.

name: Deprived Blood Cutlass (0 AC)
description: As it taints the armor of paladins with their own blood, the blade darkens to black and dissolves back into the sea's darkness.

name: Deprived Blood Cutlass (AC)
description: As it taints the armor of paladins with their own blood, the blade darkens to black and dissolves back into the sea's darkness.

name: Derp Star Sword
description: A sword that talks your opponent to death. Derp.

name: DerpBlade of Doom
description: This sword hungers for destruction… are you sure you can control such dark energy?

name: Derpblivion Blade
description: You realize Nulgath himself can communicate directly to you, AND ONLY YOU, through this sword… but I don't think that's Nulgath. There's something wrong here…

name: Derpeon Blade
description: Something has happened to the magic sword of Lore's greatest King…

name: Derpsaw of Ehhhh
description: If you listen closely, the millions of souls killed and trapped inside this chainsword of terror scream for help… and they sound like they're singing the Derp song.

name: Derpy Seppy Sword
description: OHAI! I see what you did thur… and over thurr. HUURRRPA! DURRP!

name: Derpy Stary Sword
description: OMGOSH is THAT really a Star Sword? No… no it's not… but it almost kinda looks like one… sorta… DEERRRP!

name: Desert Black Moon Blade
description: A weapon styled after the shape of the waning moon's shadow. As it hangs over the Sandsea, the worst of its monsters creep out of the desert. These blades await their challenge.

name: Desert Hound Knife
description: When all else fails, you need to trust in old fashioned steel.

name: Desert Hound Kukri
description: When all else fails, you need to trust in old fashioned steel.

name: Desolate Husk
description: A blade that has lost its identity and master. It radiates with dangerous power, but you find that it's impossible to give the blade a name.

name: Desoloth's Bane
description: Desoloth the Final is dead… or is he? Do not underestimate this prime example of the elements' power. Be wary, for you do not know what legacy Desoloth has left in his place.

name: Desoloth's Demise
description: The dragon Desoloth essence was forged into this blade.

name: Desoloth's Doom
description: Desoloth the Final is dead… or is he? Do not underestimate this prime example of the elements' power. Be wary, for you do not know what legacy Desoloth has left in his place.

name: Desoloth's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Desoloth, the Great Elemental Dragon boss originally released in AdventureQuest Worlds. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Destinoidermanusicus
description: It's a mouthful to say, but well worth the trouble when you start slicing and dicing the foes that step in your way. And if you can manage to scream out its name in the heat of battle, the world may end.

name: Destiny Dragon Blade
description: As the name suggests, this blade is only visible to those with a promising destiny. A design completely created by player Skyline.

name: Destructor Sword
description: Powered by the rare mineral Emridium, found in the year 20122013, this blade is able to slice like a ninja and cut like a razor blade!

name: Devoto Valentidus
description: A blade forged for Heroes Heart Day masquerades. It's a replica of the original Valentidus, who ascended to Arcadian godhood alongside his beloved Lupercalia.

name: Devoured Sinner's Blade
description: Forgotten with time, this once formidable blade has been overgrown with mother nature's "gift". the thorns on the vines help compensate for lack of a sharp edge.

name: Devourer of Souls Greatsword (0 AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Devourer of Souls Greatsword (AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Devouring Sea's Blade
description: In the silence of the depths, you hear whispers. Or is that the chewing of flesh? Even the leviathans of the sea will one day fall, and the scavengers tear what they can from it. Just like how you made this blade from a rotting Titan.

name: Dexterous Blade
description: A light, ornamented sword. This weapon is made for quick agile fighters.

name: Dexterous Blade of Cold
description: Lost by another Adventurer, this sword has been enchanted by the Ice Elemental's energy.

name: DF Frozen Claymore
description: The iconic sword from DragonFable!

name: Diabolical Armorbreaker
description: Forged to tear into metal plating like paper, the blade bypasses your foe's skills, talent, and experience. Time and effort become meaningless, and what remains is left to rot.

name: Diabolical Ectoblade
description: A typical occultist weapon, this dagger is known for rituals and bringing upon great despair unto one's sacrifices. You can also use it to cast anguish upon those who dare tread among you.

name: Diabolical Foam Sword
description: Carrying a weapon on a beach is illegal you know! Take this foam replica of a sword so it won't get confiscated. While you can't actually harm anyone with it, it's easy to swing around.

name: Diabolical Glorybringer
description: This sword sings you enemies sorrows and consumes their dreams, yet this once harmonious weapon's source of energy remains to be a mystery.

name: Diabolical Light Slasher
description: May the fourth be with you… and also the cookies!

name: Diabolical Resolution
description: This overclocked keyblade will have eldritch beings with little time left on this plane, I don't think it supports WiFi though.

name: Diabolical Sinner's Blade
description: A sword formerly held by no one of consequence, this blade from another realm will guide you to salvation.

name: Diabolical SpineRipper
description: An aberrant lance, only gifted to the most dedicated of the Diabolical Monks, it's bestowed upon those who prove their mastery in the otherworldly trials, use it with pride.

name: Diabolical Sword
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical Warden's Katana
description: An ornate katana, with a pure silver blade, perhaps it’ll be stained with a different color once its use is up.

name: Diabolical Witch's Katana
description: A sleek katana is often nice to have in case of a sudden attack, this silver trimmed katana is sharp as one can come.

name: Diamond Darkness Blade
description: Forged from a variety of gemstones, these swords make it easier to defeat you Draconic foes.

name: Diamond Key Of Revontheus
description: The blade of this sword holds the key to the destruction of Dage's Legion!

name: Diamond Polaris Blade (0 AC)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Diamond Polaris Blade (AC)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Diamond Polaris Dirk
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, gripped tightly in your quest to bring the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Diamond Polaris Sword
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Diamond Pyre Blade (0 AC)
description: A fire fueled by the diamonds from the Fiend's Void burn hot enough to melt bones. Only those with greed that burns even harder can wield this weapon.

name: Diamond Pyre Blade (AC)
description: A fire fueled by the diamonds from the Fiend's Void burn hot enough to melt bones. Only those with greed that burns even harder can wield this weapon.

name: Digital DoomLord's Blade (0 AC)
description: This monstrous blade was once powerful enough to split one kingdom into sixteen regions during a costly uprising. Are you sure you want to risk wielding it?

name: Digital DoomLord's Blade (AC)
description: This monstrous blade was once powerful enough to split one kingdom into sixteen regions during a costly uprising. Are you sure you want to risk wielding it?

name: Digital Dragon Blade
description: Pulled out of a digital rock, this weapon is perfect for slaying all sorts of low-resolution wyrms.

name: Digital Phoenix Blade
description: By the powers of Good and Evil combined… the Phoenix Blade has been enveloped in a warm, golden glow. Crafted by renowned weaponsmith, Hikari.

name: Dimmed Overdriven Knight's Blade
description: Wrenched out of the dark, this blade has been blessed with divine Light. Redemption can be yours if you promise your body and soul.

name: Dinner Knife
description: Great for buttering giant slices of bread AND slicing up your enemies!

name: Dire Delusion Katana
description: A blade drenched in dark power, once dragged through the belly of its master's Lord. The severance of loyalty gives deeper depths to the shadows powering the katana.

name: Dire Delusions Blade
description: A blade drenched in dark power, once dragged through the belly of its master's Lord. This is a law of the land. Power must be passed on. Eventually, the wielder will become a mentor themselves. (Changes in combat)

name: Dire Marrowblade
description: Blunt but effective, what this blade lacks in elegance it makes up for in brute force.

name: Dirk of the Underworld
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Disaster
description: This sword, Disaster was created by a cursed knight alongside its twin staff, Cataclysm. Together these two weapons seem to have a history of seeming to cause heartbreak and bloodshed wherever they are found.

name: Discordian Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Avast! Ye better be beltin' out a hearty sea chanty as ye sail, or yer commander will keelhaul you and kick ya out of Discordia's Navy!

name: Discordian Cutlass (AC)
description: Avast! Ye better be beltin' out a hearty sea chanty as ye sail, or yer commander will keelhaul you and kick ya out of Discordia's Navy!

name: Dishonored Guardian Claymore
description: This blade is actually gold until it is touched by a Fallen Guardian which turns it infernal red.

name: Dishonored Sword
description: Aaah! It's looking at me!

name: Dissonant Espressivo
description: Created from the chaotic tendrils that sprout from a Dissonant Bandmaster's body when they immerse themselves in chaos, these weaponized instruments enrapture their victims. Tentacles will crawl out of their ears.

name: Distorted Mana Blade
description: Mana crystalized and forged into a blade. It invokes the power of a slumbering child trapped in the Mana Core. They have the potential for destruction as well as boundless good, never to be realized as decreed by the powers that be.

name: Disturbed Blade
description: Dare you test your fortitude, Hero? Dare you take up the sword that seems to boast its prowess, bloodstained and disturbed? Look closely at this mighty blade created by disturbed indestructible and feel yourself shiver. You shiver because you know what comes next…

name: Divine Intervention
description: Sacred sword, perfect for slaying hordes of undead.

name: Divine Ox Jian
description: In the Year of the Ox, celebrate diligence, dependability, strength and determination - all the things that make the ox a wonderful creature!

name: Djinn Summoner Sword
description: There are certain individuals who possess power to summon the rare and mighty Djinn. To summon and control a being with such raw strength takes a great amount of power.

name: Djinn Warrior Blade
description: These guardians of the realm serve the Djinn, so they must always present a noble and austere appearance.

name: Djinnitar
description: This scimitar is wielded by the guards of Efreet, King of the Djinn. While they don't normally need weapons to confront their opponents, the blades are a good backup in case their magic ever fails

name: Doom Blade of Awe
description: Could this be a real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Doom Celestial Sandsword
description: Defend the helpless and help the defenseless. With the blade of the Sandknights, you are honorbound to aid those who need it.

name: Doom Dragon Blade
description: A "gift" given to a Red Dragon from a former Dragonslayer. How kind of him to pass the present along to you!

name: Doom Edge
description: Who is this stranger? They only appear near Father's Day… I wonder if Sepulchure has anything to do with this.

name: Doom ExoKatana Binsoku
description: This katana will not only aid your agility, but when you click it you can transform it into the light-wielding weapon of your dreams!

name: Doom Golden Centurion Sword (1)
description: Used by the Golden Boy to quest for the Golden Egg with the Golden Compass and Golden Retriever while following the Golden rule.

name: Doom Golden Centurion Sword (2)
description: Used by the Golden Boy to quest for the Golden Egg with the Golden Compass and Golden Retriever while following the Golden rule.

name: Doom Ice Pop
description: Mmmm! Chill out with a doom ice pop. Who knows? Maybe the monsters you're defending against will want one, too.

name: Doom Katana
description: This katana is pure doooooooooooom.

name: Doom Knuckle Sword
description: Oh you've been naughty? Well Doom Claus is coming to town…

name: Doom Lilith Katana +5
description: A mystic katana from the para-elemental plane teeming with incalculable amounts of raw magic. Does more damage against DRAGONS!!!

name: Doom Lord Sepulchure Blade
description: You sealed your fate the moment you thought this sword couldn't hold any more DOOM. Will you control this blade, or will it control you? This blade does 25% more damage to Undead and Humans when equipped.

name: Doom Lord Skull Breaker
description: Forged from shadows and DOOM, this blade is even more powerful than the original; Paladins won't need their shoelaces anymore once you're through with them. This blade has a chance to do the shadow burst animation upon attack.

name: Doom O-dokuro Blade +5
description: A blade carved from the remains of O-dokuro. Hey--it's not gross, it's resourceful! Does more damage against UNDEAD!!!

name: Doom of the Matrix
description: Doomknights are scary enough without all these cybernetic enhancements!

name: Doom of the Matrix +3
description: Doomknights are scary enough without all these cybernetic enhancements!

name: Doom Ophidian Blade
description: Not actually a sword, but an ancient draconic creature from the depths of the sea.

name: Doom Phoenix Blade +5
description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

name: Doom Pirate Captain's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Doom Pirate Captain's Cutlass (AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Doom Pirate Captain's Rapier (AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Doom Red Star Sword
description: The origins of this sword are a mystery, but Quibble assures you it's worth his excessive price.

name: Doom Soul Ripper
description: Quibble says he found this sword on the battlefield after the second great war. Deathknights were known to wield such sinister weapons to steal their enemies souls…

name: Doom Star Slasher
description: Quibble hastily mentions something about Star.. fighters.. captains or was it pirates? All you know is Quibble wants to get rid of it fast so is willing to sell it for a bargain.

name: Doom Swirl Katana
description: Swirling purple DEATH!

name: Doom Worshipper's Blade
description: Sepulchure's hold is strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Doom Worshipper's Blade Of Doom
description: Sepulchure's hold is strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Doom Worshipper's Zweihander
description: Sepulchure's hold is strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Doomblade of Balor
description: This monstrous blade was once powerful enough to split one kingdom into sixteen regions during a costly uprising. Are you sure you want to risk wielding it? Suggested by Ferozakh.

name: Doomblade of Destruction
description: This monstrous blade was once powerful enough to split one kingdom into sixteen regions during a costly uprising. This item does 15% more damage to any monster, and gives 25% more class points, XP, gold, and rep when equipped.

name: Doomblade of Genocide
description: (Item does 40% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)Nulgath enhances your Doomblade, now giving you the advantage to fight through the frontlines of endless warfare.

name: DoomBringer Blade
description: You will wreak death and destruction upon Lore!

name: DoomDragon's Blade
description: Take to the skies in fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: Doomed Dutchman's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: A possessed blade in a perpetual state of dying. It's ghostly death rattle will haunt you longer than the scars it leaves on your skin.

name: Doomed Dutchman's Cutlass (AC)
description: A possessed blade in a perpetual state of dying. It's ghostly death rattle will haunt you longer than the scars it leaves on your skin.

name: Doomed Fiend of Light Blade
description: Fiends who have fallen but still try to uphold the power of the Light. Keeping the forces of Darkness away while fighting not to succumb to it's grasp.

name: Doomed Misericordia
description: A blade of mercy, tainted by Doom. The original sunk to the depths of the coldest river in the Underworld, while this doppel found a worthy warrior in a ShadowScythe loyalist.

name: DOOMED Monster Lord Blade
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monster may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: Doomed Rapier (0 AC)
description: Some of Gravelyn's soldiers have stolen away to a life of piracy on the high seas! Avast!

name: Doomed Rapier (AC)
description: Some of Gravelyn's soldiers have stolen away to a life of piracy on the high seas! Avast!

name: Doomed SpiritSeeker Blade
description: Once simple pirates these now cursed souls sail the darkest deeps of the seas looking for souls to harvest.

name: Doomed Vengeance Blade (0 AC)
description: A Doom Blade of great power…is what you'd believe it to be if you're desperate. Many entities of malicious make know the dark allure of such a weapon, luring lost souls with empty promises. (Click to change)

name: Doomed Vengeance Blade (AC)
description: A Doom Blade of great power…is what you'd believe it to be if you're desperate. Many entities of malicious make know the dark allure of such a weapon, luring lost souls with empty promises. (Click to change)

name: Doomed Vessel Sword
description: As the old saying goes, fight fire with fire. Fight Doom with more DOOM! The annals of shadowy history etched in this blade even say so. The worst enemy of Doom is itself. (Click Handle to change art)

name: Doomed Vita Camlan
description: The swords have come to reflect what happened to the city where they were forged. Gold withered into crimson, and its enchanted stell has become the bane of all men.

name: DoomFiend Blade (0 AC)
description: Once drenched in Shadow, this blade was resharpened by the talons of the Archfiend. It hungrily hunts the Light and the Shadows they leave behind.

name: Doomfiend Blade (AC)
description: Once drenched in Shadow, this blade was resharpened by the talons of the Archfiend. It hungrily hunts the Light and the Shadows they leave behind.

name: DOOMFire Blade
description: A prized possession of a great Shadowscythe commander, it is usually kept as a decoration in the throne room because of its unchecked power. if used gently and rarely, its power might not awaken……..yet.

name: DOOMFire Warrior Sword
description: This might blade's power to start a raging whirlwind of harvested souls and thickened dark clouds allows it to live up to the legendary DoomKnight's name.

name: DoomKnight Mech Blade
description: Every mech requires guards to prevent sabotage (and DOOM) from enemies.

name: DoomKnight Naval Sword
description: The Empress gave these out to the DoomKnight Commanders personally.

name: DoomKnight's SoulEater Blade (0 AC)
description: DoomFiend Overlords are entrusted by Nulgath to command entire legions of lesser warriors due to their skill, strength, and sheer power.

name: DoomKnight's SoulEater Blade (AC)
description: DoomFiend Overlords are entrusted by Nulgath to command entire legions of lesser warriors due to their skill, strength, and sheer power.

name: DoomKnight Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword is one of two designed and built for the AQW's 6th Upholders on the game's sixth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: DoomKnight Titan's Blade
description: NO FORCE ON THIS WORLD CAN DESTROY WHAT I AM! LONG UNLIVE THE SHADOWSCYTHE!!!!!!

name: DoomMage Rapier
description: BattleMages must always have their sword ready. This has been crafted specifically for DoomKnight BattleMages, by one of their own. (3% chance to do shadowburst animation and 15% rep boost)

name: DoomReaver Blade
description: Designed by VampireMax to cleave the light spread the dark glory of Doom!

name: DoomTech Commander's Cutlass
description: YARRRR! Hoist th' Pirate Flags of DOOOOOM and terrify your enemies no matter where you face them: on land, by sea, or sailing the dark waters of the underworld!

name: DoomTech Commander's Rapier
description: YARRRR! Hoist th' Pirate Flags of DOOOOOM and terrify your enemies no matter where you face them: on land, by sea, or sailing the dark waters of the underworld!
