name: DoomWood Dragon's Roar (0 AC)
description: The DoomWood DragonKnight's original steed couldn't be recovered in one piece. The Necromancers used what they could find to craft a new sword for their Warrior. It roars, luring Dragons into the dangerous night.

name: DoomWood Dragon's Roar (AC)
description: The DoomWood DragonKnight's original Dragon couldn't be recovered in one piece. The Necromancers used what they could find to craft a new sword for their Warrior. It roars, luring Dragons into the dangerous night.

name: Dornröschen
description: A large rose thorn fashioned into a piercing blade. Its a cruel weapon that curses your enemies to an endless sleep instead of death.

name: Dotanuki
description: Sometimes, simplicity is all you need for a raucous good time with the baddies. Strong, shiny and dependable, this sword will look good slicing through the air and body alike.

name: Dotanuki Blade
description: These deadly-sharp swords have come to the Swordhaven arsenal as a gift of friendship from Yokai.

name: Double Black Blade
description: Only the most powerful time travelers can wield the double black sonic.

name: Double Blue Blade
description: Only the most powerful time travelers can wield the double blue sonic.

name: Double Edged Unlucky Sword '09
description: (RARE) A very rare, VERY unlucky sword. Careful or you'll cut yourself!

name: Double Glow of Glory
description: Feliz Ano Novo! Manigong Bagong Taon! Joyeux Nouvel An! Xin Nian Hao! S Novim Godom! Frohes Neues Jahr! Felice Anno Nuovo! Happy New Year!

name: Double Sabre Of Peace
description: Even if you have nothing to fight for, having this at your side helps.

name: Double Sabre Of War
description: Finish what has been started.

name: Double Tipped Cutlass
description: *No description* For those who like to slash and spear… just be careful which end you use!

name: Double Trouble
description: A rare double-bladed fencing sabre only for the most skilled swashbuckler who likes to take on mlore than one enemy at a time.

name: Draco Sanguis Blade
description: Deep below the waves lives a nation of sea dragons. Masters of aquatic elemental magic, these ancient and powerful creatures have never been known to interact with the humans of Lore… until now. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Dracolich Bone Blade
description: Carved from a large Dracolich bone, this blade is laden with necromancy spells and a Dragon's grudge. Its rage over the humiliation of becoming an undead thrall grants the weapon the ability to make cuts fester.

name: Dracolich Broadsword
description: This undead doesn't look too happy that you cut off its head and made it into a sword. But you should be fine as long as you keep it pointed away from you.

name: Dracolich Tinsel Carver
description: It's important for Necromancers to have full control over any Dracolich they raise. The rules are different with undead weapons. They're far more deadlier if they're aware of what's been done to them.

name: Draconian Blade Bronze
description: *No description*

name: Draconian Blade Dark
description: *No description*

name: Draconian Blade Fire
description: *No description*

name: Draconian Blade Gold
description: *No description*

name: Draconian Blade Purple
description: *No description*

name: Draconian Blade Venom
description: *No description*

name: Draconian Blade Water
description: *No description*

name: Draconic Caladbolg (0 AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors in the Legion.

name: Draconic Caladbolg (AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors in the Legion.

name: Draconic Cardbroadsword
description: Your blade will never truly break, so long as the arts and crafts store keeps having that sale on tape every weekend.

name: Draconic Chronomancer's Sword
description: Draconic Chronomancers control the flow of time, causing it to circle back upon itself to make changes to the past… and future.

name: Draconic Fury
description: Wield this blade well, Warrior! Imbued with the spirit of an ancient draconic sage, this weapon will aid you in battle as you fight the forces which would overtake Lore!

name: Draconic Pulse
description: Look into the glowing eyes of the dragon, feel the pulse of its power as it courses through your blade. Be wary, though, for gazing too long, or desiring too much will enable this blade to consume you.

name: Draconic Savior Blade
description: Congratulations! You placed in the AQ:Dragons Art Contest so this awesome sword is your prize!

name: Dracosaster
description: There was a water dragon that could erode the sea or lower it whenever it took a breath. Thankfully, it is no longer alive, but its infamous power still flows like water in this sword.

name: Dracotastrophe
description: The black dragon whose bones comprise this very blade had reaped what it sowed when it governed a graveyard within Doomwood's enclave.

name: Dragarian Blade
description: It seems as if this sword was created as an example of poetry in motion. The intricate patterns glow from within the hard steel of the blade and the razor-sharp edges call for blood, coalescing to create the perfect sword.

name: Dragon Blade
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And we aren't talking about Sneevils or Zards here… (Equip this item to do 75% more damage to dragons + gain 1% more gold and rep.)

name: Dragon Chopper
description: Forged by dragons. Stolen by humans. Now used for slaying dragons.

name: Dragon Conquest Blade
description: With this blade at your side, you successfully slayed all the dragons in the MechQuest Universe. Now it's time to conquer all the dragons of Lore!

name: Dragon Defender's Ascension
description: The righteous clad in scales of red. Dragons who stand for the weak and trapped need not live long, but become immortal live immortal through the lives they save.

name: Dragon Heart Render
description: One of many blades that growls and spits. The Dracolich Lord has an entire armory of them, created from the bones of dragons that were partnered with enemy Dragonlords.

name: Dragon Khan Blade
description: Dragon Khaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaan! Made to celebrate our complete and total takeover (almost…) of Dragon Con 2011.

name: Dragon Knight Great Sword
description: Only the greatest of blades is worth of being wielded by a Dragon Knight!

name: Dragon Knight Split Blade
description: 2 wounds in an opponent is better than 1!

name: Dragon Leviathan Sword
description: While sentient in nature, it cannot communicate with its user unless possessed by another dragon for the long-gone dragon only trust its own kind. If its power is unlocked, it can be used to access hidden, but valued knowledge about a slain dragon.

name: Dragon of Light Blade
description: Like Mortals, dragons drawn to serve the Light are infused with power that can never be overshadowed by the darkness.

name: Dragon of Light Golden Blade
description: Like Mortals, dragons drawn to serve the Light are infused with power that can never be overshadowed by the darkness.

name: Dragon of Time FangBlade
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time is one of the most powerful beings Lore has ever seen. Torn by war, corrupted by Chaos, and reborn anew to walk Lore once more - wield the power wisely.

name: Dragon Overlord Blade
description: Big, bold, and heavy. Nothing can take a blow from this weapon and still be the same.

name: Dragon Piercer
description: This blade is wielded by the loyalest Dragonslayers! Crafted in honor of Galanoth the DragonSlayers lifelong battle against dragons.

name: Dragon Roar Sword
description: The slash power which emanates sounds like the roar of a mighty dragon.

name: Dragon's Blood Energy Blade
description: This sword is so bright, I gotta wear shades.

name: Dragon's Breath Katana
description: The same dragon that offered the jizamurai villages their blood gifted the assassins their breath as well. Lightning cooled in a sacred spring, and solidified into a blade.

name: Dragon's Call
description: Legend says when you fight with this sword, the sound echoes like the roar of a dragon.

name: Dragon's Courage
description: Dragons are one of the world's most courageous creatures, and with this blade in hand, you too can harness the Dragon's Courage! Fine engraving on the hilt states: "Created by Coolboypai"

name: Dragon's Dark Demise
description: If the DragonPlane Guardians revere their Draconic kin so much, why do they carry tainted Dragonslayer weapons? In truth, they idolize the unstoppable force of nature that is death over anything else.

name: Dragon's Defender
description: An ancient blade forgotten for centuries, forged in the depths of Vasalkar's Lair. A design completely created by player Skyline.

name: Dragon's DoomKnight Blade
description: Even the great Sepulchure would be envious of this blade.

name: Dragon's Flight (Sword)
description: As you get closer to discovering who is causing the plague AND how to stop them, the dragon spirit in this blade will evolve!

name: Dragon's Incendia
description: After Zoshi's meeting with a large beast of a dragon, all that was left was this prismatic sword and the dragons head. Wonder who won that confrontation….

name: Dragon's Maw
description: There is nothing worse than a tongue lashing, but what about one from a dragon? Use this cunning weapon to slash through your opponents. Though, that begs the question, which is worse - a dragon's tongue lashing, or a mother's?

name: Dragon's Salvation Blade
description: Forged from Dragon fire, a worthy weapon to defend Lore.

name: Dragon's Twilight
description: This blade is inlaid with age-darkened lapis lazuli and will remind you of warm nights staring up at the sky, waiting for the stars to guide you to your next rendezvous point with the rest of the DragonSlayer Order.

name: Dragon Samurai Katana (Sword) (1)
description: This sleek katana is the weapon of choice for Dragon Samurai.

name: Dragon Samurai Katana (Sword) (2)
description: Look straight at the people you kill, and never forget them. Because they'll never, ever forget you.

name: Dragon Saw
description: Carved from a massive scale, the damage this sword deals is outweighed only by its cool look.

name: Dragon Sword of Chaos
description: King Alteon's sword has been tainted by chaos energy.

name: Dragon Tongue
description: Forge by an ancient warrior of Evil, this hefty blade is created in the image of the legendary dragon. Its performance in battle reflects the dragon's unyielding animosity.

name: Dragon Trophy Blade
description: Our gift to AQWorlds' heroes for helping the AQW team win the DragonSlayer Awards!

name: Dragonbane Tanto
description: A deadly midnight black blade embellished with gold from a slain dragon's hoard. Often, it's used to carve a dragon into parts to be forged into new Dragonslayer weapons.

name: DragonBlade of Nulgath
description: Nulgath bends this sword giving you dominion over its aura. (Equip this item to do 75% more damage to dragons.)

name: DragonBlade Pop
description: Sweet dragonslaying treat!

name: Dragonblessed Silverthorn
description: Annointed with blood offered by their Dragon, this blade serves to protect their Dragonlord with ancient magic.

name: Unidentified 20 (Dragonbone Blade)
description: Nulgath slayed a dragon and crafted this sword form it's very bones. Congratulations on winning the "Dragonbone Blade"!

name: Dragonbone Blade
description: Crafted from the bones and sinew of long-dead dragons.

name: Dragonbone's Treasure Blade
description: Once lost after a tomb was raided, this blade was found by a famous treasure hunter.

name: DragonFable Memorial Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Dragonfable. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: DragonFiend Blade of Nulgath
description: Trueborn Nation Dragons are exceedingly rare. They cannibalize their own brethren if they aren't slain on sight. As the face of these blades, their voracity is immortalized.

name: DragonFire Katana
description: All hail the benevolent Royal Dragon! Wield this Flaming Katana well, and the Dragon will honor you!

name: DragonFire of Nulgath
description: Nulgath forges a blade out of the fire dragon..

name: Dragonfire Of Vengeance
description: This weapon was forged in magical dragon fire to give it the ability to pierce even the scales of the mightiest dragon. Suggested by AQW player TheAvenger07

name: DragonFlame Pirate's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: RAWWWWR! Ye'll scorch any landlubbers who oppose ye. If'n they don't flee in fear th' sight o' yer burnin' banner and flamin' cannons.

description: As you get closer to discovering who is causing the plague AND how to stop them, the dragon spirit in this blade will evolve!

description: The goldsmith that created this sword was known to be a savant artist on the battlefield and from the comfort of his forge, therefore, he merged beauty and brute strength into one masterpiece.

name: DragonLord Blade Prime
description: A blade fit for pealing the scales off of a dragon. Tonight, we dine in Lore!

name: DragonLord Commander's Sabre (0 AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

description: *No description*

description: Sea dragons are nothing like their counterparts in the skies. Galanoth gears up in the heaviest weapons he can find, diving into the perilous depths to slay massive ocean terrors.

description: Yarrr! A wise commander knows th' seas they sail, the crew they command, an' what creatures are loyal… and what creatures t' fear.

name: Dragontooth Ripper
description: A dragon's fangs make excellent weapons… for those warriors brave enough to attempt to steal them in the first place!

name: Drakath's Exalted Chaos

description: Drakels don't send messengers, Their Warmongers arrive where there is peace, and split the ground with the greatswords, declaring for war.

name: Drakka Defender Blade
description: Now that you've defeated Zorbak's Dracolich's you're rewarded with this stone sword. Hopefully he doesn't get anymore ideas…

name: Dravir Shortsword
description: Hand-crafted steel blades made by the Dravir.

description: This blade can cut through cyber tech like astro-butter!

name: Dreadcrystal Blade
description: A sword made with crystal fused to bone, this blade is both dazzling and deadly.

name: Dreaded Dracowerepyre Blade
description: Sometimes you're so eager to battle you don't even wait full the blade to cool… If it ever cools. You did notice the face, right?

name: Dreadfiend Blade of Nulgath
description: Nulgath awards only his most devoted followers with the color-custom Dreadfiend Blade of Nulgath. Continue to do what is necessary to earn his approval!

name: DreadForce Katana
description: You can't just get the job done all plain and simple. Where's the style? Katanas is nothing but style.

name: Dreadhaven Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by King Dethrix Drakath I. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Dream Blade
description: The warm blade of Dreams.

name: Dreambound Unicorn Sword
description: The blade, as sharp as a unicorn's horn, is made of crystalized light. They can cut through darkness, and dispel unending nightmares.

name: Dreambrand
description: Dreams can provide all kinds of insight. From the inner desires of the heart, divinations of the future, to worlds beyond our mortal vision. This blade is constructed from the dreams of countless heroes. Perhaps it will make your dreams come to fruition.

name: Dreamer's Chainsaw Blade
description: Just LOOK at this beautifully deadly monstrosity! How can anything be more lovely more-deadly and more painful than this? Nothing! Nothing I say! This is a sordid dreamer's fantasy come true.

name: Drill Breaker
description: This bore will puncture the firmament!

name: Drow Sabre
description: Lighting fast, the Drow wield swords with deadly grace.

name: Druuz's Sword
description: You take weapon, you absorb Druuz power and skill. Druuz live on in you. Respect.

name: Dual-Edged Gold Sonic Blade
description: Only the most powerful time travelers can wield the double gold sonic blade.

name: Dual-Edged Green Sonic Blade
description: Only the most powerful time travelers can wield the double green sonic.

name: Dual-Edged Pink Sonic Blade
description: Only the most powerful time travelers can wield the double-edged pink sonic blade.

name: Dual-Edged Purple Sonic Blade
description: Only the most powerful time travelers can wield the dual-edged purple sonic blade.

name: Dual-Edged Red Sonic Blade
description: Only the most powerful time travelers can wield the double sonic.

name: Duality Blade
description: The Duality Sorcerer reaches through Time to gather power from both Good and Chaos in order to power their spells.

name: Duality Captain's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Are pirates good or evil? Depends on who you ask, and how recently they were looted and/or pillaged!

name: Duality Captain's Cutlass (AC)
description: Are pirates good or evil? Depends on who you ask, and how recently they were looted and/or pillaged!

name: Duel Ended Energy Blades
description: Be careful when wielding this double ended energy blade. The last time someone, who was unqualified, used these blades, they ended up cutting off their own leg.

name: Dungeon Butcherer
description: The torture technicians of the Legion jokingly call this a butcher's cleaver. They're used on the prisoners of the Underworld, but comparing it to a tool that usually handles food is…interesting.

name: Dungeon Guard's Blade
description: Lascivia loves Killek's DeadChewer's dedication, but for the safety of her entire hoard'em, he must be locked away. Dungeon defenders keep him in… and others OUT!

name: Durendal
description: Forged by devilmaycry, the Durendal, or also known as the "Matter of Lore", is rumored to have freed the land after a plague of darkness fell over it many of moons ago.

name: Dwakel Warrior Sword
description: This sword buzzes faintly as you hold it in your hand.

name: Dwakelcharged Slicer
description: Like most Drakel weapons, this blade runs on currents and energy.

name: Dwarven Baselard
description: It's not short, it's "Vertically Challenged". This sword is actually quite large for a Dwarf.

name: Dynasty Blade
description: A simple, yet stylish, blade used only by the quickest, deadliest warriors.

name: Dynasty's Destiny Blade
description: A blade passed on to the new leader of each new Dynasty. Wielding this blade means you are destined to rule over many.

name: Earth Blade
description: Going Green on Earth Day never looked so fierce! The blade itself is covered in Poison Oak--let's hope you're not allergic!

name: Earthborn Blade of Awe
description: A natural version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will help keep Nature at its finest. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: Earthen Sword
description: With their mastery of the elemental, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. This sword was made by invoking the stone to take a physical shape.

name: EarthVessel Blade
description: Before there were castles and Kings, the forests were ruled by the wolves. This sword, blessed by Nature, was awarded to those who protected the Sea of Trees.

name: EarthVessel Dagger
description: A sacred dagger with deep ties to the earth and forests. It was used by noble heroes to eliminate aberrations and anomalies, allowing Greenguard to flourish into what it is today.

name: EarthVessel Kris
description: Resembling a blade of grass, the kris knife was used to predict the flow of Nature. There are greater forces at work, and a purpose for everyone.

name: EarthVessel Rapier
description: A rapier wrapped in vines. When the noble courts of humans and Fae used to mingle, they'd conduct honorable duels for titles, domains, and names.

name: Ebil AI Lazer Saber
description: Forged from impeccable code generated by AI. EbilCorp does not take responsibility for any laws broken by this weapon.

name: Ebil Capital Blade
description: EbilCorp cuts costs and corners in exciting and inventive ways. They'll do the same to you.

name: Ebil Designer AI Sword
description: Forged from impeccable code, generated by AI. EbilCorp does not take responsibility for any laws broken by this weapon.

name: Ebil Kuro's Wrath
description: You'll need something sharp to survive the viciously competitive job market.

name: Ebil Operative Baton Blade
description: Once a rogue Shadowslayer from the future, these soldiers are now rogue operatives for EbilCorp.

name: Ebil Operative Death Blade
description: Once a rogue Shadowslayer from the future, these soldiers are now rogue operatives for EbilCorp.

name: Ebil Operative Long Baton
description: Once a rogue Shadowslayer from the future, these soldiers are now rogue operatives for EbilCorp.

name: Ebil Virtue (0 AC)
description: A blade comprised of pure energy… the kind used to create worlds. Let this monstrosity slice your foes out of time and space, essentially erasing all it comes in contact with.

name: Ebil Virtue (AC)
description: A blade comprised of pure energy… the kind used to create worlds. Let this monstrosity slice your foes out of time and space, essentially erasing all it comes in contact with.

name: EbilCorp Agent's Katana
description: Mission #666.D -- Chairman Platinum has ordered you to follow Target EVotS. Objective: observe only. Report all activities.

name: Ebon Blade of Sands
description: The bandits roaming the endless dunes of the Sandsea desert are fierce, deadly, and mortal enemies of the SandSea Guardians!

name: Ebony DragonBlade of Nulgath
description: A branched blade of thorns. It will bleed its wielder dry at the first sign of disloyalty.

name: Ebony VoidCaster Blade (0 AC)
description: Enhanced by Nulgath, this blade holds the power to slice through any rifts opened in this dimension. For that reason, it is often used to slay rogue VoidCasters still using Nulgath's magic.

name: Ebony Voidcaster Blade (AC)
description: Enhanced by Nulgath, this blade holds the power to slice through any rifts opened in this dimension. For that reason, it is often used to slay rogue VoidCasters still using Nulgath's magic.

name: Ebony VoidCaster Lightning Blade (0 AC)
description: Enhanced by Nulgath, this blade holds the power to slice through any rifts opened in this dimension. For that reason, it is often used to slay rogue VoidCasters still using Nulgath's magic.

name: Ebony Voidcaster Lightning Blade (AC)
description: Enhanced by Nulgath, this blade holds the power to slice through any rifts opened in this dimension. For that reason, it is often used to slay rogue VoidCasters still using Nulgath's magic.

name: EC Mach 6 Sword
description: You look like a drone, you act like a drone… but only to get to the front of the line!

name: Ecliptica Kingdom Blade (0 AC)
description: The blade of an Immortal Lich King that was used to give up their own Kingdom in an exchange for an empire of the dead. One can not rule with absolute power if they're weighed down by a heart.

name: Ecliptica Kingdom Blade (AC)
description: The blade of an Immortal Lich King that was used to give up their own Kingdom in an exchange for an empire of the dead. One can not rule with absolute power if they're weighed down by a heart.

name: Ecto Blade of Insanity
description: In order to use a weapon like this properly, the wielder has to be a master of ectomancy in order to be able to constantly channel in new fresh ectoplasm to be used as the blade. Luckily this is one seems to be able to do that job for you.

name: Ecto Enforcer Sword
description: Enforcers exist for the sole purpose of removing all leftover magic there is. But one of them seems a bit different…

name: EctoBlade
description: You know it's time to stop slaying Ectomancers and slimeskulls when your entire blade is coated in goo!

name: Eden Judgement Blade
description: Life in Eden is idyllic for the citizens of the Crystallis Administration. The Crystallis Administration makes it clear that those who do not uphold this ideal will be judged and… re-educated.

name: Edge Blade 3000
description: Inspired by lilchris3000's design, this energy blade matches your eye color. Now you HAVE to remember your significant other's eye color, or you will surely lose a head!

name: Edge of Chaos Blade
description: A blade with ancient etchings, carved to mimic leylines flowing into a humanoid body. Chaos invades its veins, fusing seamlessly, as if it were meant to.

name: Edge of Chaos (Sword)
description: In Chaos, there is no right and wrong…ONLY DISORDER!!!!!!

name: Edge of Dawn
description: This blade walks not the path of evil nor one of good. Wielding this blade you walk the path of Dawn. A hero unmatched by any adversary of both darkness and light.

name: Edge of Light
description: This mystic blade does its best work under the light of the sun.

name: Edge of the Fyreborn (AC)
description: Easy there tiger, leave enough monsters for the rest of us.

name: Edge of the Fyreborn (Special)
description: Easy there tiger, leave enough monsters for the rest of us.

name: Edge Of The Void
description: Even when enveloped by the Void's corruption, the sword's emotionless still radiates a beauty long-thought to be lost.

name: Effortless Effloresce
description: No living organism, be it flora or fauna, stands a chance when facing this behemoth blade. As the name suggests, this sword effortlessly slices through anything it encounters while maintaining its flourishing ecosystem.

name: Eggly Blue Haresplitter
description: The magical blue egg on the end of this sword glows strong as you are surely stepping closer to a camouflaged Grenwog prize.

name: Eggly Pink Haresplitter
description: The magical pink egg on the end of this sword glows strong as you are surely stepping closer to a camouflaged Grenwog prize.

name: Eidolon Wings Rapier (0 AC)
description: A weightless rapier with a crossguard styled after a Vampire's elegant bat form. They can cure the maladies of old age in exchange for a significant offering of blood.

name: Eidolon Wings Rapier (AC)
description: A weightless rapier with a crossguard styled after a Vampire's elegant bat form. In exchange for a significant offering of blood, the weapon can cure the maladies of old age.

name: Eldritch Blade of Debris
description: The Scale refer to these weapons as 'skin tags.' They appear at random, growing from empty spots in the garden. Taking the shape of lost swords, these 'lifeforms' lure unsuspecting victims into fusing with them. (Grows larger in combat)

name: Eldritch DeepDweller's Blade
description: From out of the depths, a sinister new army rises. They herald the dawn of a darker, deadlier elder deity. BEWARE. (CC to Trim)

name: Eldritch DeepDweller's Sword
description: From out of the depths, a sinister new army rises. They herald the dawn of a darker, deadlier elder deity. BEWARE. (CC to Trim)

name: Eldritch KeyBlade
description: Sometimes dressing up for Mogloween just means really dressing up. To the nines.

name: Eldritch Malarkey
description: This weapon was constructed from a writhing mass of matter. It’s difficult to consider it a living being as it lacks comprehensible internal organs.

name: Eldritch Twilight Dirk
description: The hooked blade of this dirk rips through blubber and pierces chitinous armor. You created it from the bone and flesh of a terrifying deep sea monster. The strong will one day fall, feeding the weak until they grow into new monsters.

name: Eldritch Warrior's Blade
description: From out of the depths, a sinister new army rises. They herald the dawn of a darker, deadlier elder deity. BEWARE. (CC to Trim)

name: Eldritch Warrior's Sword
description: From out of the depths, a sinister new army rises. They herald the dawn of a darker, deadlier elder deity. BEWARE. (CC to Trim)

name: Electric Loveletter Opener
description: The Archfiend knows you're as cold as ice in battle… now you can also be fabulous!

name: Electric Loveletters
description: The Archfiend knows you're as cold as ice in battle… now you can also be fabulous!

name: Electric Surcharge
description: Made up of billions of microscopic mech, this blade slices through solid steel like butter.

name: Electric Underworld Katana
description: Though the Underworld has existed since the first life expired, it keeps up with the times. Or, it even moves ahead of the game.

name: Electrified Assassin Blade
description: One stab and the electric shock stops the target's pulse dead. It's an expensive piece of weaponry meant for high risk, high reward hits.

name: Electrified Ninja Katana
description: *No description*

name: Electro Bioblade
description: You were made to wield this blade! This special sword will unlock when the BioBeasts Facebook page reaches 25,000 Likes. Show off this sword and tell all your friends about BioBeasts! http://biobeasts.artix.com

name: Elegant Cutlass
description: For the most elegant of pirates.. just remember to clean it after use.

name: Elegant Death
description: Trolls do not often engage in combat, but when they do, they are superior warriors! Brutes may bash with axes and bludgeoning instruments, but for the Trolls who enjoy battle, they make of war a dance!

name: Elegant Naval Rapier (0 AC)
description: Sometimes you just have to dress up when sailing the seas of Lore. Piracy can be fancy!

name: Elegant Naval Rapier (AC)
description: Sometimes you just have to dress up when sailing the seas of Lore. Piracy can be fancy!

name: Elegant Prestige Blade
description: A ceremonial sword weilded by nobles capable of combat and offensive light magic. This sword glows from their attunment to Light, magnifying the grace and purity that has become one with the element's image.

name: Elegant Runeblade
description: Even the most dashing of warrior-mages cannot help but look better when they have THIS blade in hand!

name: Elegant Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQWorld's 12th Upholders on the game's twelfth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Elemental Creation
description: You are a legend formed before, during, and after the fusion of 3 very different worlds, and their elements and timelines. Your fate is in your hands… what will you do with it?

name: Elemental Destruction
description: You are a legend formed before, during, and after the fusion of 3 very different worlds, and their elements and timelines. Your fate is in your hands… what will you do with it?

name: Elemental DragonSlayer Katana
description: Burning with the passion to protect just like its owner, the thin blade that is part of this katana is capable of cutting through stone and ice as if it is made out of wood.

name: Elemental DragonSlayer Sword
description: Call upon the Elements to help you fight the dragons.

name: Elemental Dragonsword
description: A sword forged from pitch black igneous rock that houses four unlikely elements; fire, ice, water, and light, which seems to amazingly coexist, creating a colourful and deadly canvas of blows if their wielder desires to get clever in the battlefield.

name: Elemental Guardian's Blade
description: A blade with ancient etchings, carved to mimic leylines flowing into a humanoid body. Mana flows easily through the crevices, able to ignite into any element.

name: Elemental Guardian's Cleaver
description: A cleaver forged with Prima Materia, able to hold its form in any environment. Few exist, and the method used to forge them has been lost to time.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Air
description: You can sense the Avatar of Air's power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Darkness
description: You can sense the Avatar of Darkness' power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Earth
description: You can sense the Avatar of Earth's power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Energy
description: You can sense the Avatar of Energy's power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Fire
description: You can sense the Avatar of Fire's power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Ice
description: You can sense the Avatar of Ice's power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Light
description: You can sense the Avatar of Light's power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Star Sword of Water
description: You can sense the Avatar of Water's power coursing through this blade. Wield it carefully, hero… this much magic is a deadly weapon.

name: Elemental Sword
description: A special type of mana sphere that can draw carved stone close to its presence. This one ended up created a stable sword when it was put to use for the first time.

name: Elim's Sword
description: This is the blade that the martyr Elim used to foil Kezeroth's attempt to destroy Lore more than 26,000 years ago.

name: Elite Exponent Saber
description: A single, shining blade singing its own song of victory over Drakath's forces. In the right hands its top quality craftsmanship can be unimaginably deadly.

name: Elite Void Broadsword
description: Those who Nulgath calls Elite must be true fiends. The Archfiend does not bestow this name on just any Void in his Nation.

name: Elite Void Sword
description: Those who Nulgath calls Elite must be true fiends. The Archfiend does not bestow this name on just any Void in his Nation.

name: Elite Warden Sword
description: The price of haloed glory and reverence is a short life made up of brutal encounters. But your name will far outlive your body.

name: EmberFlame Blade
description: The EmberFlame Dragonkin have willingly given themselves up to serve dragons who have allied with Malgor and his ShadowFlame army.

name: EmberFlame Claymore
description: The EmberFlame Dragonkin have willingly given themselves up to serve dragons who have allied with Malgor and his ShadowFlame army.

name: Embersea Overlord's Reaver
description: The volcanoes that ring Embersea burn with an elemental fury. Only the strongest rulers can survive reigning over this land.

name: Emerald Darkness Blade
description: Forged from a variety of gemstones, these swords make it easier to defeat you Draconic foes. The Emerald Blade was originally commissed by the Lady Celiena, a lover of emeralds and darkness.

name: Emerald Dragon Blade
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And then re-created it from a solid emerald block it so it would be even heavier! Better to train with that way!

name: Emerald Eons Blade
description: The lush color green is hard to come by in the Sandsea, and is as rare as a long life. This blade was forged with royal emeralds, meant to protect the wielder's bonds and bless them with longevity.

name: Emerald Eons Khopesh
description: The lush color green is hard to come by in the Sandsea, and is as rare as a long life. This weapon was forged with royal emeralds, meant to protect the wielder's bonds and bless them with longevity.

name: Emerald Willowcreek Blade
description: Infused with emerald this blade is definitely utsukushii.

name: Emerald Yokai Pirate Katana (0 AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Emerald Yokai Pirate Katana (AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Empire Bloodguard's Blade
description: Even if prey slips away, their wounds ache during nightfall. Perhaps this will be a sign of a lesson leamed, or a promise that the bloodguard will return to split the scars open.

name: Empowered Blade of Chaos
description: The legendary sword that has been used by Drakath for nearly 13 years has become even more powerful. Sooo… chaorrupted. (Item does 75% more damage to Chaos monsters when equipped)

name: Empowered BladeMaster's Katana
description: This item does 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped. The blademaster's weapons are carved with precision to move through the air faster than the human eye can see.

name: Empowered Caladbolg
description: This item does 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped. Wielding Caladbolg, you will be able to chop the heads off your enemies and the tops off hills!

name: Empowered Chaos Avenger's Greatsword
description: In one timeline, The Hero managed to defeat Drakath and get a hold of their Chaos Amulet. Instead of becoming the Slayer who tried to destroy Lore, The Hero became the Avenger that saved it. (Item does 75% more damage to Chaos monsters when equipped)

name: Empowered Charged Oblivion Blade
description: This mysterious, living blade has destroyed innumerable lives. You know of only one who has had the power to wield it, the old one. And now you may wield it's power and live to tell about it… for now.

name: Empowered DOOMFire Blade
description: A prized possession of a great Shadowscythe commander, it is usually kept as a decoration in the throne room because of its unchecked power. if used gently and rarely, its power might not awaken……..yet.

name: Empowered Higure
description: ﻿It is impossible to run away from this black blade. I wonder if there is a more worthy hero to wield it?

name: Empowered Hollowborn Caladbolg
description: Against your indomitable Hollowborn will, your enemies will fall and the mountains will bow.

name: Empowered Magus Greatsword
description: Once a Magus Greatsword reaches critical mass in terms of sapped mana, the blade glows with a power all its own. Each strike burns through armor and consumes the target with a cleansing flame.

name: Empowered Oblivion Blade
description: This mysterious, living blade has destroyed innumerable lives. You know of only one who has had the power to wield it, the old one. And now you may wield it's power and live to tell about it… for now.

name: Empowered Overfiend Blade
description: This item does 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped. Nulgath, Abyss General's monstrous form is the result of his original form shifting to another reality. His sword has also shifted.

name: Empowered Prismatic Manslayer
description: Taro had fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. ( You can probably relate.) His spirit, experience and discipline are captured in this sword. Use it well… (Blade is CC. Weapon does 51% more damage to all monsters.)

name: Empowered Shadow Magus Greatsword (0 AC)
description: Once a Magus Greatsword reaches critical mass in terms of sapped mana, the blade glows with a power all its own. Each strike burns through armor and consumes the target with a cleansing flame.

name: Empowered Shadow Magus Greatsword (AC)
description: Once a Magus Greatsword reaches critical mass in terms of sapped mana, the blade glows with a power all its own. Each strike burns through armor and consumes the target with a cleansing flame.

name: Empowered Sole Bloodletter
description: This item does 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped. The sole blades of the Blood Void.

name: Empowered Sword Of Light
description: The brightest light is a beacon in the dark. Bow down before Empress Gravelyn!

name: Empyreal Blessing Blade
description: In the distant past a warlord from the Yokai Isles was enamored by the craftsmanship of the Dwarfhold swordsmiths and had this weapon commissioned. Imbued with the tear of an angel this edge can cut through the accursed and divine.

name: Empyrean Chronomancer Blade
description: Empyrean Chronomancers seem to have simply always existed. Their bodies transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence. To tap into this strength requires particular insight though.

name: Empyrean Void's Zweihander (0 AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the most highly-revered of Nulgath's Nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Empyrean Void's Zweihander (AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the most highly-revered of Nulgath's Nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Enchanted Acheron Soul Cleaver
description: Slaine is considered the best of the Legion's Soul Cleavers, and others would be able to rise to his level if he could just stop biting them. His Lord armed him with this blade, and advised apprentices to learn by watching him.

name: Enchanted Alteon Blade
description: A good King does not wish to use his sword. But in times of necessity, the blade will cleave true for all the world to see.

name: Enchanted Aquitaine
description: The ancestral blade of House Vaughn, said to have been pulled from the heart of a golden buck. Like its master, there's a legend about it. The more paintings, copies, and depictions there are of the sword, the sharper it gets.

name: Enchanted Balloon Chainsaw
description: Designed for battling Air Elementals and other incorporeal beings. Be VERY careful this weapon doesn't POP in the middle of battle! (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Balloon Katana
description: Designed for battling Air Elementals and other incorporeal beings. Be VERY careful this weapon doesn't POP in the middle of battle! (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Balloon Rapier
description: Designed for battling Air Elementals and other incorporeal beings. Be VERY careful this weapon doesn't POP in the middle of battle! (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Balloon Sword
description: Designed for battling Air Elementals and other incorporeal beings. Be VERY careful this weapon doesn't POP in the middle of battle! (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Balor's Hunger (0 AC)
description: Built from the carcasses of arachnids in Tercessuinotlim. Brandish these swords, and become walking-arachnophobia.

name: Enchanted Balor's Hunger (AC)
description: Built from the carcasses of arachnids in Tercessuinotlim. Brandish these swords, and become walking-arachnophobia.

name: Enchanted BeastMaster Blade
description: This sword helps protect nature.

name: Enchanted Big 100K
description: Yes, that's right. THE Big 100K.

name: Enchanted Blade
description: You need a sword…

name: Enchanted Blade of DOOM
description: What arcane spell did Cysero apply to enchant Sepulchure's Blade of DOOM?! O_O Best not to ask…

name: Enchanted Blade of Dread
description: After merging an ordinary weapon looted from Lord Reignolds' lair with a mysterious, enchanted gem, this weapon pulses with a strange and unsettling power.

name: Enchanted Blade of Forbidden Doom
description: Returning from the abyss of eons past, a time when titans clawed up seas and mountains, Doom rises. This blade had the honor of leaving scars on the light, and has returned in the shade of eclipse. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Blade of Gaheris
description: Before the Avatar Haeos sent lightning bolts down to his First Champion, Gaheris wielded an enchanted blade. This replica will serve you well.. without shocks. (Item is customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Enchanted Blade of Ignis
description: A blade brimming with the power of an Infernal Warlord King. (This item is color customizable to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Blade of Light
description: Shine on, Celestial Hero! This blade gives 25% more class points when equipped.

name: Enchanted Blade of Salvation
description: The golden blade is not gilded because it serves a King or the greedy gods. It serves the people, and all that is good. Its gleam strikes fear into the hearts of evil, no matter what form it takes. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Blood Isles Cutlass
description: A battleworn cutlass that's been rusted by blood. It's haunted by a rage that refuses to die.

name: Enchanted Bloodletter Katana
description: Carnage's body has become completely made of blood, while Nulgath holds his blood ties over his head. But, anything can become a weapon. The Archfied knows that well.

name: Enchanted Bloodriver
description: This blade was forged in another dimension, made from Nexusteel and sharpened against the edge of reality itself. Impressive, right?

name: Enchanted Condemned Shadow Sword
description: A sword for the rebels and new blood. Doom may have a Master but these Shadows spit in the face of this fraud. Total domination will be achieved under new names, hand in hand with their chosen champion. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Corsair's Rapier
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it. (This item is color customizable to Accessory.)

name: Enchanted Crafted LongSword
description: Crafted? Mine!

name: Enchanted Crafted Sword
description: Crafted? Mine!

name: Enchanted Cutlass
description: Y'arrr! Th' Naval Commander is the scourge of the seven seas. An' for sailing with us for 10 years, ye've been awarded the Enchanted Naval Commander gear.

name: Enchanted Cyber FrostReaver (0 AC)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Cyber FrostReaver (AC)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Cyber FrostReaver (Legend)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Dagger of Dread
description: After merging an ordinary weapon looted from Lord Reignolds' lair with a mysterious, enchanted gem, this weapon pulses with a strange and unsettling power.

name: Enchanted Daimyo's Katana
description: Elaborate armor worn by only the highest level of Akiban defenders. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Daimyo's Sheathed Katana
description: Elaborate armor worn by only the highest level of Akiban defenders. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Dark Bloodletter Katana
description: Nation hopefuls are maddened by Nulgath's trials until they become mindlessly loyal attack dogs. Ironically, Carnage started out that way, and was shaped to become a skilled General instead. This blade sharpened as he rose.

name: Enchanted Dark Nodachi
description: An upper echelon of the warrior class, the Akiban Samurai defends the Empress and the land from evil. Their warcry is: "For honor, for the Isle, and for the Empress!"

name: Enchanted Dark Omen Barb
description: A blade that humbles houses and pact writers, yearning to tear into the arrogant might who sit atop thrones built on mortal mistakes.

name: Enchanted Dark Samurai Katana
description: An upper echelon of the warrior class, the Akiban Samurai defends the Empress and the land from evil. Their warcry is: "For honor, for the Isle, and for the Empress!"

name: Enchanted Deadsea Scalper
description: Not one of Naval Commander Vordred's favorite tools. It shaves way to much off the top, and he's left with pieces of what would have been perfectly good SKULLS.

name: Enchanted DeathLord's Blade
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: Enchanted Default Sword
description: The metal blade of this sword has been enchanted. You can customize its color any time you want!

name: Enchanted Doom Titan's Blade
description: NO FORCE ON THIS WORLD CAN DESTROY WHAT I AM! LONG UNLIVE THE SHADOWSCYTHE!!!!!! (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Dragonbane Tanto
description: A deadly midnight black blade embellished with gold from a slain dragon's hoard. Often, it's used to carve a dragon into parts to be forged into new Dragonslayer weapons.

name: Enchanted DragonMage's Blade
description: Something wicked is definitely on its way when Enchanted DragonMage's meet to summon powerful dragons. Their rituals are magic in the making.

name: Enchanted Eldritch Keyblade
description: Sometimes dressing up for Mogloween just means really dressing up.  To the nines.

name: Enchanted Empress Battle Blade (0 AC)
description: When even BrightFall is invaded by shadow, Gravelyn the Good will do whatever it takes to defend her realm. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Empress Battle Blade (AC)
description: When even BrightFall is invaded by shadow, Gravelyn the Good will do whatever it takes to defend her realm. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Empress Blade (1)
description: When even BrightFall is invaded by shadow, Gravelyn the Good will do whatever it takes to defend her realm. (This items is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Empress Blade (2) (0 AC)
description: When even BrightFall is invaded by shadow, Gravelyn the Good will do whatever it takes to defend her realm. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Empress Blade (2) (AC)
description: When even BrightFall is invaded by shadow, Gravelyn the Good will do whatever it takes to defend her realm. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Eternal PainSaw
description: If you listen closely, the millions of souls killed and trapped inside this chainsword of terror scream for help.

name: Enchanted Evanescence (0 AC)
description: An interesting name…Though a blade of great power forged by Dage the Evil himself, it's ephemeral and meant to leave the Underworld. Intended for those he can trust his realm to, Dage does not expect them to stay, nor will he trap them.

name: Enchanted Evanescence (AC)
description: An interesting name…Though a blade of great power forged by Dage the Evil himself, it's ephemeral and meant to leave the Underworld. Intended for those he can trust his realm to, Dage does not expect them to stay, nor will he trap them.

name: Enchanted Ex Tenebris
description: From darkness comes light. A young warrior wielded this blade when they began to dream of leading their clan out of the shadows. The dream became reality, but all who emerge from the dark must one day return to it.

name: Enchanted Exalted Light Blade
description: The Lord of Exalted Light's personal blade and most treasured possession. Before Malgor's creator set him free, letting go of their last hopes, they gave him a blade engraved with their courage and conviction.

name: Enchanted FireDrake's Lance
description: This lance was made from the tail of a Firedrake defeated near molten vortex and is now color-customizable. (Weapon damage is static and does 30% more to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Enchanted Formal Nation Blade (0 AC)
description: An elegant sword meant for keeping Nation business clean, in that it'll cut up enemies quickly and quietly without soiling your clothes with splatter.

name: Enchanted Formal Nation Blade (AC)
description: An elegant sword meant for keeping Nation business clean, in that it'll cut up enemies quickly and quietly without soiling your clothes with splatter.

name: Enchanted Frozen Claymore
description: Guarded by Izotz, this farmed weapon is now in the hands of the true hero! (Boost against Dragons, Gold, and Rep!)

name: Enchanted Gem Dagger
description: A custom dagger offered by the jewellers and blacksmith's of Thelima. They have different properties depending on which gems you choose, but most reccommend going with your birthstone.

name: Enchanted Greatsword of Dread
description: After merging an ordinary weapon looted from Lord Reignolds' lair with a mysterious, enchanted gem, this weapon pulses with a strange and unsettling power.

name: Enchanted Grovebreaker's Blade
description: At a young age, Grovebreak elves are given this sword for protection against the night. Made from obsidian with a flame of the morning light, this sword is the candle that will light your way through dark dungeons.

name: Enchanted Heroic Titan's Greatsword
description: Even in moments of deepest despair, we can still find hope. No matter how messed up things get, YOU have the power to save the day. (CC to Base,Trim)

name: Enchanted Holiday Cookie Blade
description: Congratulations on making one of the sweetest treats in our annual Frostval Cookie Contest!

name: Enchanted Ice Katana
description: This katana has been infused with the power of the Frozen Claymore. Use it wisely!

name: Enchanted Ice Lord Blade
description: Only a fool would battle against these frozen warriors of the North. Ice runs deep in their veins giving them the upper hand. This sword gives you 20% more gold when equipped.

name: Enchanted Infernal Underworld Battle Blade
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction. (Item is CC to Eye)

name: Enchanted Infernal Underworld Katana
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction. (Item is CC to Eye)

name: Enchanted Infernal Underworld Sheathed Katana
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction. (Item is CC to Eye)

name: Enchanted Justice Blade
description: Wielders of this blade became members of the Justice Squad after completing Nythera's Scroll of Laws quest.

name: Enchanted Kaharaka's Lightning Fang
description: WARNING: this dagger's lightning energy is capable of shocking your foes… AND your friends… AND YOU! (This item is color customizable to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Kitsune Katana (0 AC)
description: The fox spirit guides these pirates to riches beyond the shores of Yokai Island.

name: Enchanted Kitsune Katana (AC)
description: The fox spirit guides these pirates to riches beyond the shores of Yokai Island.

name: Enchanted Knight Slasher
description: No matter how many "stoneskin enchantments" your opponent has cast on his armor, this weapon will be able to pierce it (and his innards)! (This item is color customizable to Trim and Accessory)

name: Enchanted Legacy Nation Blade (0 AC)
description: This blade wears the face of Archfiend Nulgath. His likeness in exact precision is only trusted to legacy members of the Nation.

name: Enchanted Legacy Nation Blade (AC)
description: This blade wears the face of Archfiend Nulgath. His likeness in exact precision is only trusted to legacy members of the Nation.

name: Enchanted Legendary DragonBlade
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Luminous Mikazuki
description: A katana wielded by one of the founders of the Yokai Isles' royal family. Its golden edge radiates with purity, having been washed in the blood of a powerful dragon.

name: Enchanted Mana Blade
description: Complete the Legendary Enchantment Quest to unlock the final version of this blade.

name: Enchanted Marsh Sword
description: A weapon found in the long lost depths of a marsh.(Color custom)

name: Enchanted Naval Guard's Cutlass
description: YARRR! It's more fun to be a pirate than to join th' navy… but ye'll be more successful at inflitratin' other crews if'n they think ye're a legit Naval Guard. (Item is Color Customizable).

name: Enchanted Naval Guard's Rapier
description: YARRR! It's more fun to be a pirate than to join th' navy… but ye'll be more successful at inflitratin' other crews if'n they think ye're a legit Naval Guard. (Item is Color Customizable).

name: Enchanted Necrayaya's Spear
description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo! When the band is made up of undead mariachi musicians, the /party will NEVER stop! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Necrotic Dao of Doom
description: A weapon made to establish the Yinglian Dynasty. It remains an empty vessel yet to meet its Emperor and Shadow. Once it obtains both, it will have the power to cleave the sun in two. (Item is fully color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Nox Scar Carver
description: In life, the barbarians left scars on the lands and people of Lore. In the Underworld, their weapons crave that lost sensation. If unleashed back into the world of the living, the mayhem caused would be indescribable.

name: Enchanted Obsidian FrostReaver (0 AC)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Obsidian FrostReaver (AC)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Obsidian FrostReaver (Legend)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Omnia Mortis
description: Nihil interit. Everything dies, nothing perishes. All life ends, but they leave their mark. The soul persists. Dage forged this blade, and gave it to the General of the Acheron to slay those who sully this law.

name: Enchanted Phoenix Blade
description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

name: Enchanted Polar Beast Blade (0 AC)
description: The strongest ice spells transform flesh into solid ice. When a druid in the form of a bear was slain and turned to ice, a blade filled with their might was carved from their frigid bones.

name: Enchanted Polar Beast Blade (AC)
description: The strongest ice spells transform flesh into solid ice. When a druid in the form of a bear was slain and turned to ice, a blade filled with their might was carved from their frigid bones.

name: Enchanted Pretty Balloon Sword
description: Cute, but it's sure to mess up a good hair day. Everyone's nightmare. (CC to accessory)

name: Enchanted Purist's Soul Blade
description: Mercy is a gift, not an obligation.

name: Enchanted Red Star Sword
description: This blade seems to harness the power of light itself. It's a force to be reckoned with.

name: Enchanted Regal Pirate Rapier
description: With such regal bearing, none will question your right to command either ship or crew. This weapon has been enchanted and is color-customizable.

name: Enchanted RiftWalker Blade
description: The blades Riftwalkers wield are enhanced with ancient runes which, it is said, an ancient alien race used before they found better ways of traveling between realms.

name: Enchanted SandGuardian Blade
description: The Sandsea Guardian is a member of the elite Oasis Defense Force. Their armor helms helps them blend in with the dunes, making attacking their enemies much easier.

name: Enchanted Seven Fang Blade
description: The sister blade of the Seven Branch Sword wielded by the main branch of the Yokai Isles' royal family. It has torn through the scales of countless dragons, bringing an end to their everlasting lives.

name: Enchanted Shadow Blade
description: Complete the Legendary Enchantment Quest to unlock the final version of this blade.

name: Enchanted ShadowDrake's Lance
description: This lance was made from the tail of a Firedrake corrupted by the ShadowFlame and is now color-customizable. (Weapon damage is unstable and does 30% more to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Enchanted ShadowFlame Broadsword
description: Those who study the magics of the ShadowFlame slowly begin to become one with them.

name: Enchanted ShadowFlame DoomBlade
description: Continual study provides these Warlocks with the ability to fully control their flames.

name: Enchanted ShadowFlame Flamberge
description: This sword's blade was made from molten lava and tainted by the ShadowFlame's corruption. It has been enchanted and is now color-customizable.

name: Enchanted Shinobi Katana
description: These Elite Ninja warriors wear colorful raiment that allows them to move freely in any direction - so you never know from where they will attack!

name: Enchanted Skull Blade
description: …with skulls on it…

name: Enchanted Skulls on Skulls Blade
description: …and skulls on the skulls…

name: Enchanted Soul Ripper
description: Quibble says he found this sword on the battlefield after the second great war. Deathknights were known to wield such sinister weapons to steal their enemies souls…

name: Enchanted Speirling Gaheris Blade (Sword)
description: Legends say that the Avatar Haeos sent a lightning bolt down to his First Champion. Gaheris caught it in his hand, and it became his sword. (Item is customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Enchanted Speirling Guardian Dagger
description: The original gilded dagger wielded by the First Champion of Energy's younger brother. Its gold can be traced back to Camlan, where Light and Lightning clashed for dominion over the continent that would one day become Greenguard.

name: Enchanted SpellSword's Blade
description: Spellswords draw magic from the ley lines and imbue their blades with it. Enchanted Spellswords mix their magic with Malgor's Darkness and are feared across Lore.

name: Enchanted SpellSword's Flame Blade
description: Spellswords draw magic from the ley lines and imbue their blades with it. Enchanted Spellswords mix their magic with Malgor's Darkness and are feared across Lore.

name: Enchanted Spiked Skulls on Fire Blade
description: …and set the whole thing on fire!

name: Enchanted Spikes on Skulls Blade
description: …and spikes on the skulls…

name: Enchanted Spirit
description: A hauntingly beautiful blade whose power is determined by its master's spirit. A design completely created by player Skyline.

name: Enchanted Tora Katana
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Tora Warrior. The more you study, the more you become closer to the tiger. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Tora Kunai
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Tora Warrior. The more you study, the more you become closer to the tiger. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Tora Sheathed Katana
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Tora Warrior. The more you study, the more you become closer to the tiger. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Toy Soldier's Frostval Rapier (0 AC)
description: (Item is color-custom to Base)

name: Enchanted Toy Soldier's Frostval Rapier (AC)
description: (Item is color-custom to Base)

name: Enchanted Transcendence Blade
description: Grim nor valourous, evil nor good, the blade holds alliegiance only to the Great. Perhaps it transcendend time and space to find your hand.

name: Enchanted Vanguard BruteSword Of Nulgath
description: Marching proudly at the forefront of Nulgath's Nation, the warriors in his Vanguard are the first to terrify his opponents and recruit soldiers to his army. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Vanguard Claymore Of Nulgath
description: Marching proudly at the forefront of Nulgath's Nation, the warriors in his Vanguard are the first to terrify his opponents and recruit soldiers to his army. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Vanguard Fleshripper Of Nulgath
description: Marching proudly at the forefront of Nulgath's Nation, the warriors in his Vanguard are the first to terrify his opponents and recruit soldiers to his army. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Victory Blade
description: Complete the "Align the Blade" quest to take this weapon to the next level!

name: Enchanted Void Awakening Blade (AC)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Enchanted Void Awakening Blade (Special)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Enchanted Voracity of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath presents you a deadly sword, forged from solidified venom entangled with the souls of numerous traitors. A single slash is all it takes for the strongest of enemies to fall at death's door.

name: Enchanted Voracity of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath presents you a deadly sword, forged from solidified venom entangled with the souls of numerous traitors. A single slash is all it takes for the strongest of enemies to fall at death's door.

name: Enchanted Wolf Warrior's Blade
description: There are no lone Frostborn Wolves. The only thing deadlier than facing one in battle… is turning your back on a member of the pack. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Enchanted Wolf Warrior's Katana
description: There are no lone Frostborn Wolves. The only thing deadlier than facing one in battle… is turning your back on a member of the pack. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Energized TimeSplitter Blade
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Energized Veselago
description: An energy blade of mysterious make. The handle was found entombed in metal, and seemed to come alive when struck by lightning.

name: Energy Blade of Awe
description: Tek made you this energy blade into a replica of the Blade of Awe. The blade is so powerful that it can cut through almost anything with ease. Just make sure you don't use it to shave.

name: Energy Disc
description: A disc of burning, malevolent energy radiates at in your hand. At first you thought it was a cape, but then again you sometimes wear hats on your feet, don't you?

name: Energy Ripper
description: Black Hood took this meteor and fashioned it into the Energy Ripper.

name: Energy Saber
description: The science of how the energy of this blade is contained in its form is amazing!

name: Energy Scimitar Blade
description: A recreation of an energy scimitar used by students taking Energy Blades 101. The class taught students how to wield a blade when fighting outside their mechs in the Lore of MechQuest's timeline.

name: Energy Skull Sword
description: Dark magical energy courses through this blade as if it were alive, powerful enough to slice through any Mecha skull.

name: EnergySlicer
description: A multitude of precision blades on this sword will tear your foe's armor apart!

name: Enraged Fiend's Bane
description: Dage has many enemies but the ArchFiend is his most lethal. These hunters are trained for the soul purpose of destroying the Nation.

name: Enraged Pyromancer's Sabre
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAH

name: Enredo Blade
description: Be careful when you're swinging this blade around during the parade!

name: Ensnared Traveler's Falchion
description: Steel and iron can harm fairies, but this blade is used in the name of a charming muse. Its enthralled master uses it to slay the rivals of their otherworldly partner.

name: Envenomed Edge of Nulgath
description: This blade has been heated by dragonfire, and its edges are coated in a caustic mixture made from ChaosWeaver venom. The poison is fatal to humans if their skin is pierced.

name: Envoy of Kyanos Blade
description: The Envoys of Kyanos have very special gear to help handle the cold as they battle through the icy lands of Glacera.

name: Eon's Edge
description: A blade with an endless loop. It was a common design in an age long forgotten. The price of this unending existence is having your purpose lost to time.

name: Epic Duel's Dragon Buster II
description: Obtained from the Epic Slayer during Epic Duel's 10th Birthday! Be very careful, you never know what might happen when you attack with this weapon.

name: Epic Frost Slayer
description: With the coming of the ice and snow, be sure to use these powerful relics of Delta V's frozen tundra during the most epic of duels. (This item gives 20% more gold, XP, rep and class points when equipped.)

name: Epic Gamer's Broadsword
description: You reap what you sow, in real life and in-game.

name: Epic Heldenlied
description: This is a blade pledged to a Hero. A flock of Gryphons who bonded to a young warrior flew into the unknown for a full year, returning with a mysterious sword. The blade is ready for its next heroic epic.

name: EPIC Live Dragon Ranger
description: This COLOR CUSTOM sword was drawn and colored by J6 LIVE in AQ Worlds on July, 29th 2010 with the help of player suggestions. Did you join and help him create this masterful blade?

name: Epic Sword of Epicness
description: Only a blade this epic may call itself worthy of having such an epic name. Happy Winter-een-mas!

name: EpicDuel Memorial Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Epic Duel. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Epiphany of Eudaimonia
description: The Lord of the Underworld forged gifts for the Oraculi, engraved with one of the lessons he learned sitting in on a debate. The scholars pursued knowledge for its own sake, attaining a constant state of contentment even in death.

name: Epoch Definer Blade
description: A greatsword forged from the birthstone of an era defining hero. Due to their destructive potential, the forge master who created these blades did everything they could to destroy them.

name: Epsilon Veselago
description: An energy blade of mysterious make. The handle was found entombed in metal, and seemed to come alive when struck by lightning.

name: Era Definer Blade
description: A greatsword forged from the birthstone of an era defining hero. Due to their destructive potential, the forge master who created these blades did everything they could to destroy them. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Escelense Defender Blade
description: Certain kinds of crystal are actually harder and sharper than any metal blade could be.

name: Escherion's Star Sword
description: The first Chaos Lord to rise was Escherion. You can feel what is left of his power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Espada Brasileira
description: This sword was crafted to celebrate Brazilian Independence day! Obrigado Brasil!

name: Espada da Vitória
description: Parabéns, você é um vencedor! Mostre essa espada para o mundo para mostrar sua lealdade, coragem, e habilidade em batalha. (Congratulations, you are victorious! Show this blade to the world to display your loyalty, courage, and skill in battle.)

name: Estuary's Edge
description: It is obvious why this blade is a prized possession of the Mudluk tribe; its aesthetics go hand-in-hand with its effectiveness.

name: Eternal Champion's Katana
description: Guided by the Light, these warriors live to serve and uphold Good.

name: Eternal Chaos Blade: First Form
description: As the Eternal Dragon of Time, you possess a power unrivaled by almost any entity in our universe. Even the Elemental Lords marvel at what you are capable of. Combined with the power of Chaos… you are unpredictable AND unstoppable.

name: Eternal Chaos Blade: Second Form
description: As the Eternal Dragon of Time, you possess a power unrivaled by almost any entity in our universe. Even the Elemental Lords marvel at what you are capable of. Combined with the power of Chaos… you are unpredictable AND unstoppable.

name: Eternal Chaos Blade: Third Form
description: As the Eternal Dragon of Time, you possess a power unrivaled by almost any entity in our universe. Even the Elemental Lords marvel at what you are capable of. Combined with the power of Chaos… you are unpredictable AND unstoppable.

name: Eternal Chronomancer Dirk
description: Eternal Chronomancers seem to have simply always existed. Their bodies transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence. To tap into this strength requires particular insight though.

name: Eternal Doomlight Blade (0 AC)
description: Gravelyn the Good will sacrifice ANYONE to protect her home. Even her most trusted and loyal DoomLights. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Eternal Doomlight Blade (AC)
description: Gravelyn the Good will sacrifice ANYONE to protect her home. Even her most trusted and loyal DoomLights. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Eternal Dragon's Commemorative Blade (0 AC)
description: A blade running on the lifeblood of the Eternal. It exists here, in the past, and in the future, able to cut anything at any time, anywhere.

name: Eternal Dragon's Commemorative Blade (AC)
description: A blade running on the lifeblood of the Eternal. It exists here, in the past, and in the future, able to cut anything at any time, anywhere.

name: Eternal Dragon's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: YARRR! The Eternal Dragon of Time commands a crew that sails across space and time, pillaging throughout the past and present, fighting through the future, and looting both land and sea.

name: Eternal Dragon's Cutlass (AC)
description: YARRR! The Eternal Dragon of Time commands a crew that sails across space and time, pillaging throughout the past and present, fighting through the future, and looting both land and sea.

name: Eternal Dragon's Energized Blade (0 AC)
description: A blade running on the lifeblood of the Eternal. It exists here, in the past, and in the future, able to cut anything at any time, anywhere.

name: Eternal Dragon's Energized Blade (AC)
description: A blade running on the lifeblood of the Eternal. It exists here, in the past, and in the future, able to cut anything at any time, anywhere.

name: Eternal Dragon's Rapier (0 AC)
description: YARRR! The Eternal Dragon of Time commands a crew that sails across space and time, pillaging throughout the past and present, fighting through the future, and looting both land and sea.

name: Eternal Dragon's Rapier (AC)
description: YARRR! The Eternal Dragon of Time commands a crew that sails across space and time, pillaging throughout the past and present, fighting through the future, and looting both land and sea.

name: Eternal Dragon's Star Sword
description: The thirteenth Chaos Lord to rise was the Eternal Dragon of Time. We have no words to express the power contained in this sword… so far, you are the only hero we have found who can hold it.

name: Eternal Groveborn's Blade
description: Once a Grovebreak elf has mastered the use of the morning sun, they are granted the power to create an illuminating and stronger replica of their swords. This particular sword remained intact by the time you found it, demonstrating the strength of this lost power.

name: Eternal Hero Star Sword
description: Only one hero has stood between our world and total annihilation again and again and again… across time and space and eternity. This blade was crafted to honor YOU, the battles you've won so far, and all the victories you've yet to achieve.

name: Eternal Juggernaut Blade
description: Like the Warriors of the Shadowflame army vow to follow Malgor, the Eternal Juggernauts await the ultimate victory… and their rewards. Their control over the galaxies contained in their weapon is shown by the ability to change their colors.

name: Eternal Katana of Renunciation (0 AC)
description: This blade, wielded by Malakai the Contract Enforcer of Nulgath, severs the ties between lackluster fiends and the Nation. It destroys their contracts, and their souls.

name: Eternal Katana of Renunciation (AC)
description: This blade, wielded by Malakai the Contract Enforcer of Nulgath, severs the ties between lackluster fiends and the Nation. It destroys their contracts, and their souls.

name: Eternal Legion Sword
description: When one pledges their life to Dage, it is for an eternity. This blade - crafted by reknowned weaponsmith Valoroth - makes sure you never try to leave.

name: Eternal Manifestation Sword
description: Your negative emotions are being ejected from the timestream, like a mortal's body getting rid of toxins. Combined with your power, a new form of life has been created… and has evolved.

name: Eternal PainSaw
description: If you listen closely, the millions of souls killed and trapped inside this chainsword of terror scream for help

name: Eternal Revolution Katana
description: Time turns as slowly and perpetually as the symbols on this katana.

name: Eternal Seraph's Blade
description: A worthy prize for showing your allegiance to laken and purchasing a Seraph T-shirt from Heromart!

name: Eternal Sovereign Guard's Blade
description: The armor and weapons of the Guard were forged in the image the Eternal Sovereign described in myth and legends. To emulate their Sovereign, the Guards too seek to dispel myths and legends.

name: Eternally Blooming Rose
description: Formalwear for all your fanciest Mogloween parties.

name: Eternity Blade
description: The fabled blade of Sir Tendeth, once thought lost to the ages. You've fought off the worst of the worst and now this beautiful sword has been found!

name: Ethereal Wanderer's Rose Blade
description: Having journeyed across many lands in search of your heart's desire, you've finally found it in the Realm of Love.

name: Evacuation Protocol Closed Utana
description: These umbrella katana looks silly until the acid rain starts to fall.

name: Evacuation Protocol Utana
description: These umbrella katana look silly until the acid rain starts to fall.

name: Evanescence
description: An interesting name…Though a blade of great power forged by Dage the Evil himself, it's ephemeral and meant to leave the Underworld. Intended for those he can trust his realm to, Dage does not expect them to stay, nor will he trap them.

name: Evergreen Frostblade
description: Chop down trees… or your enemies!

name: Evergreen Sword Shaped Giftbox 11
description: A present shaped like a sword! Save this and it will magically open at the start of the new year. No peeking!

name: Everlasting Blade of Chaos
description: I guess some things ARE fated after all.. it does not matter which shard you visit, Drakath always ends up the same way. The path may be different, but the result remains the same. (Item does 60% more damage to Chaos when equipped)

name: Everlasting Misericordia
description: Perhaps this life didn't offer enough, or took everything it gave. A DeathSworn Knight, dissatisfied or scorned by their lot, sacrificed what little they have left to pursue power through slaughter. This is a mercy available to the lost.

name: Evil Chainsaw +5
description: This chainsaw does 5% MORE DAMAGE against Undead monsters as long as you have it equipped! Wield it well, Hero!

name: Evil J-Sixth Lord Blade
description: "It is not necessary to lie to achieve anything of value. A skilled Sixth-Lord is nearly impossible to defeat."

name: Evolution of Blade
