description: A default sword for the discriminating hero. Evolved, for more sophisticated adventuring.

name: Evolved Barbaric Blade
description: This Darkness sword has seen countless battles and thirsts for bloodshed… even more since its evolution!

name: Evolved Bunny Berserker Long Sword
description: You can taste those little foil-wrapped chocolates as you take up this Bunny Berserker Long Sword. It's might will propel you to Grenwog gluttony and greatness! Find the Magical Marshmallow Cheep, the Gold-Foil Chocolate Bunny, and the Basketful of Dyed Eggs dropping off of the bosses in Greenguard Forest and use them in Cabdury's merge shop.

name: Evolved Champion of Order Blade
description: The sword of the Champion of Order.

name: Evolved Dragon Blade
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And we aren't talking about Sneevils or Zards here… take on Dragons with your Evolved Dragon Blade!

name: Evolved DragonFire of Nulgath
description: The blade resembles the head of a dragon spewing flame. It's as if Nulgath trapped the beat in gold mid-attack. It pulses with fury.

name: Evolved Legacy of Nulgath Blade (0 AC)
description: No one knows who this armor belonged to before Nulgath came into power. Nulgath's armorers have worked day and night (literally - he never lets them sleep) to enhance the original armor. This is what they have come up with!

name: Evolved Legacy of Nulgath Blade (AC)
description: No one knows who this armor belonged to before Nulgath came into power. Nulgath's armorers have worked day and night (literally - he never lets them sleep) to enhance the original armor. This is what they have come up with!

name: Evolved Legacy of Nulgath Blade (Quest)
description: No one knows who this armor belonged to before Nulgath came into power. Nulgath's armorers have worked day and night (literally - he never lets them sleep) to enhance the original armor. This is what they have come up with!

name: Evolved Legendary Magma Sword
description: An ancient blade forged in the pits of a volcano, that was been destroyed or forgotten until Quibble dug it up. Now evolved for greater glowydeathness!

name: Evolved Phoenix Blade +5
description: From the ashes, the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth. Now evolved for greater glowydeathness! Adds 5% more gold!

name: Evolved Raziel
description: This superior weapon of bright sunlike sorcery is actually Raziel, Sayn's Celestial Knight partner, taking her battle form.

name: Evolved Soul Mender
description: Once an unlucky soul is absorbed in this sword, their personalities and memories from their past lives change depending on its nature. This cleanses the soul by shaping it into the blissful sides of themselves.

name: Evolved Soul Ripper
description: Once an unlucky soul is absorbed in this sword, their personalities and memories from their past lives change depending on its nature. This one corrupts the soul by twisting it into the opposite of who they were.

name: Evolved Soulreaper Blade of Nulgath
description: A soul-sucking sword reward for those who have served well under their master, Nulgath, and must promise to continue doing so for such ghastly arsenal to reach its true potential.

name: Evolved Void Sword
description: After years of powering up, Nulgath's Void Sword has evolved!

name: Ex's Caliber
description: This sword was left behind after a nasty break-up. Oh well, their loss.

name: Ex Tenebris Blade
description: From darkness comes light. A young warrior wielded this blade when they began to dream of leading their clan out of the shadows. The dream became reality, but all who emerge from the dark must one day return to it.

name: Exalted Apotheosis
description: A pinnacle of Exalted engineering, this ornate relic has never seen battle. Upgraded from the Exalted Penultima. Proof of your victory over the Exaltia Tower! (Weapon damage is static and does 51% more to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Exalted DOOMFire Blade
description: A prized possession of a great Shadowscythe commander, it is usually kept as a decoration in the throne room because of its unchecked power. if used gently and rarely, its power might not awaken……..yet.

name: Exalted Penultima
description: An ancient blade of Exalted design, used in a long forgotten war. Upgraded from the Exalted Unity. Can be upgraded. (Weapon damage is static and does 40% more to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Exalted Sword of Fulfilled Fate
description: These blades has delivered countless souls to their destined fate, whether it be into the light or a cruel end. Justice is a miracle, one afforded to a destined few.

name: Exalted Unity
description: A powerful blade of Exalted design, used in a long forgotten war. Can be upgraded. (Weapon damage is static and does 35% more to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Excalibur of Nulgath
description: If you break your contract with Nulgath, it is the Contract Keepers that will be sent after you.

name: Excavated Glaive: Full Config (AC)
description: The weapon used by an ancient pilot, can be switched from dagger to sword to staff.

name: Excavated Glaive: Full Config (Legend)
description: The weapon used by an ancient pilot, can be switched from dagger to sword to staff.

name: Excavated Glaive: Sword
description: The weapon used by an ancient pilot, currently in sword mode.

name: Executive Vordred's Sword
description: THIS SWORD GOT A PROMOTION. MORE SKULLS, MORE SUCCESS.

name: Exile Pride Cleaver E
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Exile Pride Cleaver P
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Exlaxcaliber
description: Just keep telling yourself it's dirt. (Heh. Boss DROP!)

name: Exodus Guardian's Blade
description: A blade forged from the flesh of an Exodus Titan. They were meant for the hands of mortals that have won their respect through combat and character. This blade would have been given to a certain Dragonlord, but the practice was already lost to time.

name: ExoKatana Binsoku
description: This katana will not only aid your agility, but when you click it you can transform it into the light-wielding weapon of your dreams!

name: Exotic Spine Splitter
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: Exsanguination Cutlass (0 AC)
description: A blade likely to injure its wielder as they drain their prey of precious lifeblood. Red seeps into its silver edge, leaving the cutlass pristine as the moon.

name: Exsanguination Cutlass (AC)
description: A blade likely to injure its wielder as they drain their prey of precious lifeblood. Red seeps into its silver edge, leaving the cutlass pristine as the moon.

name: Extriki Slime Sword
description: The slime stuck to this sword comes from the Rift. Poison to the touch it turned this once noble blade toxic.

name: Eye Of Astaroth Blade
description: Astaroth's blade, the legendary DragonLord's power still flows through it.

name: Eye of Dragon Fire
description: This blade at its core is pure lava. Sear your subordinates into the fiery submission they deserve.

name: Eye Of The Legion
description: *No description*

name: Eye Of The Nation
description: *No description*

name: Fabled Doom Blade
description: I SENSE IT! YOUR EAGERNESS TO EMBRACE THE SHADOWS! TAKE ME AND REND DESTINY. THE MASTER WILLS IT!

name: Faerie Botanis Sword
description: Despite being made out of flowers, this sword is actually pretty sharp.

name: Faerie Guardian's Keyblade
description: Faeries are the guardians of the forest. With this blade, you can unlock all their secrets.

name: Faerie Guardian's Rapier
description: The Faeries of Greenguard Forest are known to keep butterflies as pets, and craft many of their outfits based on the colorful patterns of the Monarch Butterfly's wings.

name: Falchion
description: A one-handed, single-edged sword of European origin.

name: FalconLord's Blade
description: The FalconLord Guardians that protect the tower are among Falconreach's fiercest, most skilled warriors. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Fall of Order Blade
description: Order will fall when the question is asked…

name: Fall of Order Blade +3
description: Order will fall when the question is asked…

name: Fallen Black Heart
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: How do you tell the world that the cold and callous has now turned your once beating heart into a black lump of coal? You use this sword, created from the most blackened heart of them all. Created by Fall of Troy.

name: Fallen Commander's Rapier (AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen Commander's Rapier (Non-AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen Commander's Sword (0 AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen Commander's Sword (AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen Hero Blade
description: With all the Fallen Heroes in Dreadrock, you're certain to find a few things lying around here or there! Be careful, this one is sharp.

name: Fallen Hollowsky (AC)
description: A blade that once shone bright. The sun set on its destiny, and left it behind. It seeks a wielder that is just as lost and broken.

name: Fallen Hollowsky (Non-AC)
description: A blade that once shone bright. The sun set on its destiny, and left it behind. It seeks a wielder that is just as lost and broken.

name: Fallen Leaf Sword
description: A sword colored like fallen leaves, a symbol of the season in which it was forged.

name: Fallen MonsterHunter Sword
description: Sometimes an adventurer may fall. That is a risk you take in hunting monsters. But a HERO will always rise back up and continue the battle.

name: Fallen Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Fallen Warlord Annihilator
description: Falling from the heights only lends you the power to shine even brighter!

name: FallFire Blade
description: Charged with the force of the forest, this branch works well as a blade to defend mother nature!

name: FallFire Warglaive
description: Charged with the force of the forest, this branch works well as a warglaive when defending mother nature!

name: False Blade of Champions
description: Crafted by MasterSmith Ayuzu, this blade was made to foil any attempts to steal the REAL Blade of Champions.

name: Famine's Blade
description: The icy-hot blade of the horseman of Famine.

name: Famine's Prodigal Cutlass (0 AC)
description: A cutlass embellished with cursed gold from Famine's own vaults. That gold could have been used to feed the hungry, but was spent on extravagance instead. The despair and anger of the many sharpen this deadly blade.

name: Famine's Prodigal Cutlass (AC)
description: A cutlass embellished with cursed gold from Famine's own vaults. That gold could have been used to feed the hungry, but was spent on extravagance instead. The despair and anger of the many sharpen this deadly blade.

name: Fang Blade of Nulgath
description: You are compelled to feed the fiend's spirit inhabiting this blade. Slay to slowly, and it may turn to feed on YOU! (This item is not color customizable)

name: Fang of the Dishonored (0 AC)
description: Envy drove a heroic blade to a cold grave. Vengeance and fury raised it back from the dead, twisted into a cruel fang.

name: Fang of the Dishonored (AC)
description: Envy drove a heroic blade to a cold grave. Vengeance and fury raised it back from the dead, twisted into a cruel fang.

name: Fangs of the Lion
description: Agares, son of the Sand Lion is the stealthiest Guardian. You will not see - or hear - him coming until his fangs are at your neck.

name: Fatal Keraunos
description: A blade that attracts destruction, crafted by a worthy craftsman honored by the Legion. Lightning will always find its edge no matter where it is. Your enemies will turn to trodden ash, their souls feeding the sword's energy.

name: Fatalist Cosmos Dagger (0 AC)
description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.

name: Fatalist Cosmos Dagger (AC)
description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.

name: Fatalist Cosmos Greatsword (0 AC)
description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.

name: Fatalist Cosmos Greatsword (AC)
description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.

name: Fated Blade of Doom
description: With reverence, some call it the original. With derision, others call it ancient. Neither can deny that it is heavy with Doomed fate, meant for the hands of those that would steer the Shadows closer to total domination.

name: Fear (Sword)
description: The Undead might be overrunnng DoomWood, but when you heft this impressive blade in your hands, they will run away AROOOO'ing dread. Wielding this, you are THE opponent to fear!

name: Fell Fae Carver
description: The blade is made from a mixture of metals lethal to the fair folk. Only a changeling could wield this knife without being harmed.

name: Femur Sword
description: Even though it may look humerus, the Femur Sword acts as an effective weapon against the opposing forces of nature and skeletal anatomy.

name: Ferozakh's Infernal Genocide
description: The hypocritical but kind-hearted zombie mercenary who uses the power of evil and transforms into the Hero Renegade to protect humanity is… Ferozakh!

name: Ferozakh's Neo Ender
description: Ferozakh was a warrior for the Queen of Monsters, who went rogue after witnessing the atrocities she commited.

name: Fest-EBIL Katana (0 AC)
description: The blade is heated so both you, and whoever you plan to stick these through, will be warm during cold nights.

name: Fest-EBIL Katana (AC)
description: The blade is heated so both you, and whoever you plan to stick these through, will be warm during cold nights.

name: Fest-EBIL Terminator Claymore (0 AC)
description: At full-charge, the claymore can cleave buildings. A full charge would require a building's worth of energy after all.

name: Fest-EBIL Terminator Claymore (AC)
description: At full-charge, the claymore can cleave buildings. A full charge would require a building's worth of energy after all.

name: Festive Antler Blade
description: Tinsel says "Happy Frostval, Hero!"

name: Festive Elf's Blade
description: Poor Elf! Who knows how long the outfits have been stuck inside Giefurious!

name: Festive Giftbearer Greatsword
description: When delivering Frostval gifts, it's always a good idea to dress the part!

name: Festive Giftbearer's Blade
description: When delivering Frostval gifts, it's always a good idea to dress the part!

name: Festive Hypesaber
description: Make your enemies feel the wrath of your resolute hype and joyful cheers in every Frostval, as well as the festivals and the birthday you celebrate.

name: Festive Silver Star Blade
description: The blade twinkles every time it makes contact with a person or monster that hasn't been very nice this past year.

name: Fiend Carver Betrayal Blade
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to rend the Archfiend's skin. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Fiend Champion's Blade
description: The Fiend Champion contains a small amount of Adimonde's power, given via the Fiend Shard. As they grow in power, so does Adimonde.

name: Fiend Dragon Blade
description: Every loyal fiend needs a good blade to slay with.

name: Fiend Hunter's Trust
description: When you go hunting for Fiends, your blades will need to tear into them and their contracts. The Nation keeps close tabs on promises undone.

name: Fiend Mauler's Saber
description: You may think I am evil. I am not. I am the MOST EVIL.

name: Fiend of Light Blade
description: Fiends who have fallen but still try to uphold the power of the Light. Keeping the forces of Darkness away while fighting not to succumb to it's grasp.

name: Fiend Revenant's Shame (0 AC)
description: When an unworthy Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, its successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Fiend Revenant's Shame (AC)
description: When an unworthy Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, its successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Fiend's BladeMaster Katana
description: The Archfiend's BladeMaster has studied all forms of edged weaponry.. for NULGATH!

name: Fiend's Creed Blade
description: A blade that embodies the creed of all those who give themselves to the Fiend God's Void, and seek to devour it themselves. They are a symbol of the Archfiend's pride.

name: Fiend's Inception Blade (0 AC)
description: Some Fiends are transformed in Adimonde's Void with their weapons. Even steel can grow teeth and eyes with the Fiend God's touch.

name: Fiend's Inception Blade (AC)
description: Some Fiends are transformed in Adimonde's Void with their weapons. Even steel can grow teeth and eyes with the Fiend God's touch.

name: Fiend Void's Hunger
description: A blade that was forged from steel mutated by radiation from the Fiend's Void. It influences 'food' to jump towards its edge, feeding it their blood.

name: Fiendish Bane of Ascension
description: The Nation's newest Fiends are being killed before they can finish mutating in the Fiend's Void. Blades from the abyss pierce their bodies. These practical jokes played by Adimonde were taken and reforged into masterpieces.

name: Fiendish Blood Blade
description: Victory is yours! And so is Groglurk's blade. This sinister blade holds immense dark energy.

name: Fiendish Blood Blade of Infinity
description: Victory is yours! And so is Groglurk's blade. This sinister blade holds immense dark energy. (Infinity Exclusive)

name: Fiendish Bloodhunt Dagger
description: Ever since Nulgath was betrayed, his loyal followers have begun to fuse the skulls and blood of their enemies into weapons that scream. They look to add to their collection, and please their Master.

name: Fiendish Bloodhunt Fang
description: Ever since Nulgath was betrayed, his loyal followers have begun to fuse the skulls and blood of their enemies into weapons that scream. They look to add to their collection, and please their Master.

name: Fiendish Caladbolg
description: Dage the Evil has given this blade to Nulgath the ArchFiend to strengthen the bond that they have -- as Masters of Evil, they should ally, sending their armies against common enemies. (Note: an OverFiend Blade of the Legion will arrive in March to further the peace).

name: Fiendish Covenant of Bone
description: Ever loyal to Master Nulgath, the Nation's greatest loyalists serve the Archfiend even in death. Their souls cling to their bones, waiting for another chance to prove themselves.

name: Fiendish Doomblade (0 AC)
description: The blade was forged from the armor of fallen Doomknights. They were puppets for the Shadows, easily slain and salvaged for scrap. Their dark red armor was melted down and sharpened by the Archfiend himself.

name: Fiendish Doomblade (AC)
description: The blade was forged from the armor of fallen Doomknights. They were puppets for the Shadows, easily slain and salvaged for scrap. Their dark red armor was melted down and sharpened by the Archfiend himself.

name: Fiendish DoomKnight Short Katana (AC)
description: Fallen DoomKnights who join with Nulgath the ArchFiend are among the most feared in the Nation.

name: Fiendish DoomKnight Short Katana (Non-AC)
description: Fallen DoomKnights who join with Nulgath the ArchFiend are among the most feared in the Nation.

name: Fiendish DragonKnight Blade (0 AC)
description: Fiendish DragonKnights have tamed the fiercesome wyrms of Tercessuinotlim, and have proven their ability to ride into battle and emerge victorious! (Blade is CC to Accessory)

name: Fiendish DragonKnight Blade (AC)
description: Fiendish DragonKnights have tamed the fiercesome wyrms of Tercessuinotlim, and have proven their ability to ride into battle and emerge victorious! (Blade is CC to Accessory)

name: Fiendish Duality Blade (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiendish Duality Blade (AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiendish Erlösung
description: Fiends can only be redeemed when they're all cold and dead. Nulgath imbued this blade with his cold spite, completing one of many weapons meant to slay and replace Adimonde, the God of Fiends.

name: Fiendish Fury of Ascension
description: The Nation's newest Fiends are being killed before they can finish mutating in the Fiend's Void. Blades from the abyss pierce their bodies. These practical jokes played by Adimonde were taken and reforged into masterpieces.

name: Fiendish Headhunter Blade
description: The blade itself is a contract. The Archfiend carves a name into steel, and the wielder is sealed until they wipe their target off the face of Lore.

name: Fiendish Outlaw Bowie Knife
description: Any outlaw willing to serve and obey the orders of Nulgath the ArchFiend is welcome in the Nation. But beware… the price for betrayal is eternal suffering.

name: Fiendish Persuasion
description: An unassuming blade given to Fiends disguised as Clerics, Paladins, and others of the same cloak. If a member of the Nation is caught to cheat their contract by seeking outside help, they'll be dragged back to Nulgath with sadistic glee.

name: Fiendish Reversed Katana (0 AC)
description: Fallen DoomKnights who join with Nulgath the ArchFiend are among the most feared in the Nation.

name: Fiendish Reversed Katana (AC)
description: Fallen DoomKnights who join with Nulgath the ArchFiend are among the most feared in the Nation.

name: Fiendish Soul Eater (0 AC)
description: A blade that has become an extension of the wielder. It sates the hunger of Fiendish Devourers, and prevents them from cannibalizing other Fiends.

name: Fiendish Soul Eater (AC)
description: A blade that has become an extension of the wielder. For Fiendish Devourers, this blade sates their hunger and prevents them from cannibalizing other Fiends.

name: Fiendish Transcendence Blade
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Fiendish Transcendence Cleaver
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Fiendish Trickster's Dagger (AC)
description: The end of every Archfiend always comes from behind. At some point or another, they'll forget to look over their shoulder.

name: Fiendish Trickster's Dagger (Non-AC)
description: The end of every Archfiend always comes from behind. At some point or another, they'll forget to look over their shoulder.

name: Fiendish Vengeance GreatSword
description: Warriors who betray Nulgath the ArchFiend have their minds blasted clean. They are rebuilt from the ground up to serve only him, forever, body and mind. The loss of their personality and "self" is Nulgath's ultimate punishment.

name: Fiendish Zweihander of Bhamud
description: It is common practice for members of the Nation to use the bodies of the enemies and rivals to forge weapons. This masterpiece is a work of art even the great Archfiend acknolwedged.

name: FiendLord's Claymore
description: (Item does 20% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)Nulgath says: "This weapon is a symbol of gratitude to warriors who passed the trials to become an Archfiend DeathLord!" (This item goes rare on July 14th, 2020)

name: Fiery Blade of Torment
description: You can feel a wicked energy coming from the sword. The previous owner was not human.

name: Fiery Jade Katana
description: A beautifully sculpted relic that was brightly polished, causing it to reflect like the real gemstone.

name: Fiery Necrodrake
description: A weapon created by accident combining dragon magic with necromancy in an attempt to create a dracolich.

name: Fiery Staff
description: With their mastery of the elements, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. This staff was made by beseeching molten rock to serve as a weapon for the good of the clan.

name: Fiery Sword
description: With their mastery of the elements, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. This sword was made by calling molten rock from volcanoes to come to the clans aid.

name: Fifth Lord's Saber of DOOM
description: Even the most hardened warriors fear the revenge of the Fifth. Your power is mighty, and the darkness you control can shatter galaxies.

name: Final Hearts StarBlade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Final Judgment Blade
description: What cannot be bound or conquered must be destroyed.

name: Final's Blade
description: Wow, look at that thing. Could probably cut through close to anything. I wonder what the blade is made of?

name: Fire Blade
description: Make sure you wear gloves when wielding; this blade is too hot to handle! Seriously. No one likes 3rd degree burns on their palms.

name: Fire Dragon's Guile
description: Though this blade has the strength of a Fire Dragon, it is imbued with finesse and intelligence of such a beast. For the thinking warrior, this sword will take your strength and turn you into a fighter with a pinch of know-how that will get you out of every situation, leaving your enemy scratching his head… that is, if he still has one.

name: Fire Dragon's Hunger
description: No amount of fighting with satiate this blade. Its call for more fighting fills your head with the drive to obliterate every enemy that crosses your path. And with each battle, this blade burns with the blood of the fallen.

name: Fire on the Edge
description: A Horc weapon combining the traditional tribal asthetics with fluid designs along the blade.

name: Firebird's Fury Blade
description: A blade that radiates the golden shine of the sunrise and sunset. As the bane of the undead and immortal, its fire blazes for a worthy master, and snuffs out if that master falls for the sweet allure of eternity.

name: Firebird's Fury Longsword
description: The longsword is wreathed in the feathers of the Great Firebird Anqa, and radiates with ther lifeforce. It brings your enemies death, and blesses you with rebirth.

name: FireBlade of War
description: Made of blood-red steel and magma, this blade cuts through its enemies like butter. Really hot butter.

name: Firefeather Sword
description: Made of bone, feathers and flame, Zoshi crafted this weapon while YOU watched and offered suggestions!

name: Firelit Reaver
description: A grip that never wears down, a blade that never dulls, and a flame that never goes out. Make no mistake, this is a weapon of war.

name: FireLord Molten Blade
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: First Blade OF Nexity
description: The mist which surrounds this blade is from all the souls it's crushed.

name: First Gate of Vokun
description: Rumbles with evil laughter as it slices through your foes.

name: First Gold Cutlass
description: A curved blade forged from gold, strengthened by a variety of other rare metals. They’re usually made from a corsair’s first plunder, giving every one significant meaning to their wielder.

name: First Gold Rapier
description: A sophisticated blade forged from gold, strengthened by a variety of other rare metals. They’re usually made from a corsair’s first plunder, giving every one significant meaning to their wielder.

name: First Mate's Cutlass
description: Aye as the Cap'n second in command ye better have yer ship ready for sailin'

name: First Mate’s Sword
description: Rakham needs another First Mate. With this gear you have what it takes… but I wouldn't recommend taking the job. His record for keeping them is pretty bad.

name: Fishy Sword
description: In the depths of the great waters is a fish that can do marvelous things. If brought to the surface, will transform into a rigid, vicious, weapon of mass destruction. Take a swipe at someone today!

name: Flaeschrendan
description: A malicious blade that feeds upon flesh and bone, augmenting and reconstructing itself with the bodies of its prey. To what limit will it devour and what will it become?

name: Flamberge Blade (AC)
description: This blade has not yet been enchanted to become a Frostberge Blade.

name: Flamberge Blade (Legend)
description: This blade has not yet been enchanted to become a Frostberge Blade.

name: Flame Dragon Blade
description: Bestowed to those great warriors who have purchased Founder in AQ Dragons.

name: Flame God Sword
description: Be careful not to burn yourself!

name: Flame Guardian's Blade
description: The famed Blade bestowed to the Flame Guardians.

name: Flame Ruby Katana
description: This flaming Katana seeks the life force of your enemies!

name: Flame Starblade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Flame Tender Blade
description: Black steel, tempered by a Fire Dragon's flames, warms your hands and ambitions. You feel the rumbling of magma beneath the earth in your bones. Linger too long and it'll turn you into Akriloth's kin.

name: Flame Void Blade (0 AC)
description: In the Mirror Realm, Frost becomes Flame. Channel your burning rage into the service of Nulgath the ArchAngel as a Flame Void Warrior.

name: Flame Void Blade (AC)
description: In the Mirror Realm, Frost becomes Flame. Channel your burning rage into the service of Nulgath the ArchAngel as a Flame Void Warrior.

name: FlameBlade's Fury
description: A flicker of flame, then darkness. Your enemies won't know what hit them.

name: Flameborn Blade of Awe
description: A fiery version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will help keep you warm in the coldest of climes. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: Flamebreath
description: I took that dragon's BREATH and then I used it as a SWORD!

name: Flamed Aura Blade
description: Moonhoplite enchanted this regal blade with the essence of fire. The metal is always hot, charring anything it strikes.

name: FlameDragon Knight's Blade
description: Through fire and flames, these Knights burn with the power of the dragons.

name: FlameHeart Blade
description: The heart of this flame can NEVER be frozen! It is a most fitting blade for Pyromancers. (Item does 30% more damage to elements when equipped.)

name: FlameStop Blade
description: With the power of ice and fire at the tip of your blade, taking out line jumpers has never been easier!

name: Flaming Ash Rainer
description: ﻿Deep in the southern glaciers lies blades that are slowly melting holes into the eternal ice. They once made the cold skies snow ash but when their ambitious masters became lost, so were they.

name: Flaming Blood Katana
description: A beautifully sculpted relic that was brightly polished, causing it to reflect like the real gemstone.

name: Flaming DOOMFire Blade
description: A prized possession of a great Shadowscythe commander, it is usually kept as a decoration in the throne room because of its unchecked power. if used gently and rarely, its power might not awaken……..yet.

name: Flaming DOOMFire Warrior Sword
description: This might blade's power to start a raging whirlwind of harvested souls and thickened dark clouds allows it to live up to the legendary DoomKnight's name.

name: Flaming Moose Katana
description: They may be cute, but moose can be deadly! Just like this katana.

name: Flesh Ripper Blade
description: Flesh Ripper's keep what the rip… for others activities…

name: Flowing Sword
description: With their mastery of the elements, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. Forming a bond with the weapon and the water, this sword cut down enemies with astonishing grace.

name: Fluid Chaos's Sword
description: Ooohh, glowy AND deadly!

name: For The Gourd
description: This rare weapon was custom forged for you by Cysero for winning the 2010 Mogloween Pumpkin Carving Content! Gratz!

name: Forbidden Abyssal Tenkaen
description: No one knows who forged this forbidden creation. It was sealed in a shrine that quickly became abandoned, left to rot and decay. The Kami within began to whistle, luring foolhardy warriors that still had the delicious will to fight.

name: Forbidden Apocalyptic Tenkaen
description: No one knows who forged this forbidden creation. It was sealed in a shrine that quickly became abandoned, left to rot and decay. The Kami within began to whistle, luring foolhardy warriors that still had the delicious will to fight.

name: Forbidden CA Claymore
description: This blade is the property of the Crystallis administration. Return to Suite 37a1C, c/o Chief Munitions Coordinator.

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Dagger
description: A sacred weapon that once had deep ties to the earth and forests, now tainted with forbidden magic. It was used to hunt aberrations. Now, it makes them.

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Kris
description: A ritual blade seeped in forbidden magic. The court mages of Greenguard's previous dynasty conducted wretched rites to free their liege from fate.

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Rapier
description: A rapier wrapped in vines. It used to be as vibrant and green as the Sea of Trees, but the touch of a forbidden entity twisted its form. A seed of disorder was planted, but that's the only way you can fight fate.

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Sword
description: The Royal Family once had deep ties to Nature, but dark ambition and an unknowable influence polluted this connection. Forbidden magic cursed their once pristine blades.

name: Forbidden Pathos Blade (0 AC)
description: Turning failed Fiends into weapons is a common practice in the Nation, but these kinds of blades are special. The wielder typically has two, one mother and one father.

name: Forbidden Pathos Blade (AC)
description: Turning failed Fiends into weapons is a common practice in the Nation, but these kinds of blades are special. The wielder typically has two, one mother and one father.

name: Force Guardian Light Blade
description: A true Force Guardian feels that everything flow through them while keeping their emotions in check.

name: Force Of Evil
description: Careful with your hands, it's not too particular about who it bites.

name: Forest Destroyer Blade
description: The power of a burning forest was used to create this sword, imbuing it with all that destructive might.

name: Forest Tender Blade
description: Black steel, embalmed by spring buds and awakened by death. You feel the ceaseless flow of time flow towards oblivion, but life will always finds a way. Flowers bloom and die in your skin, willing you to become Koschei Yaga's kin.

name: Forest Valeblade
description: *No description*

name: Forgotten Cutlass
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they want far below Davy Jones's locker.

name: Forked Scorpion's Stinger
description: A weapon crafted from the spoils of an arena victory. The scorpion's tail is actually black. It just turned redder and redder until a challenger finally defeated it.

name: Formal GrenwogSlayer's TrigBlade
description: Dress up for tons of GrenwogSlaying fun!

name: Formal Nation Blade
description: An elegant sword meant for keeping Nation business clean, in that it'll cut up enemies quickly and quietly without soiling your clothes with splatter.

name: Forsaken Frost Reaver (0 AC)
description: Envy drove a heroic blade to a cold grave. Vengeance and fury raised it back from the dead, twisted into a cruel fang.

name: Forsaken Frost Reaver (AC)
description: Envy drove a heroic blade to a cold grave. Vengeance and fury raised it back from the dead, twisted into a cruel fang.

name: Forsaken Outrider's Soulbiter
description: When they left the Nation, either out of disgrace or to pursue free will, the Outrider took a token to remember the Nation by. It cuts brutally, even more so than it did when Nulgath was its master.

name: Forsaken Soul Slicer
description: You found this blade locked inside the Seven Circles war chest. Dage the Evil must be pleased with your performance.

name: Forsaken Sword of Thanatos
description: It's funny that this sword is based off of a gravestone, as your enemies will be needing one soon.

name: Fortitude
description: Your work has paid off, here is your reward! As you fight Undead opponenents, Fortitude is absorbing more power - keep fighting undead for the bonus!

name: Fortune Bringer
description: Fortune's in your favor when you're wielding this blade so bring on the enemies! Happy Lucky Day!

name: Fortune's Blade
description: Some say that this sword was forged by Lady Luck herself!

name: Fortune's Protector
description: As Fortune's protector and karma's champion, finding the blade was a really lucky break! Happy Lucky Day!

name: Foundation Blade
description: A replica of the blade Presented to those who supported HeroSmash in the early days of development. (Color Custom, Clickable)

name: Fourth Consular Star Axe
description: When words fail, drastic action must be taken. If you're going to have to take this path, you might as well pull out the biggest weapon you have.

name: Fourth Guardian Star Axe
description: Guardians who wield the Fourth master a variety of weapons, but it just feels better to run at the Sixth with an axe.

name: Fowl Deathbringer Blade
description: The Fowl Deathbringer blade will guide you to new adventures… EGG-Zactly what you're looking for!

name: Fractured Aquitaine
description: The ancestral blade of House Vaughn, said to have been pulled from the heart of a golden buck. Like its master, there's a legend about it. The more paintings, copies, depictions there are of the sword, the sharper it gets.

name: Franken WereSlitter
description: Slice 'em, dice'em, then reuse as much as you can. THAT's efficient mad science!

name: FrankenFiend Blade
description: Dr. Voltabolt says: "You zurvived my latest creation, ze Frankenwerepire! Youl CRUZHED him! I zuppose I muzt go back to ze drawrink board."

name: FrankenFiend Katana
description: Dr. Voltabolt says: "You zurvived my latest creation, ze Frankenwerepire! Youl CRUZHED him! I zuppose I muzt go back to ze drawrink board."

name: Freezing Lightning Blade
description: Weapons of iron and steel were no match for a sword that could turn armor into a tool of execution. Though deadly, it can not be raised against the kin of the Energy Champion.

name: Friend's Gleaming Blade
description: The only thing that can come between two friends is their love for a blade.

name: Frigid Blade of Light
description: This brightly burning sword can only be handled by the most hardy of warriors. Can you touch the hilt of this sword without succumbing to the bitter cold? Dare you look into the blade, lest you see your soul frozen for eternity?

name: Frigid Eternity Blade (AC)
description: Wrap yourself in the power of the glacier and know the immense pressure that comes with bearing the weight of time!

name: Frigid Eternity Blade (Special)
description: Wrap yourself in the power of the glacier and know the immense pressure that comes with bearing the weight of time!

name: Frigid Flame Sword
description: A special flame burns in this icy blade.

name: Frigid FrostWeaver Blade
description: Every disappearance and death is swallowed by the snowy forest. From the branches that feasted on the frozen dead grows a blade with a fatal touch.

name: Frigid Vitae Ravager (0 AC)
description: No matter how much time passes, the White Wolves neither grow or shrink in number. Their weapons sap life force from victims and vegetation, leaving behind a cold wasteland.

name: Frigid Vitae Ravager (AC)
description: No matter how much time passes, the White Wolves neither grow or shrink in number. Their weapons sap life force from victims and vegetation, leaving behind a cold wasteland.

name: Frigid Wolf Blade (0 AC)
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frigid Wolf Blade (AC)
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frigid Wolf Dagger (0 AC)
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frigid Wolf Dagger (AC)
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frost and Steel
description: This sword, crafted entirely from steel, was magically tempered to resist the shattering effects of the cold, no matter how far the temperature drops.

name: Frost Blademaster's Blade
description: When the winds of winter whistle through the halls of Akiba, it is the Frost Blademasters that Empress Miko calls upon to keep her people warm and safe.

name: Frost Blademaster's Icy Blade
description: When the winds of winter whistle through the halls of Akiba, it is the Frost Blademasters that Empress Miko calls upon to keep her people warm and safe.

name: Frost DeathKnight Blade
description: The Frost and Frozen DeathKnights are two contingents of the icy army set to ward the Northlands and any other area where ice reigns supreme.

name: Frost Demon's Icy Sword
description: The chill of the Frost Demon suffuses this sword to the point where it ices over no matter WHAT the temperature is outside!

name: Frost Dracolich Guard's Blade
description: Keep warm this holiday season in an extra warm armor - also good for protecting various body parts when dealing with dracoliches.

name: Frost Fang Katana
description: A hunter whose heart is truly frozen by winter's skin-numbing bite can hold such a blade with no further handicap. It may be as light as paper, but it can slice glaciers as if they are citrus fruit.

name: Frost Katana
description: The chill of death waits for your opponents.

name: Frost Knight Sword
description: This blade and shield will ensure that each night would not be a silent one as long as danger lurks every Frostval night and Lore's existence is constantly threatened.

name: Frost Matriarch Sword
description: This sword is more nimble for matriarch Draconians. And matches your outfit perfectly, too!

name: Frost Saber Tooth
description: The lifeblood of centuries' worth of prey have sharpen this tooth.

name: Frost Sheathed Katanas
description: The scent of red snow, mud, and battle rouses the blade. Their true potential awakens when one must fight alone.

name: Frost SpiritReaver's Blade
description: Granted a portion of the Champion of Ice's power, Frost SpiritReavers are ice mages that specialize in gathering frost spirits to unleash in battle.

name: Frost Sword
description: This sword harnesses the power of the Arctic in its blade.

name: Frost Tiger Katana
description: A blade that reflects the will of a solitary beast. Rarely will it ever cut foes on behalf of a lord.

name: Frost Wyrm Blade
description: A sword looted from the Frostwyrm Riders. It faintly glows with icy cold power.

name: Frostbane
description: Don't let the ice frozen to this blade fool you, it still can cut through the toughest enemies.

name: Frostbane X
description: Don't let the ice frozen to this blade fool you, it still can cut through the toughest enemies.

name: Frostberge Blade (0 AC)
description: Forged from enchanted flames frozen in the middle of a blizzard, the Frostberge Knight is at home in the tundra or the halls of the highest Northlands border lords.

name: Frostberge Blade (AC)
description: Forged from enchanted flames frozen in the middle of a blizzard, the Frostberge Knight is at home in the tundra or the halls of the highest Northlands border lords.

name: Frostbite (Sword)
description: Legend foretold of a frozen blade once belonging to a great Lord of the Undead Legion. It was carved from ever-frozen Northland Ice and cursed by an ancient hex.

name: Frostblade of Hope
description: The extended endurance in the extreme climates have caused small ice particles to be naturally attracted to the right side of the blade, explaining its partial cyan hue in the present day. Talk about chilling out.

name: Frostborn Wolf Warrior's Blade
description: There are no lone Frostborn Wolves. The only thing deadlier than facing one in battle… is turning your back on a member of the pack. Each wields weaponry that can rip your throat out faster than you can scream.

name: Frostborn Wolf Warrior's Katana
description: There are no lone Frostborn Wolves. The only thing deadlier than facing one in battle… is turning your back on a member of the pack. Each wields weaponry that can rip your throat out faster than you can scream.

name: Frostborne Blade (0 AC)
description: A sword as tough as ice was forged by the Northlands barbarians to express their deep admiration for the resilient pine trees in the region.

name: Frostborne Blade (AC)
description: A sword as tough as ice was forged by the Northlands barbarians to express their deep admiration for the resilient pine trees in the region.

name: Frostborne DragonBlade
description: An Ice Dragon froze this Dragonblade with frigid breath, inadvertently creating a weapon that could destroy their fiery rivals. It can easily cut through a Fire Dragon's flames, and freeze their molten blood.

name: Frostbyte
description: A blade that's been polar-ized in the depths of the Frozen Northlands. This is one wicked cool weapon!

name: FrostDragon Knight's Blade
description: From the frozen North Mountain, these knights never feel the chill.

name: Frosted Blade of D'awwww
description: You ALWAYS need a backup blade when cutting wedding cake! You can just ignore the frosting on it… right?!

name: Frosted Falchion
description: This blade, made of ever-frozen Northland Ice, is swift and thin, perfect for slicing apart snow monsters.

name: Frosted Katana
description: Slice through ice, snow and your enemies.

name: Frosted Ninjato
description: Slice through ice, snow and your enemies.

name: FrostEdge Fae Blade (0 AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands, though this doesn't appear warm, you will never grow cold in it.

name: FrostEdge Fae Blade (AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands, though this doesn't appear warm, you will never grow cold in it.

name: FrostEdge Spellblade (0 AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands, though this doesn't appear warm, you will never grow cold in it.

name: FrostEdge Spellblade (AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands, though this doesn't appear warm, you will never grow cold in it.

name: FrostElf Warrior Sword (0 AC)
description: FrostElf Warriors have served the High Kings and Queens ruling over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. Their battle gear is spelled to protect them in battle.

name: FrostElf Warrior Sword (AC)
description: FrostElf Warriors have served the High Kings and Queens ruling over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. Their battle gear is spelled to protect them in battle.

name: Frostfang Dormius Blade (0 AC)
description: The land that the White Wolves call home is fast asleep, dreaming under a thick blanket of enchanted snow. The lives their blades take will one day awaken their lost Kingdom. It must!

name: Frostfang Dormius Blade (AC)
description: The land that the White Wolves call home is fast asleep, dreaming under a thick blanket of enchanted snow. The lives their blades take will one day awaken their lost Kingdom. It must!

name: Frostfur Knuckle Sword
description: He sees you when you're frozen, he knows when you have thawed, he brings you gifts and cheer and gear, so much that you'll be awed!

name: Frostguarde Blade
description: Created by the magic of the first champion of Ice, these blades were bestowed upon her protectors. Just a touch could freeze your blood solid.

name: Frostkissed Ballabile (0 AC)
description: A delicate saber hand-carved from ice. Though you can use it in an actual battle, the blade is meant to be a toy, or a prop for a play. Granted, it wouldn't last long in a giftbox either. At least the edge is easily replaceable.

name: Frostkissed Ballabile (AC)
description: A delicate saber hand-carved from ice. Though you can use it in an actual battle, the blade is meant to be a toy, or a prop for a play. Granted, it wouldn't last long in a giftbox either. At least the edge is easily replaceable.

name: Frostkissed Freesia
description: A blade named after the princess of a fallen Kingdom. She and her twin sister were from a far off land, but their acts of heroism earned them crowns. Despite their efforts, the land's own faults caused it to sink into the nether.

name: Frostlorn Raider Blade
description: The Winter Raiders use this style of weapon in fighting off the great white wyrms of the northlands.

name: Frostlorn Raider Katana
description: The Winter Raiders use this style of weapon in fighting off the great white wyrms of the northlands.

name: Frostlorn Rogue Cutlass
description: *No description*

name: FrostReaver
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls.

name: FrostSlayer
description: Cold to the core this blade will freeze your enemies in their tracks.

name: FrostSlayer X
description: Cold to the core this blade will freeze your enemies in their tracks.

name: FrostSpawn Invader Sword
description: To defeat the FrostSpawn and take its weapon is a feat indeed.

name: Frostsworn Ice Blade (0 AC)
description: The icy wind isn't for the faint hearted. To reign in this frozen forsaken tundra you must have nerves of steel.

name: Frostsworn Ice Blade (AC)
description: The icy wind isn't for the faint hearted. To reign in this frozen forsaken tundra you must have nerves of steel.

name: Frostus Rectar
description: Carved from enchanted polar ice, this blade can withstand the most extreme temperatures. A design completely created by player skyline2793 Skyline.

name: Frostval Barbarian Blade
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

name: Frostval Barbarian Sword (0 AC)
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

name: Frostval Barbarian Sword (AC)
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

name: Frostval Barbarian Sword (Legend)
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

name: Frostval Ice Blessing Blade
description: That gift box might be possessed, but it still holds a lot of awesome loot! Happy Frostval!

name: Frostval Morning Blade
description: Dazzle your enemies and blind your opponents with the brilliance of this festive Frostval blade. Merry Frostval!

name: Frostval On a Steeck
description: Look what happens when crazy, hyped-up moglins are allowed to create a Frostval weapon… Wacky.

name: Frostval Tree Sword
description: Ever have a fully decorated tree fall on top of you? It's not just the pine needles that get you. Those lights get super hot if you leave them on for too long.

name: Frostvale Envoy's Blade
description: Deck the halls and then your foes!

name: FrostWarlord Greatsword
description: Click on the hilt of this enchanted weapon to summon mystical frost flames.

name: Frozen Arabesque Sword (0 AC)
description: A blade that carved the ice of the deepest caverns of the North. The cold seeped into the steel, and will seep into your foes.

name: Frozen Arabesque Sword (AC)
description: A blade that carved the ice of the deepest caverns of the North. The cold seeped into the steel, and will seep into your foes.

name: Frozen Aurora Blade
description: This weapon was forged from light trapped inside Northlands crystals. Their reflection of the Aurora Borealis will mesmerize your enemies.

name: Frozen Blade of Doom
description: Forged from the combination of a shard of Sepulchure's coffin and permafrost, this sword bears a striking resemblance to the dark one's own blade.

name: Frozen Blizzard Blade
description: Swirling snowflakes are magically trapped inside with icy blade. The most powerful ice mages can unlock the fury of the snowstorm contained inside!

name: Frozen Claw
description: When you take this chilling blade into battle, your enemies are bound to get cold feet!

name: Frozen Claymore
description: Guarded by Izotz, this farmed weapon is now in the hands of the true hero! (Boost against Dragons!)

name: Frozen Dawn's Edge
description: Cut through your opponents as gracefully as a winter sun's rays slice through the sky.

name: Frozen DeathKnight Sword
description: The Frost and Frozen DeathKnights are two contingents of the icy army set to ward the Northlands and any other area where ice reigns supreme.

name: Frozen DragonFlame Blade
description: The gems in this sword are hot to the touch, and the obsidian blade still smells faintly of sulfur. Could DragonMaster Frostscythe have something to do with this?!

name: Frozen Fire Blade
description: Is it ice? Is it fire? It's the best of both worlds!

name: Frozen Flamebringer Blade
description: This blad definitaly has the cool factor down.

name: Frozen Guardian Blade
description: Yulgar pluged the red-hot Royal Guardian Blade into enchanted ice from the heights of Cryonos Mountains. Now the blade is ice-cold and will keep you looking cool no matter how hot it gets!

name: Frozen Hatred Blade
description: Only those who can withstand the frozen North Mountain are bold enough to handle this polearm.

name: Frozen Hatred Sword
description: Only those who can withstand the frozen North Mountain are bold enough to handle this polearm.

name: Frozen Legionnaire's Blade
description: The Undead can function in pieces that the living can only dream of. However, too much time spent in the frozen wastelands can have an effect - even on their weapons.

name: Frozen Queen's Ice Calibur (0 AC)
description: Only the heartiest heroes are BRRRR-ave enough to sail the frozen seas that border the Northlands!

name: Frozen Queen's Ice Calibur (AC)
description: Made from crystals mined from deep under the ice in the Northlands.

name: Frozen Soldier Sword
description: Did you pry this from his cold hand?

name: FrozenDawn Herald's Rapier
description: As the first rays of the sun rise over the Northlands, the FrozenDawn Herald calls out with joy to welcome the start of the Frostval in July holiday!

name: FrozenFlame Rapier
description: Only the most skilled Cryomancer can craft a blade made of frozen flames, and this weapon was forged by a master. (Item does 30% more damage to elements when equipped.)

name: Frozenpointe Katana
description: I ask you, isn't this a n-ICE katana?!

name: FrozenShard Blade
description: This blade has an enchanted ice shard in its core, and will transform when you press the gem in the hilt. Wield it well and wisely, hero, for it contains great magical power!

name: FrozenSoul Chaos Blade
description: Deep in the heart of the frozen Northlands, Chaos power lays dormant, trapped under dark ice… waiting for its Champion to return and unleash it.

name: Furai
description: A glazed, stylish blade rumored to have been derived from the Rift of Time. Color customizable hilt, accessories, and blade!

name: Furious Flame Blade
description: Forged in the heat of the Champion of Fire's fury, this blade will sear the souls of all who oppose you.

name: Furious Flame Katana
description: Forged in the heat of the Champion of Fire's fury, this blade will sear the souls of all who oppose you.

name: Furious Legacy Doom Blade
description: A Doomblade that was the foundation of the original Shadows. Their Empire was built brick by brick by the Mysterious Stranger of the Shadowscythe. It's influence is long gone, overcome by the Empress and her beloved father.

name: Furled Eden City Umbrella
description: Eden City is home to many wonderous things, thanks to the exemplary planning and organization of the Crystallis Administration. As a tour guide, you'll chaperone visitors around and extoll their virtues.

name: Fury Fiend's Blade
description: These fiends are fueled by the fires of Nulgath's fury at any who would oppose him.

name: Fury of the Dragon (Sword) (AC)
description: Drakath hath no fury like a Dragon scorned! Storm headstrong into battle and unleash the might of an enraged dragon!

name: Fury of the Dragon (Sword) (Merge)
description: Drakath hath no fury like a Dragon scorned! Storm headstrong into battle and unleash the might of an enraged dragon!

name: Fury of the Shadow Dragon (AC)
description: Ninjas are hailed for their dexterity. Dragons are praised for their strength. And when the Ninja trains in the way of the Dragon, they shall become the Dragon Shinobi, master of brutal warfare!

name: Fury of the Shadow Dragon (Merge)
description: Ninjas are hailed for their dexterity. Dragons are praised for their strength. And when the Ninja trains in the way of the Dragon, they shall become the Dragon Shinobi, master of brutal warfare!

name: Future Paragon Soul Kris V2
description: Dage's Undead Legion will rule over everything. Will YOU fight for your future?

name: Galactic Assassin Blade
description: A weapon that's always there when you need it. Almost like clockwork.

name: Galactic BattleMage Blade (AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Galactic BattleMage Blade (Non-AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Galactic Bi-Blade
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: Galactic Blade of Stars
description: One of the three swords that have seen many galaxies and wielded by many that were capable of shaping the stars and moons. Now it will experience a whole new journey with you.

name: Galactic Captain's Blade
description: Soar through air and space defending those who cannot fight for themselves.

name: Galactic Cutlass
description: Aim for the stars and kick some asteroids as a Galactic Naval Commander! Ye trusty be out of this world, sailor!

name: Galactic Gale Piercer

name: Galactic Void Katana (Legend)
description: Nulgath is pleased by the creation of this katana in his honor. Arcane weaponsmaster Zee the Legend has done well!

name: Galanoth's Bladehaven Blade
description: The first blade used by the first Dragonslayer.

name: Galanoth's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Galanoth the Legendary Dragon Slayer. Dragons across Lore recognize his strength. They know he has sacrificed much to ensure our world survives.

name: Gale Sword
description: With their mastery of the elements, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. Harnessing the wind, this sword strikes faster than the eyes can follow.

name: Gallow's Lord Blade
description: Pay homage to the lord of the Northlands Warriors. He is the Spear Shaker, the Shield Breaker, and all who do battle honor him in this life… and (if they are worthy) in the next.

name: Garnet Dragon Plate Sword (AC)
description: This elegant sword is crafted from the scales of a Garnet dragon for elemental resistance!

name: Garnet Dragon Plate Sword (Legend)
description: This elegant sword is crafted from the scales of a Garnet dragon for elemental resistance!

name: Gatot Keris
description: Through your courage, strength and humility, truth and justice will spread throughout the land.

name: Gekido of Shinobi
description: Never get on the Shinobi's bad side. Or you just might taste both sides of this blade!

name: Gemmed Ornamental Blade
description: In honor of our upcoming mobile game, Battle Gems, ANYONE can unlock this very shiny, begemmed blade! Battle (Gem) On!

name: Genesis Sword
description: No one's quite sure where this sword came from but it was one of the first to be found in this land.

name: Gentlemen's Epee
description: In case you run into any monster who wants to duel.

name: Geodic Warrior's Blade (AC)
description: By the strength of the stones that shape their bones, Geodic Warriors are bound to serve the Avatar of Earth.

name: Geodic Warrior's Blade (Non-AC)

description: Saehae bok mani badeuseyo! /bows

description: A sword fashioned from dead materials, loaded with a catridge of spirits forced to fuse with a body that isn't theirs.

name: Ghost's Blade of Spooky Hotness
description: A replica of Ghost's cursed blade, which he must carry with him.

name: Ghost Strizer of Nulgath
description: Vulnios allegedly removed the hands of a traitor and crafted it into a weapon for his synthetic void armies in the Neo Nation.

name: Ghostly Obelisk Blade
description: The blade is carved from a stone that holds the restless spirits of hundreds of ghosts. Drag them from their grave and unleash their terror on the land of the living.

name: Ghostly Staff
description: Even though it's made from a ghost, it can do a surprising amount of damage. OoooooOOOOooo.

name: Ghoulish Cane
description: Not only is it proper, easier to scare since it makes charming bumps and bangs in the night.

name: Gia Blade
description: Vamprincess Dorene137, a Vampire Princess plotting to take Safiria's throne in a bloodsucking battle of epic proportions, has commissioned the Gia Blade to grant to her fiercest warriors!

name: Giant Protector Blade
description: This sword is use to pummel your adversaries with it's overwhelming size and power.

name: Gibazil's Fury
description: Gibazil, a sentient program developed by EbilCorp to upgrade their soldiers; who turned into a malicious computer virus that seeks extinction to humanity after Ferozakh stole their apex weapon of mass destruction called the Renegade LoreDriver. Use this sword to restore Gibazil's data by killing humans.

name: Gift Of The ArchFiend
description: Hoping to get even a small amount of Adimonde's power, the Warfiends of Nulgath follow his every order.

name: Gift of the Void Blade
description: *No description* A Sword of Pp2 that fell from its arsenal and out through the void portal.

name: Giftbox Sword

description: To make the giants of the Nation come to heel, the Beast Masters strike them with weapons akin to shock prods. This blade was forged from pure abyssal energy. There's even a chance it could wound Nulgath.

description: To make the giants of the Nation come to heel, the Beast Masters strike them with weapons akin to shock prods. This blade was forged from pure abyssal energy. There's even a chance it could wound Nulgath.
