description: Coated with the Archivist's special secret batter, this deep fried, cheese filled hot dog is enjoyed by many in Future Akiba.

name: Gigantic Crystallis Dango
description: A common sweet in future Akiba, the Dango is a treat made from mochiko (rice flour).

name: Gilded Blade of Champions
description: Everyone on Lore is a Hero… they just need to believe in themselves! This blade is a gift from Noobstine, winner of the 2015 I Can Has Mod contest.

name: Gilded Blade of the Desert Dunes
description: This was once an ordinary Blade of the Desert Dunes, from Sandsea… but no longer! With even more gold and a blade carved of Mystic Topaz, it will shine even brighter before you use plunge it into your foes.

name: Gilded Blade of the Onslaught
description: Broad swipes make quick fights. The Firestorm Onslaught enjoys a quick battle.

name: Gilded Blade of Time
description: Feliz Ano Novo! Manigong Bagong Taon! Joyeux Nouvel An! Xin Nian Hao! S Novim Godom! Frohes Neues Jahr! Felice Anno Nuovo! Happy New Year! Ring in the new year with this golden edged beauty. May your new year bring many happy returns!

name: Gilded Blood Warblade
description: A blade fit for a god of war. The weapon was born era where it was believed someone could achieve divinity after emerging from a hundred battles victorious.

name: Gilded Calamity Blade
description: A golden gift to commemorate the birthday where all your friends AND your frenemies gathered to fete (or fight!) you.

name: Gilded Champion's Blade
description: This bright shines on the battlefields and off, and is a sign to all that you are one of the most worthy heroes on Lore! Heroes voted on our Facebook page for this weapon to be created in-game!

name: Gilded Claymore of Doomwood
description: This was once a Necrotized Claymore from the Doomwood Arena PVP shop… but no longer! It is still a blade among blades, but now it's worth WAY more, covered in gold, amethyst, and rubies instead of guts and gore.

name: Gilded Cursed Sabre
description: This used to belong to One-Eyed Willie.

name: Gilded Draconic DoomBlade
description: Even the great Sepulchure would be envious of this blade.

name: Gilded Elemental Sword
description: So golden… so shiny… so POINTY!

name: Gilded Engraved Blade
description: This was once an ordinary Grave Terror Blade, found in the Shadowfall War merge shop… but no longer! The crushed tombstones have been replaced with engraved emeralds, and it's been plated in 24 carat gold.

name: Gilded Frostedge Blade
description: For those who want more than an edge in combat.

name: Gilded Gladius Blade
description: Both the light and gold handle variants:

name: Gilded Guardblade
description: The stately blue glow of this blade hide the deadly power that is contained within it. Just be careful and Don't swing it around anything electrical or metal or… just be careful when swing the blade.

name: Gilded Heartbreaker Blade
description: You'll be breaking more than just hearts with this.

name: Gilded Knight Zweihander
description: The sword leaves a gold streak in the shields, walls, and bodies slashed by it. People will know that you passed by.

name: Gilded Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Gilded Sword of Salvation
description: ﻿A blade that has not yet reached its full potential. Or perhaps it does so out of humbleness. Even gold tarnishes if one becomes lax in duty and mindfulness. Gaze into the reflection in the sword, and be reminded. (Item is CC)

name: Gilded TreasureHunter's Blade
description: Dive down deep to seek out the riches of the ocean hides beneath the waves.

name: Gilded Widowmaker
description: Captain Nubar paid an arm and a leg for this beauty. Not because he needed to, but hocks and eyepatches are too great of an opportunity to pass up!

name: Gingerbread Blade
description: Freshly baked and pipping hot! This legendary sword was awarded to the Grand Prize winners of the 2010 Creative Cookie Contest! Great Job!

name: Gingerbread Claws Blade
description: Festive Frostval 2019! These giftboxes will open on January 1st, 2020 to reveal your EPIC Frostval set!

name: Gingerbread Cookie Sword
description: Mmm! You found one of the winners of our annual Frostval Cookie Contest and snagged one of these sweet treats from their shop.

name: Gjappy's Celestial Sword
description: Celebrate Gjappy's birthday with the Blade of Light, which helps him find all of the information heroes need to enjoy AE games to the fullest!

name: GL-1ST Salvage Blade
description: A weapon made from a droid's spare limb. Better this than nothing at all. (This item is color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Glaceran Goblin Sword
description: Take on the icy Northlands with this festive sword.

name: Glacial Berserker Claymore
description: Made from icicles that fell from cavern ceilings by junior cryomancer Betty Nevoso Albero, the sword will accidentally fire several sharp icicles unintentionally if slashed from afar because of the blade's weakened instability.

name: Glacial DreadKnight Blade
description: It's cold, it's icy - what better time of year to be a living embodiment of ice?

name: Glacial FrostElf Blade
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for the Winter Moon celebration.

name: Glacial FrostElf Curved Blade
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for the Winter Moon celebration.

name: Glacial Great Sword
description: To rise against injustice, you must be willing to send your enemies into the deep chill.

name: Glacial Knight Sword
description: These knights sparkle and shine under the glow of the New Years ball when it drops.

name: Glacial Knuckle Sword
description: Carved from the tip of an iceberg, this blade is as cool as it is intimidating.

name: Glacial Naval Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Th' frozen seas of the icy northlands be your huntin' grounds. An' no cold-hearted corsair can escape th' reach of your razor-sharp rapier.

name: Glacial Naval Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: Th' frozen seas of the icy northlands be your huntin' grounds. An' no cold-hearted corsair can escape th' reach of your razor-sharp rapier.

name: Glacial Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Glacial Warrior's Blade (0 AC)
description: Mesmerized by the crystalline beauty of their icy home, Glacial Warriors have vowed to serve the Avatar of Ice.

name: Glacial Warrior's Blade (AC)
description: Mesmerized by the crystalline beauty of their icy home, Glacial Warriors have vowed to serve the Avatar of Ice.

name: Glacier Blade of Freezing
description: Some might think these daggers are not as deadly as the Frostclaw. Those people would be wrong.

name: Gladius' Dragon Blade
description: Gladius' version of the Dragon Overlord Blade. It might not too different from the ordinary version but there's a reason Gladius chose this one.

name: Glass Refraction Dagger (0 AC)
description: The reflection in the blade of this dagger rarely ever shows your current self. Lights dance and you'll catch glimpses of you at your best, your worst, and what you'll never be.

name: Glass Refraction Dagger (AC)
description: The reflection in the blade of this dagger rarely ever shows your current self. Lights dance and you'll catch glimpses of you at your best, your worst, and what you'll never be.

name: Gleaming Blade of Light (0 AC)
description: The moglins of Frostvale wish you warm nights, loving family, and cheerful companions. Merry Frostval!

name: Gleaming Blade of Light (AC)
description: The moglins of Frostvale wish you warm nights, loving family, and cheerful companions. Merry Frostval!

name: Glint Edge Cutlass
description: The glint of this steel blade blinds your opponent until death takes its bounty. (Item is Color Customizable)

name: Glorious Savior's Blade
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Glowing Crown Blade
description: The Darkness shines brightly inside this blade. Look away, lest your spirit flee in agony!

name: Glowing Dragon's Blade
description: This sword was born in an unsettling future. One where the only light Lore knows comes from their own weapons. Survive. Face fate. Battle on!

name: Glowing Heat of Affliction
description: Intricately carved, this blade is a blaze of beauty and heat. Beware the enemy that finds this sword at his or her neck. The burning heat the heralds the final jab will ignite a wave of pain that no one can withstand.

name: Glowing Katana
description: A slight essence of mana glows around this respectable blade. Light, strong and true, it will be a bane to your enemy and friend to your ally.

name: Glowing Raptor Blade
description: The core of this blade burns blue and white, feeding off the rage the raptor feels at being ridden.

name: Gnostic Cleaver
description: A self-existing plane of magic holds the entirety of this weapon together.

name: Gobble Sword
description: How can you gobble without a head?!?!

name: Gold Corsair Cutlass
description: These buccaneer's buccaneers never back down from a fight, now whether they fight fair is another question.

name: Gold Dragon Scimitar (0 AC)
description: What's a pirates favorite color? Why it be the gleaming shine of gold! Now ye can wear the color and sparkle like the rich.

name: Gold Dragon Scimitar (AC)
description: What's a pirates favorite color? Why it be the gleaming shine of gold! Now ye can wear the color and sparkle like the rich.

name: Gold Dragon Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Gold Enchanted Retro StarSword
description: The oldest, most experienced gamers will gather in Yulgar's Inn from time to time to reminisce about the blocky, pixellated Graphics of Yore. This blade was crafted to honor their nostalgia. (Blade is color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Gold Exalted Paladin Blade
description: Had Trolle'din had the improved version of this armor, it is doubtful that he would have perished. Then again, this IS Trolle'din we are talking about. He probably would have fallen for the same trick.

name: Gold Rush Knife
description: If anyone tells you this is pure gold, they're a liar. Unless it's alloyed, you wouldn't even be able to cut butter.

name: Gold ShadowFire Blade
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Gold ShadowFire Katana
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Gold Sonic Blade
description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, the must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

name: Gold-Touched Carver
description: Fancy dinnerwear kept on the mantle unless it's a very special occasion.

name: Golden Blade of Eternity
description: A glorious golden blade, befitting an eternal hero.

name: Golden Blade of Fate (Sword)
description: I love goooooolllllllllld.

name: Golden Blade of Sanctity
description: This blade of Good constantly strives to see justice upheld. It seems that an otherworldly life force lives within it.

name: Golden Blade of the Dunes
description: Easily hidden in the sand if a Dune Prince requires it later.

name: Golden Blade of the North (1)
description: This ghostly blade appears in the hands of the High Kings and Queens of the North while they ride into battle, signaling the blessing of the Avatar of Ice.

name: Golden Blade of the North (2)
description: This is a replica of ceremonial blade used by the High Kings and Queens of the North while holding court.

name: Golden Bloodbiter
description: A blade dark as the night with an edge as gold as Gravefang's legend. It was forged as a gift to appeal to the Abyssal Horde's pride. The sword's so heavy, only a Lycan hybrid can wield it.

name: Golden BrightFlame Dagger (0 AC)
description: This blade burns with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield it, or entrust it to those who share your fire.

name: Golden BrightFlame Dagger (AC)
description: This blade burns with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield it, or entrust it to those who share your fire.

name: Golden BrightFlame Sword (0 AC)
description: This blade burns with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield it, or entrust it to those who share your fire.

name: Golden BrightFlame Sword (AC)
description: This blade burns with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield it, or entrust it to those who share your fire. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Golden Caladbolg
description: Embrace the raw power of the cleansed Caladbolg to strike down all opposition. Whatever you believe in, this blade will fight for it!

name: Golden Celebration Keysword
description: United we stand, now and always! Celebrate Singapore's National Day by wearing a beautiful, traditional outfit.

name: Golden Centurion Sword
description: Used by the Golden Boy to quest for the Golden Egg with the Golden Compass and Golden Retriever while following the Golden rule.

name: Golden Claymore
description: This was once an ordinary Silver Claymore, stolen by roaches to serve as a price in their Roach Racegame… but no longer! It's been thoroughly fumigated, disinfected, and covered in 24 carat gold.

name: Golden Commander's Cutlass
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

name: Golden Commander's Rapier
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

name: Golden Crusher Blade
description: Big, bold, and gold. This blade has it all (except for a clever item description).

name: Golden Crystal Greatsword of Order
description: Looking to take on the realm of Chaos? This is the blade you'll want by your side!

name: Golden Crystalis Bloom
description: This honey gold sword is unique. There are none like it in the world and only you may be able possess the power within. The ember blade beats with your heart, and the greater your heart the greater the blade.

name: Golden DeathKnight's Blade
description: A first-rate sword the Death Knights are envious to get their hands on, it is only given to a chosen one whose power is second to its current owner. The gold variant brings out a victim's wicked side by removing any humane emotions from their psyche.

name: Golden DeathSaw
description: Somehow, I don't this heavily-adorned chainsaw is used to cut down timber.

name: Golden Draconian Sword
description: Sword of the Golden Draconian.

name: Golden Dragen's Verdighet
description: A sword named for the dignity of the Dragon who chose you as a Draco Knight. The blade is made of its crystalized breath.

name: Golden Dragon Blade (1)
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And then we gilded it so it would shine even brighter on Galanoth's birthday!

name: Golden Dragon Blade (2)
description: Forged from the scales of an ancient golden dragon, this blade is prized by dragonslayers and treasure hunters around the world.

name: Golden Dragon's Commemorative Blade (0 AC)
description: Bright sword

name: Golden Dragon's Commemorative Blade (AC)
description: The infinite is made of an endless array of numbers, real in the realm of vision, imaginary in intangible thought, and full of meaning.

name: Golden Dragon's Memorial Blade (0 AC)
description: The infinite is made of an endless array of numbers, real in the realm of vision, imaginary in intangible thought, and full of meaning.

name: Golden Dragon's Memorial Blade (AC)
description: The infinite is made of an endless array of numbers, real in the realm of vision, imaginary in intangible thought, and full of meaning.

name: Golden Dragonblade
description: Blake Don has forged this epic shiny sword for the ultimate level of Dragon slaying! Using secret forging techniques, Blake was able to craft this blade with more Dragon's Bane in it than ever before.

name: Golden Dragonlord's Blade
description: A blade that a Dragonlord and their partner forged together to help protect the weak and the trapped. So-called ‘good’ dragons will try to use this as a toothpick from time to time.

name: Golden DragonLord's Sabre (0 AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

name: Golden DragonLord's Sabre (AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

name: Golden Dream Guardian Scimitar
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Golden Duality Pirate Blade (0 AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Golden Duality Pirate Blade (AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Golden Euphoria Blade
description: A gorgeous and intricately detailed sword. Enchanted with the mana of your closest companions, the blade is blessed with their hopes. In your darkest moments, may their light guide you home.

name: Golden Fiend Warrior's Sword (0 AC)
description: Even the evillest Fiend takes a moment to shine his brightest armor to celebrate the holidays.

name: Golden Fiend Warrior's Sword (AC)
description: Even the evillest Fiend takes a moment to shine his brightest armor to celebrate the holidays.

name: Golden Firebird's Blade
description: A blade that radiates the golden shine of the sunrise and sunset. As the bane of the undead and immortal, its fire blazes for a worthy master, and snuffs out if that master falls for the sweet allure of eternity.

name: Golden FrostElf Blade
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for winter court audiences.

name: Golden Frostvale Blade
description: A festive Frostvale blade to show your holiday cheer!

name: Golden Greatsword of Order
description: Looking to take on the realm of Chaos? This is the blade you'll want by your side!

name: Golden Guardian Blade
description: This gleaming blade is proof of your many victories in battle, and the years of dedication you've shown to defending your home and people. You are a true Guardian of Battleon, and we /salute you!

name: Golden Hanzo Void Katana
description: You are the Golden Champion, slashing through the night, killing all in your sight.

name: Golden Harvest
description: Victory is yours to harvest as you wield this beautifully gilded blade!

name: Golden Harvest Scythe (Sword)
description: The best weapon available for harvesting unruly corn stalks and rebellious potatoes during the 2010 Harvest festival!

name: Golden Heart Sabre
description: Strike your foes with LOVE!

name: Golden Inquisitor's Blade
description: After succumbing to the lure of Gravelyn's darkness, former members of the Citadel Inquisitors are ready to answer Gravelyn's call to battle at any time, day or night. Though they may die, they know they will always return in her service.

name: Golden J6 Phoenix Blade
description: Drawn during the first in-game livedrawing event of 2012 by J6!

name: Golden Katana of the North
description: This is a replica of ceremonial blade used by the hereditary Dukes and Duchesses of the North in battle.

name: Golden Lightweaver Blade
description: The power of Elemental Light surges from the glowing gemstone embedded into the hilt. Some Lightweavers say that the gemstone is special, pulled right out of their soul. Others say the gem is an Elemental. Which could be true?

name: Golden Magiska Gladius
description: Both the light and gold handle variants:

name: Golden Monster Lord Blade
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monster may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: Golden Paladin Titan's Blade
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. For the Light… For Good… BATTLEON!

name: Golden Panacea Claymore
description: A golden sword that binds instead of kills. If there is a cure for the darkness of the heart, you will find it.

name: Golden Phoenix's Fury Blade

description: It has the power to destroy Planets….be careful with it Hero.It is rumored to be one of the most powerful weapons in existence. Gives 20% more Class Points and Reputation when equipped.

name: Goldenfang Blade

name: GoldenStag Warrior's Saber (AC)

name: GoldenStag Warrior's Saber (Non-AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the GoldenStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: Gongji Slayer Katana
description: *No description*

name: Gravelyn's Command Cutlass (0 AC)

description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Gravelyn's Destiny Blade in Shadow (0 AC)

name: Gravelyn's Destiny Blade in Shadow (AC)
description: The sanctified Destiny blade of Gravelyn The Good, Empress of the Lightscythe…given to Shadows.

name: Gravelyn's Imperial Blade
description: This is a ceremonial blade used by Gravelyn the Good while on the throne in Brightfall.

name: Gravelyn's Purified DoomBlade
description: By her very nature, the Champion of Light could purify with a touch almost any object of Darkness.

name: Gravelyn's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Empress Gravelyn, daughter of Sepulchure and ruler of the ShadowScythe. Though she commands legions of undead while wielding her Necrotic Sword of DOOM, her history is darker than Though beautiful and powerful, her history is as dark as the shadows that dance around her Necrotic Sword of DOOM!

name: Graves End Sword
description: What awaits heroes at the end of the grave? No one knows.

name: Great Blade of Frostclaw
description: You have proven your worth as a Glacial Lord and have been gifted this impertuable blade. Unleash the bitter wind on your foes.

name: Great BoneSword Of Eminence
description: The blade is made from the Titan's own gargantuan bones. The transformation this monster underwent continues to force growth. The Legion subdues this behemoth by using its own remains to seal it.

name: Great Calabaza Blade
description: An eldritch touch awakened humble pumpkins, and it's evolution surged. A snarling jaw, greedy vines, and temptingly sweet edge - ready to harvest and reap.

name: Great Claymore of Pain
description: Why Dilligaf thought he would be able to keep this epic blade from you is a mystery. I guess we'll never know, since all that is left of his is this lifeless corpse.

name: Great Dragon Sword
description: Hard as dragon scales, a noble sword for the protection of dragons.

name: Great Fire Blade
description: One of the greatest mage-smiths in Lore, Wolf Bane solidified fire itself to form the core of this shining blade. You'll really be able to turn the heat up on your monster attacks with THIS sword!

name: Great Fire DragonBlade
description: Akriloth's attacks last only a moment, but his legacy: a lifetime.

name: Great Heldenlied

name: Great Hraesvelgr (0 AC)
description: Even the heavens will meet their end. This blade was forged for the Warbringers of the Legion, named after a soul Dage created himself. Should a final choice be made, it will set the sky ablaze and turn it to dust.

name: Great Hraesvelgr (AC)
description: Even the heavens will meet their end. This blade was forged for the Warbringers of the Legion, named after a soul Dage created himself. Should a final choice be made, it will set the sky ablaze and turn it to dust.

name: Great Moonlit Khopesh

name: Great Pumpkin King Sword
description: You've fashioned a sword out of the Great Pumpkin King's claws.

name: Great SawBlade Of Eminence (0 AC)

name: Great SawBlade Of Eminence (AC)
description: The Titan started its unlife as just another foot soldier of the Legion. It's ruthlessness in battle grew it into a monster that could bring down a continent. This was its mortal blade, until Dage the Evil sealed it away.

name: Great Sword of Ember Flame
description: I do not recommend wiping this sword off in any dry grass to clean… Trust me on this one.

name: Great Sword of the Oracle
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Protect yourself. The truth always hurts.

name: Greatblade of the Entwined Eclipse
description: ﻿The Entwined Eclipse is the true form of the Knight of the Solstice Moon and the Priestess of the Midnight Sun, together and untoucheable. This blade houses their blessings, their wishes, and hopes that you and ﻿others will rend the skies and claim the heavens for yourselves.

name: Greatblade of the Midnight Sun
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿The Priestess of the Midnight Sun blessed this blade with the glory of the Eternal Day, and sharpened it with her malice towards Yokai and the creatures of the night. Raise this weapon high to force the Sun to stay at high noon.

name: Greatblade of the Solstice Moon
description: ﻿﻿﻿The Knight of the Solstice Moon blessed this blade with the magic of the everpresent moon, and his bloodlust for beings that claim the night as theirs. Raise this weapon high to call the moon and its purifying light to the sky.

name: Greater Artifact Blade (AC)

name: Grímnismál Fiend Blade (0 AC)

name: Grundmir Master Dwarven Broadsword

name: Guardian Prime Blade
description: The blade of the Guardians who guard the tower.

name: Guardian's Blade of Light
description: The blades bestowed to the guardians who protect the Djinn Realm.

name: Guardian's Chainsaw
description: The chainsaw of Good. This chainsaw can be turned off and on.

name: Guardian's Frozen Great Sword
description: The blade of the Northlands Guardian. Only once all threats are gone will he lower his blade, his watch done.

name: Guardian's Prime Blade of Awe
description: As an AdventureQuest Guardian, you have quested long and hard for the Blade of Awe in an alternate Lore. To show our gratitude, we have created this special exclusive version of the Blade of Awe JUST for AQ Guardians!

name: Guardian Spirit Sword
description: The thick vines of the swamp have molded together years ago and have hardened into what became a plant monster's extension of himself. It's soggy, alright but deadly.

name: Guillotine Betrayal Blade
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to slice off the Archfiend's head. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer Gunblade
description: The shadows grow stronger each passing night. A wooden stake or a silver bullet won't do. Stab the beast's heart and shoot.

name: Gunslinging Dragon Blade
description: Dressing like a DragonSlayer gives you ALL the power!

name: Gutter of Duality (0 AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Gutter of Duality (AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: HadalGlaive
description: *No description*

name: Hailblade
description: Used by ancient frost giants to butter their frozen toast. All hail this legendary blade!

name: Halcyon Skye Blade
description: A golden blade forged in a faraway land. It only gleams gold in the hands of true heroes, and can cleave storm clouds to reveal blue skies. Most rulers are unable to wield it in its golden form.

name: Halcyon Skye Longsword
description: The longsword takes on a muddy gray shade in the hands of an unworthy ruler. More often than not, its their retainers and knights that can reveal the blade's true golden gleam.

name: Halcyon Virtue Blade
description: A golden blade forged in a faraway land. It only gleams gold in the hands of true heroes, and can cleave stormclouds to reveal blue skies. Most rulers are unable to wield it in its golden form.

name: Half-Off Bright Dragon Blade
description: This blade isn't defective, it's limited-edition!

name: Half-Off Chainsaw Hand
description: Be glad it's the chainsaw and not your hand that's half-off!

name: Half-Off Sword
description: This sword is half-off! Literally… it is half-off. It's right in the title. You couldn't get a better deal anywhere!

name: Hallowed Blade Of Awe
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power! It is said that even death is subjugated by this awe-inspiring magical blade. (Imported from the original AdventureQuest.)

name: Hand of Death Blade
description: A prophecy has been foretold that a blade will fall from Death's pocket, bringing chaos and destruction to the land of Lore. Just with a single glancing touch from this blade, HE shall follow and escort to end darkest depths at the end of the tunnel, far away from that glimmering light!

name: Hand of the DoomPhoenix
description: Cheer for your favorite patriotic team!

name: Hanzamune Dragon Koi Blade
description: A legendary blade crafted by the greatest Yokai swordsman, Hanzamune, in which the sword is named after. It is a great honor to wield this century-old sword.

name: Harbinger of Destruction Blade (0 AC)
description: The blade comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harbinger of Destruction Blade (AC)
description: The blade comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harbinger of Destruction Sword (0 AC)
description: The blade comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harbinger of Destruction Sword (AC)
description: The blade comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harmony Vow Blade
description: Should the best man and maid of honor have trouble fighting off monsters and objecting guests, the bride and groom take up their blades. Weddings are a magnet for drama.

name: Harpies Hand of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite beaked destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Harvest Assassin's Blade
description: Turkill or not Turkill that is the question…

name: Harvest Baster
description: This sword drains the blood of your enemies (or, in a pinch, some au jus) to keep its monstrous heart pumping.

name: Harvest Hunter's Blade
description: Brings the phrase scrounging for food to a whole new level. These hunters explore Greenguard for food.

name: Harvest Scythe (1)
description: One of the few weapons suitable for harvesting the 2010 Harvest harvest.

name: Hateful Goliath
description: "Might makes right" haunts the behemoth that was forged into this blade. After eons without equal, an undead upstart killed it. Now, it's a weapon defined by a grudge, cursing its wielder to die like a rat.

name: Haunted Ghostly Cutlass (0 AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones' locker.

name: Haunted Ghostly Cutlass (AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones' locker.

name: Havoc Sage's Chiljido (0 AC)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Havoc Sage's Chiljido (AC)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Hawberry Grenwog Carrot Kunai
description: Carrots aren't actually that healthy of a snack to feed to rabbits. Too much sugar. It makes more sense to shower your enemies in a rain of adorable carrot kunai.

name: Hayato's Wrath
description: Energy runes inscribed into the heavy blade make this broadsword majestically intimidating and effective during melee combat.This weapon was inspired by your fellow player, Reki Hayato!

name: Hazardous Bioblade
description: What a wicked weapon! This special sword will unlock when the BioBeasts Facebook page reaches 25,000 Likes. Thanks for supporting BioBeasts… now run on off and go play with your blade.

name: Head Of Death
description: Upgrade your Face Mace with this conduit blade!

name: Headless Pumpkin Blade
description: Ne'er-do-wells using the darkness of all hallow's eve as cover will never escape your gaze, or lack there of. Don't forget your head at home.

name: Heart of Fire Blade
description: The heart of fire gives these beings their power. Their everlasting heat will burn down their enemies.

name: Heart of Shadows
description: And with all my rage, I will slaughter you next like a rat in a cage!

name: Heart of the Void Edge
description: Forged from pure Void Crystal, this blade will slice through flesh and bone, and then taint the soul left behind!

name: Heart Render Betrayal Blade
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to exsanguinate the heart of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Heart Sabre
description: Strike your foes with LOVE!

name: Heart Slasher
description: When it feels like you've been stabbed through the heart… sometimes you have!

name: HeartBlade
description: With this sword you can smite your enemies with the power of LOVE!

name: Heartbreaker Blade
description: When you're fighting for love, you use both hands.

name: HeartCrusher Blade
description: A strike to the heart, and you're too blame. You seek love, glory, and fame. (Changes when in combat)

name: Heartrend
description: The bond between a champion and his weapons is powerful. When he falls, does his blade follow?

name: Heartstone Gladius
description: Made from the shards of a broken crystallized heart, smashed to bits in the Friend Zone.

name: Hearty Cutlass
description: Avast me hearties!

name: Heavy Brightsteel Sword
description: Broad swipes make quick fights. The Brightsteel Onslaught enjoys a quick battle.

name: Heavy Holy Blade
description: A heavy golden blade with which to smash the undead to pieces!

name: Hebi Twintana
description: You are awesome. And you deserve a weapon that's equally as awesome. That's why we're giving this item to anyone who supported AQW in the past last 6 months!

name: Heimdallr Blade
description: Wield the blade of Heimdallr as you prepare for the coming of Ragnarok!

name: Hellion Beast Cleaver (AC)
description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

name: Hellion Beast Cleaver (Non-AC)
description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

name: Heretic's Metal Sword
description: These ancient druid weapons were made in secret to combat supernatural beings. It was a crime amongst the ancient peoples to wield metal.

name: Hero Heart Slasher
description: Xin the Ultimate Knew that Reki was designing a weapon created from the negative energy that looms during the holiday. Xin determined an opposite blade must be forged. This blade was crafted by channeling the innocence and love of Heroes Heart Day. Just holding the weapon make the wielder feel at peace and content.

name: Hero Hunter's Fangs Blade (AC)
description: The hunt is on and your prey is near… fangs of steel will help you reap a hearty hero harvest.

name: Hero Hunter's Fangs Blade (Special)
description: The hunt is on and your prey is near… fangs of steel will help you reap a hearty hero harvest.

name: Hero's Conviction Blade
description: Thousands of years in the past, a great Hero took up this blade to slay a foul King. This monster, who slew his own Queen to evoke forbidden power, was destroyed along with his cursed empire. Now, the blade waits for a new master.

name: HeroBlade
description: This is the strongest blade in the world. We cannot know how much damage it will do until you face the greatest foe in the world!

name: HeroBlade Lvl 1
description: This is the strongest blade in the world. We cannot know how much damage it will do until you face the greatest foe in the world!

name: Heroic Berserker Blade
description: These Berserkers fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: Heroic Titan's Greatsword
description: Even in moments of deepest despair, we can still find hope. No matter how messed up things get, YOU have the power to save the day.

name: HeroMart Defender Blade
description: Wielded in battle by the powerful xxxx clan, this elegant sword is crafted from the scales of a Ruby dragon for elemental and damage resistance.

name: HeroSmash Alpha Sword
description: While you're SMASHing opponents with this awesome sword, we'll make sure our servers aren't CRASHing our newest game!

name: Hex Blade of Nulgath
description: This sword is bejeweled with powerful gems.

name: Hidden Blade
description: If your enemy doesn't look too closely, maybe they won't notice the gun.

name: High Celestial Protector's Blade
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: High Celestial Protector's Longsword
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: High Crusader Light Blade
description: Crusaders are the next up the Good rank! You're moving your way towards the Light!

name: High ShadowScythe Blade
description: Adding the Deadtech Node seems to have removed all color from this item. How strange.

name: High ShadowScythe Cutlass
description: All color has been leeched from this item. How strange.

name: High Tatras Dagger
description: Truth prevails! May you always battle with honor, in the spirit of your homeland's motto.

name: Higure
description: ﻿It is impossible to run away from this black blade. I wonder if there is a more worthy hero to wield it?

name: Hikari no Akuma Blade
description: Do not let the name fool you. They may be driven by the light but these Akuma still have deep dark powers.

name: Hinokami Katana (0 AC)
description: An heirloom blade connected to samurai by the flames of their souls instead of their blood. Its steel was scorched black by Dragon fire, transforming it into a katana that cleaves the infinite.

name: Hinokami Katana (AC)
description: An heirloom blade connected to samurai by the flames of their souls instead of their blood. Its steel was scorched black by Dragon fire, transforming it into a katana that cleaves the infinite.

name: Hippodrome Star Cutlass
description: Originally, this weapon was crafted for the stage, not the high seas. But theatre can quickly become reality, and anything can be deadly if sharpened.

name: Hoarfrost Snowflake Rapier
description: The Court of the Winter Fae enjoy the dramatics of romance and duels. It is tradition for the duelists to have their weapons created by the ice magic of their heart's desire. A warrior of the Sluagh made this rapier.

name: Holiblade
description: A blade truly fit for the most royal of Frostval warriors.

name: Hollow Demonic Doujikiri
description: The blade of an exiled OniSlayer Empress. She died, betrayed and abandoned. Her vengeful spirit haunts the katana. Now the coveted weapon of the Four Oni Lords, it seeks the blood of those it once protected.

name: Hollow Soul Blade
description: A devious sword made from the remains of a Hollow Soul.The blade is believed to contain an uncomfortable number of lost souls.

name: Hollowborn Absolution
description: The one true companion of the Hollowborn Shadowslayer. It remains by their side until the very end of their painful journey.

name: Hollowborn Alchemist's Blade
description: Expert transmutationists, Hollowborn Alchemists are the masters of mutable magic. Their power lies in transforming objects into new states of being. The Shadow Fiend has granted them the ability to change the very nature of reality.

name: Hollowborn Assassin Dirk
description: It is wielded by the Hollowborn, and is meant to harm other Hollowborn. Those who once called themselves Vindicators now slink through shadows, cursed to become what they despise.

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Greatsword (0 AC)
description: There's a tale of a Beastmaster dying as they stabbed their weapon into a massive behemoth's heart, and together, they overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial. Which weapon was it? Perhaps you're holding it in your hands. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Greatsword (AC)
description: There's a tale of a Beastmaster dying as they stabbed their weapon into a massive behemoth's heart, and together, they overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial. Which weapon was it? Perhaps you're holding it in your hands. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Blade
description: I wonder where he got this…

name: Hollowborn Blade of Chaos
description: The legendary sword that has been used by Drakath for nearly 13 years, and the shadows have made it even more powerful…

name: Hollowborn Blade of Thorns
description: ﻿A blade that has persisted beyond death. When an elvish assassin overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial, the thorny vines sprouting from their body birthed a new poison. At a touch, it will allow the victim to meet the Fiend themselves.

name: Hollowborn Caladbolg
description: Against your indomitable Hollowborn will, your enemies will fall and the mountains will bow.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Carver (AC)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late. You've failed the test.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Carver (Non-AC)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late. You've failed the test.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Greatsword (0 AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest, comforted by death instead of the Shadow Fiend, as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Greatsword (AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest, comforted by death instead of the Shadow Fiend, as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Longsword (0 AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest, comforted by death instead of the Shadow Fiend, as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Longsword (AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest, comforted by death instead of the Shadow Fiend, as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Hollowborn Chaos Unlocker
description: This blade was created from pure Chaos and empowered by pure Shadows. It may do damage against anything at any time… including Chaos itself.

name: Hollowborn DoomBlade (Sword)
description: This sword hungers for destruction… Are you sure you can control such dark energy?

name: Hollowborn Dragon Flow
description: A Dark Matter weapon infused with the Shadow Flames. Feel the heat flowing from the blade to your soul. It's as part of you as the shadows now.

name: Hollowborn Dragon's Epicedium
description: Beyond the dark depths of death, the Dragonlord's will persists.

name: Hollowborn Dragonblade
description: The power of the Hollowborn can also be used when targeting Dragons. Use wisely.

name: Hollowborn Dragonblood Blade
description: Affectionately called a stinger because, at most, it would feel like a pinprick to a Dragon. Dragonlords use this to handle mundane disputes.

name: Hollowborn Dragonlord MasterBlade
description: When a Dragonlord dies, their partner takes this blade from their tomb, and carries it to someone worthy of inheriting an ancient legacy. One day, it will be the Dragonlord who delivers it to a Dragon.

name: Hollowborn DragonSlayer's Blade
description: To control a dragon takes strength. To control a dragon without it knowing you are the puppetmaster takes skill, stealth, and subterfuge. (Item does 60% more damage to Dragons when equipped.)

name: Hollowborn Drake Flamberge
description: The wavy shape of the blade catches the fancy of many Dragons. It resembles a breath of fire frozen in motion.

name: Hollowborn Drake Stinger
description: Affectionately called a stinger because, at most, it would feel like a pinprick to a Dragon. Dragonlords use this to handle mundane disputes.

name: Hollowborn Dreadsaw
description: This blade was forged from beasts of the void. The creature made from this sword was very powerful, but may not survive this new shadow form.

name: Hollowborn Empress' Blade (Sword)
description: The Royal blade of the Shadowscythe, transformed into pure darkness by the will of the Shadowfiend.

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Claymore (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Claymore (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as Hollowborns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Katana (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Katana (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Skullblade (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Skullblade (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Executioner's Bite
description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Executioner has mastered all types of combat. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Judgement Ex Vi Legis
description: The Hollowborn Judge is sometimes brought into combat to punish the defendant. They must use weapons instead of words. Apply the sentence more than once to make the consequences more severe.

name: Hollowborn Keyblade
description: Kasebel's exotic weapon is also the only way to unlock the Gates of the Fortress. What mysteries are waiting for you inside?

name: Hollowborn Kindness
description: The Shadow Fiend always attends to the call of his followers. He now gifts you with his weapon. Keep your mind focused, and don't let the blade consume you.

name: HollowBorn Laserblade
description: Found in the depths of Hollowdeep, this odd dark laserblade will give any Hollowborn the power of the Fourth.

name: Hollowborn Nightmare Blade
description: Some DreamWalkers can send their minds through dreams and dimensions to get information or watch their enemies, but Hollowborn DreamWalkers are able to go there personally if needed. Though it is a gift from the Shadow Fiend to do such thing, it comes with a  price.

name: Hollowborn Oblivion Blade
description: You are now the sole owner of this sword. No voices . No rules. No weakness. Only the shadows, and what's in there…

name: Hollowborn Omega Blades
description: With this blade, you will bring about the End: the end of your opponents, the end of Order, and the end of LORE itself! All shall fall to the power of Shadows!

name: Hollowborn Omega Sword
description: With this blade, you will bring about the End: the end of your opponents, the end of Order, and the end of LORE itself! All shall fall to the power of Shadows!

name: Hollowborn Penance
description: The one true companion of the Hollowborn Shadowslayer. It remains by their side until the very end of their painful journey.

name: Hollowborn Plague Calibur
description: Laced with the plague the Hollowborn Vampire Knights succumbed to in their previous lives, it is now weaponize by its victims against their enemies.

name: Hollowborn Punitio
description: The Hollowborn Judge is sometimes brought into combat to punish the defendant. They must use weapons instead of words. Apply the sentence more than once to make the consequences more severe.

name: Hollowborn Reaper's Katana
description: Fallen warriors seeking for justice or revenge… it can be hard to tell the difference. Trained specially to fight infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper is both slayer and puppetmaster. (Item does 15% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Hollowborn Sinner Blade
description: This blade was once aimed by diabolical beings from another realm. Beware of people trying to steal it!

name: Hollowborn Soul Eater Blade
description: A symbol of the Undead Legion, few have ever had the privilege of seeing such blades, let alone wield them. When their wielder passed the Shadow Fiend's test, the souls forged into the blades became influenced by its powers as well.

name: Hollowborn Sword (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Sword (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as Hollowborns!

name: Hollowborn Sword of Doom (IoDA)
description: The shadows compel… DOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!

name: Hollowborn Sword of Doom (Sword)
description: This shadows compel… DOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!

name: Hollowborn Zweiblade (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Zweiblade (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: HollowNight Pumpkin Blade
description: Picked at the dark of the moon, these gourds are not recommended for eating… but for wearing!

name: HollowNight Pumpkin Greatsword
description: Picked at the dark of the moon, these gourds are not recommended for eating… but for wearing!

name: HollowSoul Ghoul Blade
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: HollowSoul Ghoul's Dirk
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: HollowSoul Knight Captain's Blade
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: HollowSoul Knight Captain's Dirk
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: Holly Sword
description: A massive blade forged on the eve of Frostval for the holliest of knights.

name: Holly Wand
description: It seems that going back even to the time of the Druids, the holly branch was both a fearsome weapon and a useful child rearing tool.

name: Holy Intention
description: An elegant platinum blade designed for those of regal descent. The ornate hilt, with its empirical crossguard, proves its standing without question.

name: Hongbaoshi Blade (0 AC)
description: (This is the 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)A ruby blade that represents the burning passion in a Dragon's breath. Being gifted this weapon from Earthen Dragons is akin to a promise of protection.

name: Hongbaoshi Blade (AC)
description: (Alternate 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)

name: Honor Guard's Blade
description: By the honor of my fathers, I will strike down any foe who opposes Lore!

name: Honorable Koi Ningyo Tachi
description: The aquatic nations which dwell under the Seven Seas of Yokai must defeat a ningyo in battle before they can be considered warriors. Legend also has it that eating a a ningyo's flesh may grant immortality… but no one has proven it true. Yet.

name: Honorable Ninja Blade
description: Only those who devote them selves to the path the Moon Bow Ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Honorable Ninja Katana
description: Only those who devote them selves to the path of Honor may wield this weapon.

name: Honorbound Ornate Katana
description: This weapon marks you as a creature of duty as well as honor.

name: Honorbound Prime Katana
description: We don't kill for sport, for lust, or for greed. We kill for honor!

name: Hook Sword
description: No weapon is more versatile than the hook sword: defeat your foes, move blocks of ice, and catch a fish… all at the same time!

name: Hooked Elite SoulSeeker Blade
description: Essentially a weaponized meat hook, used to dangle a SoulSeeker to prevent them from mindlessly attacking their own kin. When they're unleashed, the SoulSeekers brandish it in battle.

name: Hooked SoulSeeker Blade
description: Essentially a weaponized meat hook, used to dangle a SoulSeeker to prevent them from mindlessly attacking their own kin. When they're unleashed, the SoulSeekers brandish it in battle.

name: HopeBringer Blade
description: When all hope seems to be lost unsheathe this legendary blade forged by Prince Knight to turn the tide of battle!

name: Horc BattleBlade
description: Long-time sword from father's father's father. Seen many battles, still whole. Like me.

name: Horc Jom Dat
description: A deadly Horcish blade. Jom Dat literally means Will Of the Metal. Each Jom Dat has its own shape. The forger must allow the blade to take shape following natural curves of the steel.

name: Horc Sell-Sword Scimitar
description: It's a Sell-sword's sold sword.

name: Horc Slicer
description: No Troll be able to reach me when I hold THIS blade!

name: Horc War Sword
description: It's similar but not the same as Thrax's blade. Still… it's an impressive weapon.

name: Horcish Naval Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horcish Naval Cutlass (AC)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horcish Ripper
description: Unleash your battlecry into the distant azure sky! This sword has defeated many enemies, and has been entrusted to you. Wield it proudly.

name: Horn of Terra Suul
description: Such a memorable sword. You'll never forget its beauty, or the size of the hole it leaves.

name: Horned Longsword
description: An honorable sword originated in the Shadowfall Empire, wielded by the elite Shadowscythe.

name: Horse Tail Katana
description: COLOR CUSTOM: In the Zodiac, the Snake is exciting, collected and dark. They are smooth and never lose their cool. Are you cold blooded enough to handle the Water Katanas?

name: Hraesvelgr
description: Even the heavens will meet their end. This blade was forged for the Warbringers of the Legion, named after a soul Dage created himself. Should a final choice be made, it will set the sky ablaze and turn it to dust.

name: Hubris
description: Your work has paid off, here is your reward! Your work has paid off, here is your reward! As you fight Human opponents, Hubris is absorbing more power - keep fighting humans for the bonus!

name: HullBreaker
description: For destroying Shadowscythe mech troopers, this nanotech light blade is what you'll want to have at your side.

name: Hunter's Moon Cleaver
description: These warriors fight against the Mooncursed beast, Marchosisas to save their village.

name: Hydra Blade
description: Forged from the scales of Hydra, the sword actually repairs itself when damaged.

name: Hydra Rapier
description: A keen blade paired with a keen Monster Hunter will make even the most ferocious Hydra turn tail to save its own neck.

name: Hyperborean Blade
description: Slender, elegant and deadly, this blade will seek out the blood of your enemy, slowing its pulse until freezing in the victim's veins. Painful and spiteful, this weapon isn't for the faint for heart.

name: Hyperphysical Fey
description: A strange, otherworldly weapon forged with unidentifiable materials unknown to the human race. The source of the weapon's endless energy remains a mystery.

name: HyperReaver
description: You unlocked this weapon by purchasing the Nation Logo t-shirt from heromart. Evil salutes you!

name: Hyperspace Marine Sword
description: In space, no one can hear you.. oh, GROSS, what was THAT goo?

name: Iadoa's Star Sword
description: The tenth Chaos Lord to rise was Iadoa. You can feel what is left of his power pulsing through this Star Sword as the seconds tick away.

name: Ice Calibreaker
description: In legend, it's said that the balde was pulled from the side of a glacier and can take any enemy down with a single blow.

name: Ice Cold Katana
description: This katana is cooler than being cool! It's ice cold! Use it wisely.

name: Ice Cold Steel
description: This sword knows nothing outside of freezing the soul of your enemy. Handle with care, for the last thing you want is to join the ranks of your enemies in eternal cold sleep.

name: Ice Frost Sabre
description: Just because the blade is ice doesn't mean it's brittle. This sword will put anyone in the freeze.

name: Ice Katana (1)
description: Originally designed by Clay, forged by Yulgar, and given magical might by Warlic, the Ice Katana was constructed by combining samples found from AdventureQuest.

name: Ice Katana (2)
description: This katana has been infused with the power of the Frozen Claymore. Use it wisely!

name: Ice Lord Guardian's Blade
description: Only a fool would battle against these frozen warriors of the North. Ice runs deep in their veins giving them the upper hand.

name: Ice Reborn
description: Glaciers melt slowly, but contain great power. This blade was forged from a shard of ice taken deep inside the heart of a glacier at the top of the world.

name: Ice Sabre
description: A sword made of polar ice. Hard and sharp as steel. Just don't leave it next to a fire.

name: Ice Sickle
description: This is a sickle… made of ice. Get it?

name: Ice Slayer
description: Lord SlayR crafted this weapon out of the permafrost of the north. The ice will never melt, and it is as hard as diamonds, forever maintaining its sharp jagged blade.

name: Ice Storm Blade
description: Crafted by a group of wizards working in the teeth of a howling ice-storm, this blade will keep you cool even in the warmest nights.

name: Ice Walker's Blade
description: Forged from the very ground that the travel one, the Ice Walkers have crafted a blade ready to send their foes to their icy grave!

name: Icebane Blade
description: The elder gods walk the frozen forests of the Northlands. Only their devoted warrior-priests know the ritual to summon them. But once they do… BEWARE!

name: Iceborn Blade of Awe
description: An icy version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will help keep you cool in the hottest of places. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: IceBreaker Blade
description: Your enemies will freeze in fear when you step onto the battlefield!

name: Icebreath
description: I took that dragon's BREATH and then I used it as a SWORD! …but this time I did it with an ice dragon!

name: IceEdge Sword
description: The spirit of ice gives these beings their power. Their everlasting chill will freeze their enemies to the core.

name: Iceheart
description: The legendary blade of the rules of the Northlands Wield this well, Your Majesty!

name: IceRender
description: The legendary blade of the rulers of the Northlands should only be drawn when the world has ended…and one must break through the ice to a new dawn!

name: IceShard Stabber
description: Just make sure your vanquish your enemies by the spring, or you might not have anything to fight with. Take the foes! Slip on the puddle!

name: IceStorm General's Blade (0 AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors.  No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: IceStorm General's Blade (AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors.  No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: Icewater Blade of Nautica
description: Made of icewater harvested from the deepest reaches of the depths, this blade will pierce your enemies through their cold, dead hearts.

name: Ichneumon's Grand Slayer
description: Upon his travels, Shadowslayer Rei came across the tribe of Ichneumon Dragonslayers. The Ichneumons wield the remains of the dragons they slay. The sword is constructed from dragon bones, encasing a flame-exuding magical orb which empowers the blade with the might of a dragon.

name: Ichorus Leo
description: A blade crafted from the blood of the legendary Atlas Lion to hunt all Evils. It can only be wielded by the right and worthy King. No prince or princess could hope to inherit the weight of its destiny.

name: Ichorus Nemean
description: A blade crafted from the blood of the legendary Atlas Lion to hunt all Evils. It can only be wielded by the right and worthy King. No prince or princess could hope to inherit the weight of its destiny.

name: Icy Barbarian Blade
description: Warriors of the tundra, brute strength and determination give these barbarians a clear advantage in the battle.

name: Icy Blade of Doom (0 AC)
description: Even Evil heroes (maybe ESPECIALLY Evil heroes) need to chill out after battle. With your Icy Blade of Doom, you can cool off without sacrificing that battle-ready edge.

name: Icy Blade of Doom (AC)
description: Even Evil heroes (maybe ESPECIALLY Evil heroes) need to chill out after battle. With your Icy Blade of Doom, you can cool off without sacrificing that battle-ready edge.

name: Icy Bloodletter of Nulgath
description: The Archfiend knows you're as cold as ice in battle… now you have Bloodletters to reflect that!

name: Icy Frostlorn Raider Blade
description: The Winter Raiders use this style of weapon in fighting off the great white wyrms of the northlands.

name: Icy Frostlorn Raider Katana
description: The Winter Raiders use this style of weapon in fighting off the great white wyrms of the northlands.

name: Icy Frostlorn Rogue Cutlass
description: *No description*

name: Icy Infernal Blade
description: Don't let it being made of ice cold your judgment, this is a mighty weapon.

name: Icy Katana
description: The icy rift has spilled not only monsters into Lore, but also LOOT! Happy Frostval!

name: Icy Rapier
description: Shiver me timbers! It be th' Icy Naval Commander's rapier! A pirate weapon this cool freezes over.

name: Icy Soldier Sword
description: Is a little frostbite going to stop you? It better not!

name: Icy Spirit Rapier
description: Sculpted from ice, this rapier suffers and unknown curse that makes its blade disappear and reappear without warning. Icy Naval Commanders are often seen wielding this blade.

name: Idalion's Blazing Fang
description: This blade is as swift and merciless as the dragon whose fangs inspired their shape; they''re balanced to strike faster than the shadows can fall.

name: Idalion's Shadowbrand Blade
description: Forged in Mount Maleno’s sacred fire, this blade hums with a heat that only grows in battle.

name: Igneus Assassin Blade
description: You've got the eye of the tiger in this stealth assassin armor. Always on the prowl, the cat-like reflexes of the Igneus Assassin are those of legends.

name: Ignited Frost Sword
description: A volcanic winter was caused by this sword being thrusted into the core of a slumbering mountain. The culprit knew they would burn, but did so willingly.

name: Ignited Guardian's Blade
description: Hot to the touch, only the truest and bravest guardians may wield this weapon.

name: Illusionist's Channel
description: Formed of pure mana this sword conducts the illusions.

name: Illusionist's Pain
description: A lost blade, damaged by not only combat but by the user itself. The sword reflects the mental state of its previous users, it's damaged and mangled into something not quite practical.

name: Illustrious Savior's Blade
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Illustrious Splendor
description: This is the light of a resilient soul, and a face that screams that it exists. The last sunset approaches, but it isn't the end. Given a little hope and just enough time, nothing is impossible.

name: Imbalanced King's Star Sword
description: The power of the Mirror Realm pulses through this Star Sword. You can also FEEL Imbalanced Alteon's wrath at his defeat.

name: Imbalanced Sword
description: Alteon the Imbalanced made a pact with a cloaked stranger to obtain a weapon of raw dark power and rule the kingdom with an obsidian fist. The sword's power came from an infamous dark dragon whose name strikes fear and uncertainty in the veins of innocents. Glancing at the sword the dragon's eyes stare right back at you. Could it be that this sword is the host of that dragon? No wonder Alteon has been unchallenged.

name: Immortal Chronomancer Blade (AC)
description: Immortal Chronomancers transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence.

name: Immortal Chronomancer Blade (Special)
description: These intrepid, timely explorers can step into a shadow in one time-stream and emerge from a completely different shadow in another time stream. Immortal Chronomancers transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence.

name: Immortal Crusader Saber (AC)
description: As long as you stand together with your compatriots, you will NEVER be defeated! Your motto: Libertad O Muerte!

name: Immortal Crusader Saber (Non-AC)
description: As long as you stand together with your compatriots, you will NEVER be defeated! Your motto: Libertad O Muerte!

name: Immortal Sacrificer Maquahuitl (0 AC)
description: Dage the Evil fancies the Beast half of his soul to be the fabled Dark Sun the Immortal Sacrificers speak of. He forged a toothed blade to match their preferences. It shreds flesh, and lets blood gush like rivers into the Styx.

name: Immortal Sacrificer Maquahuitl (AC)
description: Dage the Evil fancies the Beast half of his soul to be the fabled Dark Sun the Immortal Sacrificers speak of. He forged a toothed blade to match their preferences. It shreds flesh, and lets blood gush like rivers into the Styx.

name: Immortal Shadow Breaker
description: This time-worn blade was made from a vein of silver that passed through a leyline. It is constantly won and lost, treated as the regalia of both Vampires and Werewolves, and stolen back by ShadowSlayers to reclaim the night.

name: Immortal Void Blade (0 AC)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Immortal Void Blade (AC)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Immortal Void Sword (0 AC)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Immortal Void Sword (AC)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Imperial Blade in Shadow (0 AC)
description: his is a ceremonial blade used by Gravelyn the Good while on the throne in Brightfall.

name: Imperial Blade in Shadow (AC)
description: his is a ceremonial blade used by Gravelyn the Good while on the throne in Brightfall.

name: Imperial Chunin Kunai
description: A Chunin is a ninja field commander. Highly trained to attack from stealth but focusing on strength and power rather than agility and speed.

name: Imperial Chunin Ninjato
description: A Chunin is a ninja field commander. Highly trained to attack from stealth but focusing on strength and power rather than agility and speed.

name: Imperial Chunin Sai
description: A Chunin is a ninja field commander. Highly trained to attack from stealth but focusing on strength and power rather than agility and speed.

name: Imperial Doomblade
description: Bones and crimson steel burn in the forges of the Empire. They are no longer vessels to hide Doom Spirits, but a prison for the Shadowscythe to harness their power.

name: Imperial Gladius
description: Crafted by the masterful hands of dwarven smiths, this sword performs exceptionally in close quarter skirmishes.

name: In-Djinn-ious Blade
description: With this lamp you only get one wish, and the wish has to be murder.

name: In-Djinn-ious Blade +3
description: With this lamp you only get one wish, and the wish has to be murder. (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Incandescent Claymore
description: From the mountain's heart of gold, the claymore's blade is still warm from the fires of Dwarfhold Keep's forges. It is a double edged sword, both a devastating weapon and a beacon that beckons greed and danger.

name: Incandescent Phoenix Shard
description: This sword's blade was made from molten lava drawn from the heart of the Plane of Fire itself.

name: Incendiary Cutlass (0 AC)
description: A cutlass forged from mana-infused, superheated metal. It's extremely volatile, and likely to cause an explosion on impact. Only someone who doesn't mind sixth-degree burns should wield it.

name: Incendiary Cutlass (AC)
description: A cutlass forged from mana-infused, superheated metal. It's extremely volatile, and likely to cause an explosion on impact. Only someone who doesn't mind sixth degree burns should wield it.

name: Incendiary Rapier (0 AC)
description: One nick will light your body like it's a candlewick. Count down from 3, and you'll be gone; evaporated into a crispy pink mist.

name: Incendiary Rapier (AC)
description: One nick will light your body like it's a candlewick. Count down from 3, and you'll be gone; evaporated into a crispy pink mist.

name: Infantry Assault Blade
description: Time to hack and slash your way through undead, make Artix proud! Released in honor of Artix Entertainment's neew mobile game "Undead Assault"

name: Infantry Blade
description: A standard sword of war.

name: Infection Waiting to Happen
description: This knife would make your mother worry. Unless your mother enjoyed pain and suffering.

name: Infernal Abyss Blade
description: The fall is inevitable. Fate and the abyss are one and the same.

name: Infernal ArchFiend Sword
description: A Greater Infernal was torn apart and forged into a sentient weapon. It watches as those who once served it call Nulgath their Master. (CC to Accessory)

name: Infernal Blade of Judgement
description: The bells will toll, and all will answer. No one will escape judgement.

name: Infernal Blade of Malice
description: Although forged ages ago, this blade has somehow kept its heat bestowed within the steel. Understand fire as an element, and the Infernal Blade of Malice will become your greatest ally.

name: Infernal Bone Blade
description: The Infernal Flames' horns don't stop growing. They tear out the growths, and use them to tear open their enemies. Fire catches the blood, burning them to nothing.

name: Infernal Caladbolg
description: Forged in fire and bathed in blood, this blade will rip the hope, determination, and pride out of any wielding it… unless you become its master! Speak to Dage in the Underworld to begin its quests.

name: Infernal Cutlass
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they want far below Davy Jones's locker.

name: Infernal Cyber Doomblade
description: An ordinary replica of the Necrotic Blade of Doom that was later claimed by a deranged technomancer who enhanced the blade with his nano magic. The resulting experiment made it more horrifying in both appearance and electrical capacity.

name: Infernal Dark Blade of Cruelty
description: Yeah that's a lot of words but this sword belonged to only the most ruthless of the underworld generals. Be wary of its power.

name: Infernal Defender's Devastator
description: Dark Infernal Defenders are among the strongest warriors a Celestial Guardian will ever face… and their prowess in battle cannot be denied.

name: Infernal Flame Khopesh
description: The fire raging inside you has made you unstoppable… channel it and sear your way to victory! (75% damage boost against Elementals)

name: Infernal General's Destroyer
description: High Infernal Generals command legions of Dark Infernal Defenders. Their power has been known to decimate entire armies… until today.

name: Infernal Pirate Rapier
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they want far below Davy Jones's locker.

name: Infernal Revenger's Blade (0 AC)
description: The twisted Infernals who follow Evil Archmage Brentan in the Mirror Realm love two things best. Fire, and dealing pain to their enemies.

name: Infernal Revenger's Blade (AC)
description: The twisted Infernals who follow Evil Archmage Brentan in the Mirror Realm love two things best. Fire, and dealing pain to their enemies.

name: Infernal Rocks
description: It's a flaming great sword! (Not to be confused with a flaming greatsword. This doesn't need 2 hands to wield).

name: Infernal Slayer's Blade
description: Infused with the Light of Good, the blade never fails.

name: Infernal SoulRipper
description: The edges of this blade have been smeared with a toxic substance made from the saliva of Dark Makai mixed with the tears of your fallen enemies… plus a few other esoteric ingredients known only to Nulgath's Alchemists.

name: Infernal Starsaber
description: When a star collapses into a black hole, it can never go back to what it once was. Powered by raw hatred and despair, this weapon drags its enemies down with it.

name: Infernal Trigger Blade
description: A blade born from blood, drenched in the rage of the fallen and Infernal.

name: Infernal Underworld Battle Blade
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Underworld Katana
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Underworld Sheathed Katana
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Void Katana (AC)
description: Nulgath is pleased by the creation of this katana in his honor. Arcane weaponsmaster Zee the Legend has done well!

name: Infernal Void Katana (Legend)
description: Nulgath is pleased by the creation of this katana in his honor. Arcane weaponsmaster Zee the Legend has done well!

name: Infernal Warlord's Blade
description: An elite corps of Underworld Battlemages, the Infernal Shadow Warlords can summon infernal creatures from the place between worlds.

name: Infinitum
description: Its bitter blade will pierce foes with a numbing sensation.

name: Infinity Titan Sword
description: The hardest choices requires the stronger will. The end is near, but you have the strength of will to act on those choices. Never forget.

name: Inkwell Sword
description: The pen is mightier than the sword. But what if the sword happens to be a pen?

name: Inquisitor Captain Claymore
