description: *No description*

name: Inquisitor's Bright Blade
description: The highest honor one can be bestowed upon, the Inquisitors are the very definition of Good.

name: Insatiable Death Drive (0 AC)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of this blade is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Insatiable Death Drive (AC)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of this blade is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Insidious Frost Sword
description: A volcanic winter was caused by this sword being thrusted into the core of a slumbering mountain. The culprit knew they would burn, but did so willingly.

name: Interfector Blade
description: Channel the power of the beyond to take down any who oppose you!

name: Inverted Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Inverted Sword of Light
description: Conversion glows burning bright, giving this its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Ionized TimeSplitter Blade
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Iron Blade of the Wolf Commander
description: The iron blade wielded by the commander of the Greywolf Brigade has been handed down through the generations. Rumor has it the blade will glow when betrayal threatens the commander.

name: Iron Draconian Sword
description: Draconian sword of Iron.

name: Iron Dreadsaw
description: Between the razor sharp blade and the pointed spikes this is not a weapon you wish to find yourself on the receiving end of.

name: Iron Dussack
description: It's called a dussack, but resembles a butcher's cleaver more than a saber. Hopefully, none of the monsters you're slaying in Darkovia end up being sold as 'beef.'

name: Iron Flight Cutlass
description: Swimming silent and undetected is part of a seafaring ninja's skillset. There are odd rumors that they've even dyed their hair blue to blend in with the water, but that's silly.

name: Ironward Dirk
description: A dagger that never rusts, dulls, or breaks. Magic forges a deep link between it and the will of its master. So long as they never break, their dagger will shine stainless.

name: Irredeemable Fiend Blade (0 AC)
description: Once one crosses the threshold of the Fiend's Void, there's no going back. Every inch of your being, down to the steel of your blade, is claimed and mutated.

name: Irredeemable Fiend Blade (AC)
description: Once one crosses the threshold of the Fiend's Void, there's no going back. Every inch of your being, down to the steel of your blade, is claimed and mutated.

name: Iryerris
description: Sword of the fallen angels.

name: Ivory Blade Of Aegis
description: A noble and elegant blade, craftted in the Celestial Forges, that symbolizes the unending loyalty the Order of Celestial Knights have for each other. While it was supposedly going to be a decoration in the halls of Aegis, it serves much better in combat.

name: Ivory Defiler of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged this sword using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Ivory StarBlade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Ivoryblood Blade
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed-blood descendants.

name: Ivy Blade
description: This leaves your foes itchy and irritated.

name: Ixionidae Gravastar
description: A noble golden blade that was once fused with a star, used to hunt comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae Neutrostar
description: A noble golden blade that was once fused with a star, used to hunt comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae StarDeath
description: A noble golden blade that was once fused with a star, used to cull comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: J-Roku Katana
description: Sentou Kaishi! Unsheathe your blade and prove yourself as the J-Roku Samurai!

name: J-Sixth Blade (AC)
description: "It is not necessary to lie to achieve anything of value. A skilled Sixth-Lord is nearly impossible to defeat." (This item color-customizable trim.)

name: J-Sixth Blade (Special)
description: "It is not necessary to lie to achieve anything of value. A skilled Sixth-Lord is nearly impossible to defeat." (This item color-customizable trim.)

name: J6's Machete
description: Great for trekking through the jungle or shaving down pesky ingrown toenails.

name: J6's Rose of Thorns Blade
description: A gift bestowed to the newly married couple, this blade represents the turbulent times that relationships can face. If you take on hardship with your partner, a beautiful rose and a blissful life awaits you both.

name: J6's Star Sword
description: J6 the Bounty Hunter travels the galaxy on a mysterious mission. He is capable, versatile and very, very fast. This Star Sword is a testament to his efficiency, accuracy, and dedication to fulfilling his goal.

name: J6's Sword
description: Swish… Thud.

name: J6 Sailor's Delight (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space. (Weapon art changes each time you equip item.)

name: J6 Sailor's Delight (AC)
description: ﻿﻿Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space. (Weapon art changes each time you equip item.)

name: Jaan's Dark Ward Blade
description: *No description*

name: Jaan's Ward Blade (AC)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Jaan's Ward Blade (Legend)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Jack O Blade
description: You can carve A LOT more than just pumpkins with the Jack O Blade!

name: Jack's Haunted Dagger
description: MUAHAHAHA! A deep, dark laugh rings out as you equip these. That's… that's fine, right? Nothing wrong with a good, hearty chuckle from an invisible companion. Right.

name: Jade Bushido Katana
description: Slice like a ninja, cut like a… really sharp sword!

name: Jade Dragonguard Katana
description: A thin layer of steel hides a core made of pure Jade, blessed by the Empress to help ward off evil. In Wuji, Jade symbolizes eternity and immortality. To the Isles, it represents hope and unity.

name: Jade Dragonguard Sword
description: A thin layer of steel hides a core made of pure Jade, blessed by the Empress to help ward off evil. In Wuji, Jade symbolizes eternity and immortality. To the Isles, it represents hope and unity.

name: Jade Rabbit Buccaneer Blade
description: The Jade Rabbit Pirates moved so quickly that their blades might as well have been invisible. Their techniques were eventually adopted by the Wuji Empire's navy.

name: Jade Rabbit Buccaneer Rapier
description: A charming rapier that plundered ships and freed prisoners. The original belonged to the Jade Rabbits' Captain, and it rests beside its master in her tomb.

name: Jade Samurai Gitou
description: Bestowed upon great Samurai warriors, who prove themselves worthy of defending Lore's honor, the prestigious sword is a gift given by the Shogun.

name: Jagged Kill
description: Jagged, sharp and all natural, this blade will rip apart the enemy painfully and effectively, rendering them completely unable to fight back.

name: Jagged Wolf Blade
description: Uniquely curved down the entirety of the blade, this sword appeals to many classes, especially Lycans.

name: Jaw of a Savage
description: What was once used to bite and chew is now a monstrous way to punch a foe's lights out, keeping with the fossil's original function.

name: Jay Sun's Machete
description: Never journey to Camp Murkey Lake on Friday the 13th without your trusty Machete!

name: Jimpul Blade
description: Ancestors of the Dayak warriors once lived in the Celestial Realm, but now make the island of Nusantara their home. They protect their people and the land they've come to love

name: Jingling Sword Giftbox 12
description: A present shaped like a sword! Save this and it will magically open at the start of the new year. No peeking!

name: Jolly Frostval Caster's Sword
description: Most mages in Frostval are typically known to use staffs and wands in combat. However, Garaja trains his mages to using magical swords infused with his magic which also grants them the ability to change its colours.

name: Jolly Prismatic Frostval Blade (0 AC)
description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Grab your sharpest blade and put on your your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Jolly Prismatic Frostval Blade (AC)
description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Grab your sharpest blade and put on your your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Jorin Fear of Death
description: The one called Jorin Fear of Death was made by player "Jorin900000".

name: Joyful Resolve
description: Make a joyful battle-noise because of your sword!

name: Joyous Traveler Keeper's Sword (AC)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / Deck your home with its greenery / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Joyous Traveler Keeper's Sword (Non-AC)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / Deck your home with its greenery / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Joyous Traveler LongSword (0 AC)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / Deck your home with its greenery / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Joyous Traveler LongSword (AC)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / Deck your home with its greenery / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Jungle Assassin Katana
description: Curved and slick as a solid rock, it can do much more than slice and dice fruit to make smoothies.

name: Jungle Avenger
description: This wicked weapon is built for taking down anyone who would enter the jungles of Bloodtusk Ravine uninvited.

name: Justice Blade
description: Golden and gleaming, administering justice to the helpless and needy will seem effortless when you wield this shining blade!

name: K'Sork Blade
description: Given to the defenders of K'Thurr, this blade is made of the finest Horc steal and infused with the shards of Arashtite, the Living Ore.

name: Kabasaran Sword
description: Wentira had its own humble beginnings, and has no wish to hide or disregard them. These aged and battle weathered weapons have protected their home for time immemorial.

name: Kage (Sword)
description: A legendary blade used by the ninjas of Yokai. "Kage" means "shadow" in Japanese. A design completely created by player Skyline.

name: Kagutsuchi Inori Katana
description: The flames can only be lit with blood. A swordsmith modeled this masterpiece after a child of flame. Their birth and immediate death created eight volcanos.

name: Kaharaka's Lightning Fang
description: WARNING: this dagger's lightning energy is capable of shocking your foes… AND your friends… AND YOU!

name: Kaiju Pirate Rapier
description: In honor of the beasts that fought OMGzilla eons ago, these captains were these Kaiju uniforms to intimidate the poor saps they plunder from.

name: Kaiju's Crusher Blade
description: Probably should not ask where the teeth for this weapon came from… (This item has a low chance to play an animation when you use a skill AND do more damage against human enemies.)

name: Kaiju's Scimitar
description: This scimitar belonged to a scurvy dog that served the Kaiju. They be rotten to the core… but at least ye'll get a good weapon out o' them.

name: Kaiju's X-Static Blade
description: Probably should not ask where the teeth for this weapon came from…

name: Kaiju Slayer Sword
description: Ready to use against any strange creatures that might want to attack Lore.

name: Kalayo's Oath
description: Forged from molten metals from the depths of a volcano. Kalayo breathed fire on the blade, embuing it with an everlasting heat. When you wield the blade, you and Kalayo become as one.

name: Kaleidoscope Blade
description: The 70s were a terrible decade for Paladins.

name: Kalestri Cutlass
description: An ancient mystic blade awarded to those who offer their full servitude to Kalestri.

name: Kali's Blade
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng manlalaro sa Pilipinas. // Happy Independence Day to all our players in the Philippines. Laban! Battle on!

name: Kaminari Kunai
description: Striking a pair of these kunai together will call down a lightning bolt. It will electrocute nearby enemies, and whisk you away into the howling winds.

name: Kampilan Sword
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng manlalaro sa Pilipinas.

name: Kappa Sword
description: You have stolen this from the Kappa you defeated. It's much more useful in your hands!

name: Kasuari Sword
description: Traditionally made of straw, Ewer clothing and accessories are worn by the men and women of Western Nunsantara for ceremonies.

name: Katana
description: A curved single-edged sword traditionally used by Japanese samurai.

name: Katana of Cold
description: This gives a new meaning to the phrase, "cold steel".

name: Katana of Emeralds
description: With a blade made of emeralds, this katana slices through almost everything. But not diamond, because that's stronger.

name: Katana of Excellence
description: This is a sword. Razgriz made it. Sort of.

name: Katana of Flames
description: Fire - what some perceive to be one of the deadliest of elements is also one of the most necessary. Without fire, there is no warmth in the cold, no light in the darkness. The Infernal Flame Guardian keep watch over an Eternal Flame - to ensure that Lore is never plunged into darkness.

name: Katana of Meiyo
description: The Shinobi strives to deliver honor upon himself, his kin, and his lands. Once the Shinobi accumulates enough honor, he is awarded with a great blessing: the Katana of Meiyo.

name: Katana of Renunciation
description: This blade, wielded by Malakai the Contract Enforcer of Nulgath, severs the ties between lackluster fiends and the Nation. It destroys their contracts, and their souls.

name: Katana of Revontheus
description: Don't be fooled by its thin blade as many of Dage's fallen follower have.

name: Katana of Sapphires
description: With a blade made of sapphires, this katana slices through almost everything. But not diamond, because that's stronger.

name: Katana of Shadows
description: Fade into the night, these stealthy warriors lurk in the shadows.

name: Katana of Vokun
description: The weapon of choice for a master Assassin.

name: Keening
description: Named for the way it whistles through the air, and the sound of the target afterwards.

name: Keeper Of Darkness
description: Commissioned by Gravelyn herself, your fellow warrior Snowcownes designed this blade to represent all that the Shadowscythe stand for.

name: Keepin' Toasty
description: Perfect for interior lighting, cooking delicious meats and keeping your Cave, Sweet Cave nice and toasty. Those cavemen sure know how to live!

name: Ker Berethrou
description: A blade inspired by Cerberus and his many pups. Some believe his name means "flesh-devouring" while others theorize it meaning "evil of the pit."

name: Key Of Revontheus (AC)
description: The blade of this sword holds the key to the destruction of Dage's Legion! As a color customizable weapon, you'll be able to find it immediately and not stumble at the doorsteps of your foes.

name: Key Of Revontheus (Non-AC)
description: The blade of this sword holds the key to the destruction of Dage's Legion! As a color customizable weapon, you'll be able to find it immediately and not stumble at the doorsteps of your foes.

name: Key to Eden City
description: Eden City is home to many wonderous things, thanks to the exemplary planning and organization of the Crystallis Administration. As a tour guide, you'll chaperone visitors around and extoll their virtues.

name: Key to Your Heart Blade
description: With this sword you can smite your enemies with the key to your heart!

name: Kezeroth Knight Polearm
description: Hold this bad boy by the hands when you wield it because the touch of its blade can deal a lot more damage than a measly snowflake.

name: Kezeroth Knight Sword
description: Hold this bad boy by the hands when you wield it because the touch of its blade can deal a lot more damage than a measly snowflake.

name: Kezeroth's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Kezeroth the World Ender, Destroyer of Time, a fan-favorite boss originally released in AdventureQuest Worlds. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Khasaanda's Star Sword
description: The ninth Chaos Lord to rise was Khasaanda. You can feel what is left of her power pulsing through this Star Sword… as she knew you one day would.

name: Kimberly's Star Sword
description: The sixth Chaos Lord to rise was Kimberly, crashing in on a wave of discord. You can feel what is left of her AWESOME!!! power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Kimon Benevolence Nagamaki
description: A blade made by the Great Yokai Spirit that is strongest when it's used to defend the innocent. Unfortunately, that magic only activates in the hands of an Oni, who are known to eat the innocent.

name: Kindred SpiritHunter (AC)
description: The creation of this blade was an unspeakable crime that was committed unto the world by no other than Dage himself. To wield this katana is to wield wrongness itself.

name: Kindred Spirithunter (Legend)
description: The creation of this blade was an unspeakable crime that was committed unto the world by no other than Dage himself. To wield this katana is to wield wrongness itself.

name: King Alteon's Echo Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by King Alteon. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: King Alteon's Golden Sword
description: Corvak was King Alteon's Draconic partner, meant to protect the realm and his family until the end of their shared days. This dream did not come to be, but his memory lives on, defending the realm and King Alteon's daughters.

name: King's Blade
description: This blade belongs to royalty… which is why you should own it!

name: King's Hallowed Blade (0 AC)
description: A blade created from pale moonlight shining on darkness. It was awarded to the first of the Unhallowed Wights before being passed to the next generation, and the next, searching for one who would eclipse the moon.

name: King's Hallowed Blade (AC)
description: A blade created from pale moonlight shining on darkness. It was awarded to the first of the Unhallowed Wights before being passed to the next generation, and the next, searching for one who would eclipse the moon.

name: KingSlayer's Blade (0 AC)
description: The KingSlayer is an eldritch warrior that feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts.

name: KingSlayer's Blade (AC)
description: The KingSlayer is an eldritch warrior that feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts.

name: KingSlayer's Straight Sword
description: The KingSlayer is an eldritch warrior that feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts. (This item goes rare March 31, 2021)

name: Kinnaree Kris
description: A small weapon with a jagged blade.

name: Kinsman's Single Blade
description: This sword desires a partner, and a third to become complete.

name: Kismet's Edge
description: Weapons might glow red-hot from normal fire, but it's the magical fires that make metal glow green-hot, and that makes them even deadlier! Happy Lucky Day!

name: Kitsune Commander's Katana (0 AC)
description: The fox spirit guides these pirates to riches beyond the shores of Yokai Island.

name: Kitsune Commander's Katana (AC)
description: The fox spirit guides these pirates to riches beyond the shores of Yokai Island.

name: Kitsune Kitsune Katana
description: This weapon is sugoi!

name: Kitsune Kitsune Katana +3
description: This weapon is sugoi! (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Kitsune Kukolnyy Katana
description: A weapon that rots, trapped in a dying moment. It used to be Chaos Lord Kitsune's blade, but now it suffers the humiliation of becoming a Dragon's toy.

name: Kitsune's Star Sword
description: The fourth Chaos Lord to rise was Kitsune. You can feel what is left of his power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Knight's Sword
description: A basic sword for the discerning Knight of the realm.

name: Knight's Sword of Brilliant Honor
description: From generation to generation, born under the auspices of the same righteous star, this sword changes hands. The spirit within grants its wielder's wishes.

name: Knight Slasher
description: No matter how many "stoneskin enchantments" your opponent has cast on his armor, this weapon will be able to pierce it (and his innards)!

name: Knight Zweihander
description: Sharp, heavy, and meant for two hands. Handlers of this humble sword are critically underestimated.

name: Knighthood Conferment
description: Compared to the tyranny of the past, the noble ideals of Swordhaven and its rulers are still in their infancy. May the fight for justice be carried forth by the generations of tomorrow.

name: Knives of a Savage
description: When resources are scarce, it is not uncommon to use fallen teeth and leftover bones as a means of attack especially when they belonged to a monster once before.

name: Kogane no Ha
description: Wielded by the soldiers of Yokai Isle.

name: Kogane no Katana
description: Wielded by the soldiers of Yokai Isle.

name: Kotaro's Sealed Katana
description: A katana appears through the merging of all of the crystallis weapons. It's cold to the touch…this weapon gives off an omnipotent aura. Could this be the very same katana which Kotaro uses to uphold balance? Unfortunately, it seems like its power is sealed within the lock on the sheath…it's impossible to open.

name: Krenos Spirit Katana
description: Krenos is set to be the strongest of its kind. Even now, lightning sparks in anticipation of their birth. Like the warriors who wield this blade, their strength will venerate and alienate them. A great, yet lamentable fate awaits.

name: Kringleblade
description: Ho Ho Ho! Torment those who suffer Clawstrophobia with this blade!

name: Kuro's Wrath
description: After a well fought battle you find this fine weapon of the deep.

name: Kurogatana
description: The black blade will soon be strained red.

name: Kurts Sword
description: Get your BAMF on!

name: Kushinada Nodachi
description: Named after a princess said to have married Orochi, but her existence is impossible to verify. The poison coating the blade smells sweet as peaches, like a captivating lie.

name: La's Bat
description: The blacksmiths of the army had no idea how to tackle La's request. La ended up hammering the studs to the bat herself, while the Crown Prince held the whittled chunk of wood for her. Luckily, no smashed fingers. Just tons of splinters.

name: Lachrymal Sword
description: Crafted from a shard of glacial water, this blade is as beautiful as a tropical sea but is as deadly and swift as an open-water undertow.

name: Lán sè Shu Katana
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these Ninja are celebrating!

name: Lapis Infernalis Dagger
description: A sky blue dagger that's pretty and sharp, but doesn't live up to its name. Lapis Infernalis is silver. The jeweller or blacksmith who made this blade were thinking they could make more gold if their wares had an alchemical vibe.

name: Laser Dragon Saw
description: Carved from a massive scale, the damage this sword deals is outweighed only by its cool look.

name: Laser Hanzamune Blade
description: A legendary blade crafted by the greatest Yokai swordsman, Hanzamune, in which the sword is named after. It is a great honor to wield this century-old sword.

name: Laser Hanzo Void Katana (AC)
description: You are a Horror, slashing through the Matrix, killing all in your sight. Discovered by the intrepid Fairy, your fellow AQW hero!

name: Laser Hanzo Void Katana (Legend)
description: You are a Horror, slashing through the Matrix, killing all in your sight. Discovered by the intrepid Fairy, your fellow AQW hero!

name: Laser Ragna-NOT
description: You won't get your reward until the war meter hits 50%. BATTLE ON!

name: Laser Ragnarok
description: Channel the blinding fury of the future into DEATH for your enemies!

name: Lava Formed Broadsword
description: Forged from volcanic igneous rocks, this molten broadsword exudes enough heat that can liquify even the hottest fire elementals.

name: Lava Starsword
description: Forged by Tana in the very heart of the Lore's Sun. This starsword is special. It's hilt contains a fragment of Fiamme's Fire Avatar Essence.

name: Lavacore Crusher
description: The internal heat creates most a painful blade with which to cut down and decimate your enemy. Turn up the heat, and the pain, the next brawl you engaged in.

name: Lavadragon Mace
description: Born in the molten caverns beneath the earth, the lavadragon has made its home in fire. But you can harness its fury when you wield this weapon!

name: Lavamorph Stinger
description: This lava rock sword holds lava within it which can be released as another means of attack or block your foe off while fleeing.

name: Lavarock Destroyer's Blade (0 AC)
description: Molten rock twisted and hardened into a jagged blade fit for their breath starved masters. Fire still pulses, and just being near it suffocates the living.

name: Lavarock Destroyer's Blade (AC)
description: Molten rock twisted and hardened into a jagged blade fit for their breath starved masters. Fire still pulses, and just being near it suffocates the living.

name: LaZer Blade of Time (0 AC)
description: A fancier way to cut through the ages.

name: LaZer Blade of Time (AC)
description: A fancier way to cut through the ages.

name: Ledgermayne's Star Sword
description: The seventh Chaos Lord to rise was Ledgermayne. You can feel what is left of his mana — what hasnt drained back into his realm — pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: LEDragonblade +5
description: This sword is so bright, I gotta wear shades.

name: LEDragonFire Blade +5
description: This sword is so bright, I gotta wear shades. Gives 5% more class points when equipped.

name: Left Sock Sheathed Cutlass (AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿ Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Left Sock Sheathed Cutlass (Non-AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿ Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Legacy Nation Blade (0 AC)
description: These blades wear the face of Archfiend Nulgath. His likeness in exact precision is only trusted to legacy members of the Nation. And his gifts do NOT come cheaply.

name: Legacy Nation Blade (AC)
description: These blades wear the face of Archfiend Nulgath. His likeness in exact precision is only trusted to legacy members of the Nation. And his gifts do NOT come cheaply.

name: Legacy Nation Blade (Legend)
description: This blade wears the face of Archfiend Nulgath. His likeness in exact precision is only trusted to legacy members of the Nation. And his gifts do NOT come cheaply.

name: Legend Sword
description: You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

name: Legendary Broodfiend Blade
description: Infect the world with Nulgath's darkness and bring strength and victory to the Nation!

name: Legendary Golden Death Blade
description: Brother to the Undead Champion Blade, this legendary gilded sword was crafted by the Dark Lord's half brother, Skyline. It is an honor to wield this blade.

name: Legendary Knight's Sword
description: These brave soldiers swear to defend King Alteon, Queen Lynaria and all of Swordhaven from any danger.

name: Legendary Magma Sword
description: An ancient blade forged in the pits of a volcano, that has been destroyed or forgotten. Until now because Quibble Coinbiter has for sale!

name: Legendary Member Blade
description: This item, featuring the Membership symbol, will show the world that you have supported AdventureQuest Worlds. Thank you for being legendary!

name: Legendary Sword of Dragon Control
description: Vath's gift is now yours! Use at your own risk.

name: Legion Beast Carver (0 AC)
description: A savage weapon made for beasts to slay and carve their kin. There are rumors among the Legion that it works best in the hands of those who have turned their backs on the Archfiend and his minions.

name: Legion Beast Carver (AC)
description: A savage weapon made for beasts to slay and carve their kin. There are rumors among the Legion that it works best in the hands of those who have turned their backs on the Archfiend and his minions.

name: Legion Beast's Claw Dirk
description: From deep within the shadows of the Underworld, the Beasts of the Legion stalk their prey, slaying swiftly and silently. To slay the beast, you must BECOME the beast.

name: Legion Conqueror Sword
description: Before the Legion Conqueror met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror across the land. Now, they do the same for Dage the Evil. (Item is color customizable.)

name: Legion Cutlass
description: Slay your foes, me hearty!

name: Legion DeathSpine
description: Before the Legion Conqueror met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror across the land. Now, they do the same for Dage the Evil. (Item is color customizable.)

name: Legion Devourer of Souls Blade
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Legion Devourer Void Blade (0 AC)
description: FEED UPON THE SOULS OF THE FALLEN.

name: Legion Devourer Void Blade (AC)
description: FEED UPON THE SOULS OF THE FALLEN.

name: Legion DoomBlade (AC)
description: Even Sepulchure would be envious of this DoomBlade. (Has a chance to do the Shadowburst animation when equipped)

name: Legion DoomBlade (Merge)
description: Even Sepulchure would be envious of this DoomBlade. (Has a chance to do the Shadowburst animation when equipped)

name: Legion Doombringer
description: The weapon of choice for wrecking the halls.

name: Legion Dragon Blade
description: Take on Dragons (especially UNDEAD Dragons) with your Legion Dragon Blade!

name: Legion Dragon Blade +5
description: Do more damage against Dragons (especially UNDEAD Dragons) with your Legion Dragon Blade… and get even MORE rep while doing it!

name: Legion DragonBlade of Nulgath
description: When a DragonBlade of Nulgath is reforged in Dage the Evil's Soul Forge, the result is a weapon of unparalleled power and intimidation. (Equip this item to do 75% more damage to dragons.)

name: Legion Drow Blade
description: Inspired by Quinteni's designs, the Drow Blade is one of the most feared blades in all of Dage's Legion. Rumor has it that this sword is even powerful enough to bring down Dage.

name: Legion Evocatus's Spada (AC)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Dage after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Evocatus's Spada (Non-AC)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Dage after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Executioner
description: A weapon forged from the depths of the Underworld. Use it to bring forth judgment on those unfit to live.

name: Legion Fiend's Bane (0 AC)
description: Having the blades crafted from the finest metal ores in the Styx River and also from the bone dusts of the dead fiends, this sword carries a threatening reminder to all Nation Fiends who are preparing to battle a Legion FiendHunter.

name: Legion Fiend's Bane (AC)
description: Having the blades crafted from the finest metal ores in the Styx River and also from the bone dusts of the dead fiends, this sword carries a threatening reminder to all Nation Fiends who are preparing to battle a Legion FiendHunter.

name: Legion Flesh Ripper
description: Drawn for you LIVE by Dage The Evil!

name: Legion Fleshrender
description: Slice at your enemies with the jagged edges of this evil sword.

name: Legion Horrid Cleaver
description: Infused with and powered by the dark soul magic used to create all weapons in Dage The Evil's SoulForge!

name: Legion Malignant Blade
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Legion Marauder's Sword
description: The first in line to bash through and ask questions later.

name: Legion MonsterHunter's Sword
description: Not even death can stop the most legendary heroes from hunting down their enemies once they join the Undead Legion.

name: Legion OathKeeper Blade
description: Those who join the Undead Legion vow eternal loyalty. For all who break that vow… YOUR blade awaits!

name: Legion Overfiend Blade
description: A blade for the fiends of the Legion.

name: Legion Paragon Cutlass
description: Instead of being shaped like average cutlasses, Legion blacksmiths forged this one to resemble a large knife because smaller cutlasses just won't do when the Undead Legion go on a conquest to rule the seas and potential new recruits in its depths.

name: Legion Pirate's Cutlass
description: Maybe one day you will be a Pirate Captain…

name: Legion Pride Cleaver E
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Legion Pride Cleaver P
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Legion Scout's Sword
description: The first in line to bash through and ask questions later.

name: Legion Soul Devourer
description: A sharp yet enchanted blade, capable of absorbing the soul of your defeated enemies. It works as a core, sending the soul essence directly to yours.

name: Legion Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword is one of five designed and built for the AQW's 5th Upholders on the game's fifth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Legion Symbiote's Rage
description: The parasite infecting this armor was created especially for Dage's Legion. Now truly be one with the Dark Lord.

name: Legion Undersworn Blade
description: The underworld is a vast realm and eternity a long, long time to serve. But for those who swear allegiance to Dage the Evil, great rewards await!

name: Legion War Wraith Sword (0 AC)
description: The War Wraiths' blades pulse cold from gathering souls that still yearn for the rush of battle. They cling to this blade, desiring further glory.

name: Legion War Wraith Sword (AC)
description: The War Wraiths' blades pulse cold from gathering souls that still yearn for the rush of battle. They cling to this blade, desiring further glory.

name: Legion Warlord's Dragonblade (0 AC)
description: The elongated skull of a fallen dragon adorns this broadsword, forever sworn into the service of Dage the Evil and his loyal Warlords. Runes and possessive magic keeps its fiery breath in check.

name: Legion Warlord's Dragonblade (AC)
description: The elongated skull of a fallen dragon adorns this broadsword, forever sworn into the service of Dage the Evil and his loyal Warlords. Runes and possessive magic keeps its fiery breath in check.

name: Legion Wolf Sword (0 AC)
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Legion Wolf Sword (AC)
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Legion Wolf Sword (Merge)
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Legit Chaos Blade
description: Yup. There's no denying that this sword is the true epitome of Chaos.

name: Leo's Blade
description: In the name of our general and the great land of Lore, we shall fight against all the Evils that plague the world and all of those who don't see it fit to fight those Evils. Glory to Maximillian Lionfang!

name: Leonine Regalia Greatsword
description: Ruled by the Sun, heroes who were born and battle under the Leo's star sign are recognized everywhere as passionate and creative. But much like the lion that represents them, they can be fiercely prideful when attacked.

name: LeoSpire Royalty Kris
description: The lion symbolises three of LeoSpire's greatest national values: courage, excellence and strength. May you always embody these as you battle through Lore!

name: Lesser Caladbolg
description: The original legendary Caladbolg exuded so much energy that one day it spawned this less enchanted version. Just as powerful but with none of the magic flowing out of it.

name: Lesser Hollowborn Caladbolg
description: The original legendary Hollowborn Caladbolg exuded so much energy that one day it spawned this less enchanted version. Just as powerful but with none of the magic flowing out of it.

name: Lethe Sword of Vokun
description: Covered in rusty chains that slash and ensnare their foes, these deadly minions of Vokun send anyone who crosses them to oblivion.

name: Letum Codex Blade
description: This blade is a creature, or many creatures, that recite forbidden passages from the burned tomes. Only a resilient soul can withstand its curses, let they be crushed, twisted, and dragged into the writhing mass themselves.

name: Leviasea Sword
description: The energy coursing through the futuristic blade crystallizes into particles that dance around the hilt. Crafted by Veneeria.

name: Leviasean Rapier
description: Some humans find The Gift heavy and unwieldy. The mysterious Leviasea can provide, combining its immense power with the grace of a more dexterous weapon.

name: Leviathan Slayer's Slasher
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Liberty Blade
description: For Liberty and Justice for all! The Red, White and Blue!

name: Liberty Blade Blue
description: …With Liberty and Justice for all!

name: Liberty Blade Red
description: …With Liberty and Justice for all!

name: Liberty Blade White
description: …With Liberty and Justice for all!

name: Lichen-Crusted Blade
description: While flowers can be strong, those with thorns are strongest!

name: Lichen-Crusted Crypt Blade
description: While flowers can be strong, those with thorns are strongest!

name: LifeGiver
description: Perfect for interior lighting, cooking delicious meats and keeping your Cave, Sweet Cave nice and toasty.

name: Light Blade of the Rebellion
description: Good you are, Evil you may be. Not *all* good, you are! Dark exists not without Light.

name: Light Prismatic Katana
description: An ivory blade that proves its wielder to be an honorable Hero on the Island of Yokai. Color custom base, trim, and glow!

name: Light Shattering Blade
description: A blade of magically suspended crystal shards which split the light into a riot of colors as easily as they would split the skulls of your foes.

name: Light Tower Sword
description: This blade emanates a pure power, pushing away the darkness and harnessing the energy of all the life force around it.

name: LightBlade of Necryptos
description: This Weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And we aren't talking about Sneevils or Zards here…

name: Lightborn Blade of Awe
description: A Light version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will light your way in the darkest of environs. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: LightGlaive Orden
description: This weapon has been enchanted by a master weaponsmith. Click its handle to activate a transformation that will distract your enemy in battle!

name: Lightguardian Spirit Blade
description: The Lightguardian Spirit has granted you his blade, formed of ectoplasm and solidified by his strength of will this blade will never fail you.

name: Lighting Bolt Cutlass
description: Omigoshomigoshomigoshomigoshomigosh! It's WONDER(ful) Bolt!

name: Lightninagi
description: The ShadowKage have the power to coalesce lightning from the air around them.

name: Lightning Helix
description: A conductive weapon carved from horns shed by an Energy Dragon after a calamitous battle. It's charged to the very limit, despite how the feud with the Manticores ended long ago.

name: Lightning Knuckle Sword (AC)
description: What better way to tear into Tinsel's gifts?

name: Lightning Knuckle Sword (Legend)
description: What better way to tear into Tinsel's gifts?

name: Lightning Pirate's Cutlass
description: When ye sail the seas, ye get the storms. Lightnin' crashes and suddenly yer electric!

name: Lightning Pirate's Rapier
description: When ye sail the seas, ye get the storms. Lightnin' crashes and suddenly yer electric!

name: Lightning Sea Splitter (0 AC)
description: A relic found in a metal ship that had turned into rust at the bottom of the sea. A stab could electrocute everyone in the water. A slash could split the oceans open.

name: Lightning Sea Splitter (AC)
description: A relic found in a metal ship that had turned into rust at the bottom of the sea. A stab could electrocute everyone in the water. A slash could split the oceans open.

name: Lightning Slasher
description: Call down the lightning and summon thunder to terrify your foes!

name: Lightning Strikes (Sword)
description: The harnessing of the sheer heat and magnitude of lightning was unthought of until now. The blade defies all logic, yet, here it is, in your hands, ready to fight. Know that such power will only obey for so long. Be careful, hero.

name: Lightning Tender Blade
description: Black steel, electrified by lightning that splits the earth and sky. You feel the storm gathering above your head. Energy floods your veins and enters your heart, willing you to become Volgritian's kin.

name: Lightstrike Energy Blade
description: The gleaming blade is made up of pure energy, capable of giving your targets a world-class sunburn on strike.

name: Lilith Katana
description: A mystic katana from the para-elemental plane teeming with incalculable amounts of raw magic.

name: Lime Ice Pop
description: Mmmm! Chill out with a lime ice pop. Who knows? Maybe the monsters you're defending against will want one, too.

name: Lineage of Devastation
description: The skulls that decorate this blade belonged to its previous masters. They were warriors whose acts of devastation overshadowed their own names. In claiming this weapon, you join a long lineage of evil legends.

name: Lion's Fang Blade
description: Not his real fang sadly.

name: Lion's Fang Blade +3
description: Not his real fang sadly. (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Lion Slayer
description: Beware because this sword will leave me than a scar.

name: Lionfang's Silver Blade
description: Used by the younger brother of Maximillian Lionfang, Xavier waits until the day that they will rise and rule in the name of all that is Good.

name: Lionfang's Star Sword
description: The eleventh Chaos Lord to rise was Lionfang. You can feel what is left of his righteous wrath and power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Lionfang's Will
description: Given to his younger brother as a show of support, Maximillian Lionfang normally keeps this blade safe. Handed down from father to son for generations, it is the embodiment of the will of the Lionfang Clan.

name: Litch Knight's Sword
description: Just because you're a knight doesn't mean you can't take pride in your appearance!

name: Live Dragon Ranger
description: This sword was drawn and colored by J6 LIVE in AQ Worlds on July, 29th 2010 with the help of player suggestions. Did you join and help him create this masterful blade?

name: Living Shadow Katana (Sword)
description: Summon the shadows to aide you. HAS SHADOW ANIMATION

name: Living Sin
description: The sword is pulsing with dark energy. Try to control it, before it controls you.

name: Living Star Blade
description: Formed from starlight this weapon will make any hero shine brighter.

name: Longclaw
description: Said to belong to a warrior who always had an albino dire wolf by his side.

name: Longsword of Nightmares
description: A twisted, writhing mass of a blade that pulses with the fear of your enemies. Make them fear you, so that you may cut them down. Just don't ever show fear yourself…

name: Longsword of the Dark
description: In a sea of darkness, real or imaginary, makes one realize how small they are. This sword that was born from a wish to escape weakness, to fuse into a greater, powerful wave of shadow.

name: Looking Glass Cutlass (AC)
description: A cutlass Scarletta made from enchanted glass, able to perfectly catch her reflection as well as her victims. It's very fragile, and the person inside knows that all too well. Their screams are great at distracting the enemy.

name: Looking Glass Cutlass (Non-AC)
description: A cutlass Scarletta made from enchanted glass, able to perfectly catch her reflection as well as her victims. It's very fragile, and the person inside knows that all too well. Their screams are great at distracting the enemy.

name: Lord Brentan's Glory
description: This sword has been handed down from one noble member of the Brentan family to their heir of years. It carries the honor of generations.

name: Lord of Order Blade (0 AC)
description: The best line of defense against the corrupt force of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm.

name: Lord Of Order Blade (AC)
description: The best line of defense against the corrupt force of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm.

name: Lord of Order Blade (Quest)
description: The best line of defense against the corrupt force of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm.

name: Lord Soul Blade (0 AC)
description: A blade pulsing with a power that the greatest Mages of Lore could only ever hope to attain. Having seen the center of the universe, Dage the Evil crafted this weapon from its essence, tempering it with his own soul.

name: Lord Soul Blade (AC)
description: A blade pulsing with a power that the greatest Mages of Lore could only ever hope to attain. Having seen the center of the universe, Dage the Evil crafted this weapon from its essence, tempering it with his own soul.

name: Lore's Champion Blade
description: The greatest heroes of Lore are gifted this blade in a ceremony as ancient as the Eternal Dragon of Time. Wield it well, hero!

name: Lorosian Hunter Saber
description: Capable of hunting the most devious of bounties, the Lorosian Hunters were feared all through the Galaxy.

name: Lost Bayonet
description: A bayonet once fastened to the muzzle of a respected commander's rifle. It snapped off the moment a deep sea curse claimed the lost seafarer. Will it pass that curse to you, too?

name: Lost Blade of Thagnul
description: This blade was thought to be lost in the fliery depths of a mountain's heart.

name: Lotic Blade
description: A stoic blade crafted by Merpeople ages ago. It draws its power from the magical waters of The Natatorium.

name: Love Hurts (Sword)
description: This broadsword will cause a world of hurt as it rips through the enemy, thrust after thrust. Let this blade do all your talking on the field of battle as your enemy cowers in fear.

name: Love's Gladiator Sword
description: Prepare yourself to pierce loneliness right through its wretched heart with this large but light blade.

name: LoveBringer's Blade
description: The LoveBringer appears in Lore every Heroes Heart Day to help spread the feelings of Love and Happiness throughout the world.

name: Lovely Amethyst Claymore (0 AC)
description: The incricate craftsmanship that has gone into this large blade hides the engineering behind its awesome power.

name: Lovely Amethyst Claymore (AC)
description: The incricate craftsmanship that has gone into this large blade hides the engineering behind its awesome power.

name: Lovely Heart Sabre
description: Strike your foes with LOVE!

name: Lovely Moonlighter
description: May silver moonlight and diamond stars lead you to love. The wielder of this arcane blade of illusion and mystery can let the loveless live their dreams, even if they'll never be real.

name: Lovely Scimitar (AC)
description: Why are all oasis mirages blue? Wouldn't you be happier to see a bubblegum pink pool?

name: Lovely Scimitar (Non-AC)
description: Why are all oasis mirages blue? Wouldn't you be happier to see a bubblegum pink pool?

name: Lovesick Infernal Murakumo
description: A thunderous katana that calls down lightning with each beat of your heart. (Click to transform)

name: Loyal Alloy Dagger
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master of their kin.

name: Loyal Alloy Dirk
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master or their kin.

name: Loyal Alloy Knife
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master or their kin.

name: Loyal Alloy Tourne
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master of their kin.

name: Loyal Hand of Domination
description: Cheer for your favorite patriotic team!

name: Loyal Hand of Domination 15
description: Cheer for your favorite patriotic team!

name: Loyalist Blade
description: Given to only the highest members in command.

name: Loyalty Blade of the Nation
description: Nulgath smirks. Then tells you this blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. Though you can wreak incredible devastation the sword can also betray you…

name: Lu Niu's Jian
description: Lu Niu's primary weapon given to him from the late Emperor Daisho for his service in Akiba during the Taruean Dynasty.

name: Lu Niu's Sheathed Jian
description: Lu Niu's primary weapon given to him from the late Emperor Daisho for his service in Akiba during the Taruean Dynasty.

name: Lucevan Le Stelle
description: This sparkling blade of festive wishes hides a darker story. A Knight tried to save his Lady from a wedding she didn't want. He was caught, and sentenced to death. The Noblewoman wished for a miracle, but the stars fell too late.

name: Lucky Caladbolg
description: Top o' the morning to ya Legion gombeens. Feeling lucky today?

name: Lucky Coin Katana
description: With a lucky coin magically forged into the blade, this katana always seems to strike true.

name: Lucky Dragon Blade
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And then re-created it from a solid emerald block it so it would be even heavier! Better to train with that way!

name: Lucky Star Sword
description: Do ya feel LUK-y, Hero?

name: Lucky Sword
description: It might be lucky for you, but it wasn't lucky for the guy who first found it! He picked it out of the grass - blade first! Happy Lucky Day !

name: LUDP Halter (0 AC)
description: When competition between rivals gets too crazy, EbilCorp encourages you to take matters into your own hands. Do it with the scariest looking weapon imaginable. Make it send a message.

name: LUDP Halter (AC)
description: When competition between rivals gets too crazy, EbilCorp encourages you to take matters into your own hands. Do it with the scariest looking weapon imaginable. Make it send a message.

name: Lumenomancer's Gift
description: A sword once held by a wielder of light, the runes inscribed on the blade still glow with ancient energy.

name: Luminous Beam Blade
description: Light brings life, and with it power. Luminomancers combine their lifeforce with that bright power to shine more brightly than any other elemental mage!

name: Luminous Mikazuki
description: A katana wielded by one of the founders of the Yokai Isles' royal family. Its golden edge radiates with purity, having been washed in the blood of a powerful dragon.

name: Luminous Soul Blade
description: A blade imbued with powerful spells, lit by the color of one's soul. The Light sees all, and will destroy all in your way. In exchange, it only asks for adoration.

name: Luminous Warrior's Rapier (0 AC)
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Luminous Warrior's Rapier (AC)
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Lunar Gleam
description: In the darkness, a single light will shine brightly on your path to victory on the battlefield!

name: Lunar Khopesh
description: Battle the undead with the power of moonlight! This weapon will do 25% more damage against undead when equipped.

name: Lunar Pirate Rapier
description: Silver and bright as the light on the crescent moon, a swift, cunning swing can strengthen or soften the ocean tides.

name: Lunar Sand Sword (AC)
description: When the desert gets cold, this sword's icy flame keeps you warm… and drives right through the hearts of your enemies!

name: Lunar Sand Sword (Legend)
description: When the desert gets cold, this sword's icy flame keeps you warm… and drives right through the hearts of your enemies!

name: Lunarbrand
description: ﻿﻿﻿The breath of a moon deity was torn from its lungs and used to enchant this blade. Somewhere in the Northlands, the moon has lost its face and dignity. You wield the cold night in your hands, released from the curse of needing to sleep.

name: Lunaris Curved Moonbeam Dagger
description: The Lunaris Clan's moon watches over them no matter where they go.

name: Lunaris Moonbeam Saber
description: The Lunaris Clan's moon watches over them no matter where they go.

name: Lunisolar Katana
description: This blade has been infused with the energy heavens. Tempered during the day under the scorching rays of the sun and cooled underneath the gentle glow of the moon, the edge of this katana is sharp enough to cut stars out of the sky.

name: Lurid Blade of the Void
description: The remains of a Void Elemental have somehow merged together with an extraordinary sinister blade found deep within the Void. The blade itself seems more alive than the Elemental…

name: Lusè Shu Katana
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these Ninja are celebrating!

name: Luxorlight Blade
description: Though the Pharaoh who gave the light of their soul to this blade has disappeared into history, their desire to protect their people lives on. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Lycan Blade Of Hemorrhaging
description: A blunt axe used by the Legion of Lycans in Dage's army. Only the heads of the Nation will satisfy this axe's thirst!

name: Lycan Darkness Sabre
description: Appealing to those who wish to strike absolute fear into their pray, this Lycan Sabre has been seen by few and survived by none.

name: Lycan Flesh Destroyer
description: A blunt axe used by the Legion of Lycans in Dage's army. Only the heads of the Nation will satisfy this axe's thirst!

name: Lycan Of Nulgath Sword (0 AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchAngel welcomes guardians of all species, races, and creeds… as long as they vow to fight for the good of the Mirror Realm!

name: Lycan Of Nulgath Sword (AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchAngel welcomes guardians of all species, races, and creeds… as long as they vow to fight for the good of the Mirror Realm!

name: Lycan Of Nulgath Sword (Legend)
description: Nulgath the Archangel welcomes guardians of all species, races, and creeds… as long as they vow to fight for the good of the Mirror Realm!

name: Lycan Runed Blade
description: Even without opposable thumbs, this blade can be wielded by most canine humanoids. Legend says the creator's name, Blake Don, is inscribed somewhere within the runes.

name: Lycan Spirit Katana
description: Not just an blade will take down Vampirates, the spirit blade is blessed with many ancient warnings.

name: Lycan Stalker's Blade (AC)
description: The hunt is on and your prey is near… but if you aren't careful, you just might become the hunted! That's why it's ALWAYS good to have an extra blade.

name: Lycan Stalker's Blade (Special)
description: The hunt is on and your prey is near… but if you aren't careful, you just might become the hunted! That's why it's ALWAYS good to have an extra blade.

name: Lycan Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: M4tr1x Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Tales tell that these pirates be unlucking flying under the colors of Cyber Monday but no one has found their booty yet. So who's really the unlucky one?

name: M4tr1x Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: Tales tell that these pirates be unlucking flying under the colors of Cyber Monday but no one has found their booty yet. So who's really the unlucky one?

name: M4trix SkyGuard Captain's Blade (0 AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: M4trix SkyGuard Captain's Blade (AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: Macabre Meat Slicer
description: Oh, no. Ew. OW. Whyyyyy? What fresh horror is this?!

name: Machete
description: Ma… che… te! Ma… che… te! Ma… che… te!

name: Macuahuitl
description: For those who like to slash and bash simultaneously!

name: Macuahuitl of the Dead
description: Common weapon used by tribes to fend off enemies.

name: Mad Pirate-Smith's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Mad Pirate-Smith's Cutlass (AC)
description: Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Magenta Defender Sword
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword holds power beyond compare.

name: Magenta Starblade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Magical Dryad's Blade
description: These nymphs of the forest help the plants flourish with their powers. Small seeds suddenly become towering trees in their presence.

name: Magma BlazeBeard Cutlass
description: Blazebeard, known as "the dread pirate of Drakonus," is the most notorious pirate to sail the Seven Seas. But with the Magmanacles, he is now strong enough to expand his control BEYOND the water.

name: Magma Katana
description: Be careful which end you touch.

name: Magmagilt Odachi
description: It's only right that you keep it as a reward.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Blade (0 AC)
description: A greatsword forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Blade (AC)
description: A greatsword forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Dirk (AC)
description: A daggers forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Dirk (Non-AC)
description: A dagger forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Sword (0 AC)
description: A sword forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Sword (AC)
description: A sword forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magus Greatsword
description: The mighty swords of the Magus a made with enchanted glass blades. The magus can sap magical energy from their foes with every devastating blow, empowering their blades further.

name: Magus Short Sword
description: "Short" is the operative term.

name: Mahorc-Uraga Branched Knife
description: Sacred blade swing and ring, ring. With this relic, I summon…

name: Makai Bloodletter
description: You did it! Keep this item with you at all times to show that you are indeed a Makai Bloodletter!

name: Makai Bloodtaker
description: You did it! Keep this item with you at all times to show that you are indeed a Makai Bloodletter!

name: Makai Eradicator
description: Much like their name sake, these Makai inspired swords attack viciously without holding back.

name: Makai Savager
description: Much like their name sake, these Makai inspired swords attack viciously without holding back.

name: Making a Point (Sword)
description: When you want to make a point, this is how you do it.

name: Malachite Brightsword
description: The cold air of Frostval has nothing on this sword. Watch it easily cut through the air as you take down each enemy; its glow brightening with each monster defeated. Your calm and collected demeanor is unmatched with this by your side.

name: Malachite Claymore
description: Malachite is called the "mirror of the soul" and is often used in scrying spells and potions. Draughts containing malachite should be sipped before journeying, or applied to weapons taken on trips, as the stone's magical properties protect travelers.

name: Malachite Cutter
description: It's not easy being green, but it IS pretty sweet wielding this blade! Happy Lucky Day!

name: Malady
description: A terrifying weapon, the wounds caused by this sword never seem to completely heal, causing the victim to prolonged suffering.

name: Maleno's Fang
description: This blade is carried only by Idalion's most brutal enforcers. Each strike leaves a trail of smoldering ash - a warning to those who would defy their master's claim.

name: Maleo Keris
description: The Keris blades are thought to have a real, tangible presence about them. Each one has its own individual self, with their own separate abilities. Like people, no two are exactly alike.

name: Maleo Kujang
description: Wielding this dagger makes you feel preternaturally quick, as though you're wielding the wind itself.

name: Maleo Mandau
description: This sword is the essence of the word "weapon." Just holding it feels strangely satisfying, like giving an old friend a firm handshake. This is a blade that is waiting to be used.

name: Malevolent Scarecrow Chainsaw
description: Cuts through bone as easy as a scythe can cut through wheat.

name: Malgor's Exalted Light Blade
description: The Lord of Exalted Light's personal blade and most treasured possession. Before Malgor's creator set him free, letting go of their last hopes, they gave him a blade engraved with their courage and conviction.

name: Malgor's ShadowFlame Blade
description: Malgor's personal blade, in your hands. You can feel his conviction, sorrow, anger, and desperation engraved into the features of the sword.

name: Malgor's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Malgor, leader of the ShadowFlame, who is integral to your future after the Queen of Monsters rises. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Malicious Blade of Nightmares
description: One sight of you with this weapon equipped and your enemies will NEVER sleep peacefully again. Mission accomplished.

name: Malicious Code Blade
description: It can hack its way through any simulation…which means it can cut through everything?

name: Malicious Dirk of Nightmares
description: One sight of you with this weapon equipped and your enemies will NEVER sleep peacefully again. Mission accomplished.

name: Malignant Blade of Doom
description: Within this blade, two of the mightiest forces known to Lore merge. Both covet, both seek to swallow everything, and transform all into something to call their own. It sleeps in the depths, waiting for a new hand to reach into its cage.

name: Malignant Sword of Doom
description: Within this blade, two of the mightiest forces known to Lore merge. Both covet, both seek to swallow everything, and transform all into something to call their own. It sleeps in the depths, waiting for a new hand to reach into its cage.

name: Mallow Longsword
description: Be careful when you swing this… and don't get it hot! So sticky.

name: Mallowpuff
description: Be careful when you swing this… and don't get it hot! So sticky.

name: Malthael
description: Malthael is the Celestial Knight in charge of the gate between the Celestial Realm and the Infernal Realm. In his weapon form it is told that he is able to break any spell thrown at him and send it flying back with double the force.

name: Mammoth Crusher Black
description: Striking someone with this massive black sword is like hitting someone with a black mountain!

name: Mammoth Crusher Blade
description: Striking someone with this massive blade is like hitting someone with a mountain!

name: Mammoth Ender
description: Any mammoths near?

name: Mana Crusher
description: This blade has an unending thirst for magic.

name: Mana Manipulator
description: An ethereal that drains its foes' life and transfers it back to its wielder. The circle is now complete!

name: Mana Sabre
description: The Fiend's claw is now your sword.

name: Mana Solace Paladin's Awe Sword
description: A weapon made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest a reflection this pure.

name: Mana Solace Paladin's Sword
description: A weapon made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest a reflection this pure.

name: Mana Sword
description: This sword is nothing but pure mana, woven together tightly so that it is a tangible object of offense. Don't let the odd shape fool you. What you see is a direct manifestation of your mind. Not our fault if you see something strange.

name: Manabound Blade
description: Forged a pure non pasteurized mana.

name: ManaShaper's Blade
description: Legends says the glacial core for this was stolen from the Ice Queen Aisha.

name: Manti-hardcore
description: This massive weapon is crafted entirely of Thunderforge manticore. Everything from the stinger to the horn, enhanced with just a touch of Chaos.

name: Manticore Slayer
description: Slay the beast, wield the blade, and show ALL your battle prowess!

name: Manticore Tail Slasher
description: Don't worry, the poison has been drained.

name: Manticore Tamer
description: A weapon forged from the manticore's own carapace used on breaking disobedient manticores.

name: Many-Eyed Monstrosity
description: We are not quite so sure what this thing is or why it's hanging around One-Eyed Doll, but this "sword" isn't exactly mosh-pit material. It is probably best if you keep this away from your face.

name: Marauder's Cutlass
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Marauder's Rapier
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Marauder Sword
description: A rugged weapon for bandit.

name: Marrowblade
description: Blunt but effective, what this blade lacks in elegance it makes up for in brute force.

name: Marsh Sword
description: A weapon found in the long lost depths of a marsh.

name: Marshmallow on a Stick
description: Mmmmm… perfect for telling ghost stories around a campfire. Find a campfire during the event and click on it to make a roasted Marshmallow on a stick!

name: Marvel-ous Photon Blade (0 AC)
description: This weapon was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Photon Blade before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Marvel-ous Photon Blade (AC)
description: This weapon was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Photon Blade before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Massive Horc Cleaver
description: This iron blade is utilized by a Horc warriors brute strength to smash through the front lines.

name: Massive Werewolves Bane
description: As the name suggests, this massive blade can only be wielded by the most powerful Lycan pack members. Strange engravings are elegantly carved into the blade itself.

name: Master Trainer's Sword
description: After defeating the esteemed Training Golem, you've earned the right to call yourself a… Master Trainer! Enjoy your reward. (This item does 30% more damage to all monsters.)

name: MatchMaker Blade
description: No hero will be able to resist your matchmaking machinations when invite them to join you on your next adventure.

name: Matrix Hanzo Void Katana (AC)
description: You are a Horror, slashing through the Matrix, killing all in your sight.

name: Matrix Hanzo Void Katana (Legend)
description: You are a Horror, slashing through the Matrix, killing all in your sight.

name: Maugs Blade
description: The great beast has awakened… the dragon awaits! But one does not simply SLAY Maugs… one must defeat him honorably.

name: Maurinelle's Melody
description: A nearly perfect duplicate of a blade enchanted by the magical voice of Maurinelle in the Lore of AdventureQuest's timeline.

name: Maw of Chaos
description: Don't get too close to the blade. It looks like it may devour you.

name: Mecha Dragon Commander Blade
description: You are the commander of Mecha Dragons… all shall bow before you! (Item is customizable to base and accessory.)

name: Mecha Kaiju Slayer Sword
description: Ready to use against any strange creatures that might want to attack Lore.

name: Mecha Leprechaun Sword
description: The future is now and your mecha helm is primed for combat. Do ya feel LUCKY?! (Color-customizable to accessory)

name: Mechabinky's Uni-horn
description: You…you still realize you could've taken the head OFF before you stuck the hilt onto this thing, right? May play a special animation when auto-attacking.

name: Mechanical Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword is one of two designed and built for the AQW's 7th Upholders on the game's seventh birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Mechanical Sword
description: Looks as if this sword has forgotten to recharge its batteries.

name: Mechanized Naval Cutlass
description: If one looks closely at the prized weapon from the Ruwa Armada, a small depiction of a seaweed plant is carved into the hilt. This particular seaweed is the symbol of agriculture on Ruwa Village.

name: MechFiend Of Nulgath Blade
description: Not your average sword, but MechFiend's aren't your average Voids.

name: MechQuest Memorial Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Mechquest aesthetics. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Mediator Saber
description: A high-frequency long sword with a molecular edge. It can sever through limbs and armor with ease.

name: Medium Rare Bloodletter
description: For those who like their steak a little more cooked…

name: Meeta's Machete
description: Slice and dice your enemies into a loaf of pain with this blade.

name: Mega Dragon Blade
description: After finding samples from the Lore of AdventureQuest, a massive Dragon Blade, containing (almost) as much dragonbane mineral as the real thing was forged. Lions, and Tigers, and Dragons OH MY!

name: Meiotic Blade of Shroom
description: Most heroes believe the ShroomKnight shows little sympathy for humans. But once you get to know him, he's really a fungi. (Parody of the Necrotic Blade of Doom)

name: Melody Of The Rose
description: As the sun rises over the mountains, a condor calls the warriors to battle. The Dawn Duelists prepare to defend their home. They will give their life for the land and people they love so much.

name: Melty Cookie Sword
description: Step 3: Pre-heat forge.

name: Memeat Formal Cleaver
description: Sure, it's a little uncomfortable. But on the plus side, it tastes good.

name: MerBlade of Aquatica
description: Long ago, an earthquake of great magnitude shook the ocean bottom, revealing a soft blue metal that was near indestructible. The people who lived in the depth mined it, learning to shape into tools and weapons. This sword is one of the first ever made, strongest of all created.

name: Merciless Ensis
description: A simple ritual tool that punishes souls who attempt to escape the Underworld. It reminds the dead that they can still feel pain. Though it originated in Legion forges the living are also keen on keeping the dead buried.

name: Mercy's Touch (0 AC)
description: An intentionally blunted blade that inflicts horrendous pain on both the living and the dead. It's name comes from it's final touch, which puts its master's victim out of their misery.

name: Mercy's Touch (AC)
description: An intentionally blunted blade that inflicts horrendous pain on both the living and the dead. It's name comes from it's final touch, which puts its master's victim out of their misery.

name: Merry Silver Slayer (0 AC)
description: Silver is an essential tool in a Shadowslayer's arsenal. Iron is turning into a close favorite as the wandering hunters become more aware of the Fae's dark side.

name: Merry Silver Slayer (AC)
description: Silver is an essential tool in a Shadowslayer's arsenal. Iron is turning into a close favorite as the wandering hunters become more aware of the Fae's dark side.

name: Merrymaker
description: A beautiful sword that evokes the Frostval spirit in us all. Even though it's the same colors as a candy cane, I wouldn't suggest licking it.

name: Mesopotamian Blade
description: The sun is beating down and making cracks in the ground. There's nowhere else to stand, but with this blade in your hand, you'll be able to defend the kingdom King Alteon reigns!

name: Metal Sneevil Chainsaw
description: Where do Sneevils get their chainsaws anyway? This chainsaw can be turned on and off!

name: MetalStar Broadsword
description: I asked for my trusty axe and all I got was this sword. How am I suppose to play a G chord?

name: Metrea's First Dagger
description: The blade's been replaced multiple times, so it can hardly be considered the first dagger Metrea ever used. That said, it has traces of magic that make it harder to hear her coming. Considering how it used to be a sacrificial knife…

name: Metrea's Frostkissed Dagger
description: There's a slight sheen to these daggers. Instead of poison, it's covered in a layer of enchanted ice. One nick and the target's limb will soon be lost to frostbite.

name: Mia's Slasher
description: The Evil Undead are coming, and if there's is one thing a Hero (or Heroine) knows, it's that you can never go wrong with a good katana! Zombies HATE katanas!

name: Midnight Assassin Dirk
description: These assassins use their stealth to averge their fallen brothers and sisters whom those blood drinkers killed. Lycan's will win!

name: Midnight Blade of Joy (0 AC)
description: The Northlands Rangers travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: Midnight Blade of Joy (AC)
description: The Northlands Rangers travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: Midnight Eroder Blade
description: A Midnight the Light can't pierce, from where the Darkness can never escape. These blades have emerged from the depths, having escaped from an oak casket in a watery grave.

name: Midnight Fiend Sword
description: Blood continuously drips from this fell sword. Its wielder underwent painful rituals to be able to master the blade, forgetting who they were before the strike of midnight.

name: Midnight Hanzo Void Katana
description: Nulgath made this blade black and blue, a symbol for what is to come. Gives +15% Class Points when equipped.

name: Midnight in Chaos Blade
description: On a starless night, Chaos emerges from the shadows and begins to hunt you down.

name: Midnight Masquerade Blade
description: Trying to find a costume for a masquerade can be difficult.. but not anymore! Keep this outfit in your closet for all your masquerade needs - no matter what time of year!

name: Midnight Nutcracker's Rapier
description: More elegant than an actual weapon, this sword still does damage.

name: Midnight Sea Commander's Cutlass
