description: A pirate's desires are carved into this gilded blade. Vain gold, sought merely for the pleasure of possessing it. The red chains bind a hunger for more in you. Greed feeds the sea. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Midnight StarBlade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Midnight Unicorn Sword
description: The blade, as sharp as a unicorn's horn, is made of crystalized light. They can cut through darkness, and dispel unending nightmares.

name: Midnight Wish
description: It's said there's a genie living inside the center of this sword, but if you ask him for a wish you'd better be very careful about your wording.

name: Midsummer Rhapsody
description: A replica of summer salvation from the dark ages of Lore. Humankind thrived when the sun shone, frolicking in flower circles to beg for the favor of the divine. In the chaos of revelry and ritual sacrifice, Changelings would sneak in.

name: Mighty Horc Cleaver
description: This iron blade is utilized by a Horc warriors brute strength to smash through the front lines. This is so much more mighty than the Massive Horc Cleaver. Damage range increases to 65.

name: Mighty Infantry Blade
description: A standard sword of war. (Gives 5% more gold when equipped.)

name: Mighty Sword Of The Dragons
description: Like a real dragon, this sword is able to scorch your enemies with the flame it emits.

name: Militis Snowflake Rapier
description: The Court of the Winter Fae enjoy the dramatics of romance and duels. It is tradition for the duelists to have their weapons created by the ice magic of their heart's desire. A banished Glaceran made this rapier.

name: Mind Expulsion Blade
description: A symbol of the Legion of Light, few have ever had the privilege of seeing such a blade, let alone wielding it. Your honorable actions coincide with extreme luck.

name: MindBreaker Angelic Sword (0 AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Aviators can attack the foe from the air.

name: MindBreaker Angelic Sword (AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Aviators can attack the foe from the air.

name: MindBreaker Paladin's Awe Sword
description: A weapon made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest a reflection this pure.

name: MindBreaker Paladin's Sword
description: A weapon made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest a reflection this pure.

name: MindBreaker's Psy-blade
description: This weapon is a psionic construct. You have focused your psychic powers into the hard reality of a razor edged sword.

name: Mindflayer's Chitinous Arrow
description: Sea shells, crab shells, giant squid peaks, and all manner of exoskeletons gathered and melted together in the belly of a fallen Leviathan. This arrow was made from that dizzying sludge, hardening into an arrow that can pierce stone.

name: MindSmasher Blade
description: This sharpened tooth was torn from the maw of a leviathan that fell into the depths. The entity who rules the deep imbued it with a maddening resonance. Every sound it makes shakes the mind with visions writing in the dark.

name: Miner Hand Of Domination (Sword)
description: Cheer on your favorite gold digging destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Miners Hand of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite gold digging destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Mirror Caladbolg
description: Wielding the Mirror Caladbolg, you will be able to cut your enemies off at the knees and bury them under the hills!

name: Mirror Caladbolg of Cheer
description: When Dage and Gravelyn of the Mirror Realm looked back at the blade, Caladbolg had matched itself with its master's festive red. And soon, it wil give a shower of snowflakes, too!

name: Mirror Chronomancer's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 10th Lord of Order, Iadoa.

name: Mirror Gravelyn's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Mirror Gravelyn. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Mirror of Makai
description: Dark Makai are some of the most under-appreciated creatures on Lore… until now. Let the #MakaiMadness begin!

name: Mirror Vordred Sword
description: The blade cuts through evil in silence. It is the soft glow of a cold light that hints its master was ever there.

name: Mirrored Bard's StarGuitar
description: Crafted in honor of the 6th Lord of Order, Kimberly.

name: Mirrored Djinn's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 8th Lord of Order, Tibicenas.

name: Mirrored Dragon's Rage
description: The big black spider, made a web on the tree. It was big and round, until you sliced it up with this sword.

name: Mirrored Drow's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 3rd Lord of Order, Tibicenas.

name: Mirrored Katana
description: A stealthy ally in the fight against Chaos.

name: Mirrored King's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 12th Lord of Order, King Alteon.

name: Mirrored Knight's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 11th Lord of Order, Lionfang.

name: Mirrored Mage's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 1st Lord of Order, Escherion.

name: Mirrored Mana Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 7th Lord of Order, Ledgermayne.

name: Mirrored Prophet's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 9th Lord of Order, Khasaanda.

name: Mirrored Samurai's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 4th Lord of Order, Kitsune.

name: Mirrored Shadow Blade
description: If you ever face a beast that takes "looks can kill" to a dangerous level, then anything with a mirror you can get your hands on is ideal for the confrontation. This one is not effective against vampires.

name: Mirrored Twin's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 2nd Lords of Order, Xing and Xang. (Click to change art.)

name: Mirrored Werepyre's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of the 5th Lord of Order, Wolfwing.

name: Misericordia
description: A simple blade that once belonged to the current General of the Cocytus. It's ab act of mercy, honoring worthy foes with death instead of cursing them with eternal undead servitude.

name: Miss Fortune
description: Man, whoever had the idea to make a Friday the 13th sword out of a mirror had the UNLUCKIEST design idea ever! The only thing unluckier would have been to slay a black cat monster!

name: Mistique Phoenix Blade (0 AC)
description: The ashes froze before they could reignite, but the phoenix will always come alive.

name: Mistique Phoenix Blade (AC)
description: The ashes froze before they could reignite, but the phoenix will always come alive.

name: MogliTech Saber
description: Battlenator 7: Rise of the MOGBOTS.

name: Mogloween Discord
description: A massive longsword appropriately named for its devastating blows dealt to the very unlucky. Its origins are unknown, but point towards a Mystcroft lineage.

name: Molten Destruction Blade (AC)
description: Wield a color custom blade to bring about the pyroclastic end of the world!

name: Molten Destruction Blade (Legend)
description: The volcano's about to explode juse as you and your blade are ready to BLAST onto the battlefield!

name: Molten Duality
description: Don't let either end of this sword touch you as your hands will surely melt off.

name: Molten FireDrake's Lance
description: This lance was made from the tail of a Firedrake defeated near molten vortex.

name: Molten Greatsword (1)
description: "Do you have a greatsword made of lava? Because I have a greatsword made of lava." -Winning retort for literally any argument.

name: Molten GreatSword (2) (0 AC)
description: Pyroclastic necromancers walk where the faint-hearted fear to tread, seeking undead minions among those who've perished in the hearts of volcanic lands.

name: Molten GreatSword (2) (AC)
description: Pyroclastic necromancers walk where the faint-hearted fear to tread, seeking undead minions among those who've perished in the hearts of volcanic lands.

name: Molten Lunara (0 AC)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, this blade will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with it.

name: Molten Lunara (AC)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, this blade will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with it.

name: Molten Scimitar of Time
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, a molten wall of flame blocks the entrance to the Plane of Fire. Only Chronomancers of Fire are able to survive the combined might of time magic mixed with the Plane's scorching elemental power.

name: Molten Solara (0 AC)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, this blade will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with it.

name: Molten Solara (AC)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, this blade will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with it.

name: Molten Sword
description: It's not entirely sure clear how this sword holds its shape, but be thankful that it does. You know when you have an ice cream cone and it melts all over your hand? Yeah, like that but with lava.

name: Monster Priestess' Blade
description: Many worship the Queen of Monsters, but few are called to serve in her castle. The High Priest and Priestess of Monsters - once Generals of Nulgath the ArchFiend --  have now sworn eternal obedience and absolute loyalty.

name: Monster Queen Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: If'n ye are smarter than ye look, ye'll jump to obey when th' Monster Queen commands. Else she'll be destroyin' ye, me, an' th' rest o' th' world.

name: Monster Queen Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: If'n ye are smarter than ye look, ye'll jump to obey when th' Monster Queen commands. Else she'll be destroyin' ye, me, an' th' rest o' th' world.

name: Monsterborn Blade
description: Nothing is so dangerous that it can't be conquered and controlled.

name: MonsterLord Sword
description: In a different world, a different timeline, Drakath -- Champion of Chaos -- would have been the MonsterLord, heir to the Queen of Monsters. But this is not that world, and he has seized his own power, and his own destiny.

name: Monstrous Blade of Control
description: Centuries after the Queen of Monsters was sealed away, Vath fell, corrupted by Chaos, and was raised up, reborn as ChaosLord Vath.

name: Monstrous DoomBlade
description: This sword hungers for destruction… are you sure you can control such dark energy?

name: Monstrous Pirate's Cutlass
description: Not all pirates are monsters, but then again some truly are.

name: Moon Bow Blade
description: Only those who devote them selves to the path the Moon Bow Ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Moon Bow Ninja Katana
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of the Moon Bow ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Moon Crusher Kanabo
description: One of the mighty Oni clan leaders of the Yokai Isles, Hoshiguma-Douji, bragged that they could crush the moon with a swing of their club. The Great Yokai Spirit has yet to give them a chance to try.

name: Moon-Forged Dirk
description: Bonnie Blood has gifted every member of her crew with a Moon-forged weapon. These silver blades are made with the sole purpose of doing grievous bodily harm to lycans. Vampire smiths are ONLY able to craft them during a lunar eclipse, to maximize the power of the magic spells woven into them.

name: Moon Phaser Sword (0 AC)
description: The magic of this blade changes with the face of the moon. A new moon gifts its wielder with regeneration, while the waning gibbous imparts an aura that maddens the mind.

name: Moon Phaser Sword (AC)
description: The magic of this blade changes with the face of the moon. A new moon gifts its wielder with regeneration, while the waning gibbous imparts an aura that maddens the mind.

name: Moon Sword
description: This mystic blade does its best work under the light of the moon.

name: Moonbeast Cutlass (0 AC)
description: The daring blade of a brave wolf. A golden snarl bites down on a slice of the moon.

name: Moonbeast Cutlass (AC)
description: The daring blade of a brave wolf. A golden snarl bites down on a slice of the moon.

name: Moonlight Hunter's Candle Blade
description: The power of the Moon keeps these hunters warm and guides their way on every mission.

name: Moonlight Hunter's Sawblade
description: The power of the Moon keeps these hunters warm and guides their way on every mission.

name: Moonlit Khopesh
description: Battle the undead with the power of moonlight! This weapon will do 15% more damage against undead when equipped.

name: Moonlit Steel Rapier
description: The blade is invisible in the night, only seen when the moonlight reflects off them. By then, the shinobi's target is already sinking into the sea.

name: Moros' Flaming Blade
description: Once wielded by Moros of Thir, this flaming blade helped to stem the tide of the Blight King's army.

name: Mortal Fiend Katana
description: Thin, but extremely sharp. A proper weapon for a high rank fiend.

name: Mountain Oak Katana
description: If one holds the katana in a straight angle, it could split the wind in two. Likewise, the blade came from a tall mountain that survived even hurricanes.

name: Muck Mauler
description: This sword was created using the Slime Alien technology.

name: Muddy Chainsaw +5
description: This chainsaw does 5% MORE DAMAGE against Undead monsters as long as you have it equipped! Wield it well, Hero!

name: Muddy Soulflare
description: You might want to wash this off, a muddy sword is no use to anyone.

name: Mudluk Blade
description: Some sort of swamp creature has fused itself to the hilt of this Mudluk-crafted blade. It is still alive…

name: Multiverse Combustion Katana (0 AC)
description: To successfully traverse the multitude of dimensions in which you coincide, members of the Crystallis must achieve the required level of skill and approval from the Archivist. Only then are they allowed to shift into overdrive and experiemce the multiverse.

name: Multiverse Combustion Katana (AC)
description: To successfully traverse the multitude of dimensions in which you coincide, members of the Crystallis must achieve the required level of skill and approval from the Archivist. Only then are they allowed to shift into overdrive and experiemce the multiverse.

name: Murk's Blade
description: Ooh…. stabbity club!

name: Mutated Blade of the Truth
description: Dark forces are hungry to feed on any hero unfortunate to wield this blade. Will you risk great power and great rewards… if the cost is your life itself?!

name: Mutated Rebirth Blade
description: The remains of the Creatures plaguing Astravia were forged into writhing weapons. They're still warm to the touch, have no mouths, but speak to your soul.

name: Mutated Rebirth Dagger
description: The remains of the Creatures plaguing Astravia were forged into writhing weapons. They're still warm to the touch, have no mouths, but speak to your soul.

name: Mutated Rebirth Greatsword
description: The remains of the Creatures plaguing Astravia were forged into writhing weapons. They're still warm to the touch, have no mouths, but speak to your soul.

name: Mutated Rebirth Rapier
description: The remains of the creatures plaguing Astravia were forged into writhing weapons. They're still warm to the touch. These blades have no mouth, but you can hear them whispering to your soul.

name: Mutative Broodfiend Talon (0 AC)
description: Like many of the Nation's weapons, these barbs grow from the Broodfiend's own body. The more painful the process is, the deadlier the blade will be.

name: Mutative Broodfiend Talon (AC)
description: Like many of the Nation's weapons, these barbs grow from the Broodfiend's own body. The more painful the process is, the deadlier the blade will be.

name: Mystery Moon Katana
description: The trusty weapon used by…SPACE SAMURAIS!!!!

name: Mystery Moon Long Sword
description: Fending off enemies from the sky since….well since the dawn of the sky!

name: Mystery Moon Sword
description: Now you can harness the power of the wild blue yonder in your blade!

name: Mystic Bleu
description: This blade is the very essence of mana, defying the laws of physics known only to this world.

name: Mystic Tribal Sword
description: An ancient, unreadable hex has been inscribed into the sword's blade. The tufts of fur about the magically attune with your Accessory Color.

name: Mystical Acolyte's Mana Blade
description: Some of the most sensitive mage and priests believe that they have heard the heart of our world whispering to them. These Mystical Acolytes believe a being lives inside the Mana Core itself. They are not — yet — a cult.

name: Mystical Apocryphal Katana
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness! (Click Gem to change)

name: Mystical Devotee's Scimitar
description: At rest, the scimitar appears as an ornamental hilt. In battle, mana flares into the curve of a blade. It burns, freezes, shocks, and persists.

name: Mystical Holiday Trick Blade (0 AC)
description: It's just a trick of the light. (Item is color-custom to Trim)

name: Mystical Holiday Trick Blade (AC)
description: It's just a trick of the light. (Item is color-custom to Trim)

name: Mystical HydraSlayer Blade
description: This blade was crafted from the remains of one left by a fallen HydraSlayer.

name: Mystical Plank Of Awe
description: Made from 100% driftwood. And spells.

name: Mystical Sentinel's Katana (AC)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Mystical Sentinel's Katana (Legend)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Mystical Warrior's Katana
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Mystical Warrior's Sheath
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Mystical Warrior's Sheathed Katana
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Mythic Elemental Edge
description: Light and Darkness clash and fuse. These forces tear into each other, making them stronger. Through this chaos comes evolution, if the wielder can survive the tempest it creates.

name: Mythical Black Iron
description: According to the lore of Arcangrove, there was once a race of exceptional weaponsmiths who harvested lost souls to enchant their weapons. This dark magic enables the weapon to have a soul of its own.

name: Na'al's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: When Naal was still a Celestial, he had a fascination with weapons of all shapes and purposes. His brethren saw Azalith in him. Perhaps, this was what the Bright One had always intended.

name: Na'al's Cutlass (AC)
description: When Naal was still a Celestial, he had a fascination with weapons of all shapes and purposes. His brethren saw Azalith in him. Perhaps, this was what the Bright One had always intended.

name: Nameless Ceremonial Dagger
description: A small dagger that rested on the forest floor, once stolen, found, lost, and found again. It's original ceremonial purose is gone forever, and it seeks a new life in your hands.

name: NaNdroid General's Saber
description: The Galactic NaNdroid General is noted for their ruthlessness in battle. The very name strikes fear into the heart of those who travel through the lands of the Galactic Federation.

name: NarwhalSlayer Rapier
description: A blade made from the horn of a 'whale' with a horn made of steel. When dipped into the sea, the sword shakes if an abomination is swimming nearby.

name: NarwhalSlayer Sword (AC)
description: A blade made from the horn of a 'whale' with a horn made of steel. When dipped into the sea, the sword shakes if an abomination is swimming nearby.

name: NarwhalSlayer Sword (Non-AC)
description: A blade made from the horn of a 'whale' with a horn made of steel. When dipped into the sea, the sword shakes if an abomination is swimming nearby.

name: Natatorium Scimitar
description: A merfolk backsword with a massive curved blade, as sharp underwater as it is on dry land.

name: Nation Dragonbane Blade (0 AC)
description: Dragons are a uniquely powerful lifeform, blessed with power and purpose - perfect for the Fiends to devour and use. Members of the Nation seek to slay them and use their parts to make weapons that embody their might.

name: Nation Dragonbane Blade (AC)
description: Dragons are a uniquely powerful lifeform, blessed with power and purpose - perfect for the Fiends to devour and use. Members of the Nation seek to slay them and use their parts to make weapons that embody their might.

name: Nation Hunter's Sword
description: The many eyes, numerous fangs, and sharp wit of the archfiend represented in blade-form. Pity the fool that descrives it at a "big jagged red tongue" instead of "sharp wit."

name: Nation Night Terror (0 AC)
description: A blade made from a Nightmare Fiend's skull. It's bone and cranial fluid solidified into a weapon that can tear into the spatial fabric of one's mind. The Nation will reach into your dreams.

name: Nation Night Terror (AC)
description: A blade made from the skulls of Nightmare Fiends. Their bones and cranial fluid were solidified into weapons that can tear into the spatial fabric of one's mind. The Nation will reach into your dreams.

name: Nation of Z Blade
description: Rarely used for battle because of its extremely heavy wieght, it was instead a ceremonial sword only used by Nulgath to knight members of his nation who have a burning desire to follow his footsteps. This weapon give 25% more XP when equipped!

name: Nation of Z ShortBlade
description: Rarely used for battle because of its extremely heavy wieght, it was instead a ceremonial sword only used by Nulgath to knight members of his nation who have a burning desire to follow his footsteps. This weapon give 25% more XP when equipped!

name: Nation Phalanx Blade (0 AC)
description: On closer inspection, the blade is two-pronged. Most of the unruly Nation minions do get that close look when they're disciplined for insubordination.

name: Nation Phalanx Blade (AC)
description: On closer inspection, the blade is two-pronged. Most of the unruly Nation minions do get that close look when they're disciplined for insubordination.

name: Nation Rogue's Knife
description: A simple knife is all this Rogue needs to fulfil their end of the contract. After that, they stay with the Nation for the perks. There's a lot of blood out there, and it's easier to hunt when you're a Fiend.

name: Nation's Draconic Soldier's Sword (AC)
description: The fang of the Nation's Dragons. Blades that smother the flames of prideful beasts.

name: Nation's Draconic Soldier's Sword (Legend)
description: The fang of the Nation's Dragons. Blades that smother the flames of prideful beasts.

name: Nation's Draconic Soldier Sword (AC)
description: The fang of the Nation's Dragons. Blades that smother the flames of prideful beasts.

name: Nation's Draconic Soldier Sword (Non-AC)
description: The fang of the Nation's Dragons. Blades that smother the flames of prideful beasts.

name: Nation's Draconic Warrior Broadsword (0 AC)
description: The fang of the Nation's Dragons - tempered in the boiling blood of ancient wyrms.

name: Nation's Draconic Warrior Broadsword (AC)
description: The fang of the Nation's Dragons - tempered in the boiling blood of ancient wyrms.

name: Natural Selection
description: The origins of this blade is a mystery. Some say that in response to the all the unnatural magics pouring out of the Necropolis, nature herself grew this holy sword. It pulses with the light of life and the spirit of nature.

name: Nautican Defender Blade
description: This blade remains one of the Medusae's favorite swords to award his most talented defenders!

name: Naval Guard's Cutlass
description: YARRR! It's more fun to be a pirate than to join th' navy… but ye'll be more successful at inflitratin' other crews if'n they think ye're a legit Naval Guard.

name: Naval Guard's Rapier
description: YARRR! It's more fun to be a pirate than to join th' navy… but ye'll be more successful at inflitratin' other crews if'n they think ye're a legit Naval Guard.

name: Naval Noxus Cutlass (0 AC)
description: A toxic green cutlass carved from the bone of an undead juggernaut. Noxus is a Necromancer, not an unga bunga Warrior. He just wanted to raise it and yell "ARRR!"

name: Naval Noxus Cutlass (AC)
description: A toxic green cutlass carved from the bone of an undead juggernaut. Noxus is a Necromancer, not an unga bunga Warrior. He just wanted to raise it and yell "ARRR!"

name: Nebula Dragonslayer Blade (0 AC)
description: The blade runs on the lifeblood of cosmic dragons. It's an umbrella term for dragon-like life forms from beyond Lore, theoretically speaking.

name: Nebula Dragonslayer Blade (AC)
description: The blade runs on the lifeblood of cosmic dragons. It's an umbrella term for dragon-like life forms from beyond Lore, theoretically speaking.

name: Nebula Dragonslayer Blade (Legend)
description: The blade runs on the lifeblood of cosmic dragons. It's an umbrella term for dragon-like life forms from beyond Lore, theoretically speaking.

name: Nebula Dragonslayer Sabre (0 AC)
description: The blade runs on the lifeblood of cosmic dragons. It's an umbrella term for dragon-like life forms from beyond Lore, theoretically speaking.

name: Nebula Dragonslayer Sabre (AC)
description: The blade runs on the lifeblood of cosmic dragons. It's an umbrella term for dragon-like life forms from beyond Lore, theoretically speaking.

name: Nebula Nova Katana
description: Star dust superheated into a deadly blade. Kitsune that live among the stars gather dust and magic on their tails, using those materials to create weapons that can harm immortals.

name: Nebula Paladin's Breaker
description: To punfinity… and BEYOND!

name: Nebula Slasher
description: Made from starstuff and grains of sand from Chaos Lord Iadoa's hourglass, the Nebula Slasher will destroy your enemy… in the past, present, AND future.

name: Necho Tech Claymore
description: Necho Tech gear is a fusion of paladinum and Zorba's patented VantaBak metallic coating. It is strong enough to withstand any force… or fourth.

name: Necho Tech Saber
description: Necho Tech gear is a fusion of paladinum and Zorba's patented VantaBak metallic coating. It is strong enough to withstand any force… or fourth.

name: Nechronomancer's Blade
description: Time and death, two things a dragon thought it would never fear.

name: Necrayaya's Spear
description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo! When the band is made up of undead mariachi musicians, the /party will NEVER stop!

name: Necro Crewmember's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: ﻿A deadly cutlass used to add new deck swabs to the crew. One clean stab and the living joins the sea's undead.

name: Necro Crewmember's Cutlass (AC)
description: ﻿A deadly cutlass used to add new deck swabs to the crew. One clean stab and the living joins the sea's undead.

name: Necro Crewmember's Knife
description: A deadly blade used to add new deck swabs to the crew. One clean stab and the living joins the sea's undead.

name: Necro Energy Saber
description: The hilt of this saber is a portal to the underworld, drawing the energy of unwilling souls from their resting place to add more to their numbers.

name: Necro Paragon's Broadsword (0 AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Necro Paragon's Broadsword (AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Paragon's Executioner (0 AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Paragon's Executioner (AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: NecROMANCE Blade
description: Love is never dead with a NecROMANCEr around.

name: NecroTech D00MBLADE
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 1)

name: Necrotic Avenger
description: You can see the smith's stamp on this. It was crafted by El_Rue. I do not know why that weird line is in his name. Must be a regionally specific grammar thing.

name: Necrotic Blade of Chaos
description: After Sepulchure's defeat, his blade was infected by Chaos energies.

name: Necrotic Blade of Doom
description: The darkness compels… DOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!

name: Necrotic Blade of the Underworld
description: After Sepulchure's defeat, his blade was found in the Underworld. Its darkness resonates with the DOOM coursing through the realm. This item does 51% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold when equipped.

name: Necrotic Bonefang Blade
description: The Bonefang has always been connected to the Undead. You can sense the ghost of that dark connection faintly pulsing. Almost as if the blade itself remembered.

name: Necrotic Broadsword of Bane
description: Their screams and cries are like a beautiful Baroque symphony!

name: Necrotic Chronomancer's Sword
description: Time and death, two things a dragon thought it would never fear.

name: Necrotic Commander's Cutlass
description: Unlife is cruel. But sail with a good crew and yer afterlife will be richer than your mortal life ever was!

name: Necrotic Commander Soul Cutlass
description: Unlife is cruel. But sail with a good crew and yer afterlife will be richer than your mortal life ever was!

name: Necrotic Cutlass of Doom (0 AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Necrotic Cutlass of Doom (AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Necrotic Dao of Doom
description: A weapon made to establish the Yinglian Dynasty. It remains an empty vessel yet to meet its Emperor and Shadow. Once it obtains both, it will have the power to cleave the sun in two.

name: Necrotic Katana of Doom
description: A myth sleeps in this Katana, one of fallen civilizations, a lost future, and the flames of vengeance. A Doom Spirit is not trapped to this blade, but its spite is.

name: Necrotic Light Blade of DOOM
description: Support the ShadowScythe Empire… in space!

name: Necrotic Shade Blade
description: Someone is going to have to clean up all of these bodies. Just because I put them there doesn't mean I need to get my hands messier!

name: Necrotic ShadowCutlass of Doom (0 AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Necrotic ShadowCutlass of Doom (AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Necrotic Sword of Doom (IoDA)
description: This is a special IoDA version of the original sword. It will not give any badges and cannot be used in any quests or shops which require the farmed version.

name: Necrotic Sword of Doom (Sword)
description: The darkness compels… DOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!

name: Necrotic Sword of the Abyss
description: The Nation Necrotic Sword is a sister-blade to the original. Both a nod of respect to the current ruler of the Shadowscythe, and an insult against the Shadows that thought it could control them all.

name: Necrotized Claymore
description: A blade among blades, wield this weapon well and your opponents will cower with fear and your tear through the field, rending your foes.

name: Nega Warrior Blade
description: The energy given off by these weapons produce a subtle yet effective burst of nega waves which dance around the blade.

name: Nekoyasha Blade
description: This sword sometimes shrinks in size… so make sure to harness your true power within!

name: Nekyia Rite Blade (0 AC)
description: To descend to the Underworld and return would prove you immortal and untoucheable. This blade was born under the sun, and darkened in the Underworld. It has yet to complete its journey.

name: Nekyia Rite Blade (AC)
description: To descend to the Underworld and return would prove you immortal and untoucheable. This blade was born under the sun, and darkened in the Underworld. It has yet to complete its journey.

name: Nemesis Dinner Knife (Mem)
description: The most dangerous of all dinner knives, the Nemesis Dinner Knife is the undisputed ruler of kitchen cutlery.

name: NeoChaos DoomSword
description: Individually, the powers of Doom and Chaos could shake the foundations of our world. Combined into one ultra-powerful Hero… we could destroy it entirely!

name: Neon Dragon Saw
description: Blind your opponents with this neon dragon saw! Glow comes from irradiated Dragonsbane.

name: Neon Lights Heart
description: Light up the night with this neon weapon as you ring in the new year!

name: Neon Lights Star
description: Light up the night with this neon cape as you ring in the new year!

name: Neon Spectrum Sword
description: By the power of Rainbows!

name: NeOni Katana (0 AC)
description: The color of an Oni's katana will depend on the clan they belong to. A fight will break out if any of them see the wrong type of neon lights, even if it's coming from a corner-side store window.

name: NeOni Katana (AC)
description: The color of an Oni's katana will depend on the clan they belong to. A fight will break out if any of them see the wrong type of neon lights, even if it's coming from a corner-side store window.

name: Neophyte Shadowslayer Blade
description: A solid pewter blade forged long ago in Darkovia. Ironically enough, this sword is most often used by Vampire Slayers.

name: Nerfed Blade
description: Intended to be used novices during practice fights, or for seasoned adventurers looking for a challenge.

name: Nerfed Blade of Awe
description: What's more impressive? Defeating monsters the easy way, or humiliting them with hollow plastic?

name: Nerfed Doom Blade
description: The folks over at the Shadowscythe are either going to laugh a whole lot. Or, they're going to get really mad.

name: Nerfed Dragonblade
description: Newts and geckos are shaking in their scales.

name: Nerfed Overfiend Blade
description: A safe for tots Overfiend Blade. They'll have to wait until they're an adult before they can shift over to another reality.

name: Nethershard Blade
description: Nethershard are quite a rare and even in the depths of Nulgath's lair. For a weapon to be crafted from them takes many years of service.

name: Neuling Brandt
description: A balanced and durable blade meant for adventurers who've just made the switch from wood to steel. The Dwarves make a lot of them, but each is forged with care. This is the start of someone's dream, after all.

name: Neuling Stahlschwert
description: A greatswords meant for bulkier beginners. These are usually forged for Dwarves who're looking for new horizons, but regularly given to humans and Drows that like carrying bigger sticks.

name: Neverborn Energy Saber
description: The hilt of this saber draws energy from the realm of souls yet to be born. Though it robs some souls completely of a chance at life, it dooms others to a short one. Their anguish gives power to this blade.

name: Neverborn Necromancer's Blade
description: An undead minion, raised from the limbo before birth, taken apart and forged into a caustic blade. The soul in your hand only knows darkness, and your control.

name: Nevermore Tribute Blade
description: Quoth the raven on Mogloween Eve, "Nevermore!"

name: Neveya's Laser Blade of Joy (AC)
description: Use the force of your hero powers to wish Neveya the happiest of birthdays!

name: Neveya's Laser Blade of Joy (Legend)
description: Use the force of your hero powers to wish Neveya the happiest of birthdays!

name: New Year's Glow
description: Feliz Ano Novo! Manigong Bagong Taon! Joyeux Nouvel An! Xin Nian Hao! S Novim Godom! Frohes Neues Jahr! Felice Anno Nuovo! Happy New Year!

name: New Year's Spirit Katana
description: As the new year dawns, the spirit of 2013 solidifies into the heart of this katana. Use it wisely, Hero!

name: Newbatron Prime Lightsaber
description: Your first lightsaber, or perhaps given to you by a newbie. It's simple and has trouble slicing through metal. Giving it some elbow should do the trick.

name: Nexus Rift Blade
description: A slight essence of mana glows around this respectable blade. Light, strong and true, it will be a bane to your enemy and friend to your ally.

name: NibbleOn Guardian Blade
description: You've been given the task to defend NibbleOn!

name: Nifarii Blade
description: This blade is given to shield-warriors who defend the Trolls as they cast their battle-magic! Made of Arashtite, the Living Ore, receiving it is one of the highest honors!

name: Nightborn Drak Blade
description: Creatures of the night are no like you and I. Those from the Rift are even more alien. Beware… oh, beware!

name: Nightborn Riftbreaker Cutlass
description: In the night, shadow creatures stalk near the rift - but is their goal to break it? Or become one with it?!

name: Nightborn Riftbreaker Sword
description: Even though Riftbreakers disguise themselves as rift monsters, using their fists to fight them is extremely dangerous as the chances of getting poisoned increases.

name: NightFrost Elf Sword
description: Elves are some of the most resourceful beings in Lore. Even the colds of the Northlands cannot keep these skilled warriors away.

name: Nightlocke Blade (Sword)
description: In honor of the launch of AdventureQuest 3D's open beta, we bring you this dark, deadly sword - the Nightlocke Blade!

name: Nightmare BattleBlade
description: Even the weapons the SkyPirates carried with them into the Land of Nightmares and Dreams were not immune to the twisted effects of this OtherRealm. The blades of their swords developed deadly, poison-tipped spikes, and now YOU can carry one home with you!

name: Nightmare Blade
description: The cold blade of Nightmares.

name: Nightmare Carnax's Dagger
description: Carnax, a beast that is nearly immortal, has appeared in the Nightmare Queen’s realm. It retains its power to dominate all life but is now even MORE monstrous than before.

name: Nightmare Knuckle Sword
description: Festive Frostvale 2016! These giftboxes will open on January 1st, 2017 to reveal your EPIC Frostval set!

name: Nightmare Pumpkin Blade
description: Harvest time is when the best gourds are found… and sometimes you can wear them!

name: Nightmare Pumpkin Greatsword
description: Harvest time is when the best gourds are found… and sometimes you can wear them!

name: Nightmare Queen's Sword
description: The Nightmare Queen rules the land of Horror, where thoughts beget matter and dreams become a reality.

name: Nightshock Sword
description: A quick slicing blade arcing with electricity. The bite of this blade is quite shocking.

name: NightStalker's GreatSword
description: Stalking the shadows of the Black Labyrinth, the NightStalker is one of the terrors that waits to prey on those foolish enough to believe they can come out alive.

name: NightStalker's ManSlayer
description: Stalking the shadows of the Black Labyrinth, the NightStalker is one of the terrors that waits to prey on those foolish enough to believe they can come out alive.

name: Nightstalker's Sword
description: Stalking the shadows of the Black Labyrinth, the NightStalker is one of the terrors that waits to prey on those foolish enough to believe they can come out alive.

name: NightTerror
description: Fight fire with fire, and fear with Fear! The NightTerror will slay your dream-demons and slaughter your nightmares.

name: Ninemares +3
description: Heroes will gain an extra 3% rep while wielding this sword, to atone for the scars its nightmarish blue flame can leave on your soul.

name: Ninja Sword
description: A sword made of folded steel by the master Ninja… Thyton.

name: Ninja Warrior Blade
description: If you can see the ninja's blade, you're already dead!

name: Nix Sicarius (0 AC)
description: A blade carefully crafted by the Champion of Mana. She wanted it to look pretty, but her natural inclincations produced a rather threatening-looking blade. Tara chalks it up to the very normal and girly urge to cut someone.

name: Nix Sicarius (AC)
description: A blade carefully crafted by the Champion of Mana. She wanted it to look pretty, but her natural inclincations produced a rather threatening-looking blade. Tara chalks it up to the very normal and girly urge to cut someone.

name: Noble Amethyst Katana
description: Each of the Yokai Isles’ Noble Houses passes a blessed blade from one family head to the next. It must be periodically purified at a shrine to keep evil spirits from possessing the heirloom.

name: Noble Blade
description: This blade was forged long ago for a line of great kings who knew that a sword didn't need to be jewel encrusted to belong to a king.

name: Noble Ceremonial Blade
description: A sword for the noblest heroes of all.

name: Noble Defender Of Balemorale Blade
description: The Knights of Summer guard Castle Balemorale, the holiday home of Greenguard's royal family. Trained by the elites from the days of Alteon's Rebellion, they say Darkness fears falling on Balemorale's blades.

name: Noble Heldenlied
description: This is a blade pledged to a Hero. A flock of Gryphons who bonded to a young warrior flew into the unknown for a full year, returning with a mysterious sword. The blade is ready for its next heroic epic.

name: Noble Naval Cutlass (0 AC)
description: This cutlass was created in a royal forge. You won't see any ugly nicks or chips in a weapon made for a blueblood.

name: Noble Naval Cutlass (AC)
description: This cutlass was created in a royal forge. You won't see any ugly nicks or chips in a weapon made for a blueblood.

name: Noble Naval Rapier
description: This rapier was created in a royal forge. You won't see any ugly nicks or chips in a weapon made for a blueblood.

name: Noble Sacrifice
description: This sword was paid for by the people of a small farming village who were all saved when a single paladin laid down his life to protect them from an undead invasion until help arrived.

name: Noble Yokai Amethyst Blade
description: Each of the Yokai Isles’ Noble Houses passes a blessed blade from one family head to the next. It must be periodically purified at a shrine to keep evil spirits from possessing the heirloom.

name: Noblesse Mortelle Rapier (0 AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: Noblesse Mortelle Rapier (AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: Nocturan MoonSlicer
description: In the darkness, a single light will shine brightly on your path to victory on the battlefield!

name: Nocturnal Blade of Malice
description: The night is your ally. You share a connection with the darkness that no one else understands. This blade thrives off said empowerment.

name: Nocturnal Ravager (0 AC)
description: You rule all who enter your domain; their blood, breath and bones all belong to YOU. And should any choose to challenge you… well, you can always use a new ghoul or two to serve you.

name: Nocturnal Ravager (AC)
description: You rule all who enter your domain; their blood, breath and bones all belong to YOU. And should any choose to challenge you… well, you can always use a new ghoul or two to serve you.

name: North Star Brilliance (0 AC)
description: In the cold isolation of the north, only the stars will witness your bravery. They shine for you, piercing the darkness.

name: North Star Brilliance (AC)
description: In the cold isolation of the north, only the stars will witness your bravery. They shine for you, piercing the darkness.

name: North Wind's Memory
description: This ancient sword carries with it the memories of one of the oldest warriors in Lore, the North Wind. Be one of the privileged to wield his fabled sword. Don't be fooled by its worn blade, this weapon is much more than it seems.

name: Northern Warblade
description: A blade fit for a god of war. The weapon was born era where it was believed someone could achieve divinity after emerging from a hundred battles victorious.

name: Northlands Crystal Ice Blade (0 AC)
description: The Northlands are littered with crystals mined from deep below the ground. These will focus and channel your magic extremely well.

name: Northlands Crystal Ice Blade (AC)
description: The Northlands are littered with crystals mined from deep below the ground. These will focus and channel your magic extremely well.

name: Northlands Giftbox Sword 2017
description: Tinsel says "Happy Frostval, Hero!" (Does NOT transform)

name: Northlands Hunter Blade
description: Northlands BeastHunters are rarely seen in town; they are too focused on the vital task of patrolling the snowy plains and valleys. Ever watchful, they defend their homes and people.

name: Northlands Zweihander
description: The elder gods walk the frozen forests of the Northlands. Only their devoted warrior-priests know the ritual to summon them. But once they do… BEWARE!

name: Nova Dragon's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by the Nova Empyrean. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Nova Fomalhaut
description: A golden replica made in the image of one of House Noelle's ancestral armaments. It's said that stars used to visit the Yew Mountain Chain. They saw the flames, and fluttered closer like moths, melting into interstellar steel.

name: Nova Striker's Blade
description: The star and plasma power that gives this blade form is younger than the technology that holds it together. Civilizations rise and fall, even in the vast emptiness of the void, until there's no one left to remember them. (This item is color customizable to base, accessory, and trim.)

name: Novani
description: Handcrafted from the finest platinum, this glorious blade glows softly due to massive amounts of stored solar energy - through the wear and tear, you can make out the symbol of a high ranking knight of Swordhaven. How did you even get this?

name: Nox Scar Carver
description: In life, the barbarians left scars on the lands and people of Lore. In the Underworld, their weapons crave that lost sensation. If unleashed back into the world of the living, the mayhem caused would be indescribable.

name: Noxious Slasher
description: Sometimes you just want to walk right out of this world, 'cause everybody has a poison heart… but now you can stab it!

name: Noxus' Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Noxus, the quintessential "insane Necromancer", originally released in DragonFable. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Nuked Mallow
description: Campfire… toxic nuclear waste… same thing, right? This very unlucky marshmallow emits a strange color custom glow--but at least it's not burnt!

name: Nul Contract Dagger
description: When an unworthy Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, its successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Nulgath's Fiend of Ralzic Blade
description: One of Nulgath's Nation fiends, more comfortable in the shadows.

name: Nulgath's Oathbreaker
description: A powerful, yet rarely seen blade. It was forged by Nulgath himself to destroy his own contracts. There should be a contingency plan for everything, including the very slim chance that a contractor can outwit him.

name: NulyClaws Knuckle Sword
description: Wreck the Halls for Master Nully, FA LOL LOL LOL LOL LOL LOL LOL LOOOOOOL

name: Number 75 - Gunblade
description: The standard issue for all Beacon Hunters. Boasts both a nuclear-powered phase blade and a fully automatic ballistic rifle.

name: Nutcracker's Rapier
description: More elegant than an actual weapon, this sword still does damage.

name: Nythera's Wedding Glaive
description: A mystic blade crafted for the wedding of Nythera and Ryuuji. Apparently the Void Giant stole some of her wedding presents….

name: Nyx Zweihander (0 AC)
description: A simple two-handed sword forged by Dage the Evil, which gains new meaning when you learn that it's meant for Warriors who are two souls in one body.

name: Nyx Zweihander (AC)
description: A simple two-handed sword forged by Dage the Evil, which gains new meaning when you learn that it's meant for Warriors who are two souls in one body.

name: O-dokuro Blade
description: A blade carved from the remains of O-dokuro. Hey--it's not gross, it's resourceful!

name: O-dokuro's Blight
description: Bad to the blight bone.

name: Oathbreaker Cutlass
description: Some of the fiercest and deadliest pirates to sail the straights of Lore. You do not want to fall onto their bad side, those who have took a long walk off a short plank.

name: Oblivion Blade of Nulgath (Sword)
description: This mysterious, living blade has destroyed innumerable lives. You know of only one who has had the power to wield it, the old one. And now you may wield it's power and live to tell about it… for now.

name: Oblivion Death Knell (0 AC)
description: This solidified Darkness and the aching emptiness of the Fiend's Void are one and the same. The blade heralds the inevitable end, and inflicts a raw hollowness that rots the soul.

name: Oblivion Death Knell (AC)
description: This solidified Darkness and the aching emptiness of the Fiend's Void are one and the same. The blade heralds the inevitable end, and inflicts a raw hollowness that rots the soul.

name: Oblivion Legion Broadsword
description: Members of Dage's Legion must have been very good this year for their master too…nevermind this is Dage we're talking about, naughty all the way.

name: Obsessor Cutlass
description: The deep dark hides even more dangers. Eventually, they'll spill out like an overfilled goblet of smoke.

name: Obsidian Blade of Nulgath
description: A dark version of Nulgath's legendary sword.

name: Obsidian Bone Sword
description: Rescued from the briney deep, this sword is the perfect match for any skull an' crossbones.

name: Obsidian Claymore
description: Not much is known about how these weapons came to be only that their strength is immeasurable and the jewels engraved in them are older than the mountains.

name: Obsidian Dragon Blade
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore… the dreaded Obsidian Dragons!

name: Obsidian Dragon Sword
description: Made from the bones and chitin of black dragons.

name: Obsidian FrostReaver (AC)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls. Gives +3 more class points!

name: Obsidian FrostReaver (Legend)
description: An ice forged blade made of frozen souls.

name: Obsidian Grovebreaker's Blade
description: At a young age, Grovebreak elves are given this sword for protection against the night. Made from obsidian with a flame of the morning light, this sword is the candle that will light your way through dark dungeons.

name: Obsidian Infinity Memorial Blade (0 AC)
description: The infinite is made of an endless array of numbers, real in the realm of vision, imaginary in intangible thought, and full of meaning.

name: Obsidian Infinity Memorial Blade (AC)
description: The infinite is made of an endless array of numbers, real in the realm of vision, imaginary in intangible thought, and full of meaning.

name: Obsidian Legendary DragonBlade
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Obsidian Mirror Caladbolg (0 AC)
description: Wielding the Obsidian Mirror Caladbolg, you will be able to cut your enemies off at the knees and bury them under the hills!

name: Obsidian Mirror Caladbolg (AC)
description: Wielding the Obsidian Mirror Caladbolg, you will be able to cut your enemies off at the knees and bury them under the hills!

name: Obsidian OmniKnight Blade
description: A blade with the strength to pierce the heavens, only a true OmniKnight may wield its power! Painted black (and green) at the suggestion of fellow AQW hero, Celiena!

name: Obsidian Paladin Cutlass
description: Naval commanders that the or the paladin code of honor and persevere even through a voyage where the destination is uncertain have set themselves on a path to righteousness.

name: Obsidian Paladin Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Obsidian Paladin Sword
description: Naval Commanders that honor the paladin code of honor and persevere even through a voyage where the destination is uncertain have set themselves on a path to righteousness.

name: Obsidian Phoenix Sword
description: A powerful sword of Phoenix fire used by the relentless Golden Onslaught.

name: Obsidian Rhiannon's Blade (0 AC)
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Obsidian Rhiannon's Blade (AC)
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Obsidian Samurai's Katana (AC)

description: Envy - defined as a feeling of discontented or resentful longing by someone else's possessions. Will you fall to Envy? Or will others be envious of you?

name: Pandora's Hope
description: Hope - a feeling of expectation and desire for a certain thing to happen. You will bring Hope to everyone with this.

name: Pandora's Joy
description: Joy - a feeling of great pleasure and happiness. Spread Joy as you fight monsters, they'll never know what hit them.

name: Pandora's Light
description: Light - illuminate. Always remember light can be found in even the darkness places.

name: Pandora's Rage
description: Rage - violent, uncontrollable anger. Be careful with this, it may cause Rage to swell within you.

name: Panopticon Teuthi Armament
description: Prior to Mission Incident 00x1:72B6, this armament was once owned by S. UID. 2.6129-1, Lucernaria Quadricornis. Now, it's kept as the last memoir of what's regarded as long-gone cherished moments for Teuthi.

name: Peacebringer Blade

description: *No description*

name: Pink Blade of Destruction
description: Stellaria isn't the only Rainbow Paladin in Lore's Future.

name: Pink Bounty Hunter Blade
description: Well if anything this might blind your opponents into submission.

name: Pink Chainsaw Katana
description: The ancient mystical weapon referred to in the journal found in /darkoviahorde. Never bring a gun to a katana fight.

name: Pink Default Sword
description: By default, Defaults Swords are better when they're pink! Bring the beauty to the battlefield!

name: Pink Draconian Sword
description: Draconian sword of cuteness and funsies.

name: Pink Dragon Ninja Sword
description: The creation of this blade was an unspeakable crime that was committed unto the world by no other than Dage himself. To wield this katana is to wield wrongness itself.

name: Pink Heart Reaper
description: Before finishing their Red Heart Reaper, Na Tra brought the prototype sword to Beleen to see what she thought. She felt it "Needed a little something!" Na Tra went on to finish the blade, though the "improved" model is still available.

name: Pink Phoenix Blade
description: Catching a glimpse of the legendary Pink Phoenix is a great gift. Harnessing the power of the Pink Phoenix Blade is beyond epic. Only the most pink veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

name: Pink Plastic Princess Blade
description: You found a pretty pretty PINK plastic princess blade! Better not let Princess Tara see this!

name: Pink ShadowSlayer's Broadsword
description: A broad, ornate sword crafted by Elder Shadowslayers… and improved by Beleen.

name: Pink Sockatana
description: To find the socks, you must first unravel many nefarious plots. Use the Green Sockatana to convince your foe to tell you where the socks are hidden. (This item requires a Pink Potion + Green Socktana)

name: Pink Sonic Blade
description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, the must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

name: PinkSlayer's Knife
description: You battle the shadows, but that doesn't mean you have to dress like them!

name: Pinky Blade of Torment
description: You can feel a cute energy coming from the sword.

name: Pinky's Uni-horn
description: You…you do realize you could've taken the head OFF before you stuck the hilt onto this thing, right?

name: Pirate Angler Rapier
description: Stabs most elegantly.

name: Pirate Captain Sally's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Sally became a lot more interested in classic pirate weapons after they got an adorable makeover. She even did some arm curls, gaining a little muscle to be able to lift such a heavy accessory.

name: Pirate Captain Sally's Cutlass (AC)
description: Sally became a lot more interested in classic pirate weapons after they got an adorable makeover. She even did some arm curls, gaining a little muscle to be able to lift such a heavy accessory.

name: Pirate Mage Cutlass
description: Small traces of a deadly disease course through the hilt of the cutlass. Initially pacifists, pirate mages often sheathe them to avoid endangering their mates. If they were attacked, that's when they'll break out their lethal cutlasses.

name: Pirate Ninja Cutlass
description: Get those Pirates….errr Ninja's… no no Pirates…wait…attack something!

name: Plague DragonsFang Blade
description: Plague Knights use the infectious powers of this sword to increase the delay rate of their victims brains if things are going to plan.

name: Plank
description: Made from 100% driftwood

name: Plasma Cutter
description: A blazing blade of super-heated plasma powered by geomagnetic forces.

name: Plasma Pyro Blade (AC)
description: Spark your inner flame with this technological torcher.

name: Plasma Pyro Blade (Legend)
description: Spark your inner flame with this technological torcher.

name: Plasma Shard
description: Discovered in Arcangrove after a monstrous lightning storm passed the land, this runed blade holds a tremendous amount of electrifying energy.

name: Plasma Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Plasmic Energy Blade 3000
description: A plasma-powered blade often used for unsheathing in style, but because looks are deceptive, it can power down nearby machines if turned on. Try not to use that around Dr. Voltabolt.

name: Plastic Princess Blade
description: You found a pretty pretty plastic princess blade! Better not let Princess Tara see this!

name: Platinum BrightFlame Sword
description: This blade burns with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield it, or entrust it to those who share your fire.

name: Platinum Broad Sword
description: The razor sharp broadsword of the Platinum Knights. Effective in close calls… and close shaves!

name: Platinum Dragen's Verdighet
description: A sword named for the dignity of the Dragon who knighted the Drakkar. The blade is made of its crystalized breath.

name: Platinum DragonLord's Starsword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by the Platinum Naval Commander released during AdventureQuest Worlds 2022 Talk Like a Pirate Day event. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Platinum Eternal Champion's Katana
description: Guided by the Light, these warriors live to serve and uphold Good. Only the most dedicated warriors are allowed to wear the Platinum Eternal Champion's armor.

name: Platinum Heroic Titan's Greatsword
description: Even in moments of deepest despair, we can still find hope. No matter how messed up things get, YOU have the power to save the day.

name: Platinum Naval Sabre
description: Platinum is one of the most valuables metals in the world. Having an entire weapon crafted from it is a sign of high standing on the high seas.

name: Platinum ShadowFire Blade
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Platinum ShadowFire Katana
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Platinum Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 3rd Upholders on the game's 3rd third birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Platinum Steampunk Fangblade
description: A blade that has yet to reach its full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Platinum Stormbringer Katana
description: The life of a true warrior is as fleeting and brilliant as lightning. A katana that sparks with the rage of a ceaseless storm brings honor to those it strikes down.

name: PlatinumEdge
description: A Platinum Record is cool, sure… but the PlatinumEdge is much more effective against Music Pirate roadies!

name: Playa's Blade
description: You're the one to be ballin and shot callin on the battlefield!

name: Plundered Tarnished Rapier
description: Just because it's made of silver doesn't mean it won't tarnish! A stylish rapier uncovered around the time of the PTR release.

name: Pocky Manslayer
description: Taro has fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. But what no one knew until today is that he'd /rest afterwards and eat pocky as a snack.

name: Poison Bottle Sword
description: *Spooky music plays as fog creeps through the town.* O_O

name: Poison Drinker Betrayal Blade
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to absorb the power of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Poisonheart Blade
description: The bright colors of this curved blade of gleaming emerald are as deceptive as the swamp itself. Don't touch the blade!

name: Polar Beast Blade (0 AC)
description: The strongest ice spells transform flesh into solid ice. When a druid in the form of a bear was slain and turned to ice, a blade filled with their might was carved from their frigid bones.

name: Polar Beast Blade (AC)
description: The strongest ice spells transform flesh into solid ice. When a druid in the form of a bear was slain and turned to ice, a blade filled with their might was carved from their frigid bones.

name: Polar Katana (0 AC)
description: The cold cuts through bone, freezing blood in an instant. Your quarry falls, shattering into pieces, left to melt into the gutter.

name: Polar Katana (AC)
description: The cold cuts through bone, freezing blood in an instant. Your quarry falls, shattering into pieces left to melt into the gutter.

name: Polar Naval's Northern Cutlaxe (0 AC)
description: Only the heartiest heroes are BRRRR-ave enough to sail the frozen seas that border the Northlands!

name: Polar Naval's Northern Cutlaxe (AC)
description: Only the heartiest heroes are BRRRR-ave enough to sail the frozen seas that border the Northlands!

name: Polar Royalty Rapier
description: Those bound to rule the Northlands possess a cold heart and crystalline strength, ancient, and unshakeable as the glaciers.

name: Polaris Duelist Rapier
description: In the old days, Ice Dragons preferred Elven partners over humans. Competitors would duel each other for the honor of holding an audience with the now-extinct court of Queen Khione.

name: Polish Warrior's Sabre
description: Za wolnosc Wasza i nasza! Fight for freedom and for honor. Your name will forever live in glory.

name: Polish Warrior's Sheathed Sabre
description: Za wolnosc Wasza i nasza! Fight for freedom and for honor. Your name will forever live in glory.

name: Polished Chaotic Hanzamune
description: The energies coming out of the Realm of Monsters have somehow changed the Chaos Hanzamune.

name: Polished Dragon Blade
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And we aren't talking about Sneevils or Zards here…

name: Polished Dragon Blade +7
description: This weapon was made for doing MORE damage to the most fearsome beasts of Lore… and for getting more rep while you do it!

name: Polished Dragon Sword of Chaos
description: The energies coming out of the Realm of Monsters have somehow changed the Dragon Sword of Chaos.

name: Polished Manslayer
description: It was hard to get this away from Taro to clean it up.

name: Polished Necrotic Blade of Chaos
description: The energies coming out of the Realm of Monsters have somehow changed the Necrotic Blade of Chaos.

name: Polished Sword of Dragon Control
description: Vath's gift is now yours! Use at your own risk. (Item does 30% more damage to all monsters when equipped)

name: Portal Energy Blade
description: The essence of Time has been molded into a flowing, glowing green blade. There is always the danger when wielding it that you will be hurled through space and time into a whole new dimension!

name: Possessed Diabolical Blade
description: Tormented by the previous users, this blade gives you voices that guide you towards their “salvation”. Whether you decide to listen to them… that choice is up to you.

name: Possessed Grave Altar Blade (0 AC)
description: Underworld Summoner weapons are forged from steel stripped from tombs and crypts. The nature of such material lends itself to trapping souls.

name: Possessed Grave Altar Blade (AC)
description: Underworld Summoner weapons are forged from steel stripped from tombs and crypts. The nature of such material lends itself to trapping souls.

name: Possessed Spiritual Cleaver (0 AC)
description: Countless spirits are sealed in this blade whose names have been cruely taken from them. Their restless anguish sharpens its cruel edge.

name: Possessed Spiritual Cleaver (AC)
description: Countless spirits are sealed in this blade whose names have been cruely taken from them. Their restless anguish sharpens its cruel edge.

name: Powered Golden Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

name: Powered Golden Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

name: Precision Tachi of the Remarkable
description: Perfectly balanced and weighted, this tachi was once wielded by a great Emperor of Yokai Island. A remarkable find that was discovered around the time of the PTR release.

name: Preternatural Sun
description: Think that the sun harshness a lot of energy? Just wait until you brandish this barbaric alien blade against your foes!

name: Pretty Marshmallow on a Gold Stick
description: Mmmmmm… perfect for telling ghost stories around a campfire. Find a campfire during the event and click on it to make a Roasted Marshmallow on a stick!

name: Pretty Marshmallow on a Stick
description: Mmmmm…perfect for telling ghost stories around a campfire. Find a campfire during the event and click on it to make a roasted Marshmallow on a stick!

name: Pretty Pink DreadSaw
description: Between the razor sharp blade and the pointed spikes this is not a weapon you wish to find yourself on the receiving end of… and then Beleen got ahold of it and turned it Pink!(Requires Iron Dreadsaw from Dirtlicker's Shop)

name: Pretty Pinkie Pirate Balloon Sword
description: Cute, but it's sure to mess up a good hair day. Everyone's nightmare.

name: Pride of Brazil
description: Brazil, terra de beleza e contrastes, pessoas e culturas. Leve contigo este lembrete de sua patria enquanto ensina ao inimigo um pouco sobre poder e valentia.

name: Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath
description: Nulgath tells you this blade was forged from beasts of the void. The creature made from this sword was very powerful and very much still alive. (color custom: accessory )

name: Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath (Rare)
description: Nulgath tells you this blade was forged from the beasts of the void. The creature made from this sword was very powerful and very much still alive. (color custom: accessory )

name: Primal Hanzo Void Blade
description: These imperial Voids of Nulgath's army possess qualities that normal primal Voids do not have, hence why they are prized by the ArchFiend.

name: Primal Hanzo Void Katana
description: These imperial Voids of Nulgath's army possess qualities that normal primal Voids do not have, hence why they are prized by the ArchFiend.

name: Primal Saber Tooth
description: The lifeblood of centuries' worth of prey have sharpen this tooth.

name: Primal Sheathed Katanas
description: The scent of red snow, mud, and battle rouses the blade. Their true potential awakens when one must fight alone.

name: Primal Void Tiger Katana
description: A blade that reflects the will of a solitary beast. Rarely will it ever cut foes on behalf of a lord… unless that lord is Nulgath the ArchFiend.

name: Primaris Paladin's Chainsword
description: No matter how vast your enemies, shielded by the symbol of your order, you battle without fear. Your current mission: to guard the guardians fighting to defend Battleon from the Titans.

name: Prime Blade of Awe
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this artifact is granted massive power!

name: Prime Blade of Chaos
description: The legendary sword that has been by Drakath for nearly 6 years. Soooo…chaorrupted.

name: Prime Blade of Half-Off
description: Valencia is just in awe that someone would consider buying this.

name: Prime Bloodletter of Nulgath
description: Primed and ready for battle! This Color Custom blade comes with a quest that offers a bunch of sweet rewards. Because you know you're awesome. And now everyone else will know it, too!

name: Prime Champion Of Order Blade
description: Drakath's the Good personal sword is filled with Good and Light as he works to extinguish the forces of Chaos.

name: Prime's Star Striker
description: It has the power to destroy Planets….be careful with it Hero. It is rumored to be one of the most powerful weapons in existence.

name: Primordial Edge
description: Do organic beings fossilize within the Void? No one is quite sure… but it appears that this "sword" is the petrified form of a Void monster.

name: Prince of Dragon's Blade
description: The silversmith that created this sword was known to be a savant artist on the battlefield and from the comfort of his forge, therefore, he merged beauty and brute strength into one masterpiece.

name: Prisma Blade
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with this color-shifting blade crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Prisma Blade of Victory
description: Freedom. Equality. Liberty for all!

name: Prisma Laser Katana 1.0
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with this color-shifting blade crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: PrismaShard Blade
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with this color-shifting blade crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Prismastealth Venom Knife
description: It's called a venomous knife, but the snake wrapped around the blade is actually electrified to stun your opponents. It just seems like the effects of venom.

name: Prismatic Aquamer Bloodtaker
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Prismatic Arachnotana
description: The big black spider, made a web on the tree. It was big and round, until you sliced it up with a this sword.

name: Prismatic Beam Saber
description: Use the force to change the color of this wicked blade, crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Prismatic Cyber SoulSeeker
description: Must be in Undead Legion to use. Straight from the Dage's Soulforge, and empowered by the rage and hatred of those who have passed on. A special alloy will respond ONLY to Undead Legion members!

name: Prismatic Dark Lord's Dark Laserblade
description: Just because you are a Dark Lord who channels the Fourth to try and take over the universe for the Dark Side doesn't mean you have to hate color! (And you still love cookies!) This item gives 20% more class points and rep when equipped.

name: Prismatic Dark Lord's Double Blade
description: Just because you are a Dark Lord who channels the Fourth to try and take over the universe for the Dark Side doesn't mean you have to hate color! (And you still love cookies!) This item gives 20% more class points and rep when equipped.

name: Prismatic Deathdealer
description: This blade's edge is so sharp that a skilled wielder can cut through the fabric of space and time. That means if you fall to this sword, it is technically possible that you will die yesterday.

name: Prismatic Deathspitter
description: Shifting colors will distract your foes as you spit your contempt upon them, and then skewer them on your sword as if on a spit!

name: Prismatic Defender's Blade
description: An ordinary sword that accompanied a Defender since the beginning of their journeys. Though good deeds need to reward, the blade was given wings and a guiding light by those who recognize purity of the soul. (CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Dragon Piercer
description: This prismatic blade is wielded by the loyalest Dragonslayers! Crafted in honor of Galanoth the DragonSlayers lifelong battle against dragons.

name: Prismatic Fiendish Transcendence Blade
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Prismatic Keeper's Blade
description: This magnetic sword is capable of drawing power from the moon when it is at its highest during the night and can store a great deal of its energy for a long period of time, allowing its user to endure long-lasting days.

name: Prismatic Maugs Blade
description: The great beast has awakened… the dragon awaits! But one does not simply SLAY Maugs… one must defeat him honorably. This item is color-customizable.

name: Prismatic Operative Baton Blade
description: Once rogue Shadowslayers from the future, these soldiers are now operatives for EbilCorp. (CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Operative Death Blade
description: Once rogue Shadowslayers from the future, these soldiers are now operatives for EbilCorp. (CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Operative Long Baton
description: Once rogue Shadowslayers from the future, these soldiers are now operatives for EbilCorp. (CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Oversoul Assassin's Katana
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend rules the OverSoul, and in the heart of his realm lies the Minotaur's Labryrinth. This battlegear was taken from its guards after they fell in its defense. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Prismatic Sheathed Bloodtaker
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia, there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Prismatic Snowheart Needle
description: A blade made from Ice extracted from an Elemental. No one was slain to forge it. A FrostFire Lord manifested it in battle as an extension of their body.

name: Prismatic Transcendence Cleaver
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: PrismLaser Katana 2.0

description: This seems like a GOOD sword to use in battle. More spikes, more better chance of survival!

description: Must be in Undead Legion to use. Straight from the Dage's Soulforge, and empowered by the rage and hatred of those who have passed on. A special alloy will respond ONLY to Undead Legion members!

name: Privateer's Cutlass
description: YARRRR! It be th' fate o' all privateeers to sail at a moment's notice, so ye'll always want t' yer weapon at hand.

name: Prof. Boylan's Bane
description: As one of the most prestigious scientists of our time, Professor Boylan forged this great blade using complex mathematical formulas. This sword was granted to Lord Shadow for being the only pupil capable of figuring out Boylan's formula.

name: Programmed Doom Blade
description: Deadtech + Shadowscythe = Techtronic Doom!

name: Pronged WarForge Blade (0 AC)
description: A weapon wielded by the Warforge Tanks of the Legion which doubles as a tool to tug out the blades being tempered inside their bodies. The tips are made of Cocytus Ice that cools molten metal instantly.

name: Pronged WarForge Blade (AC)
description: A weapon wielded by the Warforge Tanks of the Legion which doubles as a tool to tug out the blades being tempered inside their bodies. The tips are made of Cocytus Ice that cools molten metal instantly.

name: Protean Blood Blade
description: The protean blood of the Chimera crystallized into a weapon made of its progenitor's qualities. Its iron bones and pulsing veins indicate that it has attained life.
