description: The protean blood of the Chimera crystallized into a weapon made of its progenitor's qualities. Its iron bones and pulsing veins indicate that it has attained life.

name: Protector's Edge
description: No footsteps shall be left in the snow on my watch.

name: Proto Caladbolg
description: Forged in fire and bathed in blood, this blade will rip the rope hope, determination, and price pride out of any wielding it… unless you become its master!

name: Proto Slasher
description: *No description*

name: ProtoParagon Samurai Katana
description: A samurai's signature weapon that is forged with frigid hoarfrost to immobilize the user's foes by slowly immobilizing them with a single strike.

name: ProtoSlasher Mk6
description: You unlocked this weapon by purchasing the Future Legion Logo t-shirt from heromart. Evil salutes you!

name: Prowler's Denken
description: An electric katana with a serrated edge. Cat-like fangs along the blade, and decorating the hilt….well, the manufacturer is definitely consistent.

name: Psionic MindBreaker Longsword
description: An exceptionally well trained MindBreaker, skilled in the art of psionic manipulation. You bend mental energy within yourself and your opponents to your will.

name: Pulsating Blade of Triumph
description: After several years, Shaister1 harnessed a new source of energy. In doing so, he somehow contained this energy inside of a sword which has no foreseen end to the possible destruction it brings.

name: Pumpkin Carver
description: I will carve you just like a pumpkin… toothless smile and all!

name: Pumpkin Dicer
description: The Pumpkin Magi serve at the court of the Harvest Queen and Great Pumpking. Their magic is mighty, and they can squash an enemy with a single blast. Their gourd works are known throughout the land.

name: Pumpkin King's Revenge
description: An eldritch touch infected the Pumpkin King, overwhelming it with the urge to grow big enough for its shadow to fall over the moon. You ended its evolution prematurely, and had its desire for revenge sharpened into a blade.

name: Pumpkin King's Twilight
description: An eldritch touch infected the Pumpkin King, overwhelming it with the urge to grow big enough for its shadow to fall over the moon. You ended its evolution prematurely, and had its desire for revenge sharpened into blades.

name: Pumpkin Leaf Sword
description: A fabled sword that strikes fear into the Mogloween monsters. Leaf it to me! This is a Mogloween Seasonal Rare!

name: Pumpkin Slicer
description: Slice, dice and squash the opposition with your massive Pumpkin Slicer!

name: Pumpkin Sword
description: Sword of the Great Pumpkin Lord. Safely carves your enemies to a pulp!

name: PUNisher Chainsaw
description: Prepare for PUN-ishment!

name: Punishing Void Dagger
description: A weapon Nythera crafted with magic, and the materials she found in her travels through the Void. They're made from creatures that are close to the half-dragon, but she doesn't mind. If anything, that gurantees the dagger's effectiveness.

name: Purified Caladbolg
description: Embrace the raw power of the cleansed Caladbolg to strike down all opposition. Whatever you believe in, this blade will fight for it!

name: Purified Claymore of Destiny
description: Polish imbues your Warrior Claymore with divine light!

name: Purified HydraSlayer Blade

name: Purified Void Blade
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword hold power beyond compare.

description: Mercy is a gift, not an obligation.

description: Yeah sure, Drakath was defeated years ago, but that doesn't mean his right hand woman, Cemaros hasn't stopped having "fun" with the dragons she's captured.

description: Ewwww, gross! At least the handle isn't slimy.

name: Pyroclastic BeastMaster's Greatsword (0 AC)
description: In the claws of beasts that sleep in the depths of volcanoes are armanents from ages past. The beasts often outlive their former mortal masters, and wait for a day when a new partner steps fearlessly into magma.

description: In the claws of beasts that sleep in the depths of volcanoes are armanents from ages past. The beasts often outlive their former mortal masters, and wait for a day when a new partner steps fearlessly into magma.

description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as Pyroclastic pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Pyroclastic Dragonbane Blade
description: Your epic reward for making it to 60% in the Shadowflame war!

name: Pyroclastic DragonBlade
description: *Flamey swish slash* This weapon was forged in honor of the Champion of Fire. Now YOU can equip it as you battle.

name: Pyroclastic Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 11th Upholders on the game's eleventh birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Pyromatic Katana
description: Crafted by Lock747, the Pyromatic Katana is able to reach temperatures that rival the sun that heats Lore. With that thought in mind, just think of your next foe like a stick of butter…

description: For as long as heroes have existed, Chronomancers have traversed space and time. Quantum Chronomancers have mastered the ability to cross between universes and ages.

name: Quantum Force Blade

name: Queen Mary's Revenge Blade (0 AC)

description: The life of a privateer is a hard one, but rewarding. Please the Crown and riches will find you… but not without bloodshed and battle.

description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Rabid Ronin's Carrotnai
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the Rabid Ronin is truly hoppy!

name: Rabid Ronin's Katana
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the Rabid Ronin is truly hoppy!

name: Rabid Spring Rockstar's Blade
description: Spring flowers? Sunlit groves? Gentle rain and sweet songs? NO. Rabid Rockstars like you are fueled by spikes, storms, and SCREAMS OF VICTORY! (Also maybe cute baby bunnies.)

name: Radiant Euphoria Blade
description: A gorgeous and intricately detailed sword. Enchanted with the mana of your closest companions, the blade can color the world with your best memories. May the light of yesterday promise a better tomorrow.

name: Radiant Forsythia
description: A blade named after the princess of a fallen Kingdom. She and her twin sister were from a far off land, but their acts of heroism earned them crowns. Despite their efforts, the land's own faults caused it to sink into the nether.

name: Radiant Ledgesword
description: Sparks of magic fly off of this enormous sword, a testament to the overflowing magical energies contained within. A fearsome weapon - but handle with care!

name: Radiant Phoenix Blade (0 AC)
description: The phoenix's light may die, but it will never fade. (CC to Accessory)

name: Radiant Phoenix Blade (AC)
description: The phoenix's light may die, but it will never fade. (CC to Accessory)

name: Radiant Star Claymore
description: The blade only glows when gripped by the Light Mage whose power is then transferred to it.

name: Radioactive Blade of the Pumpkinlord
description: The vines used to make this blade were poisoned giving it an other-worldly aura.

name: RageRipper
description: Take a slice out of life… and your opponent!

name: Ragnarok
description: Acquired by Dage the Evil, this sword is said to bring light to the darkness. Hidden away from the world, Dage now sees no threat from this magical weapon and is willing to sell it to the highest bidder.

name: Ragnarok Cavaliers Reaver
description: These warriors have an iron clad will which makes them impenetrable to the snow and ice of the Northlands.

name: Ragnarok Cavaliers Saber
description: These warriors have an iron clad will which makes them impenetrable to the snow and ice of the Northlands.

name: Raider's Cutlass
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kracken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Raider's Gilded Cutlass
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kraken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Raider's Gilded Rapier
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kraken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Raider's Rapier
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kracken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Rainbow Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Rainbow Starsword
description: It's power level is OVER 9000! (AND it gives 25% more gold when equipped.)

name: Rainbow Uni-Blade of Destruction
description: Reverent light flows off the blade, bringing forth purity and sanctity. (This item does 50% more damage to undead monsters when equipped)

name: Rampage Katana
description: Slice those vegetables evenly or become the next dish on the menu.

name: Rapier
description: Used in Europe in the 16th and 17th centuries. It is a relatively slender, sharply pointed sword, used mainly for thrusting attacks.

name: Rapier of Awe
description: "Could dis be the real thing? The wielder o' dis legendary artifact be granted massive power!" If you shout that at Lolosia's docks, you'll get laughs and tomatoes…but is it the real thing? Did you actually just find it that easily in the sand?

name: Rapier of Maddened Will (0 AC)
description: Madness drips from the rapier's sharpened point. You are its chosen master, and your footsteps will be feared throughout these rotting lands. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Rapier of Maddened Will (AC)
description: Madness drips from the rapier's sharpened point. You are its chosen master, and your footsteps will be feared throughout these rotting lands. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Rapier of Skulls
description: You do NOT want to know how this blade was made… or who from!

name: Rapier of the Dawn
description: The rapiers were used by the dragonriders in the great battle of the Dawn against chaos. The haft smells oddly like potato… hmm…

name: Rapier of the Star
description: In the darkest night, let the stars guide you on the battlefield!

name: Rare BloodLetter
description: Literal.

name: Rare Platinum Dragon Blade +3
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And then we coated it in platinum so it would shine even brighter on Galanoth's birthday!

name: Rare Platinum Dragon Blade +5
description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And then we coated it in platinum so it would shine even brighter on Galanoth's birthday!

name: Ratnegade Katana
description: It's the Year of the Rat, and these renegade Samurai have made their allegiance known!

name: Ravager of Chaos Blade
description: Chaos ravages,

name: Raven Blade
description: This blade is given to all the sons of Ravenscar on their 16th birthday… IF they wish to be warriors.

name: RavenLord Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: RavenLord Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: RavenLord Commander's Saber (AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: RavenLord Commander's Saber (Non-AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: Ravenous Monstrosity Blade
description: Dzeza the Insatiable is an envious tangle of vines, teeth, and eyes. It longs for substenance, and the food that tastes best is often coveted by someone else. Its cultist compete with those of other unspeakable gods.

name: Ravenous Reaver Blade (AC)
description: Reavers eat anything and everything in an attempt to fill the gaping void in their lives (and chest).

name: Ravenous Reaver Blade (Legend)
description: Reavers eat anything and everything in an attempt to fill the gaping void in their lives (and chest).

name: Raver Blade
description: UNS UNS UNSuperblade! UNS UNS UNSuperblade! UNS UNS UNSuperblade!

name: Raw Cookie Dough Blade
description: Whether you like them crispy or chewy, cookies are a hero's favorite snack.

name: Raw Dreadsaw
description: Between the razor sharp blade and the pointed spikes this is not a weapon you wish to find yourself on the receiving end of.

name: Raw Mana Blade
description: Para-elemental matter is held together by an unbreakable field of magic, making this weapon as powerful as its aesthetics.

name: Raw Prawn Rapier
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia, there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Rawg's Sword
description: You carry weapon, you absorb Rawg power and skill. Rawg live on in you. Respect.

name: Razor
description: This blade's weaponsmith captured the beauty of shooting stars and combined it with the deadliness of a razor's edge.

name: RazorBack Skull Blade
description: Just look at it; This sword is extremely dangerous! This is why only those who are undead should use it!

name: Re's Absolute Annihilator
description: "OHHHH! I'm a huge fan of the movie DoomWood Chainsaw Annihilation, and after watching it like a hundred times, I gotta get myself one!" Re boomed.

name: Re's Sharp Cutter
description: "I've watched this one zombie series, and I gotta try for myself if this thing is as sharp as it seems or not," Re said.

name: Reality Cutter (0 AC)
description: Reality is what you make of it, and however you choose to break it.

name: Reality Cutter (AC)
description: Reality is what you make of it, and however you choose to break it.

name: Realm Guardian Blade
description: You have defended the area outside Swordhaven valiantly! King Alteon the Good thanks you, and wishes to reward you with this sword.

name: Realmbreaker
description: Called from the innermost reaches of the Land of Dreams and Nightmares, the Screamfeeder brings with it a relic of that most heated and deadly area. Handle with care (and asbestos gloves)!

name: Reaver of Agony
description: The tides of love and war overlap. Dull blades that once belonged to a forgotten traveler awaken, furious and alone. They seek to spread an agony that destroys language and cuts a wounded, scorned warrior to the core.

name: Reaver of Nulgath Blade
description: Ruthless followers of the Archfiend, Reavers show no mercy to their enemies and on occasion allies as well, if Nuglath commands it.

name: Reaver of Nulgath Sword
description: Ruthless followers of the Archfiend, Reavers show no mercy to their enemies and on occasion allies as well, if Nuglath commands it.

name: Reaver of Wrath
description: These Mysterious SpiritHunters are rumored to be sent from the depths of Bludrut Keep to purge the land of evil entities and to safeguard against supernatural forces that threaten the realm. Even the Shadowscythe fear to travel near Bludrut Keep.

name: Reawakened Ataraxia
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Reclamation's Justice
description: Wield a sword worthy of building cities and bringing down injustice. The intricate design of the hilt and crossbar is symbolic of the eternal struggle between that the just and honorable and the fallen and undesirable. Which side will you fight for?

name: Recycled Parts Blade
description: You never know WHAT you'll have at hand the next time you need to make a weapon. This blade is made from 100% recycled smoglin factory parts.

name: Red Balloon Star Sword
description: With a quick thrust, your opponents will be… giggling.

name: Red Cyber Blade of Awe
description: Will you choose the red blade… or the blue blade?

name: Red Cybercharged Blade Of Awe +3
description: Will you choose the red blade… or the blue blade? Does 3% more damage!

name: Red Death Athame
description: When the Red Death attacks, the victims have little time.

name: Red Dragon's Ascension
description: The ruby fang of the regal black dragon who needs no crown.

name: Red Dragon Scimitar (0 AC)
description: The fiery passion that fuels this red hot Naval fuels you with energy to reach for your hopes and dreams. Also be sure to yell as loud as you can. That'll help too.

name: Red Dragon Scimitar (AC)
description: The fiery passion that fuels this red hot Naval fuels you with energy to reach for your hopes and dreams. Also be sure to yell as loud as you can. That'll help too.

name: Red Dragon Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Red Frostvale Blade
description: A festive Frostvale blade to show your holiday cheer!

name: Red Heart Reaper
description: While it may look cute and festive, Na Tra made sure this blade was as dangerous in battle as it was a perfect gift. It feeds off of the emotions the wielder feels and of those that it strikes, so it is most powerful during Heroes Heart Day.

name: Red Hot Flamberge
description: Literally meaning "flame blade," this red-hot sword was forged deep within Mount Mafic, lending its power to those lucky enough to wield it.

name: Red Iron Dragonforge Blade (0 AC)
description: (This is the 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)A weapon that carries the heat of a fiery Dragon's heart. If one stabs the hearth of a forge with this blade, the smith will produce a thousand divine weapons.

name: Red Iron Dragonforge Blade (AC)
description: (Alternate 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)

name: Red Light Sword
description: Anyone who wields this sword has the power to bring down an empire!

name: Red Rose's Blade
description: Sharper than the thorns on a rose.

name: Red Sonic Blade (Sword)
description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, the must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

name: Red Star Sword
description: The origins of this sword are a mystery, but Quibble assures you it's worth his excessive price.

name: Red Tech Blade
description: Slice it up with a deadly tech blade, StarCaptain style!

name: Redemption Blade of Nulgath
description: Ha, little do they know that it's too late for Nulgath's redemption.

name: Refined Crystal Sword
description: Refining and sharpening the crystals even further, this blade slices even the air when you swing it.

name: Reflected Knight Blade
description: This enchanted sword captures every moment of their owner's life and its glistening light leaves a bitter reminder that as a hero, you will always be ill-fated.

name: Refugee's Sword
description: This poor refugee will never feel cold again… because they've become what they feared so much - an ice monster!

name: Refulgent Flamberge
description: This sword's blade was made from molten lava drawn from the heart of the Plane of Fire itself.

name: Regal Energy Blade
description: Slash them with the sharp edge!

name: Regal Pirate's Rapier
description: With such regal bearing, none will question your right to command either ship or crew.

name: Regal Valeblade
description: *No description*

name: Regius Revenant
description: An ingenious blade that weaponizes the corpse wax left behind by new Legion recruits. Fire burns their past, and sharpens it into a spectral blade.

name: Regius Underworld Candle
description: An ingenious blade that weaponizes the corpse wax left behind by new Legion recruits. Fire burns their past, and sharpens it into a spectral blade.

name: Regression Tear Katana
description: It can slice through buildings and paralyze giant monsters, but those are just perks. Its intended purpose is to destabalize a Leyline, and plunge the area into chaos.

name: Reho's Golden Sword
description: The golden sword of a fallen ultimate hero.

name: Reho's Sword
description: The sword of a fallen ultimate hero.

name: ReignBringer
description: Forged by the ancients of Alnaphar.

name: Renegade PhantomSlasher
description: Wield this shady blade to strongarm your local shopkeeper into giving you free things… if you dare.

name: Renowned Arcane Claymore
description: Known for its agility and purity, the Renowned Arcane Claymore was crafted to defend the Good of all magic. Mysterious runes veil the blade from opposing forces.

name: Requiem DoomKnight Blade
description: A requiem mourns the dead, and the spirit that once possessed this blade is no more. It gorged on wrath and despair until it snapped. You might as well be using a corpse as a vile club.

name: Reshaper Sword
description: A savage blade not meant for leaving survivors.

name: Resonating Polaris Rapier
description: In the old days, Ice Dragons preferred Elven partners over humans. Competitors would duel each other for the honor of holding an audience with the now-extinct court of Queen Khione.

name: Resplendent Dragonlord Blade (0 AC)
description: The foundation of our world is said to have been build by dragons. Wielding this exalted blade symbolizes your intent to fly towards the pinnacle of all that exists.

name: Resplendent Dragonlord Blade (AC)
description: The foundation of our world is said to have been build by dragons. Wielding this exalted blade symbolizes your intent to fly towards the pinnacle of all that exists.

name: Resplendent Polaris Blade (0 AC)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Resplendent Polaris Blade (AC)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Resplendent Polaris Jambiya
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, gripped tightly in your quest to bring the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Resplendent Polaris Sword
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Rest in Pieces
description: R.I.P. will be written on your body as it lies lifeless on the battlefield.

name: Restless Soul Cutlass
description: A pirate's life never ends, in a manner of speaking. This cutlass' steel rusted away. Its new blade is made from a specter's unstoppable soul and desire to plunder.

name: Resurrected Ataraxia
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Retribution of the Fallen
description: An honorable sword awarded to those who defeat the powerful Yokai beasts. Let this sword lead you to victory!

name: Revelry of Múspell
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Revelry of Surtr
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Revenant Candle
description: When mortals join the Legion, they shed their living flesh. Dark Casters convert their remains into wax, and burn them during rituals. There's no going back.

name: Revenant Incendo
description: An ingenious blade that weaponizes the corpse wax left behind by new Legion recruits. Fire burns their past, and sharpens it into a spectral blade.

name: Revenge is Super Sweet
description: Noted birthday girl, Beleen, has ventured deep into the Underworld and valiantly vanquished a rogue demon. Conscripting the corpse for her crafting needs, Beleen then made her way home to begin forging this epic scythe for her birthday party!

name: Reverse Nation Rogue's Knife
description: A simple knife is all this Rogue needs to fulfil their end of the contract. After that, they stay with the Nation for the perks. There's a lot of blood out there, and it's easier to hunt when you're a Fiend.

name: Reverse Orochi Blademaster's Wakizashi
description: The blades that wear Orochi's name are considered its younglings, forged from materials taken from its living body. Depending on who's blood seeps into the blade and why, a new yokai will be born and the weapon will be its body.

name: Reversed AeroFrost Katana
description: Gundahar, famed Northlands Hunter and Smith, forged this blade from the frozen breath of a dire beast terrorizing helpless villagers in the Northlands.

name: Reversed Apocryphal Katana
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Reversed Blade of Thorns
description: When a skilled elvish assassin dies, their connection to Nature and Poison transforms their bodies into vines of thorns. A new assassin tore this thorn from the body of their predecessor.

name: Reversed Chaos Backstabber
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: Reversed Dragon Samurai Katana (Sword)
description: Look straight at the people you kill, and never forget them. Because they'll never, ever forget you.

name: Reversed Edge of Giving
description: Spread and give the spirit of joy to the nice people, and also give the naughty people the pain they won't forget.

name: Reversed Empyrean Chronomancer Blade
description: Empyrean Chronomancers seem to have simply always existed. Their bodies transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence. To tap into this strength requires particular insight though.

name: Reversed Flameborn Dirk
description: This dagger burns with the rage of the corrupted Phedra!

name: Reversed Grimskull's Survival Knife (0 AC)
description: A tool for getting back to the basics of dungeon building in the wild. If Grimskull's hurting for gold, he'll sell these at his post-dungeon experience gift shops.

name: Reversed Grimskull's Survival Knife (AC)
description: A tool for getting back to the basics of dungeon building in the wild. If Grimskull's hurting for gold, he'll sell these at his post-dungeon experience gift shops.

name: Reversed Saber of Ebilness
description: Fear ir is the path to darkness. With this you will feel the power of darkness.

name: Reversed Sealed Blade
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Reversed Snow Hanafuyu
description: A blade that was forged under a persimmon tree in spring. It belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Reversed Streamer's Edge
description: Slice through enemies like lag through a bad connection.

name: Reversed Summoner Blade
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Reversed Urban Duelist Rebel Katana
description: Astravia's ancient rulers stole swords from distant lands, and a servant snuck them out of the castle. The commoners forged copies, arming the Duelists with weapons to train with.

name: Reviled Androktasia (0 AC)
description: An evolved form of the Legion torturers' most coveted blades. This sword contains a portion of the Executioner's soul to ensure a 'deeper' experience. They feel the sensation of their blade slicing through a neck as if it's their own.

name: Reviled Androktasia (AC)
description: An evolved form of the Legion torturers' most coveted blades. This sword contains a portion of the Executioner's soul to ensure a 'deeper' experience. They feel the sensation of their blade slicing through a neck as if it's their own.

name: Revived Ataraxia
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Revolving Rifleblade
description: Shoot 'em from a distance, stab 'em when they get close.

name: Rhapsodic Espressivo
description: A fell blade with a song that fortells death. Only the most skilled of virtuosos can express their ambitions with this weapon. To the amusement of the Rulers of Evil, many of their arrogant followers embarass themselves by clumsily performing with the Espressivo in duels.

name: Rheyl's Edge
description: The Legion sword crafted by Vhall for one of his viceroys in the Undead Legion.

name: Rhiannon's Blade
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with. (Does 25% more damage to undead when equipped.)

name: Rhubarb's Cutlass Cannon
description: Wish Captain Rhubarb a VERY Happy birthday, and celebrate with this GIANT Cannon Cutlass. YARRRRRR!

name: Riftbreaker Cutlass
description: In the night, shadow creatures stalk near the rift - but is their goal to break it? Or become one with it?!

name: Riftbreaker Sword
description: Even though Riftbreakers disguise themselves as rift monsters, using their fists to fight them is extremely dangerous as the chances of getting poisoned increases.

name: Riftwalker Blade
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: RiftWalker's Breaker Blade
description: The blades RiftWalkers wield are enhanced with ancient runes which, it is said, an ancient alien race used before they found better ways of traveling between realms.

name: Riftwalker Sentinel Blade
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a single punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: Riftwalker Spectral Blade
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a single punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: Ringed Sword
description: The rings on this sword create a loud noise which can disrupt an enemy's focus.

name: Ripper Blade of the Underworld
description: Blades for combat that are also used to prep bones and marrow to use as reagents or new mindless minions. Magic is quicker and more efficient, but deeper control can be forged with skilled hands.

name: Ripper of Vokun
description: After years of guarding the Forgotten Tombs, Vokun discovered the Sword of the Forgotten Tombs. With the ability of manipulate the dark arts, Vokun was able to recalibrate the sword's warning mechanism, giving it the ability to warn him of danger's that threaten his well-being.

name: Rippled Bone Sword
description: The power of water is magically trapped in this strong, yet light blade. The gilt is taken from a fish that frequents the shallows, hunting anything it comes across, no matter the size. Together, this is one captivating sword.

name: Rippling Void Katana
description: A piece of deep emptiness, torn from the depths of the Void. The violet color is deceptive. Get too close, and its true hues will steal your sight. Who's to know what will happen if it actually touches flesh.

name: Riptide Blade (AC)
description: Everybody needs to get away after a long session of waging war, boss battles, and hauling home loot… and a hidden island retreat is the BEST place to /rest. recoup, and re-energize.

name: Riptide Blade (Non AC)
description: Everybody needs to get away after a long session of waging war, boss battles, and hauling home loot… and a hidden island retreat is the BEST place to /rest. recoup, and re-energize.

name: Risen Sun Blade
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of the Risen Sun Ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Risen Sun Ninja Katana
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of the Risen Sun Ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Risoluto
description: This divine spear has the power to absolute absolve any demonic creature of their sins.

name: Roasted Marshmallow
description: Mmmmm…. Mmmm….. roasted Marshmallows! Who knew Chickencow toenails were so flammable?

name: Robot Parade Sword
description: There's electric cars, there's electric trains. This electronic sword will really bring the pain!

name: Rock of the Djinn
description: This weapon is carved from the very rocks that make up the floating foundation of the Djinn World. Oxymoronic? Maybe. But the blade is so pretty you just don't care.

name: Rogue Fiend Katana of Nulgath (AC)
description: Take caution. It may be empowered by the harvested souls trapped in the deadly Lake Hiyfar, one stab can result in the rapid formation of slanted ice crystals.

name: Rogue Fiend Katana of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Take caution. It may be empowered by the harvested souls trapped in the deadly Lake Hiyfar, one stab can result in the rapid formation of slanted ice crystals.

name: Rogue of Time's Dirk
description: Said to be forged from the tempered scales of the Eternal Sovereign. Frankly, it hurt to pick off scales, but it was interesting to see how enchanted fire cooled their green into a shade of sharp, cold blue.

name: Romantic Rapier
description: A blade fit for a prince who is looking to impress his princess, this rapier is simple, yet beautiful. It's simplicity is its strength, reflecting the love that embodies the blade.

name: Romulus Et Remus
description: Composed of both hallowed silver and red solanite, this sword serves as a bane to werewolves and vampires. This weapon is favored among experienced Shadowslayers who regularly combat those who would threaten the residents of Darkovia.

name: Ronin Katana
description: You stand for honor. You fall to no one. With your faithful Katana at your side, unleash what you've learned from the Samurai and prove victorious day and night!

name: Rose of Ragnarok
description: An otherworldly chrono blade glided and pinkified just in time for Beleen's unbirthday. If she could, she'd use this to have this pink-filled day last forever. (Suggested by AQWSomebody)

name: Rose Phoenix Sword
description: A powerful sword of Phoenix fire used by the relentless Golden Onslaught.

name: Rose Rapier of Reaping
description: The rule of the rose, protect beauty and gentleness with your thorns. What were once white petals were inevitably dyed crimson red.

name: Rose Thorn Blade
description: Every rose has its thorn, Just like every night has its dawn

name: Rose Visionary's Blade
description: There's a future that can be won, with great sacrifice. One without war, suffering, or prejudice! Only a visionary can seize that dream. Only a real Hero can make blue roses real.

name: Roseblood
description: Named after your favorite SLAY when you were a kid.

name: RoseRiver Blade
description: After watching many many many Ballyhoo ads, Beleen finally received the Bloodriver Blade. But it just wasn't pink enough. With the help of her Twitter friends, Beleen created the RoseRiver Blade for everyone to enjoy! =D

name: Rot-Touched Knife
description: Even a slight nick will kill you, just not right away. The wound starts looking gangrenous, and spreads until your entire body's zombified.

name: Rotting Cutlass
description: Dead men tell no tales… but they do leave behind weapons for ye to loot. Yaaarrrr!

name: Rowan's Sword of Will
description: He didn't deserve her mercy, but when she saved her life and became his weapon, not out of threats, but choice? Rowan now fights for her, instead of himself. Forged by Boxer502.

name: Royal Astravian Advocatus
description: Rather than pass laws, an Astravian Queen had this blade forged. This was the rule of the stars, to bring down any outlanders that refuse bow their heads to Alprecha.

name: Royal Blade of Swordhaven (Sword)
description: It may seem abnormally heavy at first, but if the wielder is a worthy owner, the soothing power of light helps support the weight you must carry. It's the same way your burdened responsibility as a faithful commander must carry to save the world.

name: Royal Blade of Thorns
description: Some say this blade was found within the dragon's den. So where it originally came from could be anyone's guess.

name: Royal Blade of Z
description: A claymore of gleaming gold forged by a blacksmith residing in Swordhaven who still has faith that the fallen city can rise again. Surprisingly, he was one of the gifted few who could forge a weapon worthy of battle royalty. This weapon gives 25% more Gold when equipped!

name: Royal Broadsword
description: A beautiful reminder of your loyalty to a fallen city.

name: Royal Convalescence
description: A blade born from the dreams of the Unsung. They are the crown, yet they also play the knight. This new World may have taken everything from them, but the slate has been wiped clean. The future can hold anything. Everything.

name: Royal Crystalline Sword
description: It's not royal because it belongs to a King. So many bluebloods have been felled by this sword that it has taken up their color. It's an intruiging story to tell on a long winding road.

name: Royal Cyber Blade of Z (0 AC)
description: A claymore of gleaming gold forged by a blacksmith residing in Swordhaven who still has faith that the fallen city can rise again. Surprisingly, he was one of the gifted few who could forge a weapon worthy of royalty.

name: Royal Cyber Blade of Z (AC)
description: A claymore of gleaming gold forged by a blacksmith residing in Swordhaven who still has faith that the fallen city can rise again. Surprisingly, he was one of the gifted few who could forge a weapon worthy of royalty.

name: Royal Dancing Blade
description: The Dancing Queen bestowed upon you this blade, a sign of royal favor! Wield it well, Hero!

name: Royal Deathbringer Sabre
description: Short and light as a stick, but swift and solid, the tip of its blade could cut down locked gates like paper.

name: Royal Dragon Sword
description: Corvak was King Alteon's Draconic partner, meant to protect the realm and his family till the end of their shared days. This dream did not come to be, but his memory lives on, defending the realm and King Alteon's daughters.

name: Royal Fortune Dagger
description: A jewel-encrusted blade that's so opulent, it's almost too difficult to wield. Each gem is enchanted with a powerful spell, one imparted by each noble family in Greenguard…or at least, the ones that like you.

name: Royal Fortune Greatsword
description: A jewel-encrusted blade that's so opulent, it's almost too difficult to wield. Each gem is enchanted with a powerful spell, one imparted by each noble family in Greenguard…or at least, the ones that like you.

name: Royal Fortune Sword
description: A jewel-encrusted blade that's so opulent, it's almost too difficult to wield. Each gem is enchanted with a powerful spell, one imparted by each noble family in Greenguard…or at least, the ones that like you.

name: Royal Glaceran Dirk
description: This dagger is inscribed with runes unique to the children of the royal house of Glacera. Loremasters believe -- but cannot be certain -- that one of the runes indicates it is wielded by the women of the family.

name: Royal GrenwogSlayer's TrigBlade
description: Even royalty wants to get in on the GrenwogSlaying fun!

name: Royal Guardian Blade
description: This blade, given to the most skilled of King Alteon's Royal Guardians, still glows red from all the dragons you've slain!

name: Royal Knight's Saber
description: The Royal Guard of Swordhaven swear only one vow: to protect the royal family with their swords, shields, and lives. It is an honor to serve Good.

name: Royal Legendary DragonBlade
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Royal Maximus
description: Prince Knight, a royal son of Swordhaven, has fought bravely and proved himself in combat; he is a true hero of Lore. To commemorate his numerous victories, the Order of Paladins has commissioned this blade to share with all!

name: Royal Paladin's Avalanche
description: Avalanche, named for the crushing and unforgiving rage from the mountains. But they must happen, to uncover the secrets, traps, and blood hidden in shadow and snow.

name: Royal Raider Cutlass
description: A cutlass gleaming with gold that was found inside a wooden chest locked away in an isolated grotto near Dwarfhold Mountains. Legend has it that its user could detect gold coins and valued treasures by how bright it gets.

name: Royal Retribution of Brightfall (0 AC)
description: In the name of Empress Gravelyn the Good, defend your home from ANY forces that would threaten your realm.

name: Royal Retribution of Brightfall (AC)
description: In the name of Empress Gravelyn the Good, defend your home from ANY forces that would threaten your realm.

name: Royal Rune Blade
description: An ancient platinum blade that appears too royal for any commoner to wield. Strange, illegible runes are etched within the surface.

name: Royal Sabre
description: Mostly used ceremonially, but still solid and very sharp.

name: Royal ShadowBlade
description: The magic sword of Lore's greatest king.

name: Royal ShadowBlade +5
description: The magic sword of Lore's greatest king. Gives +5 rep when equipped!

name: Royal ShadowScythe Blade
description: Only members of the Royal family are allowed to wield this blade. Though you are not family by birth, you've spilled enough blood in our honor to be counted as one of us.

name: Royal Shadowslayer's Hidden Blade
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal ShortBlade of Z
description: A claymore of gleaming gold forged by a blacksmith residing in Swordhaven who still has faith that the fallen city can rise again. Surprisingly, he was one of the gifted few who could forge a weapon worthy of royalty. This weapon gives 25% more Gold when equipped!

name: Royal Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQWorld's 12th Upholders on the game's twelfth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Royal Summer Inflatable Tachi
description: A favorite weapon for young Swordhaven royals on summer break from Skyguard Academy. (This item will return each year.)

name: Royal Vampire Rapier
description: As a member of Vampire Queen Safiria's royal blood court, all nobles are expected to serve with absolute loyalty ruthlessness, and in consummate style.

name: Royal Warrior Blade
description: The blade is engraved: Property of the Princess Cecily, First Daughter of the Realm, BladeMistress, Destroyer of Dragons and Beheader of Bandits. DO NOT TOUCH.

name: Royal Winter Paladin Rapier
description: Rapier's are a noble's dueling weapon of choice. The sharp point slides under the creases of armor and scales to piece the enemy's warmth with cold.

name: Royal Winter Paladin's Starlight
description: Starlight, a blade named for the only companions the paladin has as they fight through the long night. Eons of snowfall hide dark secrets, but the starlight will see them eventually.

name: Ruby Darkness Blade
description: Forged from a variety of gemstones, these swords make it easier to defeat you Draconic foes. The rubies for this blade were mined by fellow AQW hero and MasterMiner, Oshyn!

name: Ruby Dragon Flame Sword
description: Wielded in battle by the powerful xxxx clan, this elegant sword is crafted from the scales of a Ruby dragon for elemental and damage resistance!

name: Ruby-Edged Cutlass
description: A prized weapon that always looks like its fresh out of battle.

name: Ruby Kitsune Blade
description: Weapons gifted from Yokai for the express purpose of hunting others of their kind are inherently cursed. The shrines of the Yokai Isles see many visitors seeking purification rituals.

name: Ruby Kitsune Katana
description: Weapons gifted from Yokai for the express purpose of hunting others of their kind are inherently cursed. The shrines of the Yokai Isles see many visitors seeking purification rituals.

name: Ruby Willowcreek Blade
description: Infused with rubies in this blade is definitely utsukushii.

name: Ruby Yokai Pirate Katana (0 AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Ruby Yokai Pirate Katana (AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Ruler of Light Justice Blade (0 AC)
description: If the Doomblade wielded by Gravelyn has its purified state disguised…what's going on with the Mirror Realm's?

name: Ruler of Light Justice Blade (AC)
description: If the Doomblade wielded by Gravelyn has its purified state disguised…what's going on with the Mirror Realm's?

name: Ruler of Shadows Doomblade (0 AC)
description: The true form of the Shadowscythe's Doomblade is purified because of Gravelyn's powers. She keeps it the traditional rusty red to keep up appearances, and to color coordinate.

name: Ruler of Shadows Doomblade (AC)
description: The true form of the Shadowscythe's Doomblade is purified because of Gravelyn's powers. She keeps it the traditional rusty red to keep up appearances, and to color coordinate.

name: Rune Falcon
description: Zee the Legend journeyed long and far to acquire this enchanted blade. Combined with runes located at the opposite ends of Lore, this blade contains the power of a falcon's punch!

name: Rune of Green Earth
description: The greatest guardians of the earth element carry with them some token of defense and offense, something that will afford them the power to keep earth protected. This sword sports a rune of great power, enabling anyone who carries this sword the ability to sniff out anything or anyone who wish's harm upon its patron element.

name: Rune Sword
description: The mysterious runes on this blade give this sword power.

name: Rune Sword of the Darkness
description: An eerie sword rumored to have been forged from Darkness itself. Embedded with magical, glowing runes.

name: Runed Chainsword
description: Magically powered to chop through the deadliest of wooden or zombie foes!

name: Runed Knight's Sword
description: You recovered this mysterious, glowing item after defeating Lord Reingold in his lair. It pulses with a strange, unsettling power.

name: Runed Legion Broadsword
description: Members of Dage's Legion must have been very good this year for their master too…nevermind this is Dage we're talking about, naughty all the way.

name: Runed Longsword
description: This ancient blade has been protected from the ravages of age and battle by the enchantments places on it by a powerful wizard.

name: Runed Skyguard Sword
description: Mysterious glowing runes are etched onto the surface of this sword. A cool glow emits off this treasured Skyguard paragon.

name: RuneSword of Shadows (0 AC)
description: Evolved ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: RuneSword of Shadows (AC)
description: Evolved ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: Runic Ascension
description: This magical blade is said to elevate you senses to a higher, more elegant level.

name: Runic Blade of Cleaving
description: This sword glows with sinister energy. It shivers in your hand, eager to taste the blood of your foes.

name: Runic Destroyer
description: Created in the underground tunnels of the coal dwarves. And now it's yours.

name: Rusted Cutlass
description: A cutlass with a little character. The rust only adds to a salty sailor's image.

name: Rusted Rapier
description: The tip's breaking into rusty chips. Perhaps it lost a duel, and was tossed away.

name: Rusted Sword
description: This sword has seen better days.

name: S.S. Phantom Cutlass (0 AC)
description: The cutlass of a hapless pirate, possessed by a phantom that once ruled the seas. It gained a deadly edge, guiding its wielder to add more ghosts to the crew.

name: S.S. Phantom Cutlass (AC)
description: The cutlass of a hapless pirate, possessed by a phantom that once ruled the seas. It gained a deadly edge, guiding its wielder to add more ghosts to the crew.

name: Saber of Ebilness
description: Fear ir is the path to darkness. With this you will feel the power of darkness.

name: Saber Of Hatred
description: Finish what has been started.

name: Saber of Prismatic Destiny
description: We've included 376 color crystals in this saber so you can have unlimited color possibilities! The only setback is it weighs 90 pounds. Sorry.

name: Sabre of Hatoth
description: The spirit of Hatoth imbues this sabre with extra power.

name: Sabre Of Peace
description: Even if you have nothing to fight for, having this at your side helps.

name: Sabre Of Pretense (0 AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Sabre Of Pretense (AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Sabre of Serepthys
description: The spirit Serepthys imbues this sword with extra power.

name: Sabre Of War
description: Finish what has been started.

name: Saccara Lapis Sabre
description: These swords appear to be carved from gemstone. It's actually purified venom extracted from scorpions hatched in royal tombs. The material can ward off evil and illness, though the sick aren't eager to get medicinally stabbed.

name: Sacred Wing Keris
description: A golden wavy-edged blade, flowing with the power of tradition and legend.

name: Safety Pin
description: Safety first! Safety Pin second.

name: Safiria's Temper
description: Strike fear into your opponents with this blade, forged in honor of your Queen. Features a custom color base and accessory.

name: Saint's Radiant Blade
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Sakura Dragon Scimitar (0 AC)
description: What, you've never seen a dragon this pink and kawaii before? Where have you been living for the past 9 years? This bold an brash color is Beleen approved!

name: Sakura Dragon Scimitar (AC)
description: What, you've never seen a dragon this pink and kawaii before? Where have you been living for the past 9 years? This bold an brash color is Beleen approved!

name: Sakura Dragon Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Sakura of Ragnarok
description: An otherworldly chrono blade glided and pinkified just in time for Beleen's unbirthday. If she could, she'd use this to have this pink-filled day last forever.

name: Saladbolg
description: THE HEALTHY ALTERNATIVE TO "FATTY" WEAPONS LIKE LEG O HAM, SACK OF MEAT AND SAUSAGE CHUCKS! BEAT HEALTHINESS INTO YOUR ENEMY.

name: Salamancer Blade
description: A savage weapon taken from one of Delta V's locals. Just make sure you hold it the right way.

name: Salvation Blade of Nulgath
description: Trapped inside are the souls of those who abandoned Nulgath's servitude.

name: Samurai Katana
description: The Katana was traditionally used by samurai from the 1400s onwards. Sword design inspired by RedWolf EADS.

name: Samurai Seraph's Katana
description: A samurai's prized possession is always their blade.

name: San Dragon Blade
description: Everyone knows the best kind of swords are the ones that hurt no matter what part you get hit with.

name: Sanctified Guardian Blade (Free Player)
description: It took one of Lore's most skilled Guardians 20 years of adventuring through perilous lards and facing down the fiercest creatures our world has ever seen in order to forge this.

name: Sanctified Guardian Blade (Special)
description: It took one of Lore's most skilled Guardians 20 years of adventuring through perilous lards and facing down the fiercest creatures our world has ever seen in order to forge this.

name: Sanctified Sword
description: This sacred sword pulses with divine power.

name: Sandsea Enchanter Sword (AC)
description: Formed from pure light it can appear from nothing as long as the enchanter concentrates.

name: Sandsea Enchanter Sword (Legend)
description: Formed from pure light it can appear from nothing as long as the enchanter concentrates.

name: Sandsea General's Golden Blade
description: Charged with overseeing the defense of the Sandsea, the Sandsea Generals are the highest ranking of the Sandsea military.

name: Sandsea Naval Cutlass (0 AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: Sandsea Naval Cutlass (AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: Sandsea Strider Khopesh
description: Pumpkin spice can only be found deep beneath the desert dunes of the Sandsea. Striders are tasked with recovering it and ensuring the supply continues to flow to the rest of Lore.

name: SandStalker Sword
description: A blade cut from deep desert natural glass, forged in the heat of nature’s fire when lightning strikes the sand.

name: Sandstone Sword
description: An ancient relic carved from a massive hunk of sandstone. The Skyguard have made this blade their own by according it with three golden rings, each one representing the attributes of bravery, loyalty, and honor.

name: Sanguine Blade
description: An eerie blade teeming with sanguine chaotic energies. It is now yours to control!

name: Sanguine Dussack
description: It's called a dussack, but resembles a butcher's cleaver more than a saber. Hopefully, none of the monsters you're slaying in Darkovia end up being sold as 'beef.'

name: Sanguine Spiral Stiletto
description: As a member of Vampire Queen Safiria's royal blood court, all nobles are expected to serve with absolute loyalty ruthlessness, and in consummate style.

name: Sanguine (Sword)
description: Fused with the heart of its previous owner, the Sanguine thrives on the blood of its victims.

name: Sapphire Dragon Plate Sword
description: Wielded in battle by the powerful Razorclaw clan, this elegant sword is crafted from the scales of a Sapphire dragon for heat and damage resistance!

name: Sapphire Dragon Scale Sword
description: Wielded in battle by the powerful Razorclaw clan, this elegant sword is crafted from the scales of a Sapphire dragon for heat and damage resistance!

name: Sapphire Fairy Sword
description: During Lucky Day all of the Fairies come out to celebrate with their friends. The Sapphire Fairies enjoy the water, and can often be found by lakes and rivers.

name: Sapphire Knight's Blade
description: For when you want to pierce your enemies and look cool doing it.

name: Sapphire Willowcreek Blade
description: Infused with sapphire in this blade is definitely utsukushii.

name: Sapphire Wish Blade
description: In Sandsea legends, the eye of fate is sky blue, and casts its gaze on those whose wishes will come true. This weapon was forged with sapphires, meant to guide their wielder to their destiny.

name: Sapphire Wish Khopesh
description: In Sandsea legends, the eye of fate is sky blue, and casts its gaze on those whose wishes will come true. This weapon was forged with sapphires, meant to guide their wielder to their destiny.

name: Satria Keris
description: The attire of Nusantaran noble warriors who believe it is their duty to serve and protect their people.

name: Satria Kujang
description: The attire of Nusantaran noble warriors who believe it is their duty to serve and protect their people.

name: Savage Blade of Dilligaf
description: This mighty blade will put an end to Dage's reign!

name: Savage Frostcutter
description: A steel blade of frenetic make. It belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Savage Khopesh
description: This sword can snare your enemy's weapon or shield, leaving them vulnerable to its sharp, slashing attack.

name: Savage Reaver
description: This is an ancient Horc design which predates the Troll's presence in Bloodtusk Ravine. There have been many advances made in Horc weaponcraft since those days but this design is still seen as a tie their glorious past.

name: Savage Resolution
description: A blade forged from stone. It's engraved with runes that seal the wielder's true strength and savagery. Once it's shattered, the Void Brawler's unceasing hunger for destruction will swallow everything.

name: Sawtooth Sword
description: For eons, cavemen throughout Lore used this dino's jaw as a deadly weapon. I think you can see why.

name: Scarab Fiend Scimitar
description: Scarab Bloodrunners were once among the Sandsea's greatest warriors. Once they swore allegiance to Nulgath and embraced a new role as Fiends, they became some of his fiercest defenders.

name: Scarab Slicer
description: A serrated blade adorned with the scarabs that roam the desert. Revered by the Sandsea people, the scarab makes this blade fetch a high price.

name: Scarlet Sorcerer's Athame
description: A weapon used to draw blood but often used to engrave runes into stone and skin. The strange magic contained in the blade flows into the objects it cuts.

name: Scarlet Sorcerer's Blade
description: A weapon used to draw blood but often used to engrave runes into stone and skin. The strange magic contained in the blade flows into the objects it cuts.

name: Scarletta's Mirror Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Scarletta. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Scarsgarde Knight's Blade
description: The last line of defense for Scarsgarde, they fight to protect the Keep!

name: Scary Machete
description: Don't worry about all those screams in the next field over. You just keep farming for that new reward you're after. YOU'LL BE FINE.

name: Scimitar
description: A curved, single-edged sword of Oriental origin.

name: Scimitar of Nulgath
description: Instead of swashbuckler, ye more of a slashbuckler.

name: Scimitar Of The Seventh Sea
description: A fabled blade lost at sea ages ago. It is as rare as it is powerful, stopping landlubbers and swashbucklers alike dead in their tracks.

name: Scimitar of Zal
description: It is said the oracles of the Djinn Realm can not only SEE into the future, but can also manipulate it. If that is true… do we really control our own fates? It MUST be a rumor.

name: Scorched Blade
description: Make sure you grab these babies from the handle, they're smokin hot!

name: Scorched Fang
description: Do not let its humble appearance fool you, this weapon is magically infused with the power of FIRE! This Member-Only weapon will randomly fire a fireball at your foe!

name: Scourge Overlord Energy Blade
description: The energy that comprises the blade could chill to the bone and bring visions oh how their wielders will meet their demise.

name: Screaming Knife
description: There are certain times of year when the need to SCREAM (and make others do it too) is totally ok!

name: Screaming Might
description: Whenever you swing this sword, the screams of a thousand damned souls rip through the air.

name: Sea Dragon's Scimitar
description: The blade cuts through water and wind like the wings of the dragons that covet pearls on the misty coast.

name: Sea King's Arabella (0 AC)
description: A magnificent sword offered to seafarers who carve their legends into history. The oceans have their lions, Kings among pirates who prowl the waves in gallant ships.

name: Sea King's Arabella (AC)
description: A magnificent sword offered to seafarers who carve their legends into history. The oceans have their lions, Kings among pirates who prowl the waves in gallant ships.

name: Sea King's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Avast! These pillaging Captains raid the sea for its vast bounty. The more decorated their swag be, the more treasure they've plundered!

name: Sea King's Cutlass (AC)
description: Avast! These pillaging Captains raid the sea for its vast bounty. The more decorated their swag be, the more treasure they've plundered!

name: Sea Sapphire Cutlass
description: Gold and cerulean represent the threshold of land and sea.

name: Sea Serpent Warrior's Blade
description: When Sea Serpents attack, and you win… might as well use the scales for armor!

name: Sea Steel Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Cuts through water as if it were air. This attribute has become more and more necessary as seafarers conquer more and more of the sea.

name: Sea Steel Cutlass (AC)
description: Cuts through water as if it were air. This attribute has become more and more necessary as seafarers conquer more and more of the sea.

name: Sea Steel Machete (AC)
description: Cuts through water as if it were air. This attribute has become more and more necessary as seafarers conquer more and more of the sea.

name: Sea Steel Machete (Non-AC)
description: Cuts through water as if it were air. This attribute has become more and more necessary as seafarers conquer more and more of the sea.

name: Seabutcher's Twinblade (AC)
description: If a fishy beastie is bigger than a ship, start cutting and piercing from its soft insides. This blade is two tools in one.

name: Seabutcher's Twinblade (Non-AC)
description: If a fishy beastie is bigger than a ship, start cutting and piercing from its soft insides. This blade is two tools in one.

name: Seahorc Hand Of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite horned destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Sealed Summoner Katana
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Seascourge Blade
description: The hull of the sword crystallizes the sea water turning it hard but careful, you break it and water goes EVERYWHERE.

name: Seastrand Gold Cutlass
description: When the morning sun's rays touch the shore, the sand glitters like gold. This cutlass resembles a pirate's heaven.

name: Second Giftbox (Sword)
description: *No description*

name: Second Giftbox Sword 2016 (AC)
description: Tinsel says "Happy Frostval, Hero!" (Does NOT transform)

name: Second Giftbox Sword 2016 (Quest)
description: Festive Frostvale 2016! These giftboxes will open on January 1st, 2017 to reveal your EPIC Frostval set!

name: Second Giftbox Sword 2017
description: Tinsel says "Happy Frostval, Hero!"

name: SeedSpitter's Vine Blade
description: Don't be fooled by all those "good for you" organic warning labels on your food (and enemies). Seedspitters are proof that nature can AND WILL kill.

name: Seeker's Sword of Chaos
description: Cities will burn as Chaos runs rampant.

name: Selfie Stick
description: I think that's taking the term "selfie" a little too far.

name: Sentinel's Blade of Destiny (0 AC)
description: A blade for those who do not question their purpose or the path ahead. Destiny is not a promise, it is a command.

name: Sentinel's Blade of Destiny (AC)
description: A blade for those who do not question their purpose or the path ahead. Destiny is not a promise, it is a command.

name: Sentinel's Blazing Blade of Destiny (Legend)
description: A blade for those who do not question their purpose or the path ahead. Destiny is not a promise, it is a command.

name: Sentinel Sword
description: An elite solider needs an elite sword.

name: Sepulchure 1000 Blade
description: Salvaged from the Sepulchure of Doom 1000 mech, built in the MechQuest timeline. No one knows how it showed up here. O_O

name: Sepulchure's Dark DoomBlade
description: This sword hungers for destruction… are you sure you can control such dark energy?

name: Sepulchure's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Sepulchure, the iconic Doom Knight and ruler of the ShadowSctythe, originally released in DragonFable. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Sepulchure's Undead DoomBlade
description: This sword hungers for destruction… are you sure you can control such dark energy?

name: Seraph Avenger
description: You can see the smith's stamp on this. It was crafted by El_Rue. I do not know why that weird line is in his name. Must be a regionally specific grammar thing.

name: Seraphic Agent's Dagger
description: Seraphic Surveillance Agents are charged with eternal vigilance. "Quis custodiet ipsos custodes? Facimus."

name: Seraphic Agent's Sword
description: Seraphic Surveillance Agents are charged with eternal vigilance. "Quis custodiet ipsos custodes? Facimus."

name: Seraphic Fourth Blade
description: When a member of the Seraphic Order falls, their cybernetic enhancements are taken. They're turned into weapons until they resonate with someone worthy to be fused with them.

name: Seraphic Fourth Lazer Tonfa
description: When a member of the Seraphic Order falls, their cybernetic enhancements are taken. They're turned into weapons until they resonate with someone worthy to be fused with them.

name: Seraphic Fourth Saber
description: When a member of the Seraphic Order falls, their cybernetic enhancements are taken. They're turned into weapons until they resonate with someone worthy to be fused with them.

name: Seraphic Fourth Sanctified Saber
description: When a member of the Seraphic Order falls, their cybernetic enhancements are taken. They're turned into weapons until they resonate with someone worthy to be fused with them.

name: Seraphic Naval Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Naval Commanders devoted to Laken don’t need to loot and plunder hapless villagers for booty. All they ask is for their leader’s loyalty and stolen Legion treasures in exchange for their services.

description: I am neither Dage nor Sepulchure! I am the one who will defeat you… and everyone else that stands in my way!

name: ShadowScythe Pirate's Rapier
description: YARRRR! Hoist th' Pirate Flags of DOOOOOM and terrify your enemies no matter where you face them: on land, by sea, or sailing the dark waters of the underworld!

name: Shadowscythe Templar Claymore
description: Sworn to protect Shadowfall at all costs, these distinguished warriors are held to the highest standard.

name: Shadowscythe Templar Messer
description: Sworn to protect Shadowfall at all costs, these distinguished warriors are held to the highest standard.

name: Shadowscythe Venom Head
description: The ssssssword…with darkness and bite.

name: Shadowslayer Estoc
description: A slim blade made for thrusting between the openings of well armored foes. Despite the dull edges it can pierce through skin and muscle effortlessly.

name: Shadowslayer Relic Sword
description: The contents of this weapon are obscured by a tightly bound material that refuses to be undone. The mystery within is captivating. When will it be revealed?

name: Shadowsleigher Kringlemesser
description: SLAY bells ring, are you listenin'? (Your opponnents are, because it means you're here, and they're DOOMED!)

name: ShadowSlice Energy Blade
description: Imported from the MechQuest timeline by some shifty-eyed time-traveling fairies, this energy blade is favored by Shadow warriors who want to wield the power of light.

name: ShadowSnake's Strike Katana
description: Slithering through the shadowy back alleys of Akiba, the rogues of the ShadowSnake Clan live outside the law… but remain loyal to the Empress, a descendent of the Jade Serpent Prince.

name: Shadowspawn Katana
description: Steal through the shadows to be the first to grab the loot… just make sure you earn it first!

name: ShadowSteel Caladbolg 3025 (0 AC)
description: The future is now, but the Darkness is eternal… and so is Dage's Undead Legion.

name: ShadowSteel Caladbolg 3025 (AC)
description: The future is now, but the Darkness is eternal… and so is Dage's Undead Legion.

name: Shadowworn
description: The shadows wear away at your soul… and your sanity!

name: ShadowZard Dagger (AC)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle.

name: ShadowZard Dagger (Special)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle.

name: Shamshir
description: A Persian type of sabre with a curve that is considered radical for a sword.

name: Shark Sabre
description: Just like a shark's tooth, this blade will grow back if it breaks off!

name: SharkTooth
description: This tooth was wrestled from t' biggest man-eater in t' sea. But don't worry, I'm aye he'll grow it aft anyway

name: Sharktooth Scimitar
description: This blade was blessed by Neso, the Water Avatar, which allows some of the sea's magic to remain even on shore. (Daily Login Gift for Saturday, July 15th.)

name: Shashou Neck Carver
description: Assassins were sent after Ai No Miko, and this knife was all that was left behind. The dark metal is cursed, driving any it cuts to madness. A power, higher than any throne, wanted the Empress to perish in humiliation

name: Shattered Blood Collector Blade
description: Although their ways are founded i magic, that doesn't mean Blood Collector's won't put up a fight, if needed.

name: Shattered Cybernetic Blade (0 AC)
description: DragonLords rule the future from atop the backs of their cybernetic dragons.

name: Shattered Cybernetic Blade (AC)
description: DragonLords rule the future from atop the backs of their cybernetic dragons.

name: Shattered Glass Cutlass (0 AC)
description: A cutlass Scarletta made from enchanted glass, becoming far more dangerous when it shatters. Your enemies are unable to block the shards as they tear through their faces with glee.

name: Shattered Glass Cutlass (AC)
description: A cutlass Scarletta made from enchanted glass, becoming far more dangerous when it shatters. Your enemies are unable to block the shards as they tear through their faces with glee.

name: Shattered Guardian Sword Hilt
description: The hilt and guard of this blade are still sound, even if the blade itself has shattered. With determination, you will be able to restore it to its shining glory… some day.

name: Shattered Legendary Sword of Dragon Control
description: Vath's legendary sword… but it seems as though you broke it!

name: Shattered SpellBlade (AC)
description: Not quite forged together yet.

name: Shattered SpellBlade (Legend)
description: Not quite forged together yet.

name: ShatterFrost Blade
description: You'll be as cooooooool as ice with this frosty blade.

name: ShatterGlass Blade
description: Cut your opponents with this blade… and if it shatters cut'em with the shards!

name: Shatterglass Katana
description: Made of pure ice, this katana will freeze the hearts of your enemies… before it pierces them!

name: Shatterglass Sword
description: The fragile snow crystals that bind the hilt together can unleash a swift, but sharp blow. Just don't touch it with your hands. There are nor refunds if it melts.

name: Sheathed Blame Blade
description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but Heroes and Paladins can't handle its weight. The blade can only be wielded by sullied hands.

name: Sheathed Crystallis SeaCleaver (0 AC)
description: The Archivist entrusted this blade to her Admiral. Nothing will hinder their mission.

name: Sheathed Crystallis SeaCleaver (AC)
description: The Archivist entrusted this blade to her Admiral. Nothing will hinder their mission.

name: Sheathed Dragon's Breath Katana
description: The same dragon that offered the jizamurai villages their blood gifted the assassins their breath as well. Lightning cooled in a sacred spring, and solidified into blades.

name: Sheathed Eta's Malice
description: Along with his twin, Apa, Eta has been entrusted by the Crystallis administration to oversee all of the soldiers on the Shinkansen.

name: Sheathed Hanzamune Dragon Koi Blade
description: A legendary blade crafted by the greatest Yokai swordsman, Hanzamune. The ornate sheath is proof of the detailed craftmanship at hand.

name: Sheathed Ivory Blade
description: A blade trapped in an iron sheath, and bound in thorns. It was given to the coliseum, fated to find a wielder that can satisfy it's thirst for sullied blood.

name: Sheathed Kabasaran Sword
description: Wentira had its own humbe beginnings, and has no wish to hide or disregard them. These aged and battle weathered weapons have protected their home for time immemorial.

name: Sheathed Kagutsuchi Inori
description: The flames can only be lit with blood. A swordsmith modeled this masterpiece after a child of flame. Their birth and immediate death created eight volcanos.

name: Sheathed Kinsman Sword (Sword)
description: Not every enemy should have the honor of tasting your steel.

name: Sheathed Melody Of The Rose (Sword)
description: As the sun rises over the mountains, a condor calls the warriors to battle. The Dawn Duelists prepare to defend their home. They will give their life for the land and people they love so much.

name: Sheathed Necrotic Katana of Doom
description: A myth sleeps in this Katana, one of fallen civilizations, a lost future, and the flames of vengeance. A Doom Spirit is not trapped to this blade, but its spite is.

name: Sheathed Oni Hatamoto Katana
description: The highest honor one can achieve is being allowed to protect all those who call the Yokai Isles their home. Some of the yokai themselves have taken up this blade, keeping their oaths secret from Kitsune while he was alive.

name: Sheathed Purified Malice
description: Along with her twin, Eta, Apa has been entrusted by the Crystallis administration to oversee all of the soldiers on the Shinkansen.

name: Sheathed Soul Devouring Katana
description: Lore has always been a world for the lawless. Thus blade - which one but down men for its own etertainment and glory - now devours souls on behalf of the law of the Legion.

name: Sheathed Soulfire Odachi
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: Sheathed Urban Duelist Katana
description: Astravia's ancient rulers stole swords from distant lands, and a servant snuck them out of the castle. The commoners forged copies, arming the Duelists with weapons to train with.

name: Sheathed Warrior's Golden Blade
description: Your victories in battle honor your homeland and your ancestors. Happy Independence Day!

name: Sheng Chi's Fang
description: Hacking off enemy limbs with this blade is a win win, blocking both chi and blood flow!

name: Sheng Long's Fang
description: Warriors of the imperial Dynasty served their lords with unwavering loyalty. Thus gifted with a formidable weapon.

name: Shenlong Qiang
description: A spear made for the kin of dragons, able to purify blood into water with a touch. It's why they can destroy life, guiltless and free. Their crimes turn into rain.

name: Shepherd's Dulcet Knife
description: Surely you will only use this knife to spread cream on a scone. Oh dear, what is that harp made of? Where did the strings come from? Surely not from an actual little lamb…

name: Shepherd's Tuning Harp
description: It's a harp fused with a pitchfork for both farming and musical purposes. Each strum of the strings makes a distinct 'baa~' that calls the flock home.

name: Shimmering Silence
description: Every Silent Sentinel needs a trusty weapon that can be depended on at a moment's notice. We present to you the Shimmering Silence, the chosen sword of the Silent Sentinel. Raw power pulses, illuminating the runes on the blade, emitting a silent warning to all those who lay eyes on it.

name: Shimmering Sword Of Light
description: A celestial from the Plane of Light fashioned this blade of pure marble and gold as a parting gift to a dear friend who left her home city. Nobody knows who the man was, but a translation from the top runes hint the man bore a name with the letter R.

name: Shining Blade of Glory (AC)
description: Shine on, Celestial Hero!

name: Shining Blade of Glory (Legend)
description: Shine on, Celestial Hero!

name: Shining Dragon's Blade of Frostvale
description: A legendary Moglin Prince raised this gleaming blade of light to chase evil out of the forest! Frostval was saved…but you would have remembered this if it actually happened, right? Is this a fairy tale, or is the Moglin a Hero from another World?

name: Shining Fury
description: This sword is the true standard in combat excellence!

name: Shining Lava Starsword
description: Forged by Tana in the very heart of the Lore's Sun. This starsword is special. It's Hilt contains a fragment of Fiamme's elemental essence.

name: Shinobi Katana (1)
description: A sword commonly used by ninja. The blade is much shorter than the traditional daito katana used by the samurai of feudal Japan.

name: Shinobi Katana (2)
description: Elite Ninja warriors wear raiment that allows them to move freely in any direction - so you never know from where they will attack!

name: Shipwrecked Captain's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Shipwrecked Captain's Cutlass (AC)
