description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Short Gold Blade
description: The blade of those who treasure the Light. With this blade they shall never lose sight of what they are fighting for.

name: Shortsword of the Dark
description: Everything mortal and small was born in the dark, and will return to the dark. Take this blade, a reminder of the cradle and grave, to make your mark on the world with what little time you have.

name: Shrade's Chainsaw Blade (0 AC)
description: Be careful, Shrade might come looking for this.

name: Shrade's Chainsaw Blade (AC)
description: Be careful, Shrade might come looking for this.

name: Shrade's Chainsaw Cutlass (0 AC)
description: I wonder if Quibble obtained this illegally from Skullpunch island… (Click to stop chainsaw)

name: Shrade's Chainsaw Cutlass (AC)
description: I wonder if Quibble obtained this illegally from Skullpunch island… (Click to stop chainsaw)

name: Shrade's Dark Chainsaw Blade (0 AC)
description: Be careful, Shrade might come looking for this.

name: Shrade's Dark Chainsaw Blade (AC)
description: Be careful, Shrade might come looking for this.

name: Shrade's Slasher Blade
description: /Slay your way through hordes of undead… and try not to SCREAM!

name: Shredder
description: No foe will be left standing; at least, not with all their limbs, that is.

name: Shrimp Skewer
description: For when you cook your prawns over an open flame.. or charcoal.. or the roasting remains of your foes.

name: Shrine of Fire
description: When heated arguments aren't enough to end a dispute. (Item has a chance to call down a storm of burning meteors when equipped.)

name: Shrouded Carnage Maw Cleaver
description: Trapped in Darkness, a legendary beast is muzzled. The cleaver stirs when your hands reach its hilt. It looks for fresh meat and its hunger is infectious.

name: Shu Ninja Katana
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these colorful Ninja are celebrating!

name: Shujaa
description: A beautiful broadsword designed with gold inlaid onto razor sharp steel spikes.

name: Sickly Claymore
description: This polluted sword will give your enemies a bad head cold. But don't worry--they'll be too dead to care.

name: Sidhe's Devotee Dagger
description: An artist was given a special iron dagger to kill Leanan Sidhe, and save themselves from death. They were never be able to bring themselves to plunge the weapon into their stalker's chest.

name: Silent Knight Blade
description: No one shall speak a word for he has come. While he does not bring presents, he brings a blade sharp enough to silence a crowd.

name: Silent Void Blade (0 AC)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Void Blade (AC)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Void Katana (0 AC)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Void Katana (AC)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Wanderer Butterfly Short Sword
description: These wanderers drift through Yokai offering cutting comments on your hairstyles. They sometimes offer to cut your hair… while blindfolded. No thanks!

name: Silent Wanderer Cutting Scissors
description: These wanderers drift through Yokai offering cutting comments on your hairstyles. They sometimes offer to cut your hair… while blindfolded. No thanks!

name: Silphium Rapier
description: A blade of noble semblance, hiding an irresistible poison. Your dreams of love can become reality if you never open your eyes again.

name: Silver and Gold
description: The polished oak grip seems to spread its own inner warmth through your hand as the lights of Frostval twinkle off the silver and gold metalwork on the blade.

name: Silver Claymore
description: One of the Roach Raze prices. A silver claymore… who knows from where the Roaches got it from?

name: Silver Corsair Cutlass
description: These buccaneer's buccaneers never back down from a fight, now whether they fight fair is another question.

name: Silver DeathKnight's Blade
description: A first-rate sword the Death Knights are envious to get their hands on, it is only given to a chosen one whose power is second to its current owner. The silver variant crushes its victim's bravery by sucking it out within a short period of time.

name: Silver Dream Guardian Scimitar
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Silver Drow Saber
description: Once chaorrupted, the blade was putrefied and purified in the fires of Melano and Albedo. Now Prima Materia, the Drows' weapons can conduct and deflect an array of elements.

name: Silver Edged Lamenter
description: The blade of an Elven Heritage Guardian that set off to rescue those in need of aid. Now without a master, it laments that it can not rust. In your hands, silver born in forest soil seeks to fulfil the wishes of a lost elf.

name: Silver Enchanted Retro StarSword
description: The oldest, most experienced gamers will gather in Yulgar's Inn from time to time to reminisce about the blocky, pixellated Graphics of Yore. This blade was crafted to honor their nostalgia. (Blade is color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Silver Exalted Paladin Blade
description: Unfortunately, Trolle'din died when a foe told him his shoelace was untied. Down he looked, to double-check, and his enemy took off his head - at the neck!

name: Silver Frostvale Blade
description: A festive Frostvale blade to show your holiday cheer!

name: Silver Graydient Claymore
description: Only the most skilled weapon-welders know how to forge a sword with a gradient blade. Onwards into battle, hero!

name: Silver Pyromancer's Sabre
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAH

name: Silver Rapier
description: Modeled after the blade forged in DragonFable, the soft glow emanating from this rapier will light your way through dark territory, but be careful, as it will act as a beacon to your enemies on the battlefield.

name: Silver Ripper
description: A sword forged from the tarnished silver gathered from a battlefield in Darkovia.

name: Silver Stream Sword
description: A sword passed down through multiple generations of warriors. The steel has been burned by fiery dragon's breath, enchanting it with strength.

name: Silver Sun Cutlass
description: Avast ye Scallywag! Don't ye lay a finger on me prismatic cutlass or ye be shark bait!

name: Silver Sunrise Blade
description: A troll Chorus gathers at sunrise to welcome the day and waken sleeping Trolls, calling them to their work and their art. The blush of the sky as the sun rises is captured in the pink tourmaline inlay of the silver-edged blade.

name: Silver Victory Blade
description: This blade has been gifted to ALL the heroes of Lore for surpassing the AdventureQuest 3D Share Challenge! Enchant this blade to begin leveling it up!

name: Silver Vindicator Blade
description: As they move up the ranks, these conscripted recruits become full Vindicator Soldiers, showing their ever-increasing knowledge of the Vindicators. As a conscript, you are eligible to wield the Silver Vindicator weapons.

name: Silver Vindicator Sword
description: The lowest rank, recruits have just started learning the way of the Vindicator. As a conscript, you are eligible to wield the Silver Vindicator weapons.

name: Silver Wing Dagger
description: The handle is forged of the hardest rock found in the desert. The blade is made of sand packed so tightly together it forms an edge sharp enough to cut steel. Take the fury of the Sandsea with you at all times!

name: Silverfang Claymore
description: Slay the beasts of the night.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Saber (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Saber (Non-AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: Simple Orphium Blade
description: Made of Orphium Ore, this is the simplest of Vanda's blades.

name: Sin of Revontheus (Sword)
description: You who could barely grasp the true power of Revontheus; are you worthy of wielding his weapon?

name: Sin of the Abyss
description: You who could barely grasp the true power of the Abyss; are you worthy of wielding its power? (This item does 51% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold when equipped.)

name: Sin Of The Underworld
description: A blade that manifested from the carnage wrought by the Legion. In a flood of blood and rust bled by impudent immortals, it awaits a merciless hand. (CC to Accessory Glow)

name: Sin of the Undying
description: A blade that manifested from the carnage wrought by the Legion. In a flood of blood and rust bled by impudent immortals, it awaits a merciless hand.

name: Sin of the Warlord Cleaver
description: A fiendish blade with a hunger for war as deep as the Fiend God's Void. Only a Nation fanatic could have created such a savage masterpiece, born from blood, fangs, and talons.

name: Sinbad's Sword
description: This belonged to Sinbad, legend of the seven seas.

name: Single Blade of the Void
description: The ShadowFlame army is deadly in ANY world… but especially inside the Void. You've earned the right to wield this weapon, but take care you do not succumb to its dark power.

name: Single Butcher Knife
description: Good for cutting up dinner.

name: Sinister Black Knight's Grudge
description: The darkest knights stalk the dark night. But will they conquer the darkness? Only time will tell.

name: Sinister Leech Blade of Nulgath
description: Nulgath twists the weapon parasite to shape this vile sword.

name: Sinister PumpKing Blade
description: Only the greatest Pumpkin Kings are bestowed with such a sinister Mogloween blade. Those who see it recognize your ruthless nobility. It even glows in the LIGHT. Pretty wicked.

name: Sir Roderick's Vengence
description: Sir Roderick's own vicious blade.

name: Siren's Misery (0 AC)
description: Engraved on the cutlass is the woeful song of a Siren. It calls the living to join her in death. Your foes will find themselves drawn to the edge of this bitter blade.

name: Siren's Misery (AC)
description: Engraved on the cutlass is the woeful song of a Siren. It calls the living to join her in death. Your foes will find themselves drawn to the edge of this bitter blade.

name: Sister Ancient Platinum Blade
description: No one knew it had an almost identical twin sister.

name: Sketchy 1st Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy 2nd Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy 3rd Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy 4th Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy 5th Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy 6th Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy 7th Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy 8th Betrayal Blade
description: This blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. And it looks like it's luck (and color) has run out.

name: Sketchy Cutlass
description: This weapon hat looks pretty sketchy to me. ( But then, what would you expect from gear you found inside a Sketchy Dragon?)

name: Skullborne Sword
description: Your opponent will be BONED!

name: Skullbreaker's Blade
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS.

name: Skullcrasher Cutlass
description: Ye be truly a gentlemen o' fortune with this fine blade.

name: Skulls and Doom Blade
description: Victory is yours! And so is Groglurk's blade. This sinister blade holds immense dark energy.

name: Skullwraith
description: Forged from pure dark matter, this blade's only purpose is to bring destruction.

name: Sky Centurion's Blade
description: The intricately etched design in the blade funnels the power of the sky into this blade, giving you the might of the atmosphere at your fingertips. Use it wisely, guard the sky and keep those you love safe.

name: Skye Assassin's Final Gift
description: A dagger that's solid one moment, and phasing through your armor in the next. It strikes at the heart, and makes it burst.

name: Skye's Wailing Greatsword
description: A jagged and cruel weapon made from the dead gods of Skye. Their flesh struggles to get free, forced to strike down the people who once looked to the Storms and Shadows for protection.

name: SkyForce
description: Gaining its power from the light of day, the sword has the ability to vanquish any evil foe.

name: Skyguard Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch aerial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

name: Skyguard Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch aerial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

name: Skyguard Commander's Rapier (AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch aerial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

name: Skyguard Commander's Rapier (Non-AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch aerial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

name: Skyguard Crystal Blade
description: A heavier Skyguard armament for those knights that want an extra punch in their attacks. Forged of the toughest crystals and blessed by Clerics, this weapons spells doom for any who appose King Alteon.

name: Skyguard Falcon Blade
description: A lightweight, agile weapon designed after the falcons the Skyguard share the skies with. The falcons mastered the skies before any airship, and this sword honors these flying marvels.

name: Skyguard Highblade
description: This sword is given to Skyguard knights who have proven themselves on the field of battle. Designed to look like a ship it represents how the knight is just as important as any ship in the sky.

name: SkyGuard Infector
description: The otherwise ordinary blade has been filled with an experimental poison that could slow down your foes upon contact.

name: Skyguard Officer's Blade
description: An elegant and deadly weapon issued to all Skyguard officers. Made of lightweight metals, it boasts great range without sacrificing balance.

name: Skyguard Recruit Blade
description: If this is the recruit training blade, just imagine what they'll wield once they graduate into full Skyguards!

name: SkyGuard Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Slasher of Wrath
description: These Mysterious SpiritHunters are rumored to be sent from the depths of Bludrut Keep to purge the land of evil entities and to safeguard against supernatural forces that threaten the realm. Even the Shadowscythe fear to travel near Bludrut Keep.

name: Slashing Rabbit
description: Slice and slash through your enemies with ease using these contour curves inspired by our favorite fuzzy, egg delivering buns!

name: Slayer of Beasts Blade
description: Warmly Tip: Defeat beast, take for armor.  Best use!

name: Slayer of Time
description: As the end of the world draws near, make you have blade ready. All that is left now is survival!

name: Slayer Recruit's Blade
description: Hate dragons? Did one burn down your house? Does the name Targaryan cause rage? Then you've joined the right squad!

name: Slayer's Neophyte Broadsword
description: Don these shady garments to slither into your local shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Sleek Katana
description: An extremely sharp blade with a mirror finish. This katana can cut through the wind with ease. Oh, and your opponents, too.

name: SleuthHound Blade
description: Sniff out adventure with this silver and gold blade! Best suited for Gumshoes--but not those with gum on their shoes.

name: Slice of Awe
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary slice of pizza will experience MASSIVE FLAVOR!

name: Slice of Cheese
description: Not much you can do with a slice of cheese as a weapon. ANY fire monster can melt it… to a make a Grilled Cheese Hero sandwich!

name: Slice of Darkness
description: Truly an inspirational work of strength, this blade will cleave even the hardest enemy in two. Look at its dark brilliance, the wondrous glow of its Chaotic essence. Take it. Take it now!

name: Slicing Blade of Order
description: Carve through the forces of Chaos to save Lore!

name: Slime Collector's Arm
description: So gross. Why did you have to pick that up?

name: Slime Sword
description: Made from Ektorax's saliva.

name: Slimeviscerate
description: Mow down slimy enemies with the stuff they've been made from.

name: Slithering Hunter's Knife
description: Don these shady garments to slither into your local shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Sludge Sword
description: Glorp

name: Smaragdine Dagger
description: A dagger cut from a sharp, vibrant green gemstone. It's meant to be used in rituals and ceremonies. Anyone cut by this blade will never be able to break a promise or share your secrets.

name: Smart Sword
description: This sword was engineered to be so smart, it could fight the battle for you! The scientist forgot one thing, though… swords don't have legs. Or arms.

name: Smoky DeathBlade
description: Send the opposition back to the Shadow Realm with a single strike of your blade.

name: Snake Katana 13
description: COLOR CUSTOM: In the Zodiac, the Snake is exciting, collected and dark. They are smooth and never lose their cool. Are you cold blooded enough to handle the Water Katanas?

name: Snazzy Umbrella Lance
description: Sturdy beach umbrellas make decent lances and shields whenever they're not keeping you from being cooked alive when sunbathing.

name: Snickerdoodle Sword
description: Congratulations on making one of the sweetest treats in Frostval 2013 Cookie Contest!

name: Snow Hanafuyu
description: A blade that was forged under a persimmon tree in spring. It belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Snowborn Fae Blade (0 AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands.

name: Snowborn Fae Blade (AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands.

name: Snowheart Needle
description: This is a larger form of the original needle used to sew and stitch the FrostFire Lord's clothes. Ice and Fire magic need to be woven into their robes, or else they'll fall apart.

name: Snowshade Carrion Carver (AC)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late.

name: Snowshade Carrion Carver (Non-AC)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late.

name: Snowshade Carrion Greatsword (0 AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Snowshade Carrion Greatsword (AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Snowshade Carrion Longsword (0 AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Snowshade Carrion Longsword (AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: SnowStalker's BoneSword
description: If you go down the woods today, you're in for a big surprise. These hunters come out during the icy months to track prey that only comes out during winter.

name: Soft Light, Hard Edge
description: Your opponents will have no idea just how deadly you are when you confront them while wielding this blade!

name: Sol Accendo
description: A blade tempered by flames from distant nebulas, forged with the intent to burn hotter than the sun. The regal blade is highly unstable, and its wielder doesn't care if it reduces everything to ash, so long as they shine the brightest.

name: Sol Gloria
description: A blade tempered by flames from distant nebulas, forged with the intent to burn hotter than the sun. The regal blade is highly unstable, and its wielder doesn't care if it reduces everything to ash, so long as they shine the brightest.

name: Sol Intenso
description: A branched blade that resembles sunlight scattering through the trees. When plunged into the heart of dark creatures, it will spread light through their veins.

name: Solar Dragon Rapier
description: A golden rapier graciously donated to the Skyguard by a curious Dragon, in exchange for quicky entry and a high rank. The new recruit was scolded, but allowed entry after accomplishing the same tests everyone else took.

name: Solar Flare Naval Cutlass
description: A unique cutlass of solid golden fire. It can produce radiation if held up to the sun, granting you an edge in the coldest nights and a fight where you are outnumbered. This cutlass gives 25% more gold when equipped.

name: Solar Naval Cutlass
description: A unique cutlass of solid golden fire. It can produce radiation if held up to the sun, granting you an edge in the coldest nights and a fight where you are outnumbered.

name: Solar Pirate's Cutlass
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it. You're a Solar pirate go where those winds take you.

name: Solar Pirate's Rapier
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it. You're a Solar pirate go where those winds take you.

name: Solar Spike
description: Harness the power of the Sun! And after a few critical hits, your enemy is done.

name: Solar Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 8th Upholders on the game's eighth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Solar Tongue
description: For the wielder, this sword is a welcome warmth on any day. But for the enemy it is a scalding, burning tool of vengeance; one that will leave a lasting impression.

name: Solarbrand
description: ﻿﻿The breath of a sun deity was torn from its lungs, and used to temper this blade. Somewhere in the Northlands, the sun is cursed to never rise again, for it is now your constant companion.

name: SolarFire Blade
description: The heart of fire gives these beings their power. Their everlasting heat will burn down their enemies.

name: Solaris Double-Sided Khopesh
description: The Solaris Clan is accompanied by the rays of the sun no matter where they go.

name: Solaris Sunbeam Saber
description: The Solaris Clan is accompanied by the rays of the sun no matter where they go.

name: Sole Bloodletter of Nulgath
description: The sole blades of the Blood Void.

name: Solidified TimeBlade
description: Drops of condensation from the Timestream fell off Iadoa as he fled. Cysero has melded those drops into this bright blade. Wield it well, and who knows when you'll be defeated?

name: Solo Ship Captain's Cutlass
description: You are the master of your fate. You are the captain of your solo ship.

name: Solstice Pulse Blade (0 AC)
description: Its steel is warm to the touch, its magic growing stronger as the days grow longer. At the peak of the solstice, one could part the clouds with a single slash.

name: Solstice Pulse Blade (AC)
description: Its steel is warm to the touch, its magic growing stronger as the days grow longer. At the peak of the solstice, one could part the clouds with a single slash.

name: Solstice Pulse Sword (0 AC)
description: Its steel is warm to the touch, its magic growing stronger as the days grow longer. At the peak of the solstice, one could part the clouds with a single slash.

name: Solstice Pulse Sword (AC)
description: Its steel is warm to the touch, its magic growing stronger as the days grow longer. At the peak of the solstice, one could part the clouds with a single slash.

name: Sonic Sword-Driver
description: It's time for AE to head to Dragon*Con again, and you know what they say about sonic sword-drivers: never leave home without them!

name: Sonnet of Elegance
description: During Heroes Heart Day tourneys, courtiers wield these rapiers and act out scenes from legends of love. “I have not broken your heart - you have broken it; and in breaking it, you have broken mine.”

name: Sorcerer's Shadow Spell Blade
description: Sorcerers who support the Shadowscythe are among the deadliest in Lore. Hiding their faces, they move among the rest of the army without anyone knowing who they are.

name: Sorrow Sword
description: Yarrr! Your name - and your skill with a cutlass - will live on in infamy. FOREVER.

name: Soul Corroding Betrayal Blade
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to enfeeble the soul of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, the Archfiend was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Soul Devouring Katana (0 AC)
description: Lore has always been a world for the lawless. This blade - which once cut down men for its own entertainment and glory - now devours souls on behalf of the law of the Legion.

name: Soul Devouring Katana (AC)
description: Lore has always been a world for the lawless. This blade - which once cut down men for its own entertainment and glory - now devours souls on behalf of the law of the Legion.

name: Soul Eater
description: No one really leaves the Legion. Not even the finality of Death can save them from their fate, forged into a blade of howling souls, hungering for new blood.

name: Soul Eater Advanced (1)
description: A symbol of the Undead Legion, few have ever had the privilege of seeing such a blade, let alone wield it. Your ruthless antics coincide with extreme luck.

name: Soul Eater Advanced (2)
description: A symbol of the Undead Legion, few have ever had the privilege of seeing such a blade, let alone wield it. Your ruthless antics coincide with extreme luck.

name: Soul Eater Sword
description: Designed by DarkonDrago, this intricate blade will dazzle your allies and petrify your foes!

name: Soul Kris
description: Slay Dage the Evil's enemies with this blade and you'll steal their souls to increase his power! Only a true devoted follower of Dage will do what is necessary to purchase this blade.

name: Soul Mender
description: Quibble says he found this sword in a temple before the second great peace accord. Deathknights were known to wield such sinister weapons to steal their enemies souls…Hallowed Knight's were known to wield such glorious weapons to heal their enemies torn souls…

name: Soul of the Space
description: I call upon the heavens above to help me vanquish my enemies!

name: Soul Reaper Blade
description: Reap what you Soul! Forged by the hero DevilMayCry, this mammoth blade grows more powerful with every soul it consumes…

name: Soul Ripper
description: Quibble says he found this sword on the battlefield after the second great war. Deathknights were known to wield such sinister weapons to steal their enemies souls…

name: Soul's Bane
description: Beware, adventurer. Choose your actions wisely, for this sword has a tendency to take the soul of those who use it. The most recent unfortunates can be seen of the hilt, mouths agape. Make sure you aren't the next addition.

name: Soul Sapper
description: Mmmm… sappy souls go great with Soluna City pancakes. You need a knife this big to slice up Mecha-sized fried cake.

name: Soul Terror Sword
description: Spirits slain by this sword still haunt this blade.

name: SoulBane of New Life
description: Smooth, cool and mysterious, the runes on this blade glow with the fortitude you need to get through your battle. No matter what you go through, what you endure, this sword, designed by Hero Demon Redwolf EADS, will bring you a renewal of strength, purpose and life after each battle.

name: SoulBiter
description: This sword was forged from black magic. It thirsts for bloodshed is never ending. And if the sword its thirst isn't quenched, they say the sword will actually drain life energy from its owner.

name: SoulBound Diabolical Blade
description: A sacrificial sword, the user is forever bound to this sword until either breaks, what happens.

name: Soulcursed Vanquisher
description: Bido created these weapons when experimenting with different materials. He's personally fond of his own weapons so he offered these to you.

name: SoulDevourer Blade (0 AC)
description: You can hear a whisper coming from the sword: "Valoria… will… fall…"

name: SoulDevourer Blade (AC)
description: You can hear a whisper coming from the sword: "Valoria… will… fall…"

name: SoulEater's Dark Claymore
description: The sword's thirst for destruction and screams echos in your mind the moment you stare right into it's eyes. Look away or a dark spirit will take control of your body. It's usually best if you wield it blindfolded.

name: Soulfire Desecrator
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: Soulfire Odachi
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: Soulflare (Sword)
description: The gold in this sword will send any dullahan galloping.

name: Soulforged Cutlass (AC)
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner; SoulWeaver Naval Commanders always choose a water, air, or storm elemental.

name: Soulforged Cutlass (Non-AC)
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner; SoulWeaver Naval Commanders always choose a water, air, or storm elemental.

name: Soulharvest Katana
description: You unlocked this weapon by purchasing the Undead Legion Logo t-shirt from heromart. Evil salutes you!

name: SoulKeeper Blade
description: A blade to harvest souls… and extract the memories that come with them? Axeros and the Dark Hand must have an even darker purpose.

name: SoulKnight's Render Blade (0 AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: SoulKnight's Render Blade (AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: SoulReaper's Katana (AC)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: SoulReaper's Katana (Non-AC)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: SoulReaper's Offering (0 AC)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: SoulReaper's Offering (AC)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: SoulTaker of the Legion
description: Slice through the Shadows with the darkest blade of them all, crafted by Darkon in honor of the Undead Legion!

name: SoulWeaver Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the 13th Upholders during the AdventureQuest Worlds 13th anniversary! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Sovereign
description: Made by King Alteon's finest smith, Zukai, this blade was commissioned and used by Sepulchure himself before he became the legendary doomknight.

name: Sovereign's Merciless Blade
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Space Katana
description: In space, no one can hear your screams as you slice off one of their limbs.

name: Space Pirate Cutlass
description: *No description*

name: Space-timeless Sword
description: Time is cyclical… who knows from where (or when?) the Chronocide got these weapons. Doesn't matter - it's yours now!

name: Sparkly IceCream Sword (0 AC)
description: It's amazing what doesn't melt in the summer sun… when you treat it properly.

name: Sparkly IceCream Sword (AC)
description: It's amazing what doesn't melt in the summer sun… when you treat it properly.

name: Spectral Cutlass
description: When a person dies and becomes a ghost, they become all spectral-like. Same with their clothes and weapons. If they drop their sword, does it just stay ghostly? Are these the souls of dead swords? How? Why?

name: Spectral NovaBlade Alnitak
description: A mystic blade forged with the light of a pale supergiant, born from the merging of stars. Alnitak is an omen that always comes in threes. Should one overcome a triple challenge with its namesake, they will be given cosmic sight.

name: Spectral StarEdge Saiph
description: A mystic blade forged with the light of a pale supergiant, born from the merging of stars. Saiph favors those who stare into the beyond, reaching into the dangers of the cosmos for the pure sake of knowing what's there.

name: Speirling Blade
description: Legends say that the Avatar Haeos sent a lightning bolt down to his First Champion. Gaheris caught it in his hand, and it became his sword. This blade is a copy of the fabled original.

name: Speirling Dagger
description: Instruments of interrogation as well as deadly weapons. The crackle of electricity is constant, and reminds the wielder of the consequences of failure.

name: Speirling Gaheris Blade
description: Legends say that the Avatar Haeos sent a lightning bolt down to his First Champion. Gaheris caught it in his hand, and it became his sword.

name: Speirling Guardian Dagger
description: The original gilded dagger wielded by the First Champion of Energy's younger brother. Its gold can be traced back to Camlan, where Light and Lightning clashed for dominion over the continent that would one day become Greenguard.

name: SpellFrost Blade
description: SpellFrost Mages are known for their mastery of Cryomancy. They are among the most skilled mages of the Northlands, and the sapphire gems they wear are made of crystallized skyfire.

name: SpellFrost Empowered Blade
description: SpellFrost Mages are known for their mastery of Cryomancy. They are among the most skilled mages of the Northlands, and the sapphire gems they wear are made of crystallized skyfire.

name: SpellSword's Flame Blade
description: Spellswords draw magic from the ley lines and imbue their blades with it. ShadowFlame Spellswords mix their magic with Malgor's Darkness and are feared across Lore.

name: Spiderkin Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Spiked Gu Duo
description: A mace meant to crush bones and prevent movement, not to take life. Oft it is told in times of great strife, being forced to live on like this is a punishment in of itself.

name: Spinal Debris Sword
description: There were a number of extremities that had to be cut off of Creature 10. Re played around with the leftovers, and gave the Chimera what she called "utensils." She then set them loose, and told them to go make their own lunch.

name: Spined Gutter
description: Formed from precious metals and the skull of a most unfortunate beast, only a horc could truly appreciate significance of this blade.

name: Spirit Blade
description: The scepter of the Black Hole Sun Priests. Who knows what power lurks within.

name: Spirit Harvester's Blade
description: It's the time of year when all things are harvested… including spirits!

name: Spirit Harvester's Sheathed Sword
description: It's the time of year when all things are harvested… including spirits!

name: Spirit Katana of Wrath
description: These Mysterious SpiritHunters are rumored to be sent from the depths of Bludrut Keep to purge the land of evil entities and to safeguard against supernatural forces that threaten the realm. Even the Shadowscythe fear to travel near Bludrut Keep.

name: Spirit of Ice Blade
description: The spirit of ice gives thes beings their power. Their evertasting chill will freeze their enemies to the core.

name: Spirit Oni Sword
description: This blade is drenched in blood, but Oni are innocent in the worst way. They can't comprehend right and wrong, only understanding what feels good to them. It's unfair, but allows them to reincarnate without issue.

name: Spirit Sword
description: A mystical blade forged from lost, forgotten spirits. Perhaps the creator, Ichidori, can reveal more about this hauntingly beautiful sword's mythos.

name: SpiritHunter Katana
description: The pulsing red glow of this otherworldly katana will attract spirits whose natures push them towards revenge and anger.

name: Split Blade of the Deep
description: *No description*

name: Split Blade of the Void
description: The ShadowFlame army is deadly in ANY world… but especially inside the Void. You've earned the right to wield this weapon, but take care you do not succumb to its dark power.

name: Stable Ghostly Cutlass (0 AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones' locker.

name: Stable Ghostly Cutlass (AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones' locker.

name: Stained Edge
description: Remember the warrior code. Honor your blade. Treat it wisely and it will serve you well.

name: Stained Glass Faerie's Claymore
description: Blue and purple, gold and green,

name: Stalagbite's Fang
description: The breath of the dragon molted into a sword. +3% rep bonus.

name: Standard Shortsword
description: This weapon was crafted by a blacksmith's apprentice to practice when weapon making. It's nothing fancy but it will get the job done.

name: Star Dancer's Katana
description: A katana made from the green flickers of a distant kingly planet, used in sword dances and in combat to protect the wise words of an Emperor.

name: Star Gale Piercer
description: In the void sea, there's no air to breathe but great glittering star storms rage and prevent explorers from reaching their dreams. The Star Piercers were forged to tear through and make way for progress.

name: Star Katana
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 11th Upholders on the game's eleventh birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Shaper 1st Contact
description: (1) [[ IGNORE THE MESSAGE _ _ ]]

name: Star Slasher
description: Quibble hastily mentions something about Star.. fighters.. captains or was it pirates? All you know is Quibble wants to get rid of it fast so is willing to sell it for a bargain.

name: Star Sword
description: This blade seems to harness the power of light itself. It's a force to be reckoned with.

name: Star Sword Breaker
description: This weapon was crafted by a strange race of beings. It was designed to be the only weapon capable of fighting a Starsword, but it was lost before it could be put into production.

name: Star Sword of Awe
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by the Blade of Awe. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Carnax
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Carnax, the iconic boss originally released in AdventureQuest. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Conquest
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by the Legion Horseman of Conquest. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Death
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by the Legion Horseman of Death. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Debris
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by creatures from the Elegy of Madness saga. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Famine
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by the Legion Horseman of Famine. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Madness
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by creatures from the Elegy of Madness saga. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Nulgath
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 11th Upholders on the game's eleventh birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of Shadows
description: This specially-crafted shadowy Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of the Healer
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Juvania. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of the M4tr1x
description: This Star Sword is a visible representation of the code the AQWorlds game engine is built on. As a special bonus for this milestone year, the blade is color-customizable to Trim.

name: Star Sword of the Mage
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Arcana. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of the Warrior
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Thok. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Star Sword of War
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by the Legion Horseman of War. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Starchy Sock Blade
description: Man, whoever lost this REALLY had a heavy hand with the starch. This sock is so stiff it's lethal!

name: StarCrasher Lightblade
description: May the Fourth be with you!

name: Starfire Sword
description: The powers of Fire and Lightning have been forged together to make this blade.

name: StarGazer Blade
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: StarGazer Sword
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: Stark Groglurk Sword
description: Simple, but useful, no flashy frills for the Groglurk Knights.

name: Stark's Brilliant Ice Blade
description: This weapon was once known as "Stark's Ice," recovered during an expedition to the Blinding Snow zone… but no longer! Winter is still coming, but with a weapon this golden you can wield it in any royal court at any time of year.

name: Stark's Ice
description: "Winter is Coming."

name: Starlight & Lace Saber
description: Forged beneath the branches Chiral Valley’s crystal tree, this blade gleams with every color of the dawn.

name: Starlight Saber
description: Schwiiiiiiiing! Bwwwwwzap! Fwooooosh! Use this Forceful green starlight saber to conquer your enemies all across the galaxy!

name: Starlight Sword
description: Forged from the light of stars, there is no better weapon for defeating the nightmare of the moon.

name: StarLord Laser Prime
description: When dealing with interstellar traveling, you should always carry a plasma blade. Who knows what type of alien lifeforms your going to have to slay.

name: Starry Samurai's Sword
description: This blade was forged out of spacedust mined from a nearby galaxy and presented by the Royal Astromancer's Society to Empress Miko as a gift for this year's star festival.

name: StarWalker Light Blade (AC)
description: "You can't stop the change, any more than you can stop time from passing."

name: StarWalker Light Blade (Special)
description: "You can't stop the change, any more than you can stop time from passing."

name: Static Pyro Blade
description: Spark your inner flame with this technological torcher.

name: Stealth Ops Cold Steel Kukri (AC)
description: A skilled hand can use this blade to cut through bones like butter before the enemy realizes that they've been reduced to cubes.

name: Stealth Ops Cold Steel Kukri (Non-AC)
description: A skilled hand can use this blade to cut through bones like butter before the enemy realizes that they've been reduced to cubes.

name: Steampunk Fangblade (0 AC)
description: A blade that has yet to reach its full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Steampunk Fangblade (AC)
description: A blade that has yet to reach its full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Steampunk Knuckle Sword
description: Merry Frostval and Happy New Year!

name: Steampunk Saber
description: A handy sword for any swash-buckling explorer!

name: Steamsaw Blade
description: As if one blade isn't enough, this weapon was created with perfect results in mind. Multiple blades spin on a gear specially made to grind and slice through most, if not all armor. Scales? Not a problem. Metallic skin? Simply shredded. Leathery skin? Call a mortician.

name: Steel Blade of Swordhaven
description: This blade was given to you for answering Loremaster Maya's question. Thank you for your feedback, Hero!

name: Steel Skye Blade
description: Used by Skye Warriors who choose not to sully their blade with the blood of lesser enemies.

name: Steelscream Cleaver
description: Gives the phrase "a little off the top" to a whole new meaning.

name: Stella dei Miracoli
description: This sparkling blade of festive wishes hides a darker story. A Knight tried to save his Lady from a wedding she didn't want. He was caught, and sentenced to death. The Noblewoman wished for a miracle, but the stars fell too late.

name: Stella Empyrean Blade
description: Ambitious stars have merged into one in order to fulfill a shared wish - to become the blade that commands dominion over the universe.

name: Stella Empyrean Katana
description: Suzaku, Seiryu, Byakko, and Genbu - the four constellations that fused into the Nova Empyrean have pulled a divine blade from their body. The katana can cut fate, cursing your foes to an eternity los and aimless.

name: Stella Fomalhaut
description: A silver replica made in the image of one of House Noelle's ancestral armaments. It's said that stars used to visit the Yew Mountain Chain, and gave parts of themselves to those who braved the peaks to meet the heavens.

name: Stellar BattleMage Blade (AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Stellar BattleMage Blade (Non-AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Stellar BattleMage Claymore (0 AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Stellar BattleMage Claymore (AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Stellar Blade of Stars
description: One of the three swords that have seen many galaxies and wielded by many that were capable of shaping the stars and moons. Now it will experience a whole new journey with you.

name: Stellar Khopesh
description: Battle the undead with the power of moonlight! This weapon will do 30% more damage against undead when equipped.

name: Stellar Royalty's Rapier
description: With a throne made of stardust, you rule over an endless sea of galaxies. Your brilliance cannot be matched, and your reign will last as long as the stars themselves.

name: Stellar Royalty's Sheathed Sword
description: With a throne made of stardust, you rule over an endless sea of galaxies. Your brilliance cannot be matched, and your reign will last as long as the stars themselves.

name: Stellar Royalty's Sword
description: With a throne made of stardust, you rule over an endless sea of galaxies. Your brilliance cannot be matched, and your reign will last as long as the stars themselves.

name: Stellar Spendor Sword
description: A blade made of crystals, kissed by ten Fairy Kings and Queens. Enchanted by their magic, this regalia will lead its master to a throne of their own.

name: Stellar Splendor Rapier
description: A blade made of crystals, kissed by ten Fairy Kings and Queens. Enchanted by their magic, this regalia will lead its master to a throne of their own.

name: Stellar Steel Dagger
description: The life of a dying star hyper compressed into a weapon that can tear open holes in space. A feat of this nature should be forbidden, but that thinking holds us back from our true potential.

name: Stellar Steel Dirk
description: The life of a dying star hyper compressed into a weapon that can tear open holes in space. A feat of this nature should be forbidden, but that thinking holds us back from our true potential.

name: Stellar Steel Reaver
description: The life of a dying star hyper compressed into a weapon that can tear open holes in space. A feat of this nature should be forbidden, but that thinking holds us back from our true potential.

name: Stellar Steel Ripper
description: The life of a dying star hyper compressed into a weapon that can tear open holes in space. A feat of this nature should be forbidden, but that thinking holds us back from our true potential.

name: Stelle Invernali
description: This sparkling blade of festive wishes hides a darker story. A Knight tried to save his Lady from a wedding she didn't want. He was caught, and sentenced to death. The Noblewoman wished for a miracle, but the stars fell too late.

name: Sterling Dragonlord MasterBlade
description: When a Dragonlord dies, their partner takes this blade from their tomb, and carries it to someone worthy of inheriting an ancient legacy. One day, it will be the Dragonlord who delivers it to a Dragon.

name: Sterling Drake Flamberge
description: The wavy shape of the blade catches the fancy of many Dragons. It resembles a breath of fire frozen in motion.

name: Sterling Drake Stinger
description: Affectionately called a stinger because, at most, it would feel like a pinprick to a Dragon. Dragonlords use this to handle mundane disputes.

name: SternLord's Aurum Blade (0 AC)
description: The indomitable spirit of the ArchAngel Nulgath lives in this blade, watching over those who risk their lives to protect the innocent.

name: SternLord's Aurum Blade (AC)
description: The indomitable spirit of the ArchAngel Nulgath lives in this blade, watching over those who risk their lives to protect the innocent.

name: Stinger's Stinger
description: You will feel this sword lending you its power with every breath you take.

name: Stolen Cutlass
description: I wonder from where these swords were stolen… and why they come in pairs?

name: Stolen Legion Blade
description: This blade was stolen from Dage by a traitor to the Legion.

name: Stone And Bone
description: This poor caveman must have valued that spar of stone more than his life. He clings to it even in death. And now YOU can use it as a weapon!

name: Stone's Fury
description: This massive dwarven claymore is covered with precious gems from the heart of the Dwarfhold Mountains and has a blade crafted from rune reenforced emerald.

name: Storm Caller Dagger
description: A blade used to cut into one's soul, unleashing a storm capable of riping an army to shreds. The sacrificial knife was needed to smother ancient fires of war. When the ashes settled, the weapon became a forbidden relic.

name: Storm Caller Knife
description: A blade used to cut into one's soul, unleashing a storm capable of riping an army to shreds. The sacrificial knife was needed to smother ancient fires of war. When the ashes settled, the weapon became a forbidden relic.

name: Storm Slicer
description: Slice through your enemies with a blade as sharp as the winds that howl down from the top of the Storm Temple's mountain!

name: Stormborn Blade of Awe
description: A stormborn version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will keep you safe in the midst of the worst weather. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: Stormbringer Katana
description: The life of a true warrior is as fleeting and brilliant as lightning. A katana that sparks with the rage of a ceaseless storm brings honor to those it strikes down.

name: Stormrunner Sword
description: When the sky is full of raging dragons, all you can do is grip your sword and run into the storm. Whether you come out alive is up to you!

name: Stratospheric Tachi
description: An ancient katana imbued with the element of wind, this blade has been with Stratos for years. It lashes out with blades of wind should anyone unworthy attempt to wield it.

name: Strawberry Ice Pop
description: Mmmm! Chill out with a strawberry ice pop. Who knows? Maybe the monsters you're defending against will want one, too.

name: Streamer's Edge
description: Slice through enemies like lag through a bad connection.

name: Street Beater Blade (AC)
description: You probably found this simply lying on the ground waiting to be used.

name: Street Beater Blade (Special)
description: You probably found this simply lying on the ground waiting to be used.

name: Strong Scimitar of Zal
description: It is said the oracles of the Djinn Realm can not only SEE into the future, but can also manipulate it. If that is true… do we really control our own fates? It MUST be a rumor.

name: Stygian Blade of Piracy
description: Unlike most pirate captains, these felons use a different kind of weapon, forged from pure obsidian of the Styx River.

name: Stygian Navigator's Rapier (0 AC)
description: The cold waters of the Underworld seep into the seas of the living. It's a reminder that death is everywhere, destruction is inevitable, and no soul escapes the tide of the Styx. The Underworld Lord's ships make sure of it.

name: Stygian Navigator's Rapier (AC)
description: The cold waters of the Underworld seep into the seas of the living. It's a reminder that death is everywhere, destruction is inevitable, and no soul escapes the tide of the Styx. The Underworld Lord's ships make sure of it.

name: Sub-Zero Blade
description: Brrrr! You are an ice-cold killer!

name: Sublimated ShadowSlayer's Saber
description: Each of us faces a choice in life… do we embrace the Shadow, or choose to battle its creatures? Those who seek Light and life will always choose the latter.

name: Subzero Avalanche Shortsword
description: Your enemies will freeze in fear when they see you approach wielding this weapon.

name: Subzero Avalanche Sword
description: Your enemies will freeze in fear when they see you approach wielding this weapon.

name: Sugar Syrup Syringe
description: Just a spoonful of sugar helps the medicine go down.. but do you REALLY want to ingest something brewed in Darkovia?! O_O

name: Sugary Sword
description: The most DELICIOUSLY dangerous weapon in your inventory!

name: Suki's Seraphic Sword
description: Eye for an Eye. The motto is engraved into the blade, striking fear into evil doers everywhere. But what of self-defense? What about duress? When morality becomes grey, the motto turns into an excuse for excessive violence. The words have become a curse hidden in the shadow of a lost paladin.

name: Suki's Sword
description: Eye for an Eye. The motto is engraved into the blade, striking fear into evil doers everywhere. But what of self-defense? What about duress? When morality becomes grey, the motto turns into an excuse for excessive violence. The words have become a curse hidden in the shadow of a lost paladin.

name: Sullied Blade
description: A draconian battle sword that was prundly wielded by a dracomancer, which followed him directly to his grave, tainting it in the process.

name: Sullied Blame Blade
description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but Heroes and Paladins can't handle its weight. The blade can only be wielded by sullied hands.

name: Sullied Ivory Blame Blade
description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but heroes and paladins can't handle the weight. The blade can only be wielded by sullied hands.

name: Sullied Katana
description: Contains a thin, but prickly blade that can cut even the wind currents into two, henceforth why it's praised as a secret weapon.

name: Summer Rescuer Oath Blade (0 AC)
description: Citizens Lifeguards are encouraged by the Crystallis Administration to follow all stated rules and procedures before attempting rescue. Failure to comply will result in censure or sanctioning.

name: Summer Rescuer Oath Blade (AC)
description: Citizens Lifeguards are encouraged by the Crystallis Administration to follow all stated rules and procedures before attempting rescue. Failure to comply will result in censure or sanctioning.

name: Sun Sabre
description: Sword of the burning sun!

name: Sundered Mullion (0 AC)
description: When the fallen's souls split, the two qualities that defined them most solidified and sharpened. Violence and purity were refined in Dage the Evil's forge.

name: Sundered Mullion (AC)
description: When the fallen's souls split, the two qualities that defined them most solidified and sharpened. Violence and purity were refined in Dage the Evil's forge.

name: Sunflower Claymore
description: Sunflowers are a symbol of loyalty and longevity, and their bright yellow color signals happiness, friendship, and intelligence. We hope you become rich in all of those attributes and qualities as you adventure through Lore!

name: Sunless Master Saber
description: The Saber was torn from the core of a Sun, transforming it into a black hole as a Fifth Master trapped the light in dark steel with their own bare hands.

name: Sunless Master Twin Saber
description: The Saber was torn from the core of a Sun, transforming it into a black hole as a Fifth Master trapped the light in dark steel with their own bare hands.

name: Super Scion Blade
description: Becoming a Super Scion is easy, it's the charging up that takes most of the time. Usually close to half an hour. Plus side is you'll look super cool!

name: Superbia
description: Superbia was a weapon of war forged in the name of good. But as the sword spilled more and more blood, it began to change. Now, many years after it was made, DarkonDrago's weapon is unrecognizable.

name: Supercharged Blade of Toxicity
description: Yeah sure it's glowing green, I'm sure it's totally safe…

name: Supercharged CyberVoid Sword +5
description: Made entirely of digital code, these minions have escaped from the cyberworld to do the bidding of their cyberfiend master.

name: Superior Mudluk Blade
description: Superior in design and natural selection, this blade has evolved into… something… deep within the bogs of Mudluk Swamp.

name: Supreme Artifact Blade
description: Since Artifact Hunters use both strength and intelligence, you should always have an elegant weapon at your side. (Chance for the Meteor Storm attack animation to appear.)

name: Surtara Gladius
description: Developed by the Bloodtusk Trolls, this deft and lightweight blade excels at close quarters. In the hands of a skilled user, it relentlessly cuts and stabs like a furious swarm of wasps.

name: Swanhild's Revenge (0 AC)
description: Upon the unhonorable slaying of their kin, all members of the Frostlorn Clan are duty-bound to take brutal revenge. The snow will fall red upon the defiler's lands forevermore.

name: Swanhild's Revenge (AC)
description: Upon the unhonorable slaying of their kin, all members of the Frostlorn Clan are duty-bound to take brutal revenge. The snow will fall red upon the defiler's lands forevermore.

name: Swarthy Skean
description: A haunting aura surrounds this sinister sword, believed to have been forged within the deepest chasms of the Void. The blade itself is covered with a thick hide from an unidentified beast.

name: Swashbuckler's Rapier
description: Pirates come from all walks of life, even from the snooty tooty ranks of royal nobles. When dueling to the death wasn't enough, they took their rapier to sea.

name: Sweet Ambrosia
description: Like the nectar of the Arcadian gods, love is incredibly addictive to mortals, but it can easily burn them into nothing.

name: Sweet Poison's Kiss
description: Swordhaven's sole potion-making sorceress, Alina offers you the Poison's Kiss blade. It can kill or heal… depending on the choices you make in life. Gives +20 gold when equipped.

name: Sweet Spring Mage's Sword
description: Your magic is fueled by the scent of spring flowers, gentle rains, and the strains of sweet songs drifting through sunlit groves.

name: Sweet Star Sword Breaker (AC)
description: This weapon was crafted by a strange race of beings. It was designed to be the only weapon capable of fighting a Starsword, but was lost before it could be put into production.

name: Sweet Star Sword Breaker (Legend)
description: This weapon was crafted by a strange race of beings. It was designed to be the only weapon capable of fighting a Starsword, but was lost before it could be put into production.

name: Sweetened Chronomenace Blade
description: Rots your teeth at double time.

name: SwiftShift Knight's Blade
description: Hand crafted sword for a skilled swordsman.

name: Swirling Blood Blade
description: The outcome of one critical hit from this blade would b- negative.

name: Sword Fish
description: This type of sword is especially difficult to master.

name: Sword in the (Sand)Stone
description: If you can pull the sword out but leave the castle intact, you are the next King of the Beach!

name: Sword McLuck
description: Cut the air with the luck of the day and send the enemy to his grave. Handcrafted of the finest four leaf clovers and gold, this sword has amazing strength, durability and charm. Seize the day!

name: Sword of Abyssal Order
description: A symbol of prestige and absolute power in the Nation. Nulgath forged it in fire, and cooled it in his blood. Wielding the blade allows a Fiend to control others of their kind.

name: Sword Of Animus
description: This massive monstrosity was crafted by Vampirel28. The souls of the vanquished were drawn into the blade, causing it to squirm and writhe, as if alive. It continues to shift in your hand, more and more as you use it. Will the blade ever obtain enough souls to strike back at the wielder who trapped them there?

name: Sword of Brilliant Light
description: Brilliantly glowing burning bright, gives this sword its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Broken Dreams
description: Captured in this blade is a reflection of the sky in the Land of Dreams and Nightmares. Like the minds of those who stay too long in the realm, it has been irreparably shatterd. Take heed of the warning…

name: Sword of Burning
description: Harness the power of flame to incinerate your enemies!

name: Sword of Caledonia
description: An ancient blade forged in Caledonia, often used by brave-hearted warriors. Features a color custom accessory glow. Happy Lucky Day!

name: Sword of Chaorrupted Light
description: Chaorruption glows burning bright, gives this sword its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Cinder
description: Fueled by a fiery passion only to be used to slay your enemies.

name: Sword of Corundum Light
description: Corundum glows burning bright, gives this sword its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Creation
description: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. This sword sprang forth when the Sword of Ruin was called of into being.

name: Sword of Ctrl
description: U R N CTRL 0F UR 0WN D35T1NY!

name: Sword Of Dark Hope
description: This sword has been waiting for you since it was forged and placed at the heart of FrostDeep Dungeon countless ages ago. It might be your only hope of stopping Kezeroth's plan to destroy Lore.

name: Sword Of Del
description: A sword far superior to the Backspace Blade.

name: Sword Of Despair
description: This sword has been waiting for you since it was forged and placed at the heart of FlameHigh Dungeon countless ages ago. It might be your only hope of saving Kezeroth and helping his plan to save Lore.

name: Sword of Dragon Control
description: Dragon's are not the easiest beasts to tame, maybe this blade will help.

name: Sword of Eternal Light
description: Eternally glows burning bright, giving this its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Fabled Hope
description: The timelines may be separate, but hope springs eternal no matter where or when you are battling.

name: Sword of Gold
description: This set is 100% gold. Literally. Made out of the many gold coins you've saved up while adventuring. Talk about a status symbol!

name: Sword Of Hope (Sword)
description: This sword has been waiting for you since it was forged and placed at the heart of FrostDeep Dungeon countless ages ago. It might be your only hope of stopping Kezeroth's plan to destroy Lore.

name: Sword of Isthmia (0 AC)
description: A blade that hails from a sea sanctuary of pearls and plenty. The harsh predation of the ocean doesn't exist in this paradise…so why do its merpeople still need swords made of leviathan bones and fins?

name: Sword of Isthmia (AC)
description: A blade that hails from a sea sanctuary of pearls and plenty. The harsh predation of the ocean doesn't exist in this paradise…so why do its merpeople still need swords made of leviathan bones and fins?

name: Sword of Joyous Light
description: Joy glows burning bright, giving this its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Jubilant Light
description: Cheerful glows burning bright, giving this its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Malice
description: Infused with the souls of previous combatants this sword is only for those who've survived the Death Pit Arena.

name: Sword of Masters
description: WARNING: For use by masters only.

name: Sword of Midnight Light
description: Midnight burns in the night, gives this sword its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Misfortune
description: Everyone knows its bad luck to break a mirror… so to use a broken mirror blade in battle, that takes a level of confidence that only the greatest heroes possess!

name: Sword Of Priests
description: Once forged by Tomcat435 as a gift to Gjappy and the Divine Priests. In an untold story they lost all the swords at once because of a mischievous cat. They say Tomcat made the Divine Priest armor after this sword was lost.

name: Sword of Promised Victory
description: A sword of humble beginnings, uplifted by the machinations of fate.

name: Sword of Purity
description: A blade is what its wielder makes of it. Celestial Commander are expected to smite the wicked and humble the exalted with their sword. Are you capable of performing such tasks?

name: Sword of Rainbows
description: Despite this sword being incredibly lucky, your opponents will think otherwise. Irish you a Happy Lucky Day!

name: Sword of Ruin
description: Called from the elemental plane of darkness by a circle of Dark Druids, this sword was brought to this world to destroy anything touched by the Light.

name: Sword of Salvation (0 AC)
description: May salvation find you, even if all seems lost.

name: Sword of Salvation (AC)
description: May salvation find you, even if all seems lost.

name: Sword of Sanctuary
description: Protective magics are woven into the metal of this blade. It will project an image of nothingness around you when called upon, providing sanctuary even in the middle of a raging battlefield!

name: Sword of Screams
description: With a hack hack here and a slash slash there…

name: Sword of Shattered Reflections
description: The sword's blade isn't blood red… that's the reflection of the Ring of Fire solar eclipse gleaming malevolently back at you.

name: Sword of Soap
description: The Sisterhood of the Dishpan hands believes that cleanliness will save the world from Chaos… and they're right! Their expert soap carvers have crafted a blade modeled after the Sword of Hope. It can be yours… if it doesn't get wet. (Gives +100 to hygiene.)

name: Sword of Soothing Light
description: Softly glowing burning bright, giving this its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Sorcery
description: Only in the mirror realm would a sorcerer use a sword.

name: Sword of Sorrow
description: This sword sings your enemies' sorrows, bringing joy to all of your allies. Wield it well, warrior!

name: Sword of Surprises
description: Wait for it… O_O

name: Sword of Sweet Nomming
description: Creativity is a must when it comes to adventuring. But when an adventurer combines their battling creativity with major cookie skillz, the results are nommilicious. For the cookie creator, this sword is sure to be a great reminder of such creativity.

name: Sword of Swordlyness
description: I will give you my word but not my sw….word!

name: Sword of the Bat
description: Nana nana nana nana nana nana Bat… sword?!

name: Sword of the Depths
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: a ghostly hand grasps this blade aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… it is a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Sword of the Ebon Drake
description: Some people like their dragons like they like their coffee: dark roasted and rich.

name: Sword of the Forsaken
description: An elite cadre of sentient undead known as The Forsaken wield these weapons. They bow to no master but themselves.

name: Sword of the Golden Drake
description: I'm not even going to ask where the weapon smith got access to a dragon head to model this off of.

name: Sword of the Great Den
description: Forged by the great King Alteon, this prized blade has been used to defeat all types of Evil throughout Lore. After General Lionfang defeated a great Necromancer and became one step closer to purging Lore of Chaos, the King presented Lionfang with this blade as a reward.

name: Sword of the Lost
description: This sword looks like it's been in the sewer for a long time. Will it even still cut?

name: Sword of the Mist
description: A relic from a time before the light; when time was not yet known, and worlds had yet to exist…

name: Sword of the Northlands
description: A sword crafted long ago by the people of the Frozen Northlands.

name: Sword of the Oracle
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Protect yourself. The truth always hurts.

name: Sword of the Patriots
description: Battleon is the home of the brraaaavvvvee! Wield a symbol of liberty as you deliver critical amounts of freedom!

name: Sword of the Protector
description: For Lore!

name: Sword of The Underworld
description: This sword was first forged when Dage the Evil first declared that the Underworld would be his. Rise, reclaim, and reign. His words imbue the blade with a deep possessive magic.

name: Sword of the Unicorn
description: The blade of this sword was modled off of the icy horn of the mythical Unicorn.

name: Sword of the Vilifier
description: Adventurers who wield this blade are given the almighty task of upholding evil and corrupting the innocent.

name: Sword of the Vindicator
description: Adventurers who wield this blade are given the task of upholding justice and protection of the innocent.

name: Sword of Toxic Light
description: Toxic glowing burning bright, giving this its lovely light. (3% chance to do the Mind attack animation, 15% rep boost)

name: Sword of Unwavering Spite
description: There is no greater Evil than that of those who once believed in Good.

name: Sword of Voids
description: The power of the void is imbued within this sword.

name: Sword out of the Stone
description: Legend says that the One who pulls the Sword from the Stone shall be made KING! …but you can settle with just a shiny silver sword, right?

name: Sword Shaped Giftbox (AC)
description: A present shaped like a sword! Save this and it will magically open at the start of the new year. No peeking!

name: Sword Shaped Giftbox (Non-AC)
description: A present shaped like a sword! Save this and it will magically open at the start of the new year. No peeking!

name: Sword-shaped Present
description: It may not look sharp, but believe it or not, it does dish out some nasty paper cuts!

name: Swordaphone
description: Keep up the funky beat and smooth jazz with this literal instrument of terror!

name: Swordhaven Commander's Royal Sword (0 AC)
description: For many years, King Alteon has ruled Swordhaven with a fair and just hand. His fight to defeat Chaos will NEVER stop until all of Lore -- and everyone he loves -- is safe again.

name: Swordhaven Commander's Royal Sword (AC)
description: For many years, King Alteon has ruled Swordhaven with a fair and just hand. His fight to defeat Chaos will NEVER stop until all of Lore -- and everyone he loves -- is safe again.

name: Swordhaven Defender Star Sword
description: The Royal City of Swordhaven is home to Good heroes of many classes, races, and levels. But all are united in one purpose: defending their home and friends from any threat.

name: Swordhaven Guard's Blade
description: Swordhaven's old guard proudly lift their battle-hardened blades. They served the King, protect the Queen, and will defend the realm forevermore.

name: Swordhaven Pirate Captain Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Avast me hearties! Some of the Knights of Swordhaven have turned to piracy!

name: Swordhaven Pirate Captain Cutlass (AC)
description: Avast me hearties! Some of the Knights of Swordhaven have turned to piracy!

name: Swordhaven Pirate Captain Rapier (AC)
description: Avast me hearties! Some of the Knights of Swordhaven have turned to piracy!

name: Swordhaven Pirate Captain Rapier (Legend)
description: Avast me hearties! Some of the Knights of Swordhaven have turned to piracy!

name: Swordhaven Prestige Blade
description: A ceremonial sword weilded by nobles capable of combat and offensive light magic. This sword glows from their attunment to Light, magnifying the grace and purity that has become one with the element's image.

name: Swordhaven Scout's Dagger
description: Spies and Spy Masters are a thing of the tyrannical past. But if there was, hypothetically, a Swordhaven Spymaster that exists presently…They would have started as a Scout, with a dagger just like this.

name: SwordPhish
description: Phight your phoes with a phunkadelic phish!

name: Sylvienth Steel
description: A dark and steel that keeps its edge like few other materials but also remains mysteriously cold.

name: Symphonic Espressivo
description: The harp and its light draw out the music of your very soul. To wield it, one must dance and express the will of their life. As a consequence, many have died young with this in hand, yet they shone brighter than the stars.

name: Symphony Of Sorrow
description: You rule all who enter your domain; their blood, breath, and bones all belong to YOU. And should any choose to challenge you… well, you can always use a new ghoul or two to serve you.

name: Synderes' Blade of Shadows
description: Synderes' Blade of Shadows has revealed its true form! Will you embrace the darkness, or choose to defy it?

name: Tactical Cutlass
description: A blade given to all Skyguard Tacticians. It serves as a symbol of rank and a powerful defensive weapon.

name: Tainted Barbarian Blade of Nulgath
description: In crossing between the OverSoul and our world, the Barbarian Blade Nulgath crafted became irevocably tainted.

name: Tainted Blade of Na'al
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this blade. It is a testament to your victory in the Infernal Arena.

name: Tainted Claymore
