description: Nulgath's enchanter, Skew, imbues your ordinary Warrior Claymore Blade with powerful dark energy. You wonder what other items he might be able to transform.

name: Tainted Dagger of Na'al
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this blade. It is a testament to your victory in the Infernal Arena.

name: Tainted Destruction Blade
description: Do you wish you could summon clouds of shadows to hide in and ambush your foes? With this fiendish blade, now you can.

name: Tainted Harbinger Blade
description: Listen…can you hear the whispers of the souls this blade has consumed?

name: Tainted Naval Wave Blade (0 AC)
description: YARRRR! Th' ArchFiend recruite only th' fiercest pirates t' his fiendish crew o' seafarin' thieves. (Glow is CC to Trim)

name: Tainted Naval Wave Blade (AC)
description: YARRRR! Th' ArchFiend recruite only th' fiercest pirates t' his fiendish crew o' seafarin' thieves. (Glow is CC to Trim)

name: Tannenbaum's Tinder
description: Perhaps not the BEST weapon to use against angry snow monsters, but if all else fails, you can always set it on fire!

name: Tarandus Battle Blade
description: It's rumored that the Tarandus do not use weapons, but instead do battle with their mighty antlers. We can't expect YOU to do that without breaking your skull so here's a sword

name: Tarnished Grace
description: Along with his twin, Apa, Eta has been entrusted by the Crystallis administration to oversee all of the soldiers on the Shinkansen.

name: Taro's Manslayer
description: Taro had fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. (You can probably relate.) His spirit, experience and discipline are captured in this sword. Use it well…

name: Taro's Pretty Manslayer
description: Taro had fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. (You can probably relate.)… and then Beleen got ahold of it and turned it Pink!

name: Taro's Prismatic Manslayer
description: Taro had fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. ( You can probably relate.) His spirit, experience and discipline are captured in this sword. Use it well… (Blade is CC. Weapon does 30% more damage to all monsters.)

name: Tartarus Keyblade
description: A mysterious futuristic keyblade of unknown origin.

name: Tasty Muffin
description: No, you can't be a mod. But please enjoy this complimentary blueberry muffin, instead.

name: Tech Blade
description: Slice it up with a deadly tech blade, StarCaptain style!

name: Tech Blade Of Awe
description: AWWWWWEEE YEAH! Deuce from ED serves up some tech love for the iconic blade.

name: Techno Chaos Blade
description: You can feel the chaos emanting from this polearm. Do not stare into its eyes or you'll risk madness! This weapon gives a 10% bonus to Chaos. (This item goes rare on July 30th)

name: Techno Chaos Champion Sword (0 AC)
description: The legendary sword that has been by Drakath for nearly 6 years. Sooo…chaorrupted. (Gives 5% more damage against Chaos monsters AND 5% more XP!)

name: Techno Chaos Champion Sword (AC)
description: The legendary sword that has been by Drakath for nearly 6 years. Sooo…chaorrupted. (Gives 5% more damage against Chaos monsters AND 5% more XP!)

name: Techno DOOMFire Blade
description: Deadtech + Shadowscythe = Techtronic Doom!

name: Techno Doomlord's Blade (0 AC)
description: This monstrous blade was once powerful enough to split one kingdom into sixteen regions during a costly uprising. Are you sure you want to risk wielding it?

name: Techno Doomlord's Blade (AC)
description: This monstrous blade was once powerful enough to split one kingdom into sixteen regions during a costly uprising. Are you sure you want to risk wielding it?

name: Techno Hanzamune Blade
description: A legendary blade crafted by the greatest Yokai swordsman, Hanzamune, in which the sword is named after. It is a great honor to wield this century-old sword.

name: Techno Poker
description: Made up of billions of microscopic mech, this blade slices through solid steel like butter.

name: Techno SkyGuard Captain's Blade (0 AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment. (This item is color customizable)

name: Techno SkyGuard Captain's Blade (AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment. (This item is color customizable)

name: Technobrawler
description: Slash them with the sharp edge!

name: Teen Slasher's Knife
description: Sometimes you have to turn the tables on the monsters.

name: Telltale Bones
description: If you were to ask the bones of Lore to tell their story, what would you hear? You would hear tales of blood-soaked battle fields, wars of freedom and slavery, skirmishes of the rich and the destitute. But these bones… these stones will tell you that in the end, might and truth conquer all.

name: Tempest Soldier Laserblade
description: Huge fans of cookies, the Tempest Soldier will follow any orders given just to get more of them.

name: Temporal Tyrant Blade
description: Wield this to destroy what the Temporal Tyrant has wrought!

name: Tenebral Beam Sword
description: Without darkness, there can be no light. Tenebral Warriors know that darkness is not always evil. It is a force of nature as powerful, fundamental, and natural as any other element.

name: Tengu Typhoon Cutlass
description: The wingbeat of a Daitengu, revered as a powerful and dreaded yokai, can stir up typhoons with their wrath. This cutlass, gifted to their greatest students, can stir the sea and sky just as violently.

name: Terragon's Shout
description: Feel the rumble of earth beneath your feet every time you unsheath this blade. The presence of this blade awakens the earth as it longs to hear Terragon's voice once again. Use it to annihilate your foes.

name: Terran Annihilator of Nulgath
description: Created by Nulgath to infiltrate mountainous zones of Lore without being detected, the Dirt Void blends right in with the rocks.

name: Terror Of The Undead
description: Wield this blade made of the bones of the undead… to smite them!

name: Terror of the Void
description: A horrifying weapon forged in the Void, twisted by the unforgiving forces that dwell within the unknown…

name: Teslan Energy Blade
description: Inspired by the works of the great energy wizard, Nikolus Teslan, Bido smithed a blade channeling the power of electricity!

name: TG Gamma Experiment 1
description: This blade pulses with a mysterious Gamma energy… but it changes to match your color-customization settings, so it is probably perfectly safe. Right?! O_o

name: Thalassarathic Ripper (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Knowledge gifted by the parastic spawn of a rapidly propagating sea monster. Dreams of deadly weapons guide the hands of its infected. Where did this being come from? Another world?

name: Thalassarathic Ripper (AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Knowledge gifted by the parastic spawn of a rapidly propagating sea monster. Dreams of deadly weapons guide the hands of its infected. Where did this being come from? Another world?

name: That Which Ends Dreams
description: Are you Evil enough to wield this blade?

name: Thaumaturgus Alpha
description: A basic Celestial blade, crafted from Exalted Forgemetal. Can be upgraded.

name: Thaumaturgus Omega
description: An ornate Celestial blade, upgraded from Thaumaturgus Alpha. Can be upgraded.

name: Thaumaturgus Ultima
description: An ornate Celestial blade, upgraded from Thaumaturgus Omega. Can be upgraded. (Item deals 30% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Thawed Ice Bane Blade
description: The elder gods walk the frozen forests of the Northlands. Only their devoted warrior-priests know the ritual to summon them. But once they do… BEWARE!

name: The Better Blade
description: A crystal blade of ancient pygmy troll design.

name: The Black Wicked (0 AC)
description: Are you Evil enough to wield this obsidian blade?

name: The Black Wicked (AC)
description: Are you Evil enough to wield this obsidian blade?

name: The Blade of Absolution
description: With the blade, I will cast out all that disrupt life in Lore. All that is impure shall know my blade's wrath!

name: The Blade of Apparition
description: A foreboding aura encompasses this blade, offering aid to only to only those who have only experienced apparitions. One of the ornate skulls is inscribed with the name: The True Assasin.

name: The Blade of Maliciousness
description: Though it might not be pretty, this blade still gets the job done. Inspired by Malicious Neos!

name: The Blade of Pinkipalities
description: Everything that Beleen stands for--love, kindness, happiness, and joy--is magically drawn to this beautiful blade. This sword was a gift from the Principalities, and Beleen wishes to gift it to you as well!

name: The Blade of the Savior
description: A hero needs a blade that strikes fear into the heart of Ebil! Let this be that blade! Hold it high and watch as Chairman Platinum's minions tremble in fear!

name: The Cold Shoulder
description: Ice in its purest form is crystalline and clear. This outfit was inspired by the majesty of this coldly beautiful element.

name: The Corporation
description: Forged by a legendary guild called The Corporation, this mighty blade was a gift to honor the eternal binding enhancement between Nythera and Ryuuji.

name: The Dark Heart
description: Reki capitalized on the darker side of Heroes Heart Day with this blade. Knowing that the holiday is not as happy for all, Reki crafted a blade by channeling all the negative energy felt during the festivities. The result is this black and pink blade that causes the wielder to feel bitter.

name: The Dragon's Bane
description: Mighty DragonSlayers often decorate their weapons with souvenirs from past victories; this sword is enhanced by the strength and fury of the dragon Sh'kargth.

name: The Edge of Giving
description: Spread and give the spirit of joy to the nice people, and also give the naughty people the pain they won't forget.

name: The Faith Breaker
description: All hope is gone!

name: The Fibulious Sword
description: The leg bone was detached with the bone sword. The arm bone was detached with the bone sword. The head bone was detached with the bone sword. And the monster was dead…(Sung in a D/F#)

name: The Fierce Skullfire
description: Designed long ago for a paladin to use when battling the undead, unfortunately he died before we could wield it.

name: The First Fallen Dirk
description: Once mystical Celestial beings created by Arthelyn, the First Fallen left in search of more power.

name: The First Nothing
description: The Harbinger. It is stated that a Shapeshifting Primordial, born from the First Nothingness, roams Lore in its one thousand forms.

name: The First Something
description: The Harbinger. It is stated that a Shapeshifting Primordial, born from the First Nothingness, roams Lore in its one thousand forms.

name: The Flayer
description: "Sharp yet elegant," she said while trying to grasp onto her last breathe.

name: The Frostval Fir
description: It's a tree! No, it's a sword! No, it's a sword shaped like a tree! Awesome!

name: The Gift (Sword)
description: The ultimate manifestation of the Leviasea. None know what this blade is capable of, but its potential is a tangible force, like an act of nature. Beware those who have the sheer force of will to wield The Gift.

name: The Great Grave Blade
description: You can see that this blade was once used as a shovel after a horrific battle - it's tip has been snapped off! It's still very useful as a weapon, though, so wield it well and bravely!

name: The Great Void Slasher
description: The element of Void has been harnessed within this mystic blade. It radiates with immense, uncontrollably energy.

name: The Guiltius
description: Discovering a cursed Scimitar out in the Sandsea, Dage the Evil cursed the soul in the blade to have nightmares every night. The screaming of the lost spirit lulls Dage to sleep.

name: The Harvester's Katana
description: You roam the Black Labryinth, harvesting the bodies of fallen creatures for any loot you can find. Some day, your debt will be paid.

name: The Hollow Blade
description: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it isn't there. Those foolish enough to be on the opposing end will soon experience this seemingly invisible blade's power.

name: The Holy Assassin
description: This sword of gold and onyx was crafted for a paladin who was once a vile assassin who changed her ways and devoted her life and her stealthy skills to the paladin order in defense of the people of Doomwood.

name: The Hostile Takeover (Sword)
description: You will accept the offer they give you.

name: The Impaler
description: This time you bow to me, my lord!

name: The Infector
description: Scythe Knight and Max Man58 worked together to create this poisonous weapon. A venomous plant grows on this blade, infecting all that are struck by the blade with a crippling concoction of chemicals.

name: The Last Redemption (AC)
description: Battlemages focus on taking down their opponents as quickly as possible. They are capable of focusing greater amounts of mana into each spell for the maximum effect. They specialize in wearing heavy armor for defense in order to spend all of their mana on offensive spells.

name: The Last Redemption (Non-AC)
description: Battlemages focus on taking down their opponents as quickly as possible. They are capable of focusing greater amounts of mana into each spell for the maximum effect. They specialize in wearing heavy armor for defense in order to spend all of their mana on offensive spells.

name: The Little Biter
description: A blade that resembles a living creature rather than a weapon. Its pulse runs on the blood of its enemies.

name: The Long Rest
description: The Darknight Stalkers roam the frozen wastes of the dark north in search of any who have wronged their friends and family. Once found, they are swiftly — justly — punished.

name: The Lost Knight's Blade
description: This lost knight was once a brave warrior, but could not survive the horrors of… THE SPLATTER REALM! *Cue horror movie sound FX*

name: The Molten Flare
description: This sword is a thing of legend. The magical sword was lost in a battle with a great Fire Dragon and sank into the lava. The magic in the blade, dragon fire and lava all combined and what emerged from the boiling stone was this deadly weapon.

name: The Overscore
description: A sword once held by the most infamous warrior of evil. The symbols inscribed on the handle and the strange runes are said to spell out the fiend's name.

name: The Pain
description: Sharp spikes warn stupid Trolls not to fight.

name: The Passion of Annihilation
description: Death and devastation run through your veins. Now it's time to unleash the destruction onto your enemies! Eradicate all of those who stand in your way to total annihilation!

name: The Pink Redemption
description: This sword may be the color of bubblegum, but don't think it can't pop enemies right and left! (Suggested by Caim)

name: The Point Sword
description: What is it?

name: The Pointy End
description: Stick it with that.

name: The Rage of the Evil
description: After their loss in the second skirmish to Nulgath's Nation, Dage saw it fit to gift this cataclysmic sword to his Legion. The hate and malice that flows through Dage, flows though the very blade of this sword!

name: The Scraper
description: A nasty set of blades, this weapon is intended to slash and scrape away at an opponents armor, leaving them vulnerable to further attacks.

name: The Slay
description: Masterfully forged, The Slay is the sword that will not let you down. This magnificent blade takes killing to a higher level, cutting down all that stand before you. Hold pure slaying power in your hands today.

name: The Sword of the Fanatics
description: The light that burns inside the sword comes from the fire and passion burning inside of the wielder.

name: The Sword of the Legion
description: The standard issued sword given out to members of the Legion.

name: The Tormenter
description: Enraged eyes at your from the hilt of this blade. Take care wielding it; it might just twist in your hand and wound YOU!

name: The Underscore
description: This sword was once held by the greatest warrior of good. The symbols inscribed on the handle and the strange runes are said to spell out the warriors name.

name: The Unholy
description: These necrotic runes glow ominously green. Who knows what dark powers they will work on any who chance to read them? It's a good thing it'll be your enemies who seem them, and not your allies!

name: The Woe
description: Woe unto thee, Sleezter Bunny! For thou hath invaded Lore, and the Hero's wrath hath fallen upon ye. Woe, woe, woe.

name: The Wolves' Fury
description: It is not only four-legged wolfhounds who have sharp fangs!

name: The Wrath
description: And anger boils within you like the bubbles of hot cauldron. This sword is believed to be a relic from the Trolls more…violent past.

name: TheWicked
description: Are you Evil enough to wield this blade?

name: Thok's Disciple
description: This sword is for Thok's students who have proven themselves to be great warriors!

name: Thok's Hoarfrost Blade (AC)
description: Thok sharpened the edge of this blade on the icy horrors of the Northlands. It froze his blade, and the ice would never melt. Every now and then, it moves on its own.

name: Thok's Hoarfrost Blade (Non-AC)
description: Thok sharpened the edge of this blade on the icy horrors of the Northlands. It froze his blade, and the ice would never melt. Every now and then, it moves on its own.

name: Thok's Titan Blade
description: An extremely heavy slab of stone with roughly-sharpened edges. It'll crush you to death before it draws any blood. This weapon seems to have been made purely to accent a Warrior's brute strength.

name: Thorn of Renunciation (0 AC)
description: This blade, wielded by Malakai the Contract Enforcer of Nulgath, severs the ties between lackluster fiends and the Nation. It destroys their contracts, and their souls.

name: Thorn of Renunciation (AC)
description: This blade, wielded by Malakai the Contract Enforcer of Nulgath, severs the ties between lackluster fiends and the Nation. It destroys their contracts, and their souls.

name: Thronetaker's Blade
description: This was taken from a fallen contender for the throne of the Underworld. It is ancient and pulses with a malevolent power.

name: Thunderous Zephyr Blade of Glory
description: Hold this sword with both hands Hero, because the very roar of thunder pulses through this blade. A powerful of nature and might, nothing will be able to stop you once you pull this fearful sword out for battle.

name: Thyton's Magitech Scythe
description: A deadly scythe with its power enhanced by the seamless merging of magic and science, designed by ninja master Thyton.

name: Tibicenas's Star Sword
description: The eighth Chaos Lord to rise was Tibicenas. You can feel what is left of his power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Tickling Feather
description: Tee-hee! This weapons is a gift from your little ectoplasmic buddy, Boo.

name: Ticklish Zorbo Sword
description: From the makers of Ticklish Zorbo, Ebilcorp proudly presents the Zorbo Sword, featuring a color custom accessory and trim color! Safe to /dance party with!

name: Tidal Byakko Wakizashi
description: Ward off misfortune with the strength of the tidal waves and bring good fortune with the ferocity of the Tiger!

name: Tidal Nodachi
description: Graceful and slender, this blade gives off a false pretense of fragility. Yet, if you look at the hilt and watch the waves, you will begin to get a sense of this blades true power. Fueled by the undulations of the sea, this blade will do untold damage on those who work to overthrow you and your purpose

name: Tidal Terror
description: The tide ebbs and flows, pulls and pushes, steals and returns. All because it can and will, no matter how we rail at it. Just like that, this sword will kill and maim, steal and gut… and there is nothing the enemy can do about it.

name: Tidal Tiger Wakizashi
description: Ward off misfortune with the strength of the tidal waves and bring good fortune with the ferocity of the Tiger!

name: Tidal Warrior of Prosperity Wakizashi
description: Ward off misfortune with the strength of the tidal waves and bring good fortune with the ferocity of the Tiger!

name: Tide of Despair
description: A Dark Caster waded through the Acheron River to find suffering souls. With fell arts, they dragged terrifying memories to the surface, and solidified them into a woeful blade.

name: TigerClaw Talon
description: New for 2022, the House of Miko presents: the Tiger Hoodie! Look fierce as you ROAR into battle or stalk down the catwalk in Akiba.

name: Time Slicer
description: A weapon that's always there when you need it. Almost like clockwork.

name: Timeless Chronomancer's Double Blade
description: Time flows, curves and circles back on itself. Corrupted Chronomancers introduce flaws into the stream to better manipulate it.

name: Timeless Chronomancer's Switchblade
description: Time flows, curves and circles back on itself. Corrupted Chronomancers introduce flaws into the stream to better manipulate it.

name: Timeless Chronomancer's Sword
description: Time flows, curves and circles back on itself. Corrupted Chronomancers introduce flaws into the stream to better manipulate it.

name: Timeless Cryofreeze Dagger
description: ﻿﻿An asssasin left this blade in the chest of a completely frozen army general. The rest of his soldiers froze themselves with the dagger, either to follow him to a deathless void or to rise again when the ice finally melts.

name: TimeReaper Blade
description: Where Drakath goes the TimeReapers follow. Have to help keep the timelines clean!

name: Timestream Ravager's Cutlass
description: Those who can cross between times and worlds are the most dangerous of opponents. You never know where they will run to, or which direction they'll attack!

name: Tinsel's Sword Gift
description: Festive Frostval 2019! These giftboxes will open on January 1st, 2020 to reveal your EPIC Frostval set!

name: Titan Drakath's Blade
description: Son of the Progenitor, the Queen of monstrous Titans, Drakath has long been her pawn. His ambition and fury will continue to threaten our world… all of our worlds, in all of its times.

name: Titan Paladin's Blade
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. For the Light… For Good… BATTLE ON!

name: Titan v93 Edge
description: For when your bullets run out, because with you shooting, that is inevitable.

name: Titanic Destroyer Blade
description: Remember the terror of being dominated by Drakath's Titans… but remember, too, the hope and joy that came with your victory over them!

name: Titanio's Sword
description: Forged from the tears of a fallen comrade, this devious sword was designed by your fellow player, Titanio!

name: Titanium Blade of the North
description: This is a replica of a ceremonial blade used by the High Kings and Queens of the North while holding court.

name: Titanium FrostElf Blade
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This battle gear is worn during challenges to take the throne.

name: Titanium FrostElf ShortSword
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This battle gear is worn during challenges to take the throne.

name: Titanium Katana of the North
description: This is a replica of ceremonial blade used by the hereditary Dukes and Duchesses of the North in battle.

name: Titian Avenger
description: Weaponsmiths don't usually work with copper, as it's a fairly soft metal, but mages have enhanced this blade's metal until it's edge is as sharp as the finest steel.

name: Tomix's Pandora
description: This is an early version of the Pandora Blade, wielded by Tomix the SoulWeaver.

name: Tongue of a Savage
description: A dweller inside the underworld once had a solid tongue just like the type of blade you see now. It can't taste, but the dweller relishes the feel of fading light while in the process of consumption. Thankfully, it is not a problem anymore.

name: TOO Big 100K
description: Yes, that's right. THE BIGGEST 100K.

name: Tora Daimyo's Katana
description: Elaborate armor worn by only the highest level of Akiban defenders.

name: Tora Daimyo's Sheathed Katana
description: Elaborate armor worn by only the highest level of Akiban defenders.

name: Tora Kunai
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Tora Warrior. The more you study, the more you become closer to the tiger.

name: Tora Warrior Katana
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Tora Warrior. The more you study, the more you become closer to the tiger.

name: Tora Warrior Sheathed Katana
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Tora Warrior. The more you study, the more you become closer to the tiger.

name: Toxian Synthesis Gamma Sword
description: A blade that pulses with unknown energy. It exudes an invisible poison that causes a decay far more terrifying than the rot of death. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Toxian Synthesis Sword
description: A blade that pulses with unknown energy. It exudes an invisible poison that causes a decay far more terrifying than the rot of death.

name: Toxic Alchemist's Noxious Blade
description: A subset of the Toxic Alchemists are known to dwell in Greenguard Forest. They crafted this noxious blade for the rogues there from the reagents they harvested.

name: Toxic Alchemist's Royal Sword
description: Toxic Alchemists forged this blade in honor of King Alteon after inducting him as an honorary Toxic Alchemist to honor his many contributions to the land of Swordhaven.

name: Toxic Alchemist's Suspension Blade
description: This blade, crafted by premiere Toxic Alchemist Bido, shows two liquids suspended inside the blade's central glass column.

name: Toxic Alchemist's Venom Blade
description: A subset of the Toxic Alchemists are known to dwell in Greenguard Forest. They crafted this venomous blade for the rogues there from the reagents they harvested.

name: Toxic Aura Blade
description: A rare blade made up of the purest form of toxic mafic.

name: Toxic Blood Blade
description: Groglurk's blade is not what it used to be. Bido has infused it with toxic magic and now it's acting out of control.

name: Toxic Bloodletter of Nulgath
description: Your thirst for bloodshed has been quenched. But there's always room for seconds… and thirds… and more…!

name: Toxic Bloodriver
description: Bido fused his toxic alchemy into the Bloodriver and it turned to Onyx. The blade seems to be a lot heavier and more intune with magic capabilities now but at what cost?

name: Toxic Chainsaw
description: The Evil Undead are coming… but this chainsaw means you're well-prepared to take on any of them. Wield it well, Hero!

name: Toxic Diviner Blade
description: Bido's loyal Diviners don these robes for they are the warlocks who protect the strange relics that Bido has stashed away.

name: Toxic Eye of the Void
description: Dipped into an acid lake which has since been destroyed, the power of this weapon has not been fully tested.

name: Toxic Ivy Blade
description: This blade leaves your foes more itchy and more irritated because the color custom ivy is poisonous!

name: Toxic Knight's Blade
description: While wandering through Lore, Bido came across a set of Knights that had become corrupted by a horrible toxin. Needless to say, he just had to grab their gear!

name: Toxic Naval Commander's Blade (0 AC)
description: Avast! Who knows what kind of sludge these pirates sailed into… whatever it was, it was sure toxic!

name: Toxic Naval Commander's Blade (AC)
description: Avast! Who knows what kind of sludge these pirates sailed into… whatever it was, it was sure toxic!

name: Toxic Naval Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: Avast! Who knows what kind of sludge these pirates sailed into… whatever it was, it was sure toxic!

name: Toxic Naval Commander's Cutlass (Legend)
description: Avast! Who knows what kind of sludge these pirates sailed into… whatever it was, it was sure toxic!

name: Toxic Oblivion Blade of Alchemy
description: Bido fused his Onyx and Baltic Amber mixed with his toxic alchemy into the shape of the Oblivion Blade of Nulgath. No one knows how he manage to pull it off, but he did.

name: Toxic Resistor
description: I made this resistor EXTRA toxic. No charge!

name: Toxic Scavenger Reaver
description: The sickly, but colorful blade was formerly a part of a fungal "flower" that grew within the Rift. Now wherever you go, the "flower's" spores will follow.

name: Toxic Skull Colossus
description: This sword is so unwieldy, you'll probably just fall over when you try to swing it. But it's also so big that there's an 80% chance that your opponent will die anyway.

name: Toxic Skull Hatchet
description: Equally useful for cutting down trees and for cutting open your enemy's head. Except the trees part.

name: Toxic Skull Sword
description: DOOOOOOOOOM is upon us! We hope you've enjoyed the world premiere of the Artix and Sepulchure Action Figure video! Coming soon to Heromart.com and Toys R Us!

name: Toxic Spirit Sword
description: A corrupted sword can only bring devastation.

name: Toxic Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQWorld's 12th Upholders on the game's twelfth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Toxic Venom Blade
description: The ssssssword…with bite.

name: Toxic Void Katana
description: Nulgath is pleased by the creation of this katana in his honor. Arcane weaponsmaster Zee the Legend has done well!

name: Toxic Wanderer's Khopesh
description: Though you call the desert home, with your battle skills and intellect, you can find work anywhere… as long as someone is willing to pay.

name: Toxic WyvernSlayer's Great Blade
description: The edge of this blade is coated the elixir you helped me craft. Do not touch it with bare flesh if you want to reatin your finger… or sanity.

name: Tracker Arm Blade
description: This blade were created from the tears and fears of EbilCorp's sweatshop workers. Somehow Chairman Platinum figured out a way to harness the energy from the sweatshop workers' demons and make a physical blade out of them! Death to all that inhabit Lore!

name: Training Katana
description: A katana perfect for training.

name: Transcendence Blade
description: Grim nor valourous, evil nor good, the blade holds alliegiance only to the Great. Perhaps it transcendend time and space to find your hand.

name: Transcendent Blade of Tercessuinotlim (0 AC)
description: When you truly distinguish yourself in battle against Nulgath's foes, you may be invited to join the Transcendent. An elite force that can smash their way through any army.

name: Transcendent Blade of Tercessuinotlim (AC)
description: When you truly distinguish yourself in battle against Nulgath's foes, you may be invited to join the Transcendent. An elite force that can smash their way through any army.

name: Transcendent Blade of Tercessuinotlim (Quest)
description: When you truly distinguish yourself in battle against Nulgath's foes, you may be invited to join the Transcendent. An elite force that can smash their way through any army.

name: Transparent Edge
description: Cut your opponents with this blade… and if it shatters cut'em with the shards!

name: Trapper's Dirk (AC)
description: The hunt is on and your prey is near… slay the wolf and ensure the safety of the villagers heading to the harvest.

name: Trapper's Dirk (Special)
description: The hunt is on and your prey is near… slay the wolf and ensure the safety of the villagers heading to the harvest.

name: Treasured Blade of Gold Coins
description: This set is 100% gold. Literally. Made out of the many gold coins you've saved up while adventuring. Talk about a status symbol!

name: Treasured Sword of Gold
description: This set is 100% gold. Literally. Made out of the many gold coins you've saved up while adventuring. Talk about a status symbol!

name: Tribal Chieftains Hand of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite Bloodtuskers with this giant hand!

name: Trislayer Blade
description: This blade is carved painstalkingly from one of Trigoras' claws, formed a brutal, jagged egde able to cut through most anything with ease

name: Trislayer Blade of Doom +5
description: This blade is carved painstakingly from one of Trigoras' claws, formed a brutal, jagged edge able to cut through most anything with ease. It does 15% MORE Damage against Dragons!

name: Triumphant Legacy
description: Doctor Knives knows blades, and this sword is proof! You'll never need to see an MD again, because no monster will be able to get through your guard!

name: Troll's Bane
description: Even the bravest of trolls fall victim to this massive blade--a sacred keepsake of the barbaric Horc tribe.

name: Troll's Pledge
description: By this sword I swear, to be faithful and true. To do what I must, in the name of Arashtii!

name: Trollic Gasher
description: This sword was forged with style and portability. Just look at that chrome finish!

name: Trollic Naval Cutlass (0 AC)
description: May ye be ever free, strong, and wise as ye sail the seven seas huntin' th' Chaos Pirates that still plague yer land. Yer strong arm and loyal heart will keep Bloodtusk Ravine safe!

name: Trollic Naval Cutlass (AC)
description: May ye be ever free, strong, and wise as ye sail the seven seas huntin' th' Chaos Pirates that still plague yer land. Yer strong arm and loyal heart will keep Bloodtusk Ravine safe!

name: Trollish Quickblade
description: Winds swirl around this blade, lending their swiftness and biting cold to your sword arm.

name: True Blue Love Knife
description: Something old, something new, something borrrowed, and definitely blue. A sapphire edge should cover all that, on top of beautifully cutting through the wedding cake.

name: Truly Cursed Cutlass
description: Sometimes getting cursed isn't too bad. The blade that acts as the carriers may just have your back at a price for both you and your opponent.

name: Truly Cursed Legion Blade
description: Those who've wielded this cursed blade have all met a grisly end. And you won't be the last.

name: Turbine Saber
description: With this wand, winning all your battles will be a breeze!

name: Turdraken Carver
description: These machetes see action in the woods and at the dinner table.

name: Turdraken Scale Sword
description: Forged from the scale of the Turdraken, this weapon only appears once a year.

name: Turdraken Trophy Sword
description: A sword decorated with the claws of your latest hunt.

name: Turdrakolich Blade
description: Great for slicing up enemies! Or a deep-fried Turdraken.

name: Turkey Avenger Sword
description: Let them know what it feels like to be carved up for dinner.

name: Turquoise Darkness Blade
description: Forged from a variety of gemstones, these swords make it easier to defeat you Draconic foes.

name: Turquoise Drake
description: It is only by looking carefully at this blade, do you truly see the powers that be. Small and nonintrusive, a drake weaves its elegant body through the intricate detailing of the blade, giving the edge a sharper touch and the steel a stronger bond.

name: Twig's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Twig, the adorable, immortal, just a LITTLE BIT CRAZY yellow moglin. This Star Sword's blade shines as brightly as his love of fish and ice cweam.

name: Twig's Voyager Space Saber (AC)
description: In space, no one gives you fwish and ice cream!

name: Twig's Voyager Space Saber (Legend)
description: In space, no one gives you fwish and ice cream!

name: Twilight Dancer Blade
description: Dance adepts of the Troll community gather at twilight to celebrate life: the danced duet between sky and land, male and female, and sun and moon, is ending for another day.

name: Twilight's Arcana Blade +20
description: Rip through the darkness with this majestic blade. (Gives 20% more XP when equipped!)

name: Twilight's Star Blade
description: This sword feels heavy with the weight of the new year, but light with the glow of the stars.Swinging this sword is like moving forward in life: Heavy and slow, but necessary and life saving. It's also all twinkly and cool.

name: Twilly's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Twilly, the red healing Moglin and your first friend in Battleon. This Star Sword's blade shines as brightly as his faith in you.

name: Twilly's Voyager Space Saber (AC)
description: In space, you can't heal anyone if they scream!

name: Twilly's Voyager Space Saber (Non-AC)
description: In space, you can't heal anyone if they scream!

name: Twin Impaler
description: This weapon is ideal with those warriors who can't decide whether to stab their opponents, or hit them over the head!

name: Twisted Blade of the Pumpkinlord (AC)
description: The vines used to make this blade were poisoned giving it an-other worldly aura. Gives +25% more gold (This item will return every Halloween.)

name: Twisted Blade of the Pumpkinlord (Legend)
description: The vines used to make this blade were poisoned giving it an other-worldly aura.

name: Twisted Bone Shortsword
description: Darkest magic, pulled from the darkness of the caves near the center of the world has tormented and twisted the bones on ancient creatures into this dangerous shortblade.

name: Twisted Cleaver
description: Dem bones, dem bones, dem dead bones! And fear the blade of the sword!

name: Twisted Eldritch Blade
description: The deepest depths hide some of the strangest and most dangerous beasts.

name: Twisted Legion PumpkinLord Blade
description: The vines used to make this blade were poisoned giving it an other-worldly aura. And then of course Dage got a hold of it.

name: Tyrannical Dragonlord's Doomblade
description: A sword fashioned in the style of the Empress' blade. Ambitious dragons periodically test the might of their partners. Failure means becoming lunch. The blade carves scars into the Dragonlord's partner as they withstand their cruel talons.

name: Tyrant Blade
description: Congratz! It must have taken a small army to defeat Thrax! It seems orcs possess the ability to craft exceptional weapons.

name: Unidentified 66 (Tyrant Bone Slasher)
description: Known as the Tyrant Bone Slasher, an unknown warlord used this enchanted weapon to assassinate his rival before a turf war which was eventually cancelled.

name: Tyre Akh Blade
description: Death is but another part of life. Only the soul should be immortal. The Emissaries of Melqart ensure that it is so by guiding and guarding the dead seeking the next world. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Tyrian Edge
description: Treated with Embersea's famed firewater elixir, it will burn flesh clean even as it cuts.

name: Ukki's Sword
description: Slash, chop, and slice your way through your foes with this awesome sword stolen from Ukki!

name: Ultima Aquus
description: One of the Ultima Elemental weapons, this broadsword calls forth the force of the seas to smash against the sure, swallowing them whole like an unstopable tidal wave.

name: Ultima Frigia
description: One of the Ultima Elemental weapons, this sword calls forth the strength of ice to crush your foes with all the slow and unstopable weight of a glacier, freezing them to their very core.

name: Ultima Thermos
description: One of the Ultima Elemental weapons, this blade calls forth the power of the flames to burn your foes with relentless fire, reducing them to nothing but ashes.

name: ULTIMA VORDREADSWORD (0 AC)
description: A FINE SKULL CRUSHER…BUT I NEED SKULLS TO BE INTACT IF I'M GOING TO WEAR THEM. OH WELL. SALLY'S GOOD WITH GLUE.

name: ULTIMA VORDREADSWORD (AC)
description: A FINE SKULL CRUSHER…BUT I NEED SKULLS TO BE INTACT IF I'M GOING TO WEAR THEM. OH WELL. SALLY'S GOOD WITH GLUE.

name: Ultimate AdventureCoin Blade
description: This item, featuring the AdventureCoin symbol, will show the world that you have supported AdventureQuest Worlds. With your help, we are able to make AQWorlds free for all heroes to play!

name: Ultimate Baconed Blade of Awe
description: It's Ultimate! And Baconed! It can't get any better than this!

name: Ultimate Dragonlord Greatsword
description: A greatsword to match the majesty of its master and their dragon.

name: Ultimate Eternal Chaos Blade
description: As the Eternal Dragon of Time, you possess a power unrivaled by almost any entity in our universe. Even the Elemental Lords marvel at what you are capable of. Combined with the power of Chaos… you are unpredictable AND unstoppable.

name: Ultimate Evil Sword
description: Another way for those of true Evil intent to make sure their foes get the point. Points. You know what I mean.

name: Ultimate Flame Blade
description: This sword is hot, hot, HOT!!

name: Ultimate Game Claymore
description: Thank you for using an Ultimate Game Card to support AQW.

name: Ultimate Good Sword
description: This is a brilliant platinum sword for those of Good intent. Who knew that teal was the color of Good?

name: Ultimate Mudluk Blade
description: Evolution at your fingertips! This massive blade has grown along with the unidentified creature attached at the hilt.

name: Ultio Leo
description: As virtuous citizens, people who have sworn their allegiance to good often turn the cheek when wronged. However, nobody said what you're supposed to do after that.

name: Ultra Beast King's Glory
description: The glorious sword wielded by Bluddron, the hideous Beast King who gave Beleen a Heroes Heart Day she'll never forget.

name: Ultra OmniKnight Blade
description: A blade with the strength to pierce the heavens, only a true OmniKnight may wield its power!

name: Ultra Silver Sun Cutlass
description: Ye be truly a gentlemen o' fortune with this fine blade. Gems are color customizable.

name: Ultra Switch Katana
description: Sometimes… Size matters….. When it's about swords.

name: Ultraviolet
description: Sunscreen cannot protect your enemies when faced against this Ultraviolet blade!

name: UltraWrath of the Legion Blade
description: Forged from stone in the Underworld this sword is nearly unbreakable.

name: Umbrabrand
description: ﻿﻿A knight slew what is now the Hollow Midnight for his priestess. A priestess slew what is now the Hollow Solstice for her knight. You were able to defeat both, and were blessed with this interplay of light, dark, cold, and warmth.

name: Umbral Fiend Blade
description: Surrounded by demonfire, this blade will send the souls of your opponents to the Underworld.

name: Umbralian Slasher
description: These are the display of an Teka's finesse as an Umbramancer. Sharp, elegant, and… perfect for stabbing… things.

name: Umbrawlla
description: Thunderstorm! At long last we meet again. Prepare for battle, because your torrent tactics are all washed up!

name: Umitora's Zanbato
description: Umitora wields these blades magically. You have to use them like any other sword.

name: Unburnt Pyromancer's Blade
description: Before a Pyromancer lights their blade up… the cold steel is visible, ready for the conflagratin. (Item does 30% more damage to elements when equipped.)

name: Unchained Loyalty
description: Nulgath trusts that you will stay loyal to him without being bound by chain or blood. Return that trust… or perish

name: Unconquerable Anicetus
description: Named after a Warrior that sacrificed themselves to seal an endless war that wages in the realm of the dead. No soul, dead or alive, can pass this blade unscathed. Leave the lost to their fates.

name: Undead Adept Assassin Dagger (AC)
description: The adept assassins are without peer, but have the potential to grow past their need for a master. Time is a good teacher, and it has taught Dage the Evil to curse this dagger to shatter if it is ever turned on him.

name: Undead Adept Assassin Dagger (Non-AC)
description: The adept assassins are without peer, but have the potential to grow past their need for a master. Time is a good teacher, and it has taught Dage the Evil to curse this dagger to shatter if it is ever turned on him.

name: Undead Adept Assassin Katana (0 AC)
description: The blade is serrated, performing more as a ripper than a slicer. If the death the assassin's master wishes for is to be messy, the katana will tear their flesh slow and methodically.

name: Undead Adept Assassin Katana (AC)
description: The blade is serrated, performing more as a ripper than a slicer. If the death the assassin's master wishes for is to be messy, the katana will tear their flesh slow and methodically.

name: Undead Champion Blade
description: Only true Undead Champions may ever hope to wield such a devious masterpiece. And even then, the chances of owning such a blade are slim to nil.

name: Undead Edge of Z
description: One of the most ancient weaponry in his Legion, Dage saves his treacherous and deadly blade to a member of a Legion who would eventually rise to match his own power. It would usually take years for it to happen, but you've gotten it early because of a hidden strength Dage senses in you. This weapon gives 25% more CP when equipped!

name: Undead Falcon Blade
description: A selfish blade that hungers to spill blood in righteous fury. For its tainted steel and their wielder, justice is a delusion.

name: Undead Guardian Prime Blade
description: The blade of guardians who have fallen afoul of the dark energy now inhabiting Valen.

name: Undead Gutter
description: It takes serious guts to storm headstrong into battle. Unless you're Undead and don't have any internal organs left. In which case disregard the first statement and just Battle On!

name: Undead Horror Blade
description: It may say "undead" but given those tentacles something is definitely alive in this blade.

name: Undead Infantry Sword
description: The conventional weapon for an unconventional army.

name: Undead Leader Sword (0 AC)
description: Symbols are power. The mere sight of the fearsome blade will tame the even the wildest wills of the restless dead.

name: Undead Leader Sword (AC)
description: Symbols are power. The mere sight of the fearsome blade will tame the even the wildest wills of the restless dead.

name: Undead Legion Cutlass
description: Slay your foes, me hearty!

name: Undead Ninja Chain
description: This chain embodies both the shadow powers of the ninja and the darkness powers of the undead. Your enemies will never see what hit them.

name: Undead Ninja Katana
description: This sword embodies both the shadow powers of the ninja and the darkness powers of the undead. Your enemies will never see what hit them.

name: Undead Parabellum Blade
description: Underworld terror in a simple and familiar form. A cold blade that is always ready to drink in the spoils and gore of war.

name: Undead Pirate's Cutlass
description: Aaargh! It be an undead pirate's cutlass. Meaning the cutlass itself is undead!

name: Undead Seraph's Blade
description: *No description*

name: Undead Shovel Sword
description: A shovel sword is about as safe as a chainsaw in a blender. "Undead" has been applied to the name for blatant precautionary reasons.

name: Undeadite Destroyer
description: Given to you by Artix, the Undeadslayer, this blade will tear through any undead you encounter! Wield it well, Hero!

name: Underfriend Blade of Nulgath
description: You've got friends in low places…

name: Underglade Scavenger Reaver (AC)
description: The sickly, but colorful blade was formerly a part of fungal "flower" that grew within the Rift. Now wherever you go, the "flower's" spores will follow.

name: Underglade Scavenger Reaver (Legend)
description: The sickly, but colorful blade was formerly a part of fungal "flower" that grew within the Rift. Now wherever you go, the "flower's" spores will follow.

name: Underworld Angelos (0 AC)
description: A small flame carried by a single soul from one side of the Underworld to the other. It led scores of lost souls back from the abyss, and sharpened into a blade that reveals all paths in the nether.

name: Underworld Angelos (AC)
description: A small flame carried by a single soul from one side of the Underworld to the other. It led scores of lost souls back from the abyss, and sharpened into a blade that reveals all paths in the nether.

name: Underworld ArchFiend Sword (AC)
description: The blade of the Beast that was once Nulgath's right hand. Its teeth bit back, and took everything with it.

name: Underworld Asgardian Sword
description: Before the Underworld Asgardian met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror as they invaded land after land with their horde of warriors.

name: Underworld Blade of DOOM
description: After Sepulchure's defeat, his blade was found in the Underworld. Its darkness resonates with the DOOM coursing through the realm.

name: Underworld Candle
description: When mortals join the Legion, they shed their living flesh. Dark Casters convert their remains into wax, and burn them during rituals. There's no going back.

name: Underworld DeathSpine
description: Before the Underworld Asgardian met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror as they invaded land after land with their horde of warriors.

name: Underworld DragonBlade of Nulgath
description: When a DragonBlade of Nulgath is reforged in Dage the Evil's Soul Forge, the result is a weapon of unparalleled power and intimidation. (Cosmetic item, does not include bonuses.)

name: Underworld DreadSaw
description: In the eternal war for domination of the Underworld, Dage and Nulgath both vie for the same souls and warriors. Which master did this warrior serve first? Only the darkness knows.

name: Underworld Fury Blaze Blade (0 AC)
description: The enraged souls of your enemies are trapped in this weapon, setting its blade ablaze. If you are ever felled, your soul will join them, and the sword will have a new master.

name: Underworld Fury Blaze Blade (AC)
description: The enraged souls of your enemies are trapped in this weapon, setting its blade ablaze. If you are ever felled, your soul will join them, and the sword will have a new master.

name: Underworld Gladiator's Gladius
description: This gladiator's will was SO strong, they did not even realize when they fell in battle and crossed over into death. Now, they stalk the Underworld looking for new opponents to prove their skill in combat.

name: Underworld Horror Blade
description: Originally outcasts, Dage found these terrors, creating a new species of horror to serve him and his Legion.

name: Underworld Infiltrator Blade
description: Weapons created from the steel from the reaper's blade. It's gutsy to steal from Death, and even gutsier to taunt Death by taking lives with these yourself.

name: Underworld Katana
description: Rain death upon your enemies with a blade made of shadows and pain. (This item goes rare on March 31, 2021)

name: Underworld Knight's Sword (0 AC)
description: Underworld Knights are among the most feared warriors in all seven circles of heck. Cross them at your peril.

name: Underworld Knight's Sword (AC)
description: Underworld Knights are among the most feared warriors in all seven circles of heck. Cross them at your peril.

name: Underworld Leviathan Slayer's Blade (0 AC)
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Underworld Leviathan Slayer's Blade (AC)
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Underworld Leviathan Slayer's Blade (Legend)
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Underworld Oni's Blade

name: Underworld Oni's Burning Blade
description: The Underworld Oni emerges from its dark realm to hunt down and punish the wicked.

name: Underworld Parabellum Blade
description: Underworld Teerror in a simple and familiar form. A cold blade that is always ready to drink in the spoils and gore of war.

name: Underworld Piercer
description: FOR THE LEGION!

name: Underworld Prophet's Knife (0 AC)
description: Some heroes are able to receive visions from the Elemental Lords even after death. Heed their warnings.

name: Underworld Prophet's Knife (AC)
description: Some heroes are able to receive visions from the Elemental Lords even after death. Heed their warnings.

name: Underworld RuneSword of Shadows (0 AC)
description: Underworld ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: Underworld RuneSword of Shadows (AC)
description: Underworld ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: Underworld Scourge's Blade
description: Fighting your way through the arena proves you are truly a scourge of the Underworld. Dage will be so proud!

name: Underworld Scourge's Falx
description: Fighting your way through the arena proves you are truly a scourge of the Underworld. Dage will be so proud!

name: Underworld Sigil Sword (0 AC)
description: A blade that pulses with the mana of the dead. One could use the sword to lead souls to the surface of Lore undetected. The Legion has been ordered to destroy this weapon on-sight.

name: Underworld Sigil Sword (AC)
description: A blade that pulses with the mana of the dead. One could use the sword to lead souls to the surface of Lore undetected. The Legion has been ordered to destroy this weapon on-sight.

name: Underworld Soul Weaver's Blade (0 AC)

description: Souls wander throughout the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: Underworld SoulEater (0 AC)
description: A symbol of the Undead Legion even after the next decade, while only a few ever had the privilege of seeing and wielding the older model; your extreme luck is no longer needed— just your testament to the Legion's service and loyalty will reward you something… even better.

name: Underworld SoulEater (AC)
description: A symbol of the Undead Legion even after the next decade, while only a few ever had the privilege of seeing and wielding the older model; your extreme luck is no longer needed— just your testament to the Legion's service and loyalty will reward you something… even better.

name: Underworld Spirit Slasher
description: The spirits of fallen warriors were bound into this dual-edged blade. Now their strength is yours!

name: Underworld Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 11th Upholders on the game's eleventh birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Underworld Sword
description: Warriors of a loyal disposition are the only people who can uses these swords.

name: Underworld Sword of Loyalty
description: Warriors of a loyal disposition are the only people who can use these swords. If their loyalty is strong enough, it will manifest itself as a unique color along the blade.

name: Underworld Wrathfire Katana (0 AC)
description: A famed swordsmith forged blades to allow warriors to erradicate the deathless. When the katana fell into the Underworld, the Lord of the Legion built on top of its design. It became a sword embodying the inescapable end.

name: Underworld Wrathfire Katana (AC)
description: A famed swordsmith forged blades to allow warriors to erradicate the deathless. When the katana fell into the Underworld, the Lord of the Legion built on top of its design. It became a sword embodying the inescapable end.

name: Undine's Resolve
description: A fin-tastic sword pulled from the briny depths.

name: Undying Cleaver
description: Forged from superstitions, this indestructible blade radiates massive amounts of pure dark energy. A rare weapon making its appearance for the most unlucky day of the year.

name: Undying Covenant of Bone
description: Ever loyal to Master Nulgath, the Nation's greatest loyalists serve the Archfiend even in death. Their souls cling to their bones, waiting for another chance to prove themselves.

name: Undying Loyalty Blade
description: Do you vow to never be too far away? To never back down your sword to protect our home? (Click gem to transform)

name: Ungourdly Rage Blade
description: In the Terror Dimension, a mysterious warrior roams the lands of the Harvest, striking fear into all who cross his path. Channel his un-gourdly wrath with this greatsword depicting his intimidating visage, illuminated by blood-red lightning.

name: Ungourdly Wrath Blade
description: In the Terror Dimension, a mysterious warrior roams the lands of the Harvest, striking fear into all who cross his path. Channel his un-gourdly wrath with this greatsword depicting his intimidating visage, illuminated by blood-red lightning.

name: Unholy Fang Blade of Nulgath
description: You are compelled to feed the fiend's spirit inhabiting this blade. Slay to slowly, and it may turn to feed on YOU! (This item is color customizable)

name: Unholy Shadow Pride
description: Crafted by Israil, the only thing you will remember is the faint glow before you fall to your knees. The blade takes only prisoners.

name: UnHoly Truth
description: Reki wants to share a truth with you, an unholy, unconscionable truth with you. This weapon will slay your foes, but at the cost of your sanity and soul.

name: Uni-Blade of Destruction
description: This blade glows with the power of light. (This item does 35% more damage to undead monsters when equipped)

name: Unlucky Sword '09
description: (RARE) A slightly less unlucky sword than its conpanion rare sword.

name: Unlucky Umbrella
description: Don't open indoors.

name: Unraveling Wrapping Paper Blade
description: Wreck the halls with blade of wrapping, fa lalalalaaaaaa la la la LA!

name: Unshakeable Blade
description: Earthquakes cause mass destruction and hysteria, causing people and animals to flee and hide, or at the worst, lose their lives. These foundation shaking events come and go quickly, yet leave scars for a lifetime. So shall you, if you choose to take up this sword.

name: Unstable Betrayal Blade
description: A unique Nation weapon that cycles through the forms of different blades. All of them were meant to pierce the Archfiend at the same time. (Randomizes Art on Equip)

name: Unstable Golden Katana
description: The gold for this was mined from Dwarfhold so it is of the highest quality.

name: Upslash Sword
description: Perfectly crafted for Vampires who strike while preparing for an aerial assault. Gives a whole new meaning to Fight and/or Flight.

name: Urban Assassin Katana (AC)
description: Whoever said that assassins were restricted to long corridors and dark forests have never met these guys before.

name: Urban Assassin Katana (Special)
description: Whoever said that assassins were restricted to long corridors and dark forests have never met these guys before.

name: Urban Duelist Rebel Katana
description: Astravia's ancient rulers stole swords from distant lands, and a servant snuck them out of the castle. The commoners forged copies, arming the Duelists with weapons to train with.

name: Urban Underworld Rage
description: Though the Underworld has existed since the first life expired, it keeps up with the times. Or, it even moves ahead of the game.

name: UsEGGi Warrior's Carrotnai
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the UsEGGi Warrior is truly hoppy!

name: UsEGGi Warrior's Katana
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the UsEGGi Warrior is truly hoppy!

name: Uw3017 Sword
description: Thinner than the sharpest needle like bone that belonged to any creature, but quick to mortally injure or kill in one rapid second.

name: Vaccine Needle
description: You wouldn't want to get a vaccine with this needle. It does a great job at scaring young monsters away, though!

name: Valen Sword
description: A swordsman and mostly a friend to Alden and Lynaria, Valen once fought to protect Lore from Evil.

name: Valkress Blade
description: This color custom blade is ready to introduce your foes to their marker!

name: Valkyrie Song
description: Even Valhalla cannot contain the songs of warrior maidens. Weaponsmith Ayuzu captured the music and integrity of the warrior women, weaving them into the precious metal of this blade. Do you have what it takes to hold such power and spirit?

name: Valoroth
description: It's so awesome. Too awesome, even. And now YOU own it!

name: Valoth's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Valoth, leader of the ShadowScythe, who originally appeared in MechQuest. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Vamish Blood Blade
description: This blade was made from the bones of a fallen warrior. You can see the fire of his rage is still trapped inside… and that fury emanates from the blade itself.

name: Vamish Bloodwrath Blade
description: This blade was made from the bones of a fallen warrior. You can see the fire of his rage is still trapped inside… and that fury emanates from the blade itself.

name: Vamp Blade of Nulgath

name: Vampirate Cutlass
description: If ye be findin' yourself in a fight with other pirates or the dreaded Lycan Shinobi, always good to have ye cutlass by yer side.

name: Vampire Blade of Nulgath
description: This sword gets its crimson color from the blood it drains from your enemies.
