description: This delicious weapon serves double duty… as battle fuel AND weapon! A birthday present for you from AQWorlds community artist, Vann!

name: Vanta Katana
description: These lone blademaster's hide within the shadows, carefully avoiding enemies until their foes least expect it.

name: Vanta Reverse Katana
description: These lone blademaster's hide within the shadows, carefully avoiding enemies until their foes least expect it.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Katana (0 AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Katana (AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Sword (0 AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Sword (AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Vengeance (0 AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Vengeance (AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vast Necrosis
description: Thought to only be found in legend, the Vast Necrosis is suppose to be able to send any foe, no matter their might or strength, into the great oblivion!

name: Vath's Star Sword
description: The third Chaos Lord to rise was Vath. You can feel what is left of his dark elven power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Vector Helaine
description: A feared blade that welcomes the embrace of the storm. If it's stabbed into the ground, the land will be struck by lightning until the soil turns into charred ashes. It's named after King Gaheris' Queen, which did little to please her.

name: Velm's Sword
description: Just because the blade has a square end does not mean it is no sharper than an ordinary sword.

name: VelociCleaver
description: This dino tried to prove his worth in the Megasaurus Tricerathon (a very perstigious dino-competition) by swallowing this stone. He failed, though, and was then fossilized. Now YOU can use him as a weapon!

name: Venatrix Stiletto
description: A metallic spike inspired by deadly insect stingers. This was a gift made by a Necromancer to be given to an Arachnomancer friend. They taught each other new and novel ways to rain terror on the world.

name: Venatrix Thorn
description: A sharp spike woven from tightly bound spider's silk. It's soaked in venom that causes flesh to rot and melt. The effect can backfire on the wielder if they aren't Undead themselves.

name: Venerable Blade Of Awe
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power! It is said that even death is subjugated by this awe-inspiring magical blade. (Imported from the original AdventureQuest.)

name: Vengeful DragonKnight Sword
description: An ancestral blade, said to be stained by the blood of a Dragonlord's partner when the beast died protecting them. The Astravian nobility insist that they are only tales of fantasy. Dragons have never called Astravia home.

name: Venom Draconian Sword
description: Draconian sword of Venom.

name: Venom Head
description: The ssssssword…with bite.

name: Venom Head of Chaos
description: Chaos energy is infecting everything!

name: Venomous Fang Blade
description: The edges of this blade are coated in a caustic mixture made from ChaosWeaver venom. Toxic at any time, when heated by dragonflame, the poison becomes fatal to humans.

name: Venomous Nightshade
description: Forged from toxic shadow matter, this venomous blade is as elegant as it is deadly in melee combat.

name: Verdant Venom Knife
description: It's called a venomous knife, but the snake wrapped around the blade is actually electrified to stun your opponents. It just seems like the effects of venom.

name: Verde StarBlade
description: When you walk away, you won't hear me say, please oh bladey, don't glow.

name: Vert Vitriol Dagger
description: A crystal dagger with acidic properties, rumored to have been forged from the wrath of the mountains. You aren't sure if it's actually made of ferrous sulfate, but the color matches well enough.

name: Vesper Bat Blade
description: A blade that harnesses the power of the Vesper Bat. Sink your fangs into this beautifully-crafted sliver blade!

name: Vestal Gold Blade
description: A blade of thorns, gilded in gold from a bygone era. They came to Doomwood before darkness fell, and tried to plant its blood in pure soil.

name: Vhall's Violence
description: As a Legionnaire himself, Vhall had a personal weapon given by Dage at some point of time. His evolution gave his sword a new look, with newfound powers as well.

name: Vibrant Scimitar of Zal
description: It is said the oracles of the Djinn Realm can not only SEE into the future, but can also manipulate it. If that is true… do we really control our own fates? It MUST be a rumor.

name: Victor's Glory Blade
description: To the Victor with the Glory Blade goes the spoils!

name: Vindicated Dawn Blade
description: What transpired in the Dawn Sanctum left a lasting impression on the Hollowborn. Even their blades began to glow with the light of the Midnight Sun.

name: Vindication of the Lost
description: Let this blade serve as the hand of those who have been wronged. Let it serve as the scales that judge those who have wronged. Let it serve as the Vindication of the Lost.

name: Vindicator Assassin Dirk
description: The Assassin's tools of trade are opulently forged with gold, partly to hide Gramiel's distaste for his cloak and dagger followers. He believes their trade to be shameful, but necessary for his goals.

name: Vindicator Naval's Claymore (Sword) (0 AC)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed against you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRS!

name: Vindicator Naval's Claymore (Sword) (AC)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed againts you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRS!

name: Vindicator Naval's XL Claymore (0 AC)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed against you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRS!

name: Vindicator Naval's XL Claymore (AC)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed against you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRS!

name: Vindicator Of They Blade
description: Wield this in defense of those who might be giants, those who live in fear, and those who need a Hero, wherever they may be!

name: Violet Shades of Destruction
description: Have you seen the spikes on this thing? Mother Nature doesn't mess around.

name: Viper Venom Knife
description: It's called a venomous knife, but the snake wrapped around the blade is actually electrified to stun your opponents. It just seems like the effects of venom.

name: Viral Caladbolg
description: Forged in fire and bathed in blood, this blade will rip the rope hope, determination, and price pride out of any wielding it… unless you become its master! Speak to Dage in the Underworld to begin its quests.

name: Viridian Twist Sword
description: There's knot-thing dull about this blade's edge! Happy Lucky Day!

name: Virtue
description: A blade comprised of pure energy… the kind used to create worlds. Let this monstrosity slice your foes out of time and space, essentially erasing all it comes in contact with.

name: Virtuous Epiphaneia
description: Once a single blade, the Epiphaneia was split into two identical twins by Chaotic forces. This blade radiates pure goodness and virtue.

name: Visionary Betrayal Blade
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to harvest the eyes of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Vital Bloodletter of Nulgath
description: Your thirst for bloodshed has been quenched. But there's always room for seconds… and thirds… and more…!

name: Vivid Rosales Blade
description: A thorny rose, plucked from the grave of a lover, grows into the shape of a deadly blade. In the chaos of battle, dye its undyng passion red.

name: Vladic Knight's Blade
description: A recreation of the sword wielded by Piotr Darkspyre's champion, the Vladic Knight, from the Lore of MechQuest. This blade will be your undoing.

name: Voice from the Darkness
description: All you will see is darkness, but all you will hear are their cries and screams!

name: Void Advocatus Blade
description: Even having tiny fragments of a Fiend Shard hammered into a blade can elevate a member of the Nation's might. They come harrowingly close to the Archfiend's level.

name: Void Arsenal Ripper Blade
description: The weapons of a Voidseeker's arsenal can only be wielded by Fiends. If a mortal touches them, their skin will scream and peel back. They could claim more heads by just leaving these blades out in the open.

name: Void Awakening Blade (AC)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Void Awakening Blade (Special)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Void Beetle General Machete
description: The blades of the Void Beetle move fast. Before the enemy knows it, they have already been diced and devoured.

name: Void Beetle Warlord Blade
description: The blades of the Void Beetle move fast. Before the enemy knows it, they have already been diced and devoured.

name: Void Betrayer Dagger
description: Nameless traitors mean little to Nulgath. Only lost potential incites his rage. It's his loyalists that relentlessly hunt for the skins of the betrayers, seeking to carve them with their stolen knives.

name: Void Betrayer Sword
description: The blade of a nameless betrayer. Every time a Nation Minion turns traitor, a voice cackles. It doesn't belong to Nulgath. These slights are merely needles stabbed into his back.

name: Void Blade of Vokun
description: As the Lord of the Forgotten Tombs, Vokun needed a mammoth blade to protect its great treasures and fabled magic. Not many have lived to tell the tale of the Void Blade… so allow its legacy live on!

name: Void Champion Sword
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword hold power beyond compare.

name: Void Chronomancer's Menace
description: The fate found at the end of this blade's teeth is an eternity as shreds of your former self, falling forever through the void.

name: Void Commander Sword (0 AC)
description: The blade has a mind of it's own, and will devour those unworthy to wield it. Such is the way of the Nation - to eat the weak.

name: Void Commander Sword (AC)
description: The blade has a mind of it's own, and will devour those unworthy to wield it. Such is the way of the Nation - to eat the weak.

name: Void Decimation Blade (0 AC)
description: When a Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, proving themselves unworthy, their successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Void Decimation Blade (AC)
description: When a Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, proving themselves unworthy, their successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Void Destruction Blade
description: Do you wish you could summon clouds of shadows to hide in and ambush your foes? With this fiendish blade, now you can.

name: Void Draconian Blade
description: A prize from the fiendish Void Draconian.

name: Void Dragonfang Blade
description: A brutal sword that was formed from tainted amethysts by one of the lead cultists-voted to Tyrath. Although pure darkness can be used by either good or evil, the cultist desired to cleave the light in two, transforming this sword into a dangerous thorn to his targets.

name: Void Edge Slicer
description: Forged from processed Void Crystal, this blade will slice through flesh and bone, and then taint the soul left behind!

name: Void Executioner
description: A weapon forged from the depths of the Ynnungaap. Use it to bring forth judgement on those unfit to live.

name: Void GateKeeper's Blade (0 AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper's Blade (AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper's Edge (0 AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper's Edge (AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper's Runed Blade (0 AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper's Runed Blade (AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void General Blade
description: The Void General - some of Nulgath's most trusted allies. Or are they…

name: Void General Greatsword
description: The Void General - some of Nulgath's most trusted allies. Or are they…

name: Void Jolly Roger Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water - and these ones can traverse the Void! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Void Jolly Roger Cutlass (AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water - and these ones can traverse the Void! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Void Jolly Roger Rapier (0 AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water - and these ones can traverse the Void! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Void Jolly Roger Rapier (AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water - and these ones can traverse the Void! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Void Khopesh
description: A weapon Nythera crafted with magic, and the materials she found in her travels through the Void. The khopesh feels alive, but the half-dragon says you'll get used to it.

name: Void Knight's Blade (1)
description: The components of that hilt look suspiciously… bone-colored?!

name: Void Knight's Blade (2)
description: The blade of the void has become your weapon!

name: Void Paladin Katana
description: The bursts of electricity that spiral down the blade will deliver a "shocking" blow to the foolish who dare challenge you.

name: Void Paladin Slayer Blade (0 AC)
description: AHAHAHAHA! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT YOU WHILE YOU WIELD THE POWER OF THE ARCHFIEND!

name: Void Paladin Slayer Blade (AC)
description: AHAHAHAHA! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT YOU WHILE YOU WIELD THE POWER OF THE ARCHFIEND!

name: Void Paladin Slayer Sword (0 AC)
description: AHAHAHAHA! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT YOU WHILE YOU WIELD THE POWER OF THE ARCHFIEND!

name: Void Paladin Slayer Sword (AC)
description: AHAHAHAHA! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT YOU WHILE YOU WIELD THE POWER OF THE ARCHFIEND!

name: Void Piercer Blade
description: A common blade wielded with an iron grip by void elementals that took up soul reaping as a small hobby.

name: Void Pirate Destroyer's Blade
description: Void Pirate Destroyers only have one goal: to find and slay the Void Pirates that sail wherever darkness reigns.

name: Void Pirate's Cutlass
description: Whether they said the Black Seas or the rivers of dark blood flowing through the underworld, the Void Pirates are feared by all.

name: Void Rebirth Blade (Sword) (AC)
description: Witness the rebirth of the Void!

name: Void Rebirth Blade (Sword) (Special)
description: Witness the rebirth of the Void!

name: Void Recruit's Sword
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend calls only the strongest to serve him. To become a recruit, one must be among Lore's greatest, most evil heroes.

name: Void's Arsenal Blade (0 AC)
description: The weapons of a Voidseeker's arsenal can only be wielded by Fiends. If a mortal touches them, their skin will scream and peel back. They could claim more heads by just leaving these blades out in the open.

name: Void's Arsenal Blade (AC)
description: The weapons of a Voidseeker's arsenal can only be wielded by Fiends. If a mortal touches them, their skin will scream and peel back. They could claim more heads by just leaving these blades out in the open.

name: Void's Arsenal Nodachi (0 AC)
description: The weapons of a Voidseeker's arsenal can only be wielded by Fiends. If a mortal touches them, their skin will scream and peel back. They could claim more heads by just leaving these blades out in the open.

name: Void's Arsenal Nodachi (AC)
description: The weapons of a Voidseeker's arsenal can only be wielded by Fiends. If a mortal touches them, their skin will scream and peel back. They could claim more heads by just leaving these blades out in the open.

name: Void's Bile Sword
description: When an unworthy Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, its successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Void Shogun Katana
description: The simple weapon of a ruthless Void Shogun.

name: Void Spartan Blade
description: Long ago, there was an ancient civilization with fearsome warriors. A single warrior from their army could wipe out a group of elite assassins alone. Now twisted from their original purpose, they serve Nulgath with a fervor rarely seen in Lore.

name: Void Vampire Guard's Blade
description: Vampires from the depths of the Void, these guards will be sure to keep everyone safe. Riiiight.

name: Void Vigilante Blade
description: This armor was crafted from a fusion of Void energy from the AdventureQuest timeline and combined with magic Dage imbues into the gear he crafts for the Undead Legion. The dark horror will terrify your opponents, filling with with an otherworldly dread.

name: Void Walker Katana
description: To travel between the Void and the real world isn't easy. The Void is filled with treacherous being awaiting prey.

name: Void Walker Sword (AC)
description: To travel between the Void and the real world isn't easy. The Void is filled with treacherous beings awaiting prey.

name: Void Walker Sword (Legend)
description: To travel between the Void and the real world isn't easy. The Void is filled with treacherous beings awaiting prey.

name: Void Warlock Overfiend Blade
description: Powerful fiend's of magic, nothing will stop these Warlock's from helping their Archfiend conquer his foes.

name: VoidCaster Claymore
description: Enhanced by Nulgath, this blade holds the power to slice through any rifts opened on this dimension. For that reason, it is often used to slay rogue VoidCasters still using Nulgath's magic.

name: Voidfiend Symbiote Sword (0 AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: Voidfiend Symbiote Sword (AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: Voidfire Blade (0 AC)
description: A piece of molten earth ripped from the Voidfire themselves, forged into a fiery weapon by their master.

name: Voidfire Blade (AC)
description: A piece of molten earth ripped from the Voidfire themselves, forged into a fiery weapon by their master.

name: VoidPirate Captain Cutlass
description: Ye be truly a gentlemen o' fortune with this fine blade.

name: Voidsplinter Crystal
description: Bearing crystallized bits of the Void itself (the same material the Heart of the Void is made of), this weapon courses with dark energy!

name: Vok, the Tundra Blade
description: A blade so old that none remember the tale of it's forging. Vok has a presence all of it's own, neither good, evil, or chaotic. Just very, very cold.

name: Volcanic Fire Sword
description: Fighting fire with fire would be an issue if Dwarven handles weren't built to survive the sun. Your opponent's face has nowhere near that resistance, so this sword will do a great job of burning that.

name: Voltaic Dynami Sword
description: Slashes from a variety of directions.

name: Voltaire's Rapier
description: Such dark energy this weapon has.

name: Vordred's Blade
description: URGE TO SLAY PALADINS, RISING!

name: Vordred's DOOM Blade
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS. (CC to Base and Accessory)

name: Vordred's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Vordred the PaladinSlayer, an iconic and evil character that first appeared in AdventureQuest Worlds' Doomwood Saga. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Vordred's Sword
description: AHAHAHAHA! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT YOU WHILE YOU WIELD THIS BLADE OF MASSIVE DESTRUCTION!

name: Vorpal Plasma Blade
description: This sword emits an energy beam that could rival the power of a mini supernova.

name: Vorpal Sword
description: An ancient weapon from a long time ago. Made with such skill that the blade still holds its edge!

name: Vorpal Turbine Blade
description: The wing spins this sword's turbines to make sure you have extra power in battle!

name: Vow of Stalagbite
description: The breath of the dragon molted into a sword.

name: Vulcan's Might
description: Liquid hot magma flows freely within this massive blade, incinerating anything unfortunate enough to be on the receiving end. Legend says that this sword once belonged to the almighty deity of fire, Vulcan.

name: Wanderer's Sheathed Katana
description: The ronin which wander through tercessuinotlim were cast out by their former masters. They have not sworn allegiance to Nulgath, but choose to slay the creatures who oppose him. Their creed is: "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."

name: Wanderer's Void Katana
description: The ronin which wander through tercessuinotlim were cast out by their former masters. They have not sworn allegiance to Nulgath, but choose to slay the creatures who oppose him. Their creed is: "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."

name: Wandering Onryo Blade
description: The Wandering Onryo may have been sent by Malgor, but you now have their gear!

name: War Blade of Courage
description: The battlefield is where your courage is put to the test. Everyone dreams of making history but few are willing to die for it. The light of their courage will shine through this blade, tempered and sharpened by hardship.

name: War Blade of Power
description: Dreams and ideals will disappear into thin air if nothing is done about them. The Blade of Power are bestowed upon those willing to do anything to see their wishes come true., but only if it brings Lore to the next age.

name: War Blade of Speed
description: Dreams and ideals will disappear into thin air if nothing is done about them. The Blade of Speed is bestowed upon those who understand the urgency of taking action.

name: War Blade of Strength
description: Dreams and ideals will disappear into thin air if nothing is done about them. The Blade of Strength is bestowed upon those who have the strength to make their wishes reality, but only if it brings Lore to the next age.

name: War Blade of Wisdom
description: Dreams and ideals will disappear into thin air if nothing is done about them. The victor of a war is not decided on strength alone. Time, intellect, and experience are factors the worthy take into account, and honor is a luxury.

name: War Bringer
description: Spiky, metallic death on a stick! Space warriors around the universe favor this spiked blade.

name: War Cultist Blade (AC)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: War Cultist Blade (Special)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: War's Glory Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Even on the open seas, the fires of war burn. They smoulder, and die. The Horseman of War takes the banners of the fallen, and flies them on his own blade to honor the glory of battle.

name: War's Glory Cutlass (AC)
description: Even on the open seas, the fires of war burn. They smoulder, and die. The Horseman of War takes the banners of the fallen, and flies them on his own blade to honor the glory of battle.

name: War's Ironblood Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Intrigued by how the warriors of land and ocean differ in their weapons of choice, the Horseman of War had special blades forged for himself. This cutlass is part of the set he takes into battles at sea.

name: War's Ironblood Cutlass (AC)
description: Intrigued by how the warriors of land and ocean differ in their weapons of choice, the Horseman of War had special blades forged for himself. This cutlass is part of the set he takes into battles at sea.

name: Warden of Light's Blade
description: The blades of the wardens are the reason why darkness flees from the light. Bear witness and applaud.

name: WardKeeper's Blade
description: This magnetic sword is capable of drawing power from the sun when it is at its highest during the day and can store a great deal of its energy for a long period of time, allowing its user to endure long-lasting nights.

name: WardKeeper's Double-edged Blade
description: This magnetic polearm is capable of drawing power from the moon when it is at its highest during the night and can store a great deal of its energy for a long period of time, allowing its user to endure long-lasting days.

name: Warforged Endbringer
description: War has no mercy. Fire burns flesh, and the masses will dream of blades until knives sprout from their skulls. In another time and space, the gods allowed this. They watched War leave Death's palm.

name: WarFury Elite's Blade
description: As you rise through the ranks of the Warfury your armor reflects your rank.

name: WarFury Soldier's Blade
description: Standard gear of the Warfury soldiers. Fully protective, just not very fancy.

name: Wargoth's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Wargoth, a powerful Infernal, who originally appeared in DragonFable. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Warlic's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Warlic, the Blue Mage. His magic does not work like a normal mage's does. Those who know his secret consider him to be Lore's most powerful wizard.

name: Warlock's Mystic Sigil Blade
description: Tap into the darkness that flows through the Underworld to enhance your power and become one of Lore's most powerful magic users!

name: Warlord of Nulgath Blade
description: A fiendish blade with a hunger for war as deep as the Fiend God's Void. Only a Nation fanatic could have created such a savage masterpiece, born from blood, fangs, and talons.

name: Warlord's Blood Blade
description: *No description*

name: Warmonger's DOOMBLADE
description: Special weapon crafted for <player's name hidden>. Thanks for coming to hang out with us at PariahCon 2011!

name: WarpForce Black Beamsword
description: A black elemental energy weapon used in AdventureQuest WarpForce.

name: WarpForce Blue Beamsword
description: A blue elemental energy weapon used in AdventureQuest WarpForce.

name: Warpforce Cyber Sword (0 AC)
description: A black elemental energy weapon used in AdventureQuest WarpForce

name: Warpforce Cyber Sword (AC)
description: A black elemental energy weapon used in AdventureQuest WarpForce

name: WarpForce Green Beamsword
description: A green elemental energy weapon used in AdventureQuest WarpForce.

name: WarpForce Red Beamsword
description: A red elemental energy weapon used in AdventureQuest WarpForce.

name: WarpForce Yellow Beamsword
description: A yellow elemental energy weapon used in AdventureQuest WarpForce.

name: Warrior Claymore Blade
description: Truly great swordsmen have used this sword.

name: Warrior of Time's Blade
description: Said to be forged from the tempered scales of the Eternal Sovereign. Frankly, it hurt to pick off scales, but it was interesting to see how enchanted fire cooled their green into a shade of sharp, cold blue.

name: Warrior's Golden Blade
description: Your victories in battle honor your homeland and your ancestors. Happy Independence Day!

name: Warrior's Sword
description: A sword enhanced to improve a warrior's power!

name: WarSeeker's Blade (AC)
description: The war cry for these crusading Legionnaires is "For power! For combat! For Dage!"

name: WarSeeker's Blade (Special)
description: The war cry for these crusading Legionnaires is "For power! For combat! For Dage!"

name: Wasabi Root Blade
description: Ever wonder where that spicy green mustard comes from? Super effective against Sushi-based monsters and hungry tummies.

name: Water Blade
description: A hunk of slate transformed into a blade by water torrents. Make your enemies yell: "H2-NOOOO!"

name: Water Draconian Sword
description: Draconian sword of Water.

name: Water Weaver Sword
description: A weapon crafted by a special sect of weavers. They received some sort of gift from Hyonix to make this sword. She tore it out of herself, no longer needing such a thing…or deserving it.

name: Waterborn Blade of Awe
description: A watery version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will help keep you hydrated even in the middle of a desert. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: Wave Cutter
description: This blade is usually wielded by the commanding fishman generals. The sword embodies the the power of the ocean itself.

name: Wave of Despair (0 AC)
description: A Dark Caster waded through the Acheron River to find suffering souls. With fell arts, they dragged terrifying memories to the surface, and solidified them into a woeful blade.

name: Wave of Despair (AC)
description: A Dark Caster waded through the Acheron River to find suffering souls. With fell arts, they dragged terrifying memories to the surface, and solidified them into a woeful blade.

name: Wave of Virility
description: Chiseled from the very waves that pound the seashores, this blade will smite anyone you point it at. Though it is heavy, it is not a burden for the greatest of warriors.

name: Wayang Artix
description: Once upon a time, there was a tough paladin in Lore. Adventure and undead slaying are his hobby!

name: Wayang Gravelyn
description: Ahh, the lovely daughter of Sepulchure. Stunning, even in puppet form!

name: Wayang Kala
description: Guaranteed to give you nightmare, even in leather puppet form!

name: Weaponized Dark Shard
description: Forged by a piece of Dage's soul.

name: Webbed Blade
description: Several emptied spiders later, the Webbed Blade was completed.

name: Werebear Sword
description: A though and sturdy weapon to fight off intruders.

name: Werejaguar's Defense
description: Unique crystals found only within the Werejaguar territory festoon this ancient blade.

name: Werepyre Devotee's Cutlass
description: A dangerous silver blade that a Werepyre shouldn't be swinging around willy-nilly. They're twice as weak to this metal, but risk it to terrorize their pureblooded kin. Accidents happen often, but scars give character.

name: Werepyre Slayer Sword
description: When sterling silver blades just aren't enough… enhance them with the element of garlic! A super rare blade only suitable for fearless heroes.

name: Werepyre Warrior Blade
description: When your back and bite just aren't good enough.

name: Werewolves Bane
description: The younger brother to the Massive Werewolves Bane. This blade features engravings crudely carved into the blade itself by adolescent pack members.

name: Westion Commander's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Westion Commander's Cutlass (AC)
description: ﻿﻿Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Westion Sailor's Delight (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space. (random art on equip)

name: Westion Sailor's Delight (AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space. (random art on equip)

name: Whirlwind of Pain
description: Even as its grace hold people captive, watching it spin and turn, the whirlwind is a still killer. It picks up everything in its path and scatters it like chaff in the wind. Grasp this sword tightly, lest you get flung to the four corners of the world.

name: Whisper of Autumn
description: The sword was discovered when a druid tugged on the root of an ancient tree. They left as quick as they could, knowing that the tree was a dormant Spirit of Autumn.

name: Whisper of the Conquerer
description: Whispers follow the arc of every attack, every cut of the sword. These whispers are carried on the winds of the four corners of the world, bringing to the wielder the secrets of defeating the enemy.

name: Whisper of the Moon
description: Harnessing the silent but deadly power of the moon, this sword was forged to guide you through those cold dark nights on the battlefield.

name: White Dragon Scimitar (0 AC)
description: Just because pirates are known as pillagers and scallywags doesn't mean they dunna be wantin' to look fancy every now and again.

name: White Dragon Scimitar (AC)
description: Just because pirates are known as pillagers and scallywags doesn't mean they dunna be wantin' to look fancy every now and again.

name: White Dragon Star Sword
description: This specially crafted Star Sword was designed and built for the AQW's 9th Upholders on the game's ninth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Wicked Duality Pirate Blade (0 AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Wicked Duality Pirate Blade (AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Wicked Edged Slicer
description: Despite the fearsome name, it is wielded to protect a temple deep in a sacred ravine. Upon hearing of another temple that holds great meaning, the Trolls and H'orcs were eager to give this blade as a gift.

name: Wicked Epiphaneia
description: Once a single blade, the Epiphaneia was split into two identical twins by Chaotic forces. This is the version of the blade infused with pure Evil.

name: WickeDDD Joke Blade
description: *Insert funny joke here*

name: Wild Huntress' Blade
description: You must have really impressed Huntress Valais for her to give you her sword!

name: Wild Huntress' Sword
description: You must have really impressed Huntress Valais for her to give you her sword!

name: Willbreaker Blade
description: A blade that made up for the holes in its master's heart with splattered blood and cold cruelty. It almost brought an end to the magic of Lore, and momentarily garnered a glance from the gods.

name: Wind Blade
description: A hunk of granite elegantly carved from unyielding wind currents. Here's your chance to fight back and break wind!

name: Wind of Chaos
description: *No description*

name: Windborn Blade of Awe
description: A wind version of the Blade of Awe. This blade will keep the air moving around you at all times. (Crafted by the request of legendary Hero, EthanObi_AE)

name: WindWalker's Parang Blade
description: The WindWalkers are a sect of Warrior-Mages that defend and protect the people of Nusantara. They are sworn to serve Garuda the Bird King, and will do anything to keep their home safe.

name: Wing of the Frost Griffin
description: A treasured blade of the Frozen Northlands modeled after the sharp, dagger-like wings of the mysterious Frost Griffin.

name: Winged RunixBreaker Blade
description: The first Chaos Lord has evolved… and granted you the gift of his newest form!

name: Wings of Flame
description: Guided by the ethereal flames of doom, this sword harnesses the power of the flame that is in all of us. Once yours is ignited, no enemy will be able to escape your white hot anger.

name: Winter Assassin Katana
description: *No description*

name: Winter Assassin Ninjato
description: *No description*

name: Winter Legion Warrior Sword (Sword)
description: The Winter Legion Warriors are renowned for battling through the darkest night and harshest blizzards. They are so dedicated, they will keep fighting beyond life itself. Those are the most desirable soldiers for the Legion to recruit.

name: Winter's Bitter Edge
description: *No description*

name: Winter's Dirge
description: A replica of the dark ages' cold hands. Winter plucked the old and the sick from loving embraces. Even the highest castle and the warmest hearth can't keep out the cold when nature demands death. Men propose. The Gods dispose.

name: Winterror
description: Unleash the chilling terror of Winter year round!

name: Wolf's Honor Rapier (0 AC)
description: Lycans aren't known for their sophistication, but they uphold heirarchy and trial by first blood. This rapier came from the past life of a Werewolf who embraced the honor of beasts.

name: Wolf's Honor Rapier (AC)
description: Lycans aren't known for their sophistication, but they uphold heirarchy and trial by first blood. This rapier came from the past life of a Werewolf who embraced the honor of beasts.

name: Wolf Warrior Blade
description: A sleek, stylish sword used by the Lycan knights. The silver blade is a danger to its wielder, if they themselves are Lycans too.

name: Wolfwing's Star Sword
description: The fifth Chaos Lord to rise was Wolfwing. You can feel what is left of his bitter rage and power pulsing through this Star Sword.

name: Wonderland Hare's Harmony (0 AC)
description: You're going to be late for a wonderful tea party, and that won't do! Not at all! If people keep insisting on keeping you from respecting promises, you'll have to force the matter! (0 AC version permanently drops from Twilly's Treasure Chest.)

name: Wonderland Hare's Harmony (AC)
description: You're going to be late for a wonderful tea party, and that won't do! Not at all! If people keep insisting on keeping you from respecting promises, you'll have to force the matter!

name: Wooden Chainsaw
description: Nothing shows your love for the earth like a chainsaw made from a fallen treant.

name: Wooden Doomblade
description: Gravelyn's own practice Doomblade!

name: Wooden Saw
description: Turn your opponents into sawdust with this naturally carved and unnaturally brutal wooden saw!

name: World's Core Blade (0 AC)
description: The origin of all magic, the cores of several worlds fused into one, have been condensed into a blade that can end time. This is a theoretical idea meant for a moment when there's nothing left to lose.

name: World's Core Blade (AC)
description: The origin of all magic, the cores of several worlds fused into one, have been condensed into a blade that can end time. This is a theoretical idea meant for a moment when there's nothing left to lose.

name: World Sealer
description: Quibble hastily mentions something about World.. fighters.. captains or was it pirates? All you know is Quibble wants to get rid of it fast so is willing to sell it for a bargain.

name: Worldbreaker's Blade
description: Kin to Kezeroth the World Ender, Thorezek the World-Breaker knows that where his cousin and Quetzal failed… HE will succeed. When he is through, nothing and no one will be left standing.

name: Worshipper Key of Nulgath
description: The Evolved Worshippers of Nulgath aspire to become fiends in Nulgath's service. They will do his bidding, even though they will always remain… just human.

name: Woven Iron Blade of the North
description: The earliest swords in the far Northlands were made of pure iron. This blade contains iron, but woven in with other metals, and tempered by fire to make it stronger.

name: Wraith Of Darkness Blade
description: From the darkness you came, and to the darkness you shall return. For the Longest Night approaches, and the undead roam the streets of Mystcroft.

name: Wraith's Cursed Blade
description: Those that hide their food from the Primal Wraith face it's fury. The gagger transfers the guilty party's soul into itself and leaves the body as a hollow shell of itself.

name: WraithSlayer Blade
description: Those who hunt the elusive dullahan must be cunning, quick, and brave. And be swift with a blade.

name: Wrapped Blade
description: That gift box might be possessed, but it still holds a lot of awesome loot! Happy Frostval!

name: Wrapping Paper Sword
description: This sword was crafted from all the leftover wrapping paper. Very resourceful and effective! A present given on AQW's 1st Birthday!

name: Wrath of Nulgath
description: A blade blazing with Nulgath's power, this weapon WOULD damage you instead of your foe, but Nulgath has given you his approval.

name: Wrath of Nulgath E
description: The ArchFiend would be pleased at the effort you had to expend to obtain this blade. Use it well in his service. (changes in combat)

name: Wrath of Nulgath P
description: The ArchFiend would be pleased at the effort you had to expend to obtain this blade. Use it well in his service. (changes in combat)

name: Wrath of the Legion Blade
description: Forged from stone in the Underworld this sword is nearly unbreakable.

name: Wrathful Void Blade
description: Entirely made from the mangled body of a fellow Wrath Void Fiend. Even when they're defeated, their Master's rage prevents them from succumbing to death. They will continue to have use in this form.

name: Wretched Blade of the Underworld
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Wretched Blade of the Void
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Wretched Dark Demise
description: If the DragonPlane Guardians revere their Draconic kin so much, why do they carry tainted Dragonslayer weapons? In truth, they idolize the unstoppable force of nature that is death over anything else.

name: WroughtIron Glass Blade
description: Cut your opponents with this blade… and if it shatters cut'em with the shards!

name: WyrmHunter's Claymore
description: You've proven to Zoshi how awesome you are. Here is your reward. No monster in Lore stands a chance against you now with this sword.

name: Wyvern's Edge
description: Green as venom, sharp as vengeance. Favored by those who never miss their mark.

name: Xan's Star Sword
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's 14th Upholders. It was inspired by Xan, the iconic Pyromancer, who originally appeared in DragonFable. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Xi Qi's Claymore
description: Fight your enemies with more happiness this Yokai New Year.

name: Xiang's Star Sword
description: The second Chaos Lord to rise was Xiang. You can feel what is left of her mad power pulsing through this Star Sword… or… can you? Can you really? Or is that just an echo of an alternate reality that is still being written? *giggle* O_O

name: Xitactix Blade
description: Used by the Sr'eddit race on the planet Xitaxtix, it is razor sharp and poisoned. Take care when wielding it!

name: xXGothicXx Cutlass (0 AC)
description: What a better way to celebrate TLAPD then donning this swag inspired by Voltaire.

name: xXGothicXx Cutlass (AC)
description: What a better way to celebrate TLAPD then donning this swag inspired by Voltaire.

name: Yami no Akuma Blade
description: Driven by the dark, these warriors seek to extinguish all good in the world.

name: Yami no Ronin Blade
description: While others /partied, you studied the blade. While others were training their reputation, you mastered the art of unsheathing and striking. While others wasted their days being AFK in Yulgar, you cultivated inner strength. Now that the world is set aflame and the fiends are at the gates, only you have the power to cut through shadow as if it were steel.

name: Yami no Ronin Katana
description: An amalgation of ancient secrets and modern innovations, you forged this blade under the tutelage of Dage the Evil himself. Use it wisely, for it was forged from your own will (and also soul metal, but mostly your will). This weapon deals 15% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more class points, XP, gold, and rep when equipped.

name: Yara's Sword
description: You deserve the sword of a Paladin. It took you quite some time to obtain this weapon!

name: Yeti Soul Crusher Blade (0 AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Hunters work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yeti Soul Crusher Blade (AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Hunters work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yokai Energy Sword
description: A variation on an energy sword found on Planet Yokai in the Lore of MechQuest's timeline.

name: Yokai Oni's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Oni's Cutlass (AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Oni's Guardian Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Oni's Guardian Cutlass (AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Oni's Mystical Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Oni's Mystical Cutlass (AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Summoner Katana
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Yokai Summoner Kris
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Young Empress' Blade
description: As she grew in both the Shadow and the Light - and became Empress in truth - Empress Gravelyn's weapons became more powerful.

name: Your Last Rights
description: This is a gift from the legendary Paladin, Paladin Gan. You are one of the few he has entrusted with his sword. Wield it with pride! He only asks you to give foes their last rights before the final blow.

name: ZARDIS Key
description: Fishsticks and custard are NOT wedding reception food, but they ARE served inside the ZARDIS, so make sure you've got your key!

name: Zay_M8's Gift Caladbolg
description: Congratulations! Your friend Zay_M8 won a custom weapon for upgrading in February 2017 and has decided to share his prize with you! You are only of only 11 people to have this art.

name: Zealous Claymore
description: Warriors for Good in the time of Stellaria, these Paladins went fearlessly into battle against the Cryptborg's forces of NecroDrones and NecroMechs. There… they met their fate. Do not let their sacrifice be in vain!

name: Zelkur's Dirk
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Zenobia's BerryStain Blade
description: You roam the Black Labryinth, harvesting the bodies of fallen creatures for any loot you can find. This blade, made of petrified moglinberry juice, won't earn you much gold. But it WILL come in handy during battle.

name: Zenobia's BerryStain Dagger
description: You roam the Black Labryinth, harvesting the bodies of fallen creatures for any loot you can find. This blade, made of petrified moglinberry juice, won't earn you much gold. But it WILL come in handy during battle.

name: ZeoKnight Blade
description: With a viridian vision before his eyes, ZeoKnight put metal to anvil and crafted an awesome emerald sword which will see you through the hardest battles and darkest nights!

name: Zhongchéng's Katana
description: Those born in the Year of the Dog are considered good natured, loyal and ready to help others!

name: Zhoom's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Zhoom, Ranger of the Sandsea, silent stalker of the dunes. He could kill you seven times over before you hit the ground, but wouldn't… unless someone VERY wealthy paid his price.

name: Zhu Ronin Cleaver
description: A ronin is a samurai with no master but these follow the ancient ways of the Zhu.

name: Zhu Ronin Kanabo
description: A ronin is a samurai with no master but these follow the ancient ways of the Zhu.

name: Zombie Voodoo Greatsword
description: It was a shame to let all of those Carnaval zombies go to waste, so we made some weapons out of 'em!

name: Zombie Whackers
description: Whack 'em in the head and they'll stay dead! Until they respawn. And then whack 'em again!

name: Zorbak's Star Sword
description: Crafted in honor of Zorbak, the 100% Ebil Necromancer Moglin. This Star Sword's blade shines with energy he's harvested from the many baby dragons he's slain. JUST KIDDING! Mehehehe. (… Maybe. O_O)

name: Zorbak's VordredSlayer
description: MEHEHE! He wants more skulls? I'LL GIVE HIM SKULLS. TO THE FACE.

name: Zorbak's Voyager Space Saber (0 AC)
description: In space, no one can hear you MEHEHEHE!

name: Zorbak's Voyager Space Saber (AC)
description: In space, no one can hear you MEHEHEHE!

name: Zurvana's Pity (Sword)
description: The gears of time have been set in motion. What will the future bring for you? (This item was originally released in DragonFable and has been imported to AQWorlds to celebrate Artix Entertainment's 20th anniversary!)

name: Zurvana's Wrath (Sword)
description: The gears of time have been set in motion. What will the future bring for you? (This item was originally released in DragonFable and has been imported to AQWorlds to celebrate Artix Entertainment's 20th anniversary!)
